jobs.title: Emergency Credentialed Veterinary Technician (Part Time) - Maple Grove, MN
jobs.description:
ABOUT VEG

In 2014, VEG was born with a mission to help people and their pets when they need it most. This meant challenging the status quo and fixing everything that was wrong with the ER experience. Since then, we’ve expanded rapidly, with hospitals nationwide open 24/7, 365 days a year, and created a better emergency experience—not only for people and their pets, but also for everyone who works here—our VEGgies!

At VEG we find a way to say yes to the career you want in veterinary emergency medicine. This means transforming how ER works, from our open-concept hospitals, where you can handle emergency cases of every kind (even exotics!) to our immersive, customer-focused experience, which helps us give people and their pets the care they deserve.

This also means saying yes to creating the greatest experience possible for our VEGgies. Yes to working in an environment where you can find your place and feel valued for the amazing work you do. Yes to having unparalleled opportunities for learning and mentorship so you can grow where you want to go in your career. And yes to making an impact here in ways you never thought possible.

VEG is a 2025 and 2026 certified Great Place to Work®.

THE JOB

As a part-time Emergency Credentialed Veterinary Technician, you’re part of a team that thrives on the front lines of emergency veterinary care where every second counts. You’ll handle a wide range of cases, from minor to complex emergencies, collaborating with our doctors and team in delivering gold standard, emotionally intelligent care. You’ll jump into triage, treatments, diagnostics, anesthesia, monitoring, and critical care nursing, all while being a steady, compassionate presence for pet parents in their most stressful moments. This role is for someone who wants to do the work they were trained to do (and more), continue growing their skills, and help people and their pets when they need it most.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

• Treat every patient and person like they matter—because they do! You keep people and pets together and stay by their side through tests, treatments, and everything in between

• Jump into action, delivering nursing care, treatments, and emotional support in the most critical moments, from first triage to discharge

• Bring the meds, the monitoring, the mastery—from IVs and CRIs to blood transfusions and beyond

• Communicate like a teammate and think like a leader, helping shape plans and keep care flowing

• Be ready to perform CPR like the trained RECOVER rockstar you are (not only do we offer training, we have the highest number of RECOVER CPR professionals and instructors in the industry!)

• All the techy stuff—from diagnostics and imaging to sample collection and placing tubes

• Anesthesia, even for our most fragile patients? You’ve got it.

• Use all the advanced techniques in your toolkit: central lines, endoscopy, ultrasounds, and more

WHAT YOU NEED

• High school diploma or equivalent required; associate’s degree or higher in veterinary technology from an AVMA accredited program strongly preferred

• Credentialed as a veterinary technician (CVT, RVT, LVT, LVMT) in the state the VEG practice is located is required; VTS in ECC, internal medicine or anesthesia/analgesia is a plus and will lead to extra considerations in compensation.

• 1+ years of experience in a veterinary technician role; experience in emergency or specialty medicine preferred

• Basic computer skills and a comprehension of practice management software and electronic medical record keeping

• Excellent communicator and calm under pressure; ready to lend a hand to support those around you

• Fine motor skills for handling patients and medical equipment

• Ability to stand for prolonged hours, kneel, and work on the floor as well as ability to lift up to 25 kg on own and able to support up to 40 kg with assistance

• Must be willing to work in a noisy environment with strong or unpleasant odors.

• Availability to work nights, weekends, and holidays on a rotating or as needed basis based on hospital needs

• Work well in a fast-paced environment with people from all backgrounds and different personality types

WHO YOU ARE

• Empathetic, instinctively taking a people-centric approach, whether supporting your colleagues or making an effort to understand different perspectives

• Have a sense of humility; acknowledging mistakes, sharing credit with others, and lifting up your team’s’ accomplishments

• Feel a strong sense of ownership over your work, taking responsibility for outcomes and staying committed to achieving long-term, impactful results

• Curious by nature; you ask insightful questions and continuously seek out opportunities to learn and grow your skills and knowledge

HOW WE INVEST IN YOU

• Competitive compensation

• A BIG focus on learning and growth from VEG-created clinical and leadership programs to Unlimited ER CE + travel stipend (No really!). Part-time credentialed VEGgies receive a $1,000/year travel stipend. Part-time uncredentialed VEGgies receive a $400/year travel stipend.

• Flexible work schedules to support your life outside of work

• Generous employee referral program, so our awesome people can bring in more awesome people

• And the little (big) things, like comfy scrubs, cool VEG swag, and food in the fridge for when you’re hungry

DEI

At VEG, diversity is not just a word—it's a strength that fuels innovation and kindness. Our mission is “Helping people and their pets when they need it most.” And we do that better when our VEGgies (employees) feel valued, respected, and empowered to bring their authentic selves to work. That's why we're devoted to creating an environment that reflects the diverse communities we serve—where different perspectives are not only welcomed but celebrated.

We are focused on providing equitable opportunities for growth, promoting inclusive decision-making, and ensuring that everyone's perspective is considered. Saying yes to VEG means helping us build a culture where your unique experiences and background contribute to a shared vision: being the world’s veterinary emergency company.

jobs.title: Sr. Staff Engineer, Care (Fullstack/Backend)
jobs.description:
Hims & Hers is the leading health and wellness platform, on a mission to help the world feel great through the power of better health. We are redefining healthcare by putting the customer first and delivering access to care that is affordable, accessible, and personal, from diagnosis to treatment to delivery. No two people are the same, so we provide access to personalized care designed for results. By normalizing health & wellness challenges and innovating on their solutions, we’re making better health outcomes easier to achieve. 



Hims & Hers is a public company, traded on the NYSE under the ticker symbol “HIMS.” To learn more about the brand and offerings, you can visit hims.com/about http://hims.com/about and hims.com/how-it-works http://hims.com/how-it-works . For information on the company’s outstanding benefits, culture, and its talent-first flexible/remote work approach, see below and visit www.hims.com/careers-professionals http://www.hims.com/careers-professionals.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

We are seeking a visionary and technically exceptional Sr. Staff Engineer to lead architectural innovation and strategic technical direction. This individual will operate at the organizational level, shaping the long-term technical landscape, enabling cross-functional execution at scale, and aligning engineering efforts with product and business outcomes.




YOU WILL:

 - Architectural Vision & Strategy
   Define and evolve the architectural vision for customer-facing systems in alignment with business strategy. Lead cross-org initiatives that address long-term scale, system boundaries, and foundational capabilities

 - Technical Leadership & Governance
   Establish patterns and frameworks that ensure quality, resilience, and operational excellence across the organization. Serve as the authority on design decisions and foster alignment across teams

 - Org-Wide Enablement & Collaboration
   Collaborate with engineering and product leadership to shape product direction and ensure our architecture supports strategic goals. Drive org-wide adoption of scalable practices, tools, and development norms

 - Mentorship & Talent Growth
   Mentor senior technical leaders, elevating engineering capabilities across the organization. Champion initiatives that foster talent density, engineering rigor, and a culture of continuous learning

 - Ambiguity Navigation & Execution Acceleration
   Lead through complexity and ambiguity, clarifying direction where ownership is unclear. Remove organizational blockers, simplify decision-making, and accelerate delivery of strategic initiatives

 - Customer-Centric Engineering
   Translate customer needs and product goals into scalable technical solutions. Define principles and patterns that embed customer obsession into our platform’s architecture

 - Sustainability & Scalability
   Design systems and team boundaries to support sustainable growth. Drive investment in non-functional priorities (e.g., observability, migrations, reliability) early in the design process




YOU HAVE:

 - 12+ years of professional software engineering experience, with a strong record of group-level technical leadership.

 - Experience with technologies such as Kotlin, Java or Go, with a deep understanding of system design for scale and performance.

 - Full-stack capability with frontend proficiency in modern frameworks and libraries (React, Next, GraphQL)

 - Experience introducing and scaling shared infrastructure, frameworks, or libraries across multiple teams.

 - Proficiency with CI/CD workflows (e.g., CircleCI, GitHub), cloud infrastructure (AWS, Docker, Kubernetes), and observability tools (e.g., Datadog).

 - Demonstrated ability to drive architectural clarity and strategic technical alignment across functions.

 - Experience translating customer and clinical needs into reliable, maintainable, and high-impact technical solutions.

 - A track record of driving meaningful improvements in developer experience, team velocity, and system sustainability.




YOU’LL THRIVE HERE IF YOU:

 - Create alignment and momentum in ambiguous or complex technical spaces.

 - Balance short-term deliverables with long-term scalability, system health, and customer experience.

 - Lead with curiosity, adaptability, and principled decision-making.

 - Take initiative to address cross-squad blockers, scale constraints, or misaligned priorities before they escalate.

 - Drive consistent, action-oriented execution even without perfect clarity.

 - Mentor senior engineering talent and reinforce a culture of growth, feedback, and high technical standards.

 - Inspire confidence through transparency, humility, and deep technical credibility.

 - Advocate for customers through scalable, resilient design that anticipates clinical complexity and future scale.

 


OUR BENEFITS (THERE ARE MORE BUT HERE ARE SOME HIGHLIGHTS):

 - Competitive salary & equity compensation for full-time roles

 - Unlimited PTO, company holidays, and quarterly mental health days

 - Comprehensive health benefits including medical, dental & vision, and parental leave

 - Employee Stock Purchase Program (ESPP)

 - 401k benefits with employer matching contribution

 - Offsite team retreats



We are committed to building a workforce that reflects diverse perspectives and prioritizes ethics, wellness, and a strong sense of belonging. If you're excited about this role, we encourage you to apply—even if you're not sure if your background or experience is a perfect match.

jobs.title: Vehicle Production Technician
jobs.description:
Ever imagined saying, “I helped launch the future of transportation”?

We’re rewriting the rules of urban mobility. At Vay, customers tap a button and a car arrives - with no one inside - powered by our world-first Remote Driving technology on real public streets.

We’re live in Las Vegas and scaling fast, powered by a strategic investment of up to $410 million from Grab. Our mission is simple: replace private car ownership with a faster, cleaner, door-to-door mobility model. If you want to build something real, visible, and genuinely transformative, you’ll feel right at home here.

What’s happening at Vay

• First to roll out vehicles in both Europe and the USA on public roads without a human being inside & currently the 2nd largest commercial, driverless car fleet in the Western World.

• We've partnered with Kodiak to bring remote-driving technology to autonomous trucks in the US, showcasing our ability to integrate our system into heavy-duty commercial vehicles and expand the applications of our tech across the US.

• We’ve completed over 150,000 trips so far and are busy multiplying our Las Vegas fleet just to meet demand!

• ...And soon we’ll be expanding across the US & Europe 🚀

Why this role is awesome:

As a Production Vehicle Technician at Vay, you'll play a hands-on role in bringing the future of mobility to life. You'll help transform vehicles into remotely operated systems, working with cutting-edge Remote Driving technology as we scale our fleet in Las Vegas.

This isn't your typical technician role. You'll work across mechanical, electrical, and advanced vehicle systems, tackling technical challenges that don't always come with a manual. Working closely with our engineering and operations teams, you'll contribute directly to how we build, test, and improve our technology.

If you love building things, figuring out how they work, and seeing the results of your work out on the road, this is your opportunity.

What you'll be driving:

• Build the future of mobility: Assemble, install, and integrate mechanical, electrical, communication, camera, and sensor systems into our remotely operated vehicles and Tele-stations.

• Test and troubleshoot: Perform system validation, diagnose faults, and resolve technical issues using multimeters, precision instruments, and computer-based diagnostic tools.

• Solve technical challenges: Identify and troubleshoot mechanical, electrical, and software-related issues, including those involving EV systems, embedded electronics, and Linux-based platforms.

• Drive continuous improvement: Identify opportunities to improve assembly processes, reduce inefficiencies, and contribute ideas that make our workshop more effective.

• Own quality and safety: Maintain accurate digital build and maintenance records while ensuring high standards of workshop safety, quality, and organization.

What are we looking for:

• 3+ years of hands-on experience in automotive, EV, aerospace, or a similar technical assembly, maintenance, or systems integration environment.

• Strong mechanical and electrical troubleshooting skills, including wiring, soldering, and electronic system diagnostics.

• Experience assembling, modifying, or integrating complex vehicle systems, ideally including prototype, experimental, or custom vehicle builds.

• Willingness and ability to learn Linux-based systems and computer-based diagnostic tools.

• Familiarity with EV technology, embedded systems, cameras, sensors, or autonomous vehicle hardware is a strong advantage.

• A proactive, hands-on approach with the ability to troubleshoot unfamiliar technical challenges and know when to seek support.

• Strong attention to detail, a safety-first mindset, and the ability to collaborate effectively with engineering and operations teams.

• A technical trade qualification, Associate Degree, or equivalent practical experience. ASE or manufacturer certifications are a plus.

• Flexibility to support occasional overtime or holiday work when operationally required.

Why choose Vay:

💪 A global team of smart, motivated people from 30+ countries who love tackling hard problems and turning bold ideas into reality.

🌍 Huge scope for impact in a fast paced environment

💰 ESOP stock options: A stake in Vay’s future - not just a salary.

🌴 Unlimited Paid Vacation Days

🎫 401(k) programme

🏥 Health, Dental & Vision Insurance

🚗 All Vay team members receive 30% off their Vay rides

🏋️‍♂️ Wellness hub gym access

🛍️ Exclusive external discounts

✈️ Relocation financial assistance when relocating to Las Vegas

🎊 Regular team events throughout the year

For more information on Vay’s physical demands, working environments and safety requirements, you can review this link. We’ll also cover anything specific to this role during the first interview.

We’d love to stay connected for future opportunities, so feel free to include your LinkedIn profile when you apply.

We welcome applications from all backgrounds and experiences. If you’re excited about shaping something truly groundbreaking, we’d be happy to hear from you.

Curious to experience Vay yourself? In Las Vegas? Use the code VAYCANDIDATE for $10 off your first trip in Las Vegas! Download the "Vay" app from the Apple or Google Play store & off you go!

jobs.title: FedRAMP Information System Security Officer (ISSO)
jobs.description:
At Semperis, our mission is to be a Force for Good. Starting with being a great place to work. We believe that when people feel valued, supported, and empowered, they do their best work. That’s why we focus on creating an employee experience rooted in purpose, growth, and balance. Semperis has been recognized as one of America’s Fastest-Growing Cybersecurity Companies by the Inc. 5000, a DUNS 100 Top Startup to Work For, and a multi-year Inc. Best Workplace awardee.



Location: Hybrid In-Office: Hoboken, NJ; Addison, TX; Phoenix, AZ; or Austin, TX




ABOUT THE ROLE

We protect some of the world's largest, most complex hybrid identity environments, and that mission depends on earning and keeping our customers' trust. Our GRC team is the engine behind that trust, running the certification and audit programs that let security-conscious enterprises, regulated industries, and government customers confidently adopt our cloud products.

As the designated Information System Security Officer (ISSO), you will lead and execute day-to-day FedRAMP operational work at Semperis. Your role will define and document the certification boundary, specify and deploy the mandatory Key Security Indicators (KSIs), and deliver the automated evidence pipeline, FedRAMP Trust Center, and Security Inbox that FedRAMP 20x requires.

This is a hands-on, highly technical GRC role for someone who can guide how Semperis meets FedRAMP requirements and get into the details of continuous assurance automation. You will guide Semperis’s interpretation of each FedRAMP requirement and outline the implementation details directly to Semperis leadership, Security Assessors, and FedRAMP reviewers.

The role reports to the Head of Risk and Compliance, who serves as the FedRAMP Information System Security Manager (ISSM). You will work very closely with Security Engineering, Product/Engineering leadership, and Sales Government Solutions, and will be relied upon as the company’s day-to-day FedRAMP 20x subject matter expert.

In addition to FedRAMP responsibilities, you may support other Governance, Risk, Compliance, and Trust initiatives and certifications as needed to advance and mature Semperis’s GRC capabilities.


What you Will Do

FedRAMP Certification & Governance

 - Mobilize the FedRAMP 20x Program for in-scope product(s): guide the project charter, establish governance and reporting cadence, develop the stakeholder RACI, and work with project management to outline a viable work plan.

 - Work with the FedRAMP ISSM to propose staffing of required FedRAMP roles for the certification project.

 - Deliver a signed charter and a published work plan tracked against internal planning gates (executive go-decision, security engineering work, listing-readiness) so that no workstream is unowned.

 - Establish the requirements for expanded use of our GRC system for Trust Center, controls mapping, evidence collection, OSCAL outputs, and associated risk management needs.



FedRAMP Certification & Continuous Compliance

 - Document the Cloud Service Offering (CSO) for 20x certification, including the production environment, data plane and data flows, management plane, security controls plane, and in-scope supporting services. As applicable, reconcile the proposed FedRAMP boundary against the most recent SOC 2 report’s scope.

 - Complete gap assessment(s) and build capability to deliver all mandatory 20x KSIs, ensuring each has a correctly defined measure, an authoritative evidence source, an accountable owner, and a documented “Meets” status.

 - Design and build the FedRAMP Trust Center, Security Inbox, and a machine-readable KSI evidence pipeline, normalizing signals from CSPM, IAM, SIEM, CI/CD, and vulnerability-scanning tools so certification data is generated from live systems rather than manually assembled spreadsheets.

 - Partner with Product, Engineering, and Security leadership to embed FedRAMP controls directly into the SDLC and cloud infrastructure design, establishing control requirements, validating designs, and setting testable success criteria for “compliance as code” workstreams.

 - Deliver the FedRAMP Marketplace listing and the full 20x Certification Package, carrying it through the FedRAMP PMO’s review process to FedRAMP certification.

 - Operationalize the post-certification maintenance program: recurring KSI reviews, POA&M-style remediation tracking, and the required ongoing reporting cycle to FedRAMP (certification data changes, accepted vulnerabilities, transformative changes, agencies using the service, reportable incidents). Assess the security impact of proposed changes and prepare significant change submissions for the ISSM’s sign off.

 - Procure or develop and deliver annual and role-based training in accordance with FedRAMP requirements and manage the associated records and compliance activities.

 - Ensure implementation of all required non-technical controls, and manage day to day 3PAO, advisory, and accelerator vendor relationships as the program moves beyond Class A.

 - Drive timely remediation of risks and control gaps surfaced through audits, vulnerability scans, and penetration tests; translate technical findings into business-risk context for internal executives and (where applicable) external parties; bring risk acceptance proposals to the ISSM; escalate high-risk blockers to the Head of Risk and Compliance and/or CISO.

 - Define and track Key Security Indicators (KSIs) and Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) for the program, and support the Head of Risk and Compliance on related Key Risk Indicators (KRIs).

 - Support other certifications on the roadmap, such as GovRAMP, HIPAA, and CJIS, and lead the workstreams assigned to you.

 - Build the data-backed analysis behind the recommendation on whether and when to pursue higher level certification(s), grounded in Year 1 pipeline, conversion, and demand-signal data, including staffing, GovCloud, and cost implications, delivered in time to inform executive and board budget planning.

Security, Privacy and Reporting Responsibilities

 - Safeguard the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of federal information and systems within the authorization boundary and protect from unauthorized access, use, disclosure, or misuse; report any instance of unauthorized access, use, or misuse through required channels.

 - Comply with and help enforce personnel-security policies and procedures and acceptable-use/rules-of-behavior requirements for personnel in trusted roles.

 - Report insider-threat indicators and security/suitability concerns promptly through designated channels; support insider-threat program requirements.

 - Document and report security incidents within required timeframes.

 - Support internal and external security assessments, audits, and agency reviews



What You Will Bring (Required)

 - 6+ years of experience in GRC, information security compliance, or IT audit, including hands-on FedRAMP ISSO experience through at least one full Rev 5 authorization (typically about 3 years) at a SaaS or cloud software company.

 - At least one of the following certifications: CRISC, CISM, CISA, CISSP, or an equivalent recognized security, risk, or audit management credential.

 - Direct implementation of NIST SP 800-53 controls within a FedRAMP authorization. If you have one full authorization behind you, some FedRAMP 20x exposure is also expected.

 - Working fluency across cloud (Azure, AWS) and platform security domains: IAM, encryption, vulnerability management, SIEM, and cloud configuration.

 - Ability to work independently as an individual contributor: owning your deliverables, setting priorities for your workstreams, and knowing when to act on your own and when to bring an issue to the ISSM.

 - Strong "manage by influence" track record: experience driving engineers, product managers, and other non-reporting stakeholders to deliver evidence, remediate findings, and meet audit deadlines.

 - Direct experience managing external auditors, assessors, or certification bodies through full audit cycles.

Preferred Qualifications

 - Experience with or exposure to FedRAMP 20x KSIs (not just Rev 5 process), and familiarity with higher-tier FedRAMP certifications (Moderate and High).

 - Experience with related frameworks: DoD Impact Levels, GovRAMP/StateRAMP, CMMC, NIST 800-171, and CUI handling requirements.

 - Familiarity with GRC and compliance automation tooling (for example, Vanta or comparable platforms), AI tools to generate automated workflows and deliverables, and Lucid or Visio to produce and maintain system diagrams.

 - Experience designing evidence collection and validation architecture that turns data and signals from CSPM, IAM, SIEM, CI/CD, and vulnerability scanning tools into machine readable (OSCAL) compliance evidence, and partnering with the engineers who build the automation.



Success Measures

 - FedRAMP certification is achieved and maintained on schedule with no high or critical assessment findings.

 - Automated continuous KSI reporting via the FedRAMP Trust Center.

 - Cross-functional control owners consistently meet remediation and evidence deadlines without requiring escalation.

 - Customer Trust support commitments are met on time whenever called upon.



Special Security and Privacy Requirements

This position carries special Security and Privacy Responsibilities for protecting U.S. Government interests:

 - Know, acknowledge, and follow system-specific security policies and procedures;

 - Protect government data and individual privacy per requirements and regulations;

 - Perform ongoing activities in compliance with service and contractual obligations;

 - Participate in role-based training, completing assignments on a timely basis;

 - Report security issues promptly, and aid security investigations when needed;

 - Support controlled changes and vulnerability remediation activities; and

 - Work collaboratively in designing, implementing, assessing or enhancing system-specific security and privacy controls.
   

Additionally, this position requires the following:

• U.S. citizenship.

• Residency within the contiguous United States (within distance of Semperis TX, NJ offices); and

• Willingness to undergo a Single Source or similar Background Investigation if required.



Position Risk Designation:

The selected incumbent may be subject to additional background checks with periodic re-screening as noted below:

 - Position Risk Designation: Non-Sensitive, Low Risk, Tier 1

 - Incumbents with certain access to U.S. Government data may be required to complete Standard Form 85 and undergo a Tier 1 Investigation (T1) for non-sensitive positions of Low Risk. (Baseline screening; formerly National Agency Check and Inquiries (NACI)).



#LI-MR1

 



Why Join Semperis? 
You’ll be part of a global team on the front lines of cybersecurity innovation. At Semperis, we celebrate curiosity, integrity, and people who take initiative. If you’re someone who sees the glass as half full, embraces challenges as growth opportunities, and values a healthy balance between work and life—we’d love to meet you.

**Semperis maintains office locations in several cities across the globe. Where the job description specifies a required location, candidates will follow our hybrid work model. This includes working up to three days per week and remotely the remaining days. 




SEMPERIS IS AN EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER AND WILL NOT DISCRIMINATE AGAINST AN APPLICANT OR EMPLOYEE BASED ON RACE, COLOR, RELIGION, CREED, NATIONAL ORIGIN OR ANCESTRY, ETHNICITY, SEX (INCLUDING GENDER, PREGNANCY, SEXUAL ORIENTATION, AND GENDER IDENTITY), AGE, PHYSICAL OR MENTAL DISABILITY, VETERAN OR MILITARY STATUS, GENETIC INFORMATION, CITIZENSHIP, MARITAL STATUS, OR ANY OTHER LEGALLY RECOGNIZED PROTECTED BASIS UNDER FEDERAL, STATE, OR LOCAL LAW. THE INFORMATION COLLECTED BY THE SEMPERIS APPLICATION IS SOLELY TO DETERMINE SUITABILITY FOR EMPLOYMENT, VERIFY IDENTITY, AND MAINTAIN EMPLOYMENT STATISTICS. 


 


APPLICANTS WITH DISABILITIES MAY BE ENTITLED TO REASONABLE ACCOMMODATION UNDER THE AMERICANS WITH DISABILITIES ACT AND/OR OTHER APPLICABLE STATE OR LOCAL LAWS. A REASONABLE ACCOMMODATION IS A CHANGE IN THE WAY THINGS ARE NORMALLY DONE WHICH WILL ENSURE AN EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY WITHOUT IMPOSING UNDUE HARDSHIP ON SEMPERIS. PLEASE INFORM SEMPERIS REPRESENTATIVE ANNA TAYLOR, DIRECTOR OF GLOBAL RECRUITING, IF YOU NEED ASSISTANCE COMPLETING THIS APPLICATION OR TO OTHERWISE PARTICIPATE IN THE APPLICATION PROCESS.

jobs.title: Business Intelligence Intern - Summer 2027
jobs.description:
At PrizePicks, we are the fastest-growing sports company in North America, as recognized by Inc. 5000. As the leading platform for Daily Fantasy Sports, we cover a diverse range of sports leagues, including the NFL, NBA, and Esports titles like League of Legends and Counter-Strike. Our team of over 550 employees thrives in an inclusive culture that values individuals from diverse backgrounds, regardless of their level of sports fandom. Ready to reimagine the DFS industry together?

Business Intelligence (Game Operations) Intern

Ready to use data to change the game? Join us at PrizePicks and help millions of sports fans get a faster, smarter product. This paid internship in Atlanta (Hybrid) is your chance to follow a Business Intelligence track for strategic thinkers who use data to inform business-wide decisions and do work that directly impacts a real-world product. You'll move beyond dashboards to drive strategy, inform decisions, and help shape the future of sports.

What You'll Do:

• Support Strategic Decisions: Contribute to analytics projects that help inform key business decisions.

• Improve & Document Core Datasets: Help enhance datasets to improve usability and support more detailed analysis and reporting.

• Develop Core Reports: Build, document, and maintain easy-to-use, insightful dashboards and re-usable analyses.

• Support Stakeholders: Partner with stakeholders to help address data, knowledge, and process gaps. Answer ad-hoc data questions with clear, reliable information.

• Build Domain Knowledge: Develop a working knowledge of our data, users, and stakeholder priorities.

What You'll Bring:

We’re looking for a sharp, driven student ready to contribute. You're a great fit if you have:

• Analytics Background: Foundational technical experience with SQL, data visualization (e.g. Tableau), and Excel formulas.

• Critical thinking: You can understand how data points interact with each other and build together like puzzle pieces to tell a full story.

• Industry Familiarity: A genuine interest in sports, gaming, or prediction markets. You understand the fundamentals well enough that you won't need a crash course on how the games work.

• A Project to Show Off: Something you can walk us through, whether it’s from a class, a personal GitHub project, or a Kaggle competition.

• Team Player: Organized, reliable, curious, professional, communicative, and growth-oriented.

• Excellent Communication: You can explain complex concepts clearly and work well within a team. Plus, you have a passion for sports!

Bonus:

• Experience playing or optimizing play at a competitive level within sports, DFS, or other games.

• Personal data or analysis projects related to sports, gaming, trading, pricing, DFS, or finance.

• Knowledge or experience with Python, R, or other programming languages.

What You'll Learn:

This internship is designed for serious growth. You’ll get a masterclass in:

• Data-Driven Decision Making: How product teams use more than just dashboards to make critical trade-offs.

• Trustworthy Analysis: How to craft reliable analyses that provide data-driven insights and recommendations that influence business decisions.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Demand Generation
jobs.description:
At Commure, we're building the AI Operating System for healthcare, the foundation that defines how care is delivered, documented, and financed. Our platform spans the full care journey: Ambient AI and Dictation eliminating documentation burden at the point of care, intelligent Agents automating patient and revenue workflows, and autonomous RCM processing billions in claims, all on a single AI-native platform integrated with 60+ EHRs.



Healthcare carries a $1 trillion administrative burden and we're at the center of transforming it. Today, 500,000+ clinicians across 500+ healthcare organizations nationwide trust Commure to handle $25B+ in annual claims and support over 200 million patient interactions. Our latest $70M raise at a $7B valuation reflects the confidence the market has placed in this mission. We've also been named to the Fortune Future 50 list and the 2026 AI Breakthrough Awards for “Overall NLP Company of the Year.”



Our team works directly alongside clinicians, not through layers of process, which means the gap between what you build and its impact on patient care is immediate. We move fast, deploy daily, and take full ownership from early thinking to production. If you're energized by hard problems, high stakes, and a team that holds itself to a high bar, you'll find your people here.



The future of healthcare is being built right now. Come deliver this transformation.




ABOUT THE ROLE

At Commure, we are building technology to simplify healthcare for patients, providers, and administrators. We're looking for a Senior Manager of Demand Generation to turn our account fit and intent data into campaigns that generate enterprise pipeline, both from new accounts and from expansion within our existing customer base. This person will own B2B paid media, campaigns, campaign operations, the lead lifecycle, and funnel measurement for our enterprise portfolio, including Ambient AI, Call Center Agents, and Orchestrator, and report directly to the Head of Enterprise Marketing.



This is a senior, high-impact role for an AI-first marketer with deep B2B paid media experience who can turn Commure's brand narrative into paid programs that build awareness and pipeline with enterprise healthcare buyers. You'll be equally comfortable building a HubSpot workflow, writing a campaign brief that rallies the team, and presenting results to sales leadership. You'll use AI to move faster than a traditional demand gen function, and you'll help the rest of the team do the same.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

Paid Media and Brand Narrative

 - Own Commure's enterprise paid media strategy, budget, and channel mix across LinkedIn, Google, ABM, and programmatic, with spend tied to pipeline and revenue targets

 - Partner with brand and content to turn our positioning into paid creative, offers, and multi-touch storylines that tell Commure's story consistently to health system and enterprise buyers

 - Run account-based paid programs against our fit and intent model, coordinated with SDR outreach and sales plays

 - Direct agency and platform partners, and test creative, audience, and offer to improve cost per opportunity and pipeline per dollar

 - Report paid performance on pipeline, account engagement, and brand lift so leadership can see how spend builds both demand and awareness

Campaigns and Programs

 - Build and run integrated campaigns and account plays against our fit and intent model, prioritizing the accounts most likely to convert

 - Partner with Customer Success to build expansion campaigns that drive cross-sell and upsell across our existing customers

 - Lead each campaign end to end with a clear brief and timeline, bringing content, brand, web, social, events, and sales along from kickoff to results readout

 - Own the webinar calendar and direct mail programs

Campaign Operations

 - Partner with our Events Manager on the pre-show and post-show motion, including attendee list enrichment, list loading, and follow-up plays

 - Set up and manage campaigns in HubSpot and Salesforce so every touch is tracked and attributable

Lead Lifecycle and Nurture

 - Optimize lead and account scoring, lifecycle stages, and routing logic, partnering with Revenue Operations on implementation

 - Build email nurture series and design the handoffs between marketing nurture, sales nurture, and SDR follow-up

Measurement and Optimization

 - Own lead and opportunity attribution and report on funnel performance from first touch through closed-won, for both new business and expansion

 - Test, measure, and optimize conversion at every stage, and turn results into clear recommendations

Sales and SDR Alignment

 - Partner with the SDR team on scripting, sequences, and activity plans so follow-up matches each campaign

 - Train sales and SDR teams on campaigns and lead handling, and hold teams to agreed follow-up SLAs

AI and Marketing Technology

 - Serve as marketing's expert HubSpot power user, working with Revenue Operations to expand what our stack can do

 - Use AI to accelerate research, enrichment, segmentation, personalization, reporting, and campaign builds, and help the team adopt AI workflows that save time
   
   


WHAT YOU HAVE

 - 7+ years in B2B demand generation, including 3+ years owning paid media programs and budgets

 - Hands-on expertise running B2B paid programs across LinkedIn Ads, Google Ads, and ABM or programmatic platforms such as 6sense or Demandbase, including audience strategy, creative testing, and budget pacing

 - A portfolio of paid campaigns that carried a brand narrative to enterprise buyers and moved both awareness and pipeline

 - Hands-on expertise in HubSpot or a similar marketing automation platform, plus Salesforce

 - Proven experience using AI to build or scale marketing workflows

 - A track record of scoring, nurture, and ABM programs that drove measurable pipeline

 - Strong project management, writing, and presentation skills

 - Healthcare experience is a bonus

Join Peachy

Join one of the fastest-growing medical aesthetics companies in the country. At Peachy, our Nurse Practitioners specialize exclusively in wrinkle prevention through personalized consultations and treatment with FDA-approved neuromodulators.

Whether you're an experienced injector or completely new to aesthetics, we'll provide the training and support you need to build a successful career in medical aesthetics. Peachy Providers earn a competitive hourly rate plus quarterly performance bonuses. Our top-performing Providers earn 20%+ in bonus compensation annually!

Why Peachy?

Named one of Fast Company’s Brands That Matter and winning a Best Carbon Footprint award, we have big goals like being Climate Positive by 2025, Circular by 2030, and pushing the whole industry forward along the way. Our work has gotten love in Drapers and Sourcing Journal, and TIME wrote about how great our CEO, Hali Borenstein, is. Basically, we're saving the Earth and looking damn good doing it.

We're a global brand with 50+ stores (and counting) around the world, and our own sustainable factory in LA. We innovate across categories like accessories, swimwear, and sleepwear, and we reach millions of people with campaigns like this, this and this.

None of this work is possible without the incredible people behind it. We're a mission-based company that invests in an inclusive culture, so we can innovate together and ensure everyone has the space to grow, thrive, and belong.

And starting right now, we want to do all that with you.

jobs.title: Care Strategy & Operations (Lead / Director)
jobs.description:
🌊 ABOUT SAILOR HEALTH

America is undergoing one of the largest demographic shifts in its history as the Baby Boomer generation enters its later years. This shift will put unprecedented pressure on Medicare, which already spends more than $1 trillion each year caring for older adults. Yet the healthcare system is built backwards: reactive instead of preventative, measuring years of life instead of the quality of them.

Sailor Health is building a new care model for aging. We combine behavioral health, healthcare advocacy, wellness classes, and AI care agents into one virtual platform designed for older adults. AI coaches help patients navigate their health between visits, while AI copilots give providers the tools to deliver higher-quality, better-informed care. We partner with Medicare to make our platform affordable and accessible to older adults nationwide.

Sailor has exceptional product-market fit:

 - Exponential growth: We are honored to serve thousands of patients across all 50 states, with strong organic demand helping make Sailor one of the fastest-growing companies in healthcare.

 - AI-powered, deeply human care: We harness the power of AI while keeping human connection at the center of care, creating an experience that feels personal, continuous, and deeply human.

 - Talent-dense team: We are a 25-person team in our NYC office and are backed by the founders of Ramp, Nourish, Headway, Charlie Health, and Spring Health.




⭐ ABOUT THE ROLE

Location: Soho, New York City

This is one of the most important hires we will make this year.

Our therapy practice is live in all 50 states and growing fast. Healthcare advocacy, our newest service line, is growing even faster. Patients come to us for therapy and quickly realize we can help with much more: finding the right specialist, untangling a Medicare bill, coordinating between doctors who never talk to each other. Demand is outpacing the systems we have built so far, and we need someone to build what comes next.

As our Director / Manager of Clinical Operations, you will own the care model behind all of it. You will scale therapy operations across a national footprint, turn healthcare advocacy into a world class service line, and launch new services that will define Sailor's future. Our case managers will report to you, and you will build the team around them.

You will partner closely with our Clinical Director, Dr. Daniel Burow, to design care that is both clinically excellent and operationally built to scale. You will report directly to our founders.




💻 YOUR KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Build the care model. Design how patients move through Sailor across therapy, advocacy, and case management, partnering with our clinical, operations, legal, and engineering teams to bring it to life.

Scale new service lines. Turn healthcare advocacy, our fastest growing service line, into a repeatable national operation with the workflows, playbooks, and metrics to match.

Shape how AI supports our clinicians. Help design how AI copilots take administrative work off our clinicians' plates, so they can spend more time listening, connecting, and caring for patients.

Lead case management and escalations. Manage and grow our case management team, oversee their caseload, and build the triage and escalation protocols for high acuity cases.

Power whole person care. Build the connective tissue that unites our clinicians and care teams into one integrated model that sees each patient as a whole person, so their mental health, physical health, and daily life are cared for together, not in silos.

Measure quality and safety. Track the metrics that tie our work to patient outcomes, and ensure everything meets clinical, privacy, and Medicare standards.




✅ WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

This role isn’t for everyone. It’s fast-paced, chaotic, and requires hard work. But if this excites you, we’d love to meet you.

 - You have 4-12 years of experience (ideally in clinical operations): You've built and scaled care delivery at a high growth healthcare company, and you know what great clinical operations look like from the inside.

 - You're a player-coach: You lead your team with clarity and warmth, and you're just as happy rolling up your sleeves to work a tough case yourself.

 - You're a strong communicator: You build trust quickly with clinicians, engineers, lawyers, and founders alike, and you can get very different teams moving in the same direction.

 - You thrive in ambiguity: You don't need a playbook to get started. When a situation is new and messy, you bring structure to it and keep moving.

 - You think from first principles: You look at problems from every angle, weigh the tradeoffs, and land on a balanced decision you can clearly defend.

 - You take work personally: You take pride in what you build and care deeply about the older adults who rely on it.

jobs.title: Staff / Tech Lead Software Engineer - OpenCTI - US East
jobs.description:
🌀 THE COMPANY

Founded in 2022, Filigran is a global cybersecurity company on a mission to empower defense teams to be proactive through open-source solutions that uncover threats and drive action.

Filigran stands out in the cybersecurity ecosystem through its open-source, AI-powered and threat-informed approach to Continuous Threat Exposure Management (CTEM). Our eXtended Threat Management (XTM) platform brings together threat intelligence, exposure validation and cyber risk reduction, enabling organizations to better understand their threat landscape and take action.

At the heart of Filigran is our open-source approach. Our vision is to unite defenders into a global community to make security more open, resilient and collaborative.

As Filigran continues to scale globally, we are building the organization, infrastructure and capabilities needed for our next stage of growth. How we scale matters just as much as how fast we scale: our CORE values: Cohesion, Openness, Responsibility and Equity  shape how we work together, make decisions and build for the future.

 

Location: United States, East Coast (full remote)




🎯 THE ROLE

You'll be the technical anchor point ensuring this partnership produces efficient, high-quality, well-integrated contributions to the OpenCTI core project — while also driving technical vision and mentoring within Filigran's own engineering team.

 - Facilitate technical refinement sessions and design reviews with partner engineers

 - Supervise, challenge, and elevate the technical quality of contributions coming from the partnership

 - Promote OpenCTI's best practices, code quality, and performance standards externally and internally

 - Coach engineers (internal and partner-side) via pair programming, code reviews, and structured feedback

 - Collaborate with EMs/POs on task sizing, scope alignment, and roadmap planning for partner-related work

🤝 WHO YOU'LL WORK WITH

jobs.title: Senior Data Analyst
jobs.description:
THE ROLE

Atomic is seeking an experienced Senior Data Analyst to own and manage high-impact data products across a dynamically expanding suite of offerings. You'll be responsible for both external and internal analytics, managing data products and insights that serve our customers and partners as well as internal teams across product, marketing, engineering, and leadership.



This role rewards strong SQL and data modeling skills, analytical rigor, and the judgment to know which questions are worth answering. As Atomic's product suite expands, you'll keep these data products accurate, reliable, and relevant while owning large, ambiguous projects end to end. You'll translate complex findings into recommendations leadership can act on and help set the standard for the analytics team.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Own large, ambiguous data and analytics projects end to end, from scoping through delivery, with a high degree of independence.

 - Own and manage data products for both external and internal stakeholders.

 - Write advanced SQL to transform data, and improve the reliability and performance of the datasets and data products the team depends on.

 - Keep data products accurate and relevant as Atomic's suite of offerings evolves, updating logic and definitions when source data, schema, or products change.

 - Turn complex analysis into clear recommendations for stakeholders and leadership, including root-cause investigation when metrics move unexpectedly.

 - Ensure data has a seat at the table during cross-functional initiatives with product, marketing, engineering, and leadership.

 - Mentor junior analysts by reviewing work, sharing best practices, and helping level up the team's technical and analytical skills.


ABOUT YOU

 - 2-4 years of experience in data analysis, analytics, business analysis, or reporting, including a track record of independently owning projects end to end.

 - Bachelor's degree in a quantitative, business, or technical field, or equivalent practical experience.

 - Strong SQL skills, including complex joins, aggregation, window functions, and querying and shaping large structured datasets.

 - Experience managing production SQL/database objects through Git/GitHub, including pull requests, peer review, testing, and CI/CD workflows.

 - Hands-on experience managing and maintaining near real-time data products in tools such as Tableau, Looker, Power BI, Mode, or Databricks.

 - A drive to solve hard problems, not just detect them, with the rigor to validate your own work before it ships.


COMPENSATION

Benefits And Perks



 - Medical, dental, vision, and 401(k).

 - Equity through stock options.

 - Remote-first workplace.

 - Unlimited PTO, 10 company-paid holidays, and office closure between Christmas and New Year.

 - Continuing education.

 - Paid parental leave.



Atomic is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, or protected veteran status and will not be discriminated against on the basis of disability.

jobs.title: Financial Data Operations Engineer
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE TEAM

Anduril's Data & Operations team is focused on combining our internal data analytics with operational processes and business systems to make insights actionable. You will collaborate with stakeholders and drive partnerships across the company to improve decision making and optimize outcomes. Your work will directly increase the velocity of the organization by becoming an expert on our most critical workflows such as staffing, supply chain, manufacturing, and field sustainment.

We're looking for analysts and builders who are seeking a role at the intersection of high impact and high collaboration across organizations and systems. Ideally you are passionate about the next generation of defense technology and are looking to become a technical expert.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

• Build sophisticated Finance tools and templates - Create Excel-based solutions, data integrations, and AI-powered workflows that eliminate manual data gathering and entry while driving more efficient and accurate finance processes

• Integrate Finance workflows with data platforms - Collaborate with our Analytics team to connect finance processes directly into our data platform, ensuring end-users have easy access to clean, reliable data

• Drive user adoption and enablement - Support Finance users through office hours, bootcamps, and training on best practices to enable efficient forecasting, self-serve financial data access, and application development

• Proactively identify automation opportunities - Seek out Finance problems that can be solved with data and work with the organization to make it a reality

• Become a trusted resource for Anduril leadership in helping them run their organizations more effectively

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• 4+ years of experience in a finance, operations, or data analysis role; ideally building financial models with large-scale data integrations

• You are motivated by our mission. We are working to solve the biggest problems in defense

• Deep understanding of data stack tools: Databricks or Palantir Foundry or dbt, Redshift, Looker/Tableau, Dagster

• You thrive in cross-functional projects that have a heavy combination of technical requirements and user-focused workflows

• You are empathetic: you are eager to see the world from your users' perspective

• You're energized by business impact & a self-starter: you love to drive the direction of ambiguous projects

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Prior FP&A, financial modeling, or forecasting experience in the Defense sector: you have an insider’s understanding of Finance workflows and painpoints

• Experience with AI/LLM-powered tooling and automation in a production environment

• Change management experience: you’ve launched tools that required user adoption, training, and iteration based on feedback

• Experience operating in SOX compliant data platforms

US Salary Range

$147,000—$196,000 USD

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

Benefits

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

• No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

• Please always verify communications: Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address. Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com.

• Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.

• What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

Data Privacy

To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant-privacy-notice/.

By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third-party service provider to conduct pre-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. This third-party service provider provides risk-intelligence services that may include analysis of sanctions and watchlists, adverse media, public-record information, and other lawful open-source or commercial data sources. This third-party service provider does not act as a consumer reporting agency. Use of this provider helps to ensure compliance with applicable laws and protect technology, intellectual property, and organizational security.

jobs.title: Lifestyle Host/Reporter
jobs.description:
About TEGNA

TEGNA Inc. helps people thrive in their local communities by providing the trusted local news and services that matter most. With 64 television stations in 51 U.S. markets, TEGNA reaches more than 100 million people monthly across the web, mobile apps, streaming, and linear television. Together, we are building a sustainable future for local news.

KSDK-TV Saint Louis, the NBC TEGNA-owned affiliate in St. Louis, Missouri is looking for a dynamic, creative and engaging Lifestyle Host & Multimedia Journalist to join Show Me St. Louis, our locally produced lifestyle and entertainment program. We are interested in finding a journalist who can create unique, memorable and well written stories, who can share them on all platforms.
St. Louis is filled with incredible people, neighborhoods, restaurants, businesses, nonprofits, attractions and experiences, and we’re looking for someone who is excited to tell their stories.

The ideal candidate is an engaging on-air personality and strong storyteller who is equally comfortable hosting in the studio, reporting in the field and working behind the camera. This person should know how to take an idea from concept to air, whether that means interviewing a guest live, shooting and editing a feature story, creating an engaging live shot or working with a local business or community partner to develop compelling content. Current driver's license and ability to operate news gathering vehicle to and from various locations is required.

Responsibilities:
•    Host Show Me St. Louis and deliver on-air content in an engaging, conversational and accurate manner.
•    Shoot, write, edit and report compelling lifestyle and community stories.
•    Conduct engaging interviews both in studio and in the field.
•    Develop original content showcasing the people, places, businesses, food, entertainment, nonprofits and experiences that make the St. Louis region unique.
•    Pitch fresh, creative and timely story ideas and help shape future Show Me St. Louis programming.
•    Generate fun, creative and content-driven live shots and field segments.
•    Work professionally and collaboratively with advertising clients and community partners to turn their ideas into compelling television.
•    Create content for broadcast, digital and social platforms.
•    Maintain an active and professional social media presence while finding new ways to engage with viewers.
•    Use photography and editing tools to create polished, visually engaging stories.
•    Contribute to sponsored content, station initiatives, special programming and community events.
•    Collaborate with producers, photographers, sales teams and other departments to execute content across platforms.
•    Manage multiple stories and projects while consistently meeting deadlines.

Requirements:
•    2–4 years of experience in broadcast journalism, multimedia journalism, lifestyle television, hosting or a related field preferred.
•    Strong on-camera presence with an authentic, approachable personality.
•    Strong interviewing, writing and storytelling skills.
•    Experience shooting and editing video.
•    Ability to independently take a story from idea to finished product.
•    Comfortable working with advertising clients, local businesses, nonprofits and community organizations.
•    Creative thinker who understands how to make lifestyle content informative, entertaining and visually compelling.
•    Strong organizational and time-management skills with the ability to perform under tight deadlines.
•    Experience in creating content for social and digital platforms.
•    Experience with ENPS and EDIUS is preferred.
•    Bachelor’s degree in journalism, communications or a related field preferred.

Who We're Looking For
We want someone who is curious about St. Louis and genuinely excited to explore it. Someone who can walk into a restaurant kitchen, community event, local business or live studio interview and immediately make people feel comfortable.
This person should bring personality and creativity to the show while also having the journalistic and production skills to find a story, shoot it, write it, edit it and tell it well.

Most importantly, we're looking for someone who wants to help viewers discover something new about St. Louis every day.

Benefits:

TEGNA offers comprehensive benefits designed to safeguard the physical, mental and financial health of our employees and their families. TEGNA offers two medical plan options for full and part-time employees through Blue Cross Blue Shield of Texas, as well as access to dental and eye care coverage; fertility, surrogacy and adoption assistance; disability and life insurance.

Our 401(k) program offers full, part-time and temporary employees the opportunity to contribute 1% - 80% of their pay on a pre-tax basis to TEGNA’s 401(k). Contributions made up to the first 4% of pay are eligible for a 100% match from the company and are 100% vested from day one.

Regardless of participation in TEGNA medical plans, ALL employees and their eligible family members receive nine free virtual doctor’s appointments with a physician through Teladoc, and 12 free annual therapy sessions with a licensed clinician through Spring Health.

TEGNA offers a generous Paid Time Off (PTO) benefit as well as nine paid holidays per year.

jobs.title: Senior Product Sales, Billing
jobs.description:
ABOUT AIRWALLEX

Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. More than 675,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own.

We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,700 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles https://www.airwallex.com/en-us/operating-principles to see it in full.

 


HOW YOU'LL MAKE IMPACT

Product Sales is a team of functional and technical specialists who lead and advise on deals to drive adoption of Airwallex’s Billing solutions across new and existing customers. You'll combine product, technical, and commercial expertise to enable regional sales teams and help them win. Part product sales and part solution architecture, you'll join regional pitches and customer conversations to scope requirements and recommend the right technical solution across Subscription Management, Usage-Based Billing, Invoicing, Tax, and Payments. You'll work closely with sales, account management, marketing, Product, Engineering, Strategy, Revenue Operations, and Product Marketing to refine our go-to-market approach and bring regional customer needs into the roadmap.

 - Lead and advise on complex deals to drive adoption of Airwallex’s Billing solutions across new and existing customers.

 - Enable regional sales teams with the positioning, pitches, and technical expertise they need to sell Billing with confidence.

 - Partner with account executives on high-value opportunities, joining customer conversations to scope requirements and recommend the right solution across Subscription Management, Usage-Based Billing, Invoicing, Tax, and Payments.

 - Design solutions that map customer billing needs to Airwallex’s platform, explaining trade-offs clearly to both business and technical stakeholders.

 - Test and refine the market positioning and selling motion for Billing, working with Strategy, Revenue Operations, and Product Marketing to improve the go-to-market playbook.

 - Act as the bridge between regional customers, Product, and Engineering by bringing customer needs into the roadmap and informing commercial priorities.



You'll work from our San Francisco or New York City office three days a week.




WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

Essentials

 - 3–5 years of experience in product sales, solution architecture, or solution engineering at a technology company, ideally in billing or subscriptions.

 - Technical fluency to speak credibly with Product and Engineering stakeholders, understand APIs and integration patterns, and recommend sound solutions.

 - Experience driving sales cycles in collaboration with account executive and account management teams, translating technical detail into business value for customers.

 - A track record of working cross-functionally across multiple stakeholders to drive product or solution adoption.

 - Strong presentation skills for in-person and online meetings with stakeholders across finance, product, and engineering.

 - A self-starter who can drive business results with limited supervision.

 - Comfort dealing with ambiguity and working in an unstructured, fast-moving environment.




PREFERRED

 - Experience at a billing platform or competitor such as Stripe, Chargebee, or Recurly, or at a billing startup.

 - Experience at a technical consulting firm such as Accenture, Deloitte Digital, or BCG X, designing and selling technical solutions.

 - Experience engaging in business-level and technical conversations with stakeholders at multiple levels, including CEOs, CFOs, and CTOs.

 - Experience building value in competitive situations and working on complex products that require deep product and technical knowledge.

 - Experience leading complex negotiations involving bespoke commercial agreements.

 - A track record of becoming a subject-matter expert, sharing knowledge, and improving the processes and organizations around you.




YOU'LL THRIVE HERE IF

 - You're excited by a category that hasn't been won yet, and want to be early enough to shape it.

 - You're comfortable with ambiguity. Give you a problem, not a prescription, and you'll run with it.

 - You have a track record of hitting your numbers, and you're motivated by stretch goals.

 - You say what you mean. You're direct, but you lead with respect.

 - You simplify complexity rather than hiding behind it.




LEARN MORE ABOUT YOUR TEAM

SME & Growth at Airwallex is about more than closing deals. We help small and mid-market businesses solve real financial challenges across borders: getting paid globally, managing multi-currency accounts, paying suppliers, and running spend across markets from a single platform. You're not selling a feature. You're helping founders and finance leaders replace fragmented financial operations with one global system that actually scales.

It's a function for sellers who like to build, not follow a script: curious, resourceful, and comfortable figuring things out in markets that are still wide open. You get real autonomy to create value, build relationships, and move opportunities forward.

If you want to sell a serious product, solve real problems for ambitious businesses, and build your career fast, this is a place to do it.


APPLICANT SAFETY POLICY: FRAUD AND THIRD-PARTY RECRUITERS

To protect you from recruitment scams, please be aware that Airwallex will not ask for bank details, sensitive ID numbers (i.e. passport), or any form of payment during the application or interview process. All official communication will come from an @airwallex.com http://airwallex.com email address. Please apply only through careers.airwallex.com http://careers.airwallex.com or our official LinkedIn page.

Airwallex will not pay any fees to search firms/recruiters if a candidate is submitted by a search firm/recruiter unless an agreement has been entered into with respect to specific open position(s).  Search firms/recruiters submitting resumes to Airwallex on an unsolicited basis shall be deemed to accept this condition, regardless of any other provision to the contrary.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY

Airwallex is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and anyone seeking employment at Airwallex is considered based on merit, qualifications, competence and talent. We don’t regard color, religion, race, national origin, sexual orientation, ancestry, citizenship, sex, marital or family status, disability, gender, or any other legally protected status when making our hiring decisions. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know.

With AI redefining the computing paradigm, solutions must evolve to unify innovations in software models, compilers, platforms, networking, and semiconductors. Our diverse team of technologists have developed a high performance RISC-V CPU from scratch, and share a passion for AI and a deep desire to build the best AI platform possible. We value collaboration, curiosity, and a commitment to solving hard problems. We are growing our team and looking for contributors of all seniorities.

Help bring Tenstorrent technology to market by connecting our products with customers and supporting the technical work behind successful product adoption. This team help customers understand, evaluate, and integrate Tenstorrent technology.

This role is on-site based in our Santa Clara, CA or Austin, TX office.

What You Might Work On

This posting spans multiple teams within GTM (FAE & Customer Success) and Product. We make this process simple for you — one application, one recruiter screen — then we match you to the specific team and location that fits best.

• Field Applications Engineering (FAE): Work with customers to understand technical requirements, support product evaluations and integration, troubleshoot technical challenges, and collaborate with Engineering to develop solutions.

• Customer Success: Support customer onboarding, technical engagement, and ongoing product adoption. Help address customer needs, coordinate technical resources, and ensure successful implementation of Tenstorrent technology.

• Product Management: Support product planning and development by gathering customer requirements, analyzing technical and market needs, tracking product capabilities, and collaborating with Engineering on product priorities.

Who You Are

• Currently pursuing a BS or MS in Business, Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field.

• Strong communication and organizational skills, with the ability to work across technical and business teams.

• Interested in go-to-market strategy, business development, product operations, and customer/market engagement.

• Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment where priorities and requirements may evolve.

What We Need

• Ability to turn ambiguous business or operational challenges into clear, actionable next steps.

• Strong analytical, problem-solving, and project management skills.

• Interest in learning Tenstorrent's technology and how our IP products are positioned, brought to market, and supported operationally.

• Ability to collaborate across Product, Engineering, Sales, and other cross-functional teams.

What You Will Learn

• How a deep-tech company develops and executes go-to-market strategies for IP products.

• How customer, market, and competitive insights influence business and product decisions.

• How product operations and program management support teams, customers, quality, and execution.

• How technical products move from internal development to commercial opportunities and customer engagement.

USA Hiring Timelines

This internship opportunity is available throughout our 3 terms with the following corresponding recruitment cycles:

• Winter Term: Jan–Apr work term, Sept–Dec recruit.

• Summer Term: May–Aug work term, Oct–Apr recruit.

• Fall Term: Sept–Dec work term, Jan–Aug recruit.

Please note these timelines are for reference only. Actual timelines may vary.

Tenstorrent offers a highly competitive compensation package and benefits, and we are an equal opportunity employer.

jobs.title: School-Based Lead Clinician – Substance Use Program (LCSW/LPC/LMFT)
jobs.description:
SCHOOL-BASED LEAD CLINICIAN – SUBSTANCE USE PROGRAM (LCSW/LPC/LMFT)
Cherry Hill High School East & West | Cherry Hill, NJ

Transforming student mental health in schools.

About Effective School Solutions
Effective School Solutions (ESS) is a leading provider of school-based mental health services, serving 6,000+ K–12 students across 12 states.

We deliver the level of clinical care typically found in private practice, out-of-district placements, or higher levels of care directly within public schools. We provide a full continuum of clinical programming, professional development, and district consultation.

Why This Role Matters
As a Lead Clinician, you’ll run ESS’s substance use program at Cherry Hill High School East and Cherry Hill High School West. You’ll give teens struggling with substance use and co-occurring mental health needs critical support they may not otherwise get, helping them stay in school, build healthier coping skills, and thrive.

At ESS, clinicians are trusted partners in shaping supportive school environments.

Starting salary range: $65,000-$75,000

Responsibilities

Direct Clinical Care & Family Support

• Provide comprehensive, school-based treatment for adolescents with substance use and co-occurring mental health concerns, including individual, group, and family therapy

• Conduct substance use screenings, intakes, and diagnostic and clinical assessments

• Use evidence-based approaches for adolescent substance use, such as Motivational Interviewing, CBT, and relapse prevention

• Partner with families and facilitate parent support and psychoeducation programming

• Conduct risk assessments and crisis intervention, ensure student safety, and coordinate referrals to higher levels of care (e.g., IOP, PHP, residential) when needed

• Develop and implement individualized treatment plans that support students’ recovery, emotional and behavioral health, and academic success

Program Leadership, Consultation & Collaboration

• Oversee the day-to-day clinical operations of the substance use program across both high schools

• Serve as the primary clinical point of contact for school partners at Cherry Hill East and West

• Collaborate with families, school staff, and community providers to deliver coordinated care

• Provide consultation, coaching, and training for school staff on adolescent substance use, mental health, and trauma-informed practices

• Participate in team meetings, supervision, and ongoing professional development

Documentation, Compliance & Professional Expectations

• Maintain timely, accurate clinical documentation in accordance with regulatory, ethical, and organizational standards, including confidentiality requirements for substance use treatment

• Uphold professional standards by maintaining active licensure, ethical practice, reliability, and a strong professional presence

• Monitor program performance and ensure alignment with ESS clinical and operational standards

Qualifications

• Master’s degree in Social Work, Counseling, or a related field

• Active New Jersey independent clinical license (LCSW, LPC, or LMFT)

• LCADC strongly preferred

• Significant clinical experience treating adolescents with substance use disorders, including co-occurring mental health conditions (required)

• 3+ years of experience working with children and/or adolescents with behavioral and emotional needs

• Demonstrated ability to work independently, exercise sound clinical judgment, and solve problems in a fast-paced environment

• Experience working with schools, families, and community-based services (school-based experience preferred)

• Strong communication, collaboration, and problem-solving skills

• Proficient in clinical documentation and electronic systems (e.g., EMR, Microsoft Office)

Why Clinicians Choose ESS
✔ School-day schedule: no weekends or on-call requirements; occasional evening hours as needed to support family engagement
✔ Light summers: 10 hours/week for 5 weeks with full-time pay
✔ Small caseloads
✔ Ongoing supervision, clinical support, and free CEUs
✔ Competitive salary + comprehensive benefits
✔ Clinical leadership at the heart of our company

Make a meaningful impact on student mental health.
Join Effective School Solutions
