jobs.title: Federal Government Relations Director
jobs.description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

Stripe is building the economic infrastructure that makes it easier for entrepreneurs and companies across the globe to grow their businesses. To support those efforts, Stripe is seeking a seasoned Government Relations professional to join our Government Relations & Public Affairs team in the US. Stripes on the Government Relations & Public Affairs team operate in a fast-paced internal and external environment that requires collaborating with teams across our organization and with outside stakeholders. The culture is thoughtful, transparent, academically rigorous, and kind. In this role you will have the opportunity to impact the trajectory of Stripe in the US and enhance financial innovation and inclusion. This role is focused on US federal legislative and regulatory advocacy and will sit alongside Stripe's existing federal team in Washington, DC.

What you’ll do

In this role you will deal with a diverse set of issues that straddle financial services, technology, internet regulation, tax and economic policy. You will define, shape, and advocate for initiatives that increase the GDP of the Internet. You will maintain deep relationships with Members of Congress, committee staff, key federal regulators, and the Executive Branch — building and executing legislative and regulatory strategies on issues central to Stripe's mission, including payments modernization, financial regulation, artificial intelligence, and the future of agentic commerce. If you are a team player who wants to represent millions of businesses around the world growing on Stripe, we look forward to hearing from you!

Responsibilities

• Be a senior member of our Government Relations & Public Affairs team, which works across the globe to strategically develop, pursue, and execute policy objectives as part of Stripe's global policy priorities

• Develop and execute federal legislative advocacy — managing Stripe's engagement with Congress on key legislative priorities including stablecoins, digital assets, open banking, AI governance, and payments regulation

• Build and maintain relationships with Members of Congress, committee and personal staff, and serve as Stripe's frontline representative on federal legislation affecting the payments and technology industries

• Engage federal regulatory agencies — including the Treasury Department, OCC, FDIC, Federal Reserve, CFPB, and others — to educate them about Stripe's business, advocate for sound policy outcomes, and navigate regulatory proceedings

• Plan, develop, and execute political, policy and advocacy initiatives and campaigns that advance Stripe's policy goals and those of our users

• Help colleagues across Stripe understand federal legislative and regulatory developments, identify policy opportunities to grow our business, and translate complex policy dynamics into actionable guidance

• Represent Stripe on trade groups, coalitions, and industry bodies engaged on federal policy issues

• Own internal budget management and reporting, including quarterly business reviews (QBRs) and regular performance reporting to leadership

• Communicate with clarity and precision — producing internal and external written work that reflects Stripe's high bar for writing

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

• At least 12+ years of experience in a policymaking, government, or senior advocacy role — ideally a mix of time on Capitol Hill, in a federal regulatory agency, or in a world-class organization as an in-house government relations expert or other business-related role

• A background working for a Member of Congress, a committee or leadership office, or in a senior policy role at the US Treasury, OCC, FDIC, White House, or comparable federal institution — with a track record of navigating bipartisan legislative environments

• Deep expertise in financial services regulation and payments policy, with a strong understanding of the legislative and regulatory landscape across banking, money transmission, and digital assets

• Familiarity with, and ideally direct experience on, emerging technology policy — including artificial intelligence, agentic commerce, and the regulatory questions that arise at the intersection of AI and financial services

• Strong relationships with policymakers and staff on both sides of the aisle and a reputation for credibility, reliability, and good judgment

• A proven track record of managing complex, technical policy issues — capable of managing major initiatives independently, driving coalitions, or project managing a cross-functional team

• Excellent judgment — capable of making smart decisions in the face of ambiguity and imperfect information and learning from them

• A terrific communicator and writer, adept at working with lawyers, regulators, engineers, business teams, and colleagues to make complex concepts clear and understandable

• Passion for Stripe's mission of helping businesses grow and thrive

• A collaborative, curious team-first mindset with experience thriving in ambiguous, high-growth or startup environments across global offices.

• Empathy, humility, and a respect for those who have views that are different from yours

• A willingness to work with a diverse group of policy, regulatory, and product professionals who care deeply about Stripe's policy issues, our users, and each other

• Willingness to travel 25% for meetings and events

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Payment Operations
jobs.description:
Dandy is transforming the massive and antiquated dental industry—an industry worth over $400B. Backed by some of the world’s leading venture capital firms, we’re on an ambitious mission to simplify and modernize every function of the dental practice through technology. As we expand our reach globally, Dandy is building the operating system for dental offices around the world—empowering clinicians and their teams with technology, innovation, and world-class support to achieve more for their practices, their people, and their patients.

About the Role

We're hiring a Senior Manager, Payment Operations to lead accounts payable and billing and collections as one function. You'll own procure-to-pay and order-to-cash from end to end, with teams across the US, the Philippines and Colombia.

This is an accounting-led role. AP and AR sit at the start of our financial data. When an invoice gets paid without a PO, or a bill goes out at the wrong price, the problem lands in the general ledger weeks later. We want a leader who understands the accounting impact of every transaction and builds controls to get the data right at the source.

Dandy runs high-volume physical operations: two US manufacturing labs, dental practice and DSO customers in several countries, a large vendor base and multiple legal entities. You'll bring accounting rigor and scale to the teams behind every dollar in and out.

What you'll do

Accounts Payable

 - Own the full procure-to-pay cycle: vendor setup, invoice processing, PO matching, approvals and payment runs.

 - Enforce PO compliance and three-way match with Procurement and Operations.

 - Manage domestic and international vendor payments across entities and currencies, in partnership with Treasury.

 - Own vendor master data quality and 1099 reporting.

Billing and Collections

 - Own billing accuracy, credit controls and pricing controls across practice and DSO accounts.

 - Run cash application and collections, including a clear process for large DSO accounts agreed with Account Management.

 - Support the bad debt reserve with aging analysis and collection forecasts.

Controls and Close

 - Design and document controls over procure-to-pay and order-to-cash, including segregation of duties, built to public company audit standards.

 - Deliver AP and AR subledger reconciliations, accruals and cut-off on the close calendar.

 - Serve as the main contact for auditors on AP and AR testing.

Team and Systems

 - Lead the AP and billing and collections teams, including managers and team leads, with clear SOPs, training and quality checks.

 - Automate invoice capture, approvals and collections workflows in NetSuite and related tools.

 - Set and report on core metrics: DSO, aged receivables, PO match rate, payment accuracy and cost per transaction.

What success looks like in year one

 - Every invoice paid against an approved PO or a documented exception.

 - A working collections process for aged receivables and a lower DSO.

 - AP and AR reconciliations complete early in the close, with no audit adjustments.

 - Documented SOPs and controls for every core AP and AR process.

What we're looking for

 - Bachelor's degree in Accounting or Finance

 - 8+ years of experience, including general ledger or public accounting, and 3+ years leading AP, AR or finance shared services.

 - Hands-on knowledge of how AP and AR transactions hit the general ledger, accruals and revenue.

 - Experience in an operational business with high transaction volume: manufacturing, distribution, healthcare services or logistics.

 - Experience leading offshore or BPO teams across time zones.

 - A track record of building controls and passing audits, ideally under SOX or PCAOB standards.

 - Multi-entity and multi-currency experience.

 - Advanced Excel and strong NetSuite or comparable ERP skills.

 - A builder mindset: you fix the process, document the fix and train the team.

Bonus Points

 - CPA preferred. 

 - AP automation or billing system implementation experience.

 - Healthcare, dental or medical device industry experience.

 - High-volume B2B or usage-based billing experience.

Req ID: J-1299

Our local benefits packages typically include healthcare, dental, mental health support, parental planning resources, retirement savings options, and generous paid time off—ensuring our team members are supported no matter where they live and work.

jobs.title: Urgent Care - Registered Nurse (RN)
jobs.description:
At ConvenientMD, we’re on a mission to make good health more convenient for all – working to improve how patients and providers experience healthcare in New England. To support this belief, we’re building a team of dedicated professionals who genuinely care about improving lives, are passionate about work that can make a difference, and are driven to learn from one another.

The Opportunity

ConvenientMD is hiring a dedicated Registered Nurse (RN) to join our growing team. In this role, you will play an essential part in delivering high-quality patient care while benefiting from opportunities for professional growth and a supportive work environment. If you excel in a fast-paced, patient-focused setting, this position could be a great fit for you.

Your Impact

• Patient Care & Triage: Conduct comprehensive patient triage by taking vital signs, documenting medical history, and performing observational examinations to identify immediate healthcare needs. Assist with patient exams, ensuring all necessary equipment and documentation are prepared, while supporting providers during testing and procedures.

• Clinical Procedures: Perform blood draws and phlebotomy with precision and adherence to safety protocols. Manage airway support through treatments such as nebulizer therapy, oral suctioning, and placement of oropharyngeal or nasopharyngeal airways, as well as administering oxygen therapy and using an AMBU bag for ventilation. Provide cardiac management by applying 12-lead ECGs, performing CPR in emergency situations, and utilizing an AED to deliver defibrillation when required.

• Medication & Immunization Administration: Administer a variety of immunizations and medications according to protocols outlined in the ConvienientMD’s registered nurse scope of practice, ensuring accuracy and patient safety. Accurately process and call in prescriptions to the patient’s requested pharmacy in compliance with provider instructions.

• Patient Communication & Follow-Up: Handle patient follow-up calls, addressing inquiries about their care plan, sharing and explaining test results, and discussing any changes in medication or therapy. Maintain clear and empathetic communication with patients, ensuring they feel informed and supported throughout their care journey.

• Collaboration with Clinical Team: Work closely with other members of the clinical team to ensure seamless coordination of patient care. Communicate effectively and efficiently with providers and other healthcare professionals to relay patient information and updates. Welcome and support the training of new team clinic team members.

Required Availability

• Must be able to work 12-hour shifts in consecutive and or non-consecutive days: For full-time: Must be able to work three (3) 12-hour shifts a week with at least four (4) shifts a month on a Saturday or Sunday. For part-time: Must be able to work two (2) 12-hour shifts per week with at least two (2) shifts a month on a Saturday or Sunday. For per diem: Must be able to work four (4) 12-hour shifts per month, ideally working one (1) shift each week.

• Flexibility to work nights, weekends, holidays.

• If needed, must be able to work at a minimum of three (3) other ConvenientMD locations within a one (1) hour travel distance from your primary clinic.

• Required to travel for training shifts which may occur outside of your primary clinic within a one (1) hour commute.

Who You Are

• Education: Associate Degree in Nursing (ADN) or a Bachelor of Science in Nursing (BSN).

• Certification and demonstrated prior experience: State licensed registered nurse (RN) with prior experience placing and monitoring IVs.

• Basic Life Support (BLS) certification: American Heart Association or American Red Cross BLS certification. We do not accept CPR, ACLS certifications, or online only classes.

• Compassionate, authentic, and patient focused: Supports patients through kindness; demonstrating understanding for others and contributing to the creating a community of belonging.

• Proactive and confident communicator (written and verbal): Foreshadows and elevates concerns as they arise, unafraid of professional directness both with colleagues and patients.

• Trustworthy: Ability to maintain confidentiality and handle all patient information in accordance with HIPAA regulations.

• Effective communicator and cross collaborator: Ability to establish and maintain positive relationships with patients, team members, and stakeholders across the organization.

• Excellent team player: Enjoys collaborating with others and being a part of a strong team dynamic.

• Technically savvy: Proficient with Microsoft Office Suite or related software, experience with or ability to learn Experity as well as other business systems.

Bonus Qualifications

• 1-2 years of patient triage experience in an urgent care or emergency department preferred.

Why You'll Love Working With Us

• Collaborative team environment that encourages professional growth

• Urgent care services at no cost to our team members and their families

• Extensive benefit offerings including health, dental, and vision coverage, company paid short-term disability, and optional pet insurance

• 401k match after one year of service

• Access to our primary care (depending on location)

• Educational Alliance with Purdue University Global and reduced tuition rates for team members and their families

• Employer rewards and access to discounts offered on services and products such as hotels, travel, entertainment, restaurants, and more

There's a job and then there's purposeful, transformative work. Our aim is to create a workplace where you can learn, grow, and continuously refine your skills. Applicants rarely meet every single job requirement, and we appreciate that many skills and backgrounds can make people successful in this role. We are committed to creating a strong sense of belonging for all team members, and our process is designed to prevent discrimination against applicants regardless of gender identity, sexual orientation, religion, ethnicity, age, disability status, or any other aspect which makes you unique. If you’re looking for a great next step, and want to feel good about what you do, we’d love to hear from you.

jobs.title: Graphic Design & Technical Communications Co-Op
jobs.description:
Graphic Design & Technical Communications Co-Op

STR is seeking a creative, detail-oriented Graphic Design & Technical Communications Co-Op to support the development of compelling visual communications for complex engineering and technical projects. This role is ideal for a student who enjoys combining graphic design with analytical thinking and has an interest in learning about advanced technologies.

The primary focus of this position will be creating and refining technical presentations, particularly in Microsoft PowerPoint, to help engineers and researchers communicate sophisticated concepts clearly and effectively. The ideal candidate will be curious, collaborative, and comfortable working with technical subject matter experts to understand their work and translate complex information into accessible, visually engaging graphics and presentations.

Additional responsibilities will include supporting corporate branding efforts, maintaining visual consistency across presentation materials, and developing graphics for internal communications and signage.

This is for an in-person role at our Woburn, MA office, with an ideal start date in January 2027.

Key Responsibilities

Technical Presentation Design

• Design, develop, and refine professional PowerPoint presentations for technical, engineering, research, and business audiences.

• Collaborate directly with engineers and researchers to understand complex technical concepts and translate them into clear, effective visual representations.

• Create custom diagrams, illustrations, infographics, and other visual elements that communicate technical information accurately and intuitively.

• Transform dense technical content, including text, data, and conceptual descriptions, into well-organized, visually compelling slides.

• Improve existing presentations for clarity, readability, visual consistency, and overall effectiveness.

• Ensure presentation materials adhere to STR's established visual identity and brand standards.

Graphic Design & Branding

• Develop graphics and visual assets for internal communications, signage, and other corporate branding initiatives.

• Support the creation and maintenance of branded templates and reusable design assets.

• Apply consistent typography, color palettes, layouts, and visual styles across materials.

• Assist in updating and refining presentation and document templates in Microsoft PowerPoint and Word.

• Prepare graphics and design files for both digital and print applications.

Collaboration & Communication

• Work closely with engineers, scientists, and technical staff to understand the purpose, context, and key messages of their work.

• Ask thoughtful questions and demonstrate a willingness to learn unfamiliar technical concepts.

• Present design ideas, incorporate feedback, and iteratively refine visual materials.

• Balance technical accuracy with visual clarity, ensuring designs enhance rather than oversimplify the underlying information.

• Manage multiple assignments and meet project deadlines in a collaborative environment.

Required Qualifications

• Currently pursuing a degree in Graphic Design or a related field.

• Must be a U.S. citizen due to the nature of STR's work and applicable regulations.

• Proficiency in Microsoft PowerPoint including slide layouts, visual composition, charts, shapes, and presentation formatting.

• Working knowledge of Microsoft Word and document formatting.

• Experience with Adobe Creative Suite, particularly Illustrator, Photoshop, and InDesign.

• Strong visual communication skills, including typography, layout, information hierarchy, and composition.

• Demonstrated ability to organize complex information and communicate visually.

• Intellectual curiosity and a willingness to engage with unfamiliar engineering, scientific, or technical subject matter.

• Strong interpersonal and communication skills, including the ability to collaborate with people who may not have a design background.

• Attention to detail and an ability to apply brand standards consistently.

• A portfolio that demonstrates graphic design, presentation design, information visualization, or related work.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience developing or modifying PowerPoint templates, Slide Masters, custom layouts, and themes.

• Experience creating or maintaining Microsoft Word templates, including styles, themes, headers, footers, and document formatting standards.

• Experience designing presentations for professional, academic, or research audiences.

• Understanding of corporate brand identity systems and visual style guidelines.

Ideal Candidate

The successful candidate will be more than a traditional graphic designer. They will be a visual problem-solver who enjoys understanding how things work.

They do not need to arrive with an engineering background, but they should be excited by the opportunity to learn from engineers and scientists, ask questions, and find creative ways to explain complicated ideas. They should be equally comfortable designing a polished technical presentation, building a clear systems diagram, and applying consistent branding to corporate materials.

Above all, we are looking for someone who recognizes that effective technical design is not simply about making information look attractive – it is about making complex ideas easier to understand without sacrificing technical accuracy.

What You'll Gain

• Hands-on experience communicating advanced engineering and scientific concepts through visual design.

• Opportunities to collaborate directly with engineers, scientists, and technical professionals.

• Experience developing presentation materials for technical and professional audiences.

• Practical exposure to corporate branding, presentation standards, and document template development.

• Portfolio-worthy experience in technical communication, information design, and visual storytelling.

Pay Information
Hourly Range: $25.20-$54.00/hour

The salary range listed is based on external market data. Offers are based on factors, such as but not limited to, the candidate’s experience, education, training, key skills/critical skills, security clearances, and prevailing market and business conditions.

STR is a growing technology company with locations near Boston, MA, Arlington, VA, near Dayton, OH, Melbourne, FL, Carlsbad, CA, Atlanta, GA, and Denver, CO. We specialize in advanced research and development for defense, intelligence, and national security in: cyber; next generation sensors, radar, sonar, communications, and electronic warfare; and artificial intelligence algorithms and analytics to make sense of the complexity that is exploding around us.

STR is committed to creating a collaborative learning environment that supports deep technical understanding and recognizes the contributions and achievements of all team members. Our work is challenging, and we go home at night knowing that we pushed the envelope of technology and made the world safer.

STR is not just any company. Our people, culture, and attitude along with their unique set of skills, experiences, and perspectives put us on a trajectory to change the world. We can't do it alone, though - we need fellow trailblazers. If you are one, join our team and help to keep our society safe! Visit us at www.str.us for more info.

STR is an equal opportunity employer. We are fully dedicated to hiring the most qualified candidate regardless of race, color, religion, sex (including gender identity, sexual orientation and pregnancy), marital status, national origin, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.

If you need a reasonable accommodation for any portion of the employment process, email us at appassist@str.us and provide your contact info.

Pursuant to applicable federal law and regulations, positions at STR require employees to obtain national security clearances and satisfy the requirements for compliance with export control and other applicable laws.

jobs.title: Urgent Care - Paramedic (Urgent Care Technician)
jobs.description:
At ConvenientMD, we’re on a mission to make good health more convenient for all – working to improve how patients and providers experience healthcare in New England. To support this belief, we’re building a team of dedicated professionals who genuinely care about improving lives, are passionate about work that can make a difference, and are driven to learn from one another.

The Opportunity

ConvenientMD is seeking a dedicated Paramedic, who is a nationally registered EMT to join our team as an Urgent Care Technician. As a vital clinical team member, you will play an integral role in providing high-quality care to our patients, working alongside medical providers, and contributing to a supportive, collaborative environment. If you are a skilled paramedic looking for an opportunity to grow your career in a fast-paced setting, this position could be a great fit for you.

Your Impact

• Patient Care & Triage: Conduct comprehensive patient triage by taking vital signs, documenting medical history, and performing observational examinations to identify immediate healthcare needs. Assist with patient exams, ensuring all necessary equipment and documentation are prepared, while supporting providers during testing and procedures.

• Clinical Procedures: Perform diagnostic and testing procedures, including vision, hearing, drug screens, breath alcohol testing, spirometry, and more. Execute point-of-care testing such as strep, flu, RSV, SARS-CoV-2, glucose, lipid panel, and urinalysis. Provide cardiac and airway management, including ECGs, AED use, nebulizer treatments, and oxygen administration. Deliver wound care assessments, immunizations, and medication administration per federal and state regulations.

• Patient Engagement & Documentation: Assist with patient inquiries, communicate test results, and explain medication or therapy plans. Maintain accurate electronic medical records, documenting patient histories and treatment details. Observe and report changes in patients' conditions, taking necessary action as needed.

• Clinic Operations: Ensure medical instruments and equipment are clean, sterilized, and maintained per organizational policies. Maintain a stocked and sterile workspace, supporting smooth clinic operations.

• Collaboration with Clinical Team: Work closely with other members of the clinical team to ensure seamless coordination of patient care. Communicate effectively and efficiently with providers and other healthcare professionals to relay patient information and updates. Welcome and support the training of new team clinic team members.

Required Availability

• Must be able to work 12-hour shifts in consecutive and or non-consecutive days: For full-time: Must be able to work three (3) 12-hour shifts a week with at least four (4) shifts a month on a Saturday or Sunday. For part-time: Must be able to work two (2) 12-hour shifts per week with at least two (2) shifts a month on a Saturday or Sunday. For per diem: Must be able to work four (4) 12-hour shifts per month, ideally working one (1) shift each week.

• Flexibility to work nights, weekends, holidays.

• If needed, must be able to work at a minimum of three (3) other ConvenientMD locations within a one (1) hour travel distance from your primary clinic.

• Required to travel for training shifts which may occur outside of your primary clinic within a one (1) hour commute.

Who You Are

• Education: High school diploma or GED required.

• Certification and demonstrated prior experience: Licensed paramedic (preferably nationally certified) with prior experience placing and monitoring IVs.

• Basic Life Support (BLS) certification: American Heart Association or American Red Cross BLS certification. We do not accept CPR, ACLS certifications, or online only classes.

• Compassionate, authentic, and patient focused: Supports patients through kindness; demonstrating understanding for others and contributing to the creating a community of belonging.

• Proactive and confident communicator (written and verbal): Foreshadows and elevates concerns as they arise, unafraid of professional directness both with colleagues and patients.

• Trustworthy: Ability to maintain confidentiality and handle all patient information in accordance with HIPAA regulations.

• Effective communicator and cross collaborator: Ability to establish and maintain positive relationships with patients, team members, and stakeholders across the organization.

• Excellent team player: Enjoys collaborating with others and being a part of a strong team dynamic.

• Technically savvy: Proficient with Microsoft Office Suite or related software, experience with or ability to learn Experity as well as other business systems.

Bonus Qualifications

• 1-2 years of patient triage experience in an urgent care or emergency department preferred.

Why You'll Love Working With Us

• Collaborative team environment that encourages professional growth

• Urgent care services at no cost to our team members and their families

• Extensive benefit offerings including health, dental, and vision coverage, company paid short-term disability, and optional pet insurance

• 401k match after one year of service

• Access to our primary care (depending on location)

• Educational Alliance with Purdue University Global and reduced tuition rates for team members and their families

• Employer rewards and access to discounts offered on services and products such as hotels, travel, entertainment, restaurants, and more

There's a job and then there's purposeful, transformative work. Our aim is to create a workplace where you can learn, grow, and continuously refine your skills. Applicants rarely meet every single job requirement, and we appreciate that many skills and backgrounds can make people successful in this role. We are committed to creating a strong sense of belonging for all team members, and our process is designed to prevent discrimination against applicants regardless of gender identity, sexual orientation, religion, ethnicity, age, disability status, or any other aspect which makes you unique. If you’re looking for a great next step, and want to feel good about what you do, we’d love to hear from you.

It is unlawful in Massachusetts to require or administer a lie detector test as a condition of employment or continued employment. An employer who violates this law shall be subject to criminal penalties and civil liability.

jobs.title: Director, Infrastructure & Data Platforms
jobs.description:
Immunovant, Inc. is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company dedicated to enabling normal lives for people with autoimmune diseases. As trailblazers in FcRn inhibitor technology, the Company is boldly developing innovative therapies for a range of debilitating autoimmune diseases with significant unmet patient needs.

Organizational Overview:

Immunovant, Inc. is a clinical-stage immunology company dedicated to enabling normal lives for people with autoimmune diseases. As trailblazer in anti-FcRn technology, the Company is developing innovative, targeted therapies to meet the complex and variable needs of people with autoimmune diseases.

The Role:

Reporting to the Senior Director, Infrastructure & Operations, this deeply technical, hands-on leader architects, builds, secures, supports, and continuously improves the company’s infrastructure and data platforms. The role operates core infrastructure, cloud, identity, security, data, and DevOps capabilities; serves as the senior escalation point for business needs; leads technical architecture for enterprise system implementations; and owns the data warehouse, MDM, and governed AI enablement, including MCP integrations. The position combines individual execution, vendor direction, and future people management.

Key Responsibilities:

Roadmap & Execution

• Partner with IT leadership to define infrastructure, security, and data roadmaps with clear priorities, budgets, and sourcing decisions.

• Execute roadmaps end to end with clear milestones, reporting, and measurable outcomes.

Infrastructure, Cloud & DevOps

• Own the architecture and hands-on engineering of Microsoft 365, Okta, Azure, endpoint, network, and collaboration platforms. Provide monitoring, support, troubleshooting, and Tier-3 escalation for complex issues.

• Lead identity, zero trust, and network architecture, including Okta and Zscaler.

• Implement DevOps practices across infrastructure, data, AI, and application integrations. Use infrastructure as code, source control, automated testing, CI/CD, monitoring, and alerting to improve security, reliability, and recovery.

• Own infrastructure lifecycle and capacity planning, business continuity, disaster recovery, and backup testing.

IT Security Operations

• Lead hands-on security operations across vulnerability management, endpoint, email, identity, cloud, monitoring, and incident response. Establish procedures, coordinate remediation, and maintain clear escalation ownership.

• Embed security by design across infrastructure. Define requirements, review configurations, drive remediation, and support audits and CSV/CSA compliance under the IT QMS.

Data Warehousing, MDM & AI Enablement

• Own the architecture, engineering, and operation of the enterprise data warehouse and supporting platforms. Build secure data pipelines for BI, analytics, and AI.

• Lead MDM and data management practices.

• Build and support governed AI capabilities, including MCP servers and integrations that connect approved AI tools to enterprise systems.

Operations, Support & Project Technical Leadership

• Serve as the senior technical SME and escalation point for IT operations. Resolve complex issues and drive problem management with the service desk MSP and Client Services team.

• Provide hands-on architecture and technical leadership for IT projects and business system implementations. Oversee design, integrations, security, testing, migration, cutover, stabilization, and operational handoff.

• Provide technical direction to the Infrastructure teams and, as the team grows, manage and develop direct reports.

Vendor Management & Delivery

• Direct MSPs, cloud vendors, and implementation partners.

• Define requirements and SOWs, enforce SLAs, scale external capacity, and support technical budgets.

jobs.title: Senior Robotics Engineer

jobs.description:
Motional is a leading autonomous driving company on a mission to make driverless vehicles a safe, reliable, and accessible reality. Backed by Hyundai Motor Group, Motional is at the forefront of the physical AI revolution. Motional isn’t just building first-of-its-kind technology; we are transforming transportation to create safer streets and more sustainable mobility options.

The Systems Readiness and Performance team is the crucial bridge between software development and real-world deployment. We are responsible for driving system design, for verifying and validating the autonomy stack, and for defining, measuring, and validating system performance targets. We work closely with stakeholders in autonomy, infrastructure, and operations to build the definitive safety case for the commercial launch of our fully driverless IONIQ 5 robotaxis in Las Vegas later this year.

We are seeking a highly skilled and autonomous Senior Robotics Engineer to play a critical role in investigating and diagnosing complex autonomous vehicle (AV) behaviors across on-road, resimulation, and synthetic simulation environments. This engineer will be responsible for taking end-to-end ownership of ambiguous problem spaces, utilizing Python, custom Spaceship tooling, and data visualization platforms to effectively perform root-cause analysis on emergent behaviors across our autonomy stack. Their work will directly contribute to accelerating the development of safe and reliable autonomous technologies by transforming deep technical debugging into clear summaries that support unified release narratives and executive insights.

What You'll Be Doing

• System Diagnosis & Root Cause Analysis: Perform deep technical investigations of undesirable AV behaviors across simulation, HIL, and on-road operations. Take end-to-end ownership of complex investigations, driving solutions autonomously from initial triage to final resolution with little to no oversight.

• Cross-Subsystem Debugging: Debug behaviors across perception, prediction, localization, planning, controls, and vehicle systems. Reason across subsystem boundaries to diagnose emergent behaviors resulting from component interactions.

• Data Analysis & Tooling: Analyze large datasets from system logs, telemetry, and software outputs using Python. Develop automated diagnostic workflows and custom internal tooling using Python and Spaceship to increase the speed and scale of investigations.

• Performance Visualization: Design and build interactive dashboards using Python frameworks and Business Intelligence tools (e.g., Looker) to effectively measure, analyze, and report on the performance of our AV systems.

• Hypothesis Generation: Develop technical hypotheses from incomplete or ambiguous evidence, distinguish behavioral symptoms from underlying root causes, and design analyses to systematically test potential causes.

• Problem Space Identification: Autonomously identify recurring undesirable behaviors, regressions, and emerging system-level performance issues, categorizing them into meaningful failure modes.

• Technical Storytelling & Synthesis: "Dive deep" into technical complexities to uncover root causes, then step back to synthesize findings. Translate raw performance metrics into clear summaries that support executive-level reporting, unified release narratives, and cross-functional communication.

What We're Looking For

• Education: Bachelor's degree in Engineering (Computer Science, Electrical, Systems, Robotics) or equivalent work experience, with a Master's degree considered a strong plus.

• Robotics Experience: 5+ years of professional software or systems engineering experience working on safety-critical, complex systems such as Autonomous Vehicles, Robotics, Medical Devices, or Aerospace. Thorough understanding of robotics systems including sensors, actuators, and software autonomy stacks.

• Data & Analytics Expertise: Strong proficiency in Python for data analysis and scripting, backed by a strong understanding of modern software development principles. Experience building data visualizations using Python frameworks, with a willingness to learn Business Intelligence tools (e.g., Looker).

• Systems Thinking & Quality: Strong analytical and problem-solving skills for complex system performance evaluation. Ability to think logically, remove bias, perform root cause analysis using system logs, and maintain a strict commitment to data quality and rigorous testing.

• Engineering Workflows: Proficient with Git and standard version control workflows, and entirely comfortable working in a fast-paced, agile, continuous integration/continuous delivery (CI/CD) environment.

• Autonomy & Communication: Proven ability to work both independently and effectively as part of a multidisciplinary team. Excellent communication skills with the ability to synthesize complex technical findings into clear summaries that support cross-functional teams and executive leadership.

Bonus Points (not required)

• Experience using AV-specific software diagnostic and visualization tools (e.g., Planner Analyzer) to troubleshoot complex autonomy behaviors.

• Knowledge of statistical analysis and machine learning techniques relevant to performance evaluation.

Success Metrics

• Core Diagnosis & RCA: Effective execution of deep technical investigations that accurately isolate the underlying root causes of complex, cross-subsystem AV behaviors and translate them into actionable engineering resolutions.

• Diagnostic Automation: Successful implementation of robust, automated diagnostic workflows that significantly reduce the time required to triage and resolve anomalous AV behaviors.

• Technical Synthesis & Insights: Consistent delivery of accurate, high-impact data visualizations and clear summaries that directly accelerate AV development and system maturity.

This is a unique opportunity to make a meaningful impact at Motional by enhancing our diagnostic capabilities, improving system reliability, and accelerating development speed for our industry-leading autonomous vehicle ecosystem. We take pride in having some of the brightest and most dedicated talent in the world on our team. If you're innovative, driven, and eager to tackle challenges, we'd love to have you join us!

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors including but not limited to specific skills, experience and expertise, role location, certifications, licenses, and business needs. The estimated compensation range listed in this job posting reflects base salary only. This role may include additional forms of compensation such as a bonus or company equity. The recruiter assigned to this role can share more information about the specific compensation and benefit details associated with this role during the hiring process.

Candidates for certain positions are eligible to participate in Motional’s benefits program. Motional’s benefits include but are not limited to medical, dental, vision, 401k with a company match, health saving accounts, life insurance, pet insurance, and more.

Salary Range

$149,000—$198,500 USD

Motional is a driverless technology company making autonomous vehicles a safe, reliable, and accessible reality. We’re driven by something more.

Our journey is always people first.

We aren't just developing driverless cars; we're creating safer roadways, more equitable transportation options, and making our communities better places to live, work, and connect. Our team is made up of engineers, researchers, innovators, dreamers and doers, who are creating a technology with the potential to transform the way we move.

Higher purpose, greater impact.

We’re creating first-of-its-kind technology that will transform transportation. To do so successfully, we must design for everyone in our cities and on our roads. We believe in building a great place to work through a progressive, global culture that is diverse, inclusive, and ensures people feel valued at every level of the organization. Diversity helps us to see the world differently; it’s not only good for our business, it’s the right thing to do.

Scale up, not starting up.

Our team is behind some of the industry's largest leaps forward, including the first fully-autonomous cross-country drive in the U.S, the launch of the world's first robotaxi pilot, and operation of the world's longest-standing public robotaxi fleet. We’re driven to scale; we’re moving towards commercialization of our technology, and we need team members who are ready to embrace change and challenges.

Formed as a joint venture between Hyundai Motor Group and Aptiv, Motional is fundamentally changing how people move through their lives. Headquartered in Boston, Motional has operations in the U.S and Asia. For more information, visit  www.Motional.com and follow us on Twitter, LinkedIn, Instagram and YouTube.

POSITION OVERVIEW:

The Project Manager drives project planning, risk management, resource alignment, and operational execution while supporting strategic priorities, transformation initiatives, integration activities, and client-focused business objectives across the CMO/CDMO industry.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Develop, maintain, and manage detailed project plans, timelines, workstreams, and implementation roadmaps utilizing tools such as Microsoft Project, Smartsheet, or similar project management platforms.

jobs.title: Senior Controller
jobs.description:
ABOUT BASIC CAPITAL

Basic Capital is a fintech company disrupting America's $1T retirement industry by building the mortgage for retirement, unlocking market ownership, and making wealth accessible to every American. Our mission is to create products, platforms, and a credit marketplace that power a fundamentally new retirement system.

Our founding team includes leaders from Goldman Sachs, Uber, Block, Stripe, and Robinhood. We're backed by top investors such as Lux Capital, Forerunner Ventures, BoxGroup, SVAngel, Inspired Capital, and Henry Kravis. Based in Tribeca, NYC, we're assembling a lean, high-performance team committed to reducing wealth inequality. This role is optionally fully remote within the United States.

For more information, visit Basic Capital's website https://www.basiccapital.com/.




THIS ROLE

We are hiring our first Controller to own accounting, tax, and finance operations at Basic Capital. This individual will manage proprietary investments on our platform that are held through individual LLCs, specifically the annual accounting and tax requirements.

You will own accounting and tax for this portfolio: books, reconciliations, annual partnership filings, and the monthly reporting we send to lenders and capital partners. You will also support the company’s own finances, from monthly close and budgeting to AP, AR, and payments.

This is a builder role. You will set up the processes, controls, and automation that let this work scale from thousands of entities to tens of thousands, working directly with our engineering and capital markets teams.




YOU WILL

 - Own accounting and administration for over 1,000 individual LLCs, including the monthly loan tape and servicing tape

 - Prepare and file year-end tax returns and K-1s for every LLC

 - Partner with engineering to automate accounting workflows using AI, and do deep data work to keep every entity reconciled

 - Oversee corporate accounting and payments as the company grows

 - Support corporate accounting and operations for Basic Capital: monthly close, budgeting and forecasting, accounts payable, accounts receivable, payroll and payments

 - Build the controls, policies, and audit readiness a growing financial company needs

 


REQUIRED COMPETENCIES

 - Experience with partnership or LLC accounting, including capital accounts, allocations, and K-1s

 - Hands-on experience preparing partnership returns in UltraTax CS or similar professional tax software, such as CCH Axcess Tax, CCH ProSystem fx, Lacerte, or GoSystem Tax RS

 - Controller-level experience, including monthly close, budgeting, AP/AR, and financial reporting

 - Strong data skills, with comfort in SQL, advanced Excel, or both

 


PREFERRED COMPETENCIES

 - Active CPA license

 - Tax experience, ideally with partnerships, funds, or multi-entity structures

 - Structured finance accounting experience (e.g., securitizations, loan tapes, SPVs, or warehouse facilities)

 - Experience in lending, consumer finance, or fund administration

 - Experience working with engineers to build or automate financial workflows

 


CULTURAL FIT

 - High agency: You believe the world is malleable and want to shape it to your vision.

 - High tastes: You have strong opinions on what “good” looks like in your field. Craftsmanship matters.

 - Friction friendly: We debate pretty hard. Friction polishes the work. You challenge and expect to be challenged. Compromise leads to mediocrity.

 - Tenacity: Relentless work ethic in the face of adversity and rejection.

 - Grand ambition: We’re energized by people’s dreams, for the world and for themselves. Energize us.

jobs.title: Senior AI Developer
jobs.description:
We’re looking for a Senior AI Engineer to design, build, and deliver production AI/ML systems. This role is ideal for an engineer with several years of experience who can confidently own features end-to-end, contribute to architectural decisions, and bring strong technical judgment to the problems they take on.

In this role, you will work as a key contributor on a cross-functional team, designing and implementing models, building the data pipelines and training workflows around them, and deploying systems to production environments. You’ll be joining real, in-flight work where reliability, performance, and scalability matter. You’ll collaborate with experienced engineers to enhance existing systems, deliver new capabilities, and contribute to the technical decisions that shape how our AI work scales over time.

Why This Role Matters

At Robots & Pencils, we design AI systems for a human world. Our name says it all. Robots and pencils means engineering paired with creativity, because every agent we ship has to work for real people in real workflows. That balance is baked into how we operate.

Every role here contributes directly to that mission. Here, you shape how AI systems integrate into enterprise operations, how teams move at real velocity, and how products create measurable impact for clients and the people they serve. We ship production-ready AI in 30 to 45 days. That pace demands people who take ownership, lead with craft, and care deeply about what they put their name on.

What You’ll Do

Craft & Delivery

• Design, implement, and deploy ML/AI models end-to-end, from concept through production, including data pipelines, training workflows, and optimization for performance, accuracy, and efficiency

• Maintain and evolve AI systems in production, monitoring for drift, debugging issues, and driving ongoing improvements to reliability and scalability

• Bring an AI-forward coding mindset to your daily work, using tools like Claude and Cursor to ship higher-quality work at pace

Collaboration & Communication

• Partner closely with product, engineering, and data teams to align AI work with broader product and business goals

• Translate technical tradeoffs, model behavior, and constraints into terms non-specialists can act on

• Participate actively in code reviews and design discussions, raising concerns and offering constructive feedback

Leadership & Influence

• Contribute to AI architecture decisions with thoughtful perspective on tradeoffs and long-term implications

• Take ownership of meaningful work end-to-end, including the unglamorous parts of getting AI into production

• Raise the bar on engineering practices through your own work and by supporting more junior engineers when opportunities arise

What You’ll Bring

• 4+ years professional software engineering experience, with 2+ years focused on AI/ML systems in production and hands-on experience with generative AI development

• Strong software engineering background (Python or similar)

• Working knowledge of cloud platforms, preferably with in-depth understanding of AWS services and AWS GenAI offerings

• Proven ability to design and ship agentic systems

• Experience with AI frameworks and orchestration tools

• Experience with evaluation frameworks, and observability tools for LLM apps

• Understanding of AI safety, responsible AI principles, prompt injection defenses, and PII handling

• Hands-on experience building RAG pipelines: chunking strategies, embedding models, vector databases

• API development experience, including designing and integrating with internal and third-party services

• Cost optimization expertise: token economics, caching strategies, model routing, quantization

• Working knowledge of Docker and Kubernetes for containerized deployments

• Demonstrable, day-to-day usage and knowledge of AI-forward coding tools such as Claude Code and Cursor

• Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to navigate ambiguous technical challenges with sound judgment

Helpful Extras and Unique Skills

You’ll Do Well Here if You Are

• A doer. You see something broken and fix it. You'd rather move on clarity than wait for certainty.

• A fast learner who knows you don't know everything. The AI landscape changes weekly. You're senior enough to know better and curious enough to keep learning anyway.

• Direct in a way that makes the work better. You give honest feedback. You'd rather have the hard conversation than blow smoke.

• Obsessed with craft. You know genius is in the details. You ship exceptional, not perfect, and you don't put your name on work you wouldn't stand behind.

• Built for ownership. You honor commitments, admit mistakes fast, and back your teammates when a decision costs something. No handoffs, no finger-pointing.

• All in. You treat clients' businesses like your own. You take the work seriously without taking yourself seriously.

• Resourceful when the budget, timeline, or team is tight. Constraints don't slow you down. They sharpen you.

• Glad to be in the room with people who care as much as you do. Our teams average fifteen-plus years of experience. We hire people who push each other to do better work.

Salary Range -  $ 139,750 - 188,125 USD

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Infrastructure Modelling
jobs.description:
ABOUT FLUIDSTACK

We exist to make humanity more free. For most of human history, you farmed or you starved. Technology gave people more time for the things they wanted to do, instead of things they had to do. Powerful AI will be the biggest lever for human choice we've ever built - but only if models are aligned with what humanity actually wants. There are groups building AI who don't share these goals. Whoever deploys frontier compute infrastructure fastest will decide whether AI expands human freedom or shrinks it. 


We're singularly focused on delivering 10 to 100s of GWs of compute faster than anyone else, rethinking every layer of the stack. We acquire power, design and build data centers, and operate them - with teams spanning hardware and software. Speed and scale are our key differentiators. Come be a part of building civilization-scale infrastructure for AI.


We hire people who care deeply about this problem space. If that is you, please apply!




HOW WE OPERATE

 - Be a barrel. Full autonomy. Own things end to end, take on scope without being asked, no permission required to operate outside your core role.

 - Insane urgency. We drive everything forward as fast as possible.

 - Reason from first principles. Challenge every assumption. Zero analogy thinking, no egos, the best idea wins.

 - Love of the game. The frontier of AI is the most interesting problem of our time. We put in long hours at high intensity to push the frontier forward.

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, Backend (Observability)
jobs.description:
At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.

The Observability team builds the platform every Affirm engineer relies on to understand the behavior and performance of our systems. Our platform ingests 200+ TB/day of metrics, logs, and traces from hundreds of services across 80+ Kubernetes clusters, and when a user's checkout fails, our data is how engineers find out why. Over the next year, we’re moving to wide events, with one context-rich event per request, improving the signal-to-noise ratio to make debugging faster. We’re also introducing log sampling and building observability best practices into agentic development and code review, so that AI-assisted code is well instrumented by default.

We’re looking for a Staff Software Engineer to be the technical lead for Observability. You’ll spend most of your time hands-on while defining the roadmap, driving cross-functional projects, mentoring a team of six engineers, and partnering closely with infrastructure and product teams.

What You'll Do

· You will own the architecture of Affirm’s telemetry pipeline, balancing reliability, query performance, and cost at 200+ TB/day.
· You will design log sampling strategies that significantly reduce volume and cost without losing the signal engineers need during incidents.
· You will shape how observability fits into agentic development, so that AI coding agents and code review catch instrumentation gaps before code ships.
· You will be responsible for setting technical strategy for your team on a year-long time scale, and help your team tie it together with critical, business-impacting projects.
· You will collaborate across teams in the product development lifecycle by collaborating with product management, design & analytics to ensure technical sustainability, risks and trade-offs are well understood and managed.
· You will act as a force-multiplier for your team through your definition and advocacy of technical solutions and operational processes.
· You take ownership of your team’s operations and availability by ensuring you have the right monitoring, triage rotations, playbooks, polcities, testing and alerting in place to support “keep the lights on” & on-call efforts.
· You will foster a culture of quality and ownership on your team by setting code review and design standards for your team, and advocating for them beyond your team through your writing and tech talks.
· You will help develop talent on your team by providing feedback and guidance, and leading by example.

What We Look For

· You have 8+ years of experience designing, developing and launching backend systems at scale using languages like Python or Kotlin.
· You have an extensive track record of developing highly available distributed systems using technologies like AWS, MySQL, Flink and Kubernetes.
· You have built or operated high-volume telemetry systems (metrics, logs, and/or traces) using technologies like OpenTelemetry, Kafka, and Terraform.
· You have a well-informed point of view on modern observability practices such as structured and wide events, sampling, cardinality management, and SLOs.
· You have driven adoption of a platform standard across many engineering teams, through both tooling and engagement.
· You have experience delivering major features, system components or deprecating existing functionality in a system through the definition of a technical and execution plan. You write high quality code that is easily understood and used by others.
· You thrive in ambiguity, and are comfortable moving from low level language idioms all the way to the architecture of large systems to understand how they work.
· Your growth and impact trajectory demonstrates that you have mastered gathering and iterating on feedback from your engineering and cross-functional peers.
· You have strong verbal and written communication skills that support effective collaboration with our global engineering team.
· This position requires either equivalent practical experience or a Bachelor’s degree in a related field.

Base Pay Grade - P

Equity Grade - 13

Employees new to Affirm typically come in at the start of the pay range. Affirm focuses on providing a simple and transparent pay structure which is based on a variety of factors, including location, experience and job-related skills.

Base pay is part of a total compensation package that may include equity rewards, monthly stipends for health, wellness and tech spending, and benefits (including 100% subsidized medical coverage, dental and vision for you and your dependents.)

USA base pay range (all other U.S. states): $204,000 - $264,000

#LI-Remote

Remote-first with flexibility built in
Affirm is proud to be a remote-first company. Most roles can be done from almost anywhere within the country of employment. Some positions may occasionally require in-person work at an Affirm office, and a few are office-based due to the nature of the work. All new hires will be invited to attend an in-person onboarding experience.

Benefits designed for you
Our benefits reflect our commitment to care, transparency, and flexibility. Here are a few highlights:

• Health coverage at no cost: We cover 100% of premiums for employees and their dependents.

• Spending stipends: Monthly stipends support your tech setup, and the ability to choose health and wellness options that are right for you.

• Time off to recharge: Flexible time off and generous holiday calendars help you rest when you need to.

We’re committed to providing an inclusive interview process, including accommodations for candidates with disabilities. If you need support, we’re happy to help.

jobs.title: Sr. Director, Talent Acquisition
jobs.description:
Sr. Director, Talent Acquisition

Job Location: United States, Remote

About the company:

Salesloft is building the next era of enterprise revenue — one where teams make confident decisions powered by AI and real signals. By combining our scale, insights, and AI innovation, we're building the industry's first Predictive Revenue System, enabling humans and AI to work together to make smarter decisions and drive consistent growth.

With thousands of customers using our platforms every day, we have an unmatched view into how revenue is actually won — the Revenue Context that reveals what happens, when, and with what outcome. This gives us a unique opportunity to transform an entire category and set a new benchmark for how modern revenue teams operate.

Join us to help transform how companies around the world run revenue — and build the platform that will guide leading revenue teams into the future.

About the role

We are hiring a Sr. Director of Talent Acquisition to lead a small, high-performing global team that hires at high volume and high speed. You will set the strategy, own the metrics, and still roll up your sleeves when a critical search needs it. You will partner with business leaders across the US, Canada, Mexico, and India, and use AI to make recruiting faster, fairer, and measurably better.

What you'll do

• Own the global TA strategy and operating plan, balancing speed, quality, and cost across a large volume of open requisitions.

• Lead and develop a lean team of recruiters and sourcers across North America and India; set clear expectations, coach to performance, and make hard calls on capacity and prioritization.

• Define and run a KPI framework (for example time to fill, pipeline health, offer acceptance, quality of hire, hiring manager satisfaction, recruiter productivity). Review it on a regular cadence and act on what it shows.

• Build and apply AI across the recruiting lifecycle, including sourcing, screening, scheduling, outreach, reporting, and recruiter performance insights. Measure the efficiency and quality gains, and retire what does not work.

• Run recruiting in the US, Canada, Mexico, and India, adapting to local market practices, compensation norms, employment regulations, and talent availability. Partner with Legal and People on compliance.

• Manage and optimize agency and vendor relationships: when to use them, how to hold them accountable, and how to reduce reliance over time.

• Act as a trusted advisor to executives, hiring managers, and People leadership. Run intake and workforce planning conversations, push back with data, and keep stakeholders aligned.

• Move between strategy and execution: build the plan in the morning, close the candidate in the afternoon.

• Partner with Finance, People Ops, and Talent Brand on headcount planning, forecasting, employer brand, DEI goals, and candidate experience.

• Build the TA leadership bench: hire, develop, and promote recruiting managers, senior recruiters, and sourcers; define career paths and succession plans.

• Run the team's operating rhythm, including weekly pipeline reviews, monthly business reviews, quarterly planning, and regular reporting to the executive team.

• Own the TA budget, including headcount, agency and vendor spend, tools, and job board and event costs. Forecast capacity against the hiring plan and make the case for investment.

• Lead TA technology strategy: ATS configuration, sourcing and scheduling tools, analytics, and vendor selection and renewals.

• Build scalable, consistent hiring practices, including structured interviewing, intake standards, interviewer training, offer approval, and candidate experience.

• Lead through change: reorganizations, hiring surges and freezes, reprioritization, and integration of acquired teams.

What you bring

• 10+ years in talent acquisition, with 5+ years leading TA teams, ideally including a Director-level or higher role. [Confirm]

• Experience in fast-paced, high-growth, or dynamic environments with high requisition volume and a small team.

• Direct experience recruiting in North America (US, Canada, Mexico) and India, and an understanding of how each market differs.

• A clear point of view on performance management and KPIs, with examples of setting goals, holding people accountable, and coaching up or out.

• Experience in both agency and corporate recruiting.

• Demonstrable examples of using AI to improve recruiting efficiency and performance management, with outcomes you can quantify.

• Strong relationship management and stakeholder skills, including with senior leaders.

• Fluency with an ATS and recruiting analytics. [Name your ATS]

• Comfort with ambiguity and with shifting priorities as the business changes.

• A track record of building and leading TA teams through growth and change, including hiring, developing, and retaining recruiting managers and individual contributors.

• Experience managing leaders and managers, plus a distributed team across multiple countries and time zones.

• Experience owning a TA budget and a hiring plan, including capacity modeling and agency and vendor spend.

• Experience building or rebuilding a recruiting operating model: team structure, process, tooling, and reporting.

• Experience presenting TA strategy and results to executive and board-level audiences, and partnering with Finance on workforce planning.

• Experience leading a team through a reorganization, hiring surge, or slowdown, and keeping morale and performance up.

Nice to have

• Experience in B2B SaaS or technology.

• Experience scaling TA through growth, restructuring, or M&A.

• Experience hiring across engineering, sales, and go-to-market roles.

• Working knowledge of employment practices in Mexico and India.

It is Salesloft’s intent to pay all Lofters competitive wages and salaries that are motivational, fair and equitable.  The goal of Salesloft’s compensation program is to be transparent, attract potential employees, meet the needs of all current employees and encourage employees to stay with our organization.

Actual compensation packages are based on several factors that are unique to each candidate, including but not limited to skill set, depth of experience, certifications, and specific work location.

The total compensation package for this position may also include performance bonus, benefits and/or other applicable incentive compensation plans.

Base Pay Range

$190,000—$280,000 USD

The primary responsibilities are to manage the project team and to plan, direct, coordinate, and budget activities concerned with specific construction projects. The Construction Project Manager is also responsible for ensuring compliance with corporate Health, Safety, and Environmental (HSE) and Construction Quality Control policy for all assigned projects.

The Construction Project Manager - Traveling shall have experience managing at-risk construction projects ranging from $3M to $20M in size. Job requirements may include travel, temporary duty assignments, or relocations. Willingness to travel for project assignments is a must.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:
•    Manage construction and design/build proposals to include planning, estimating, scheduling, subcontracting, detailing technical and management approach, past performance, and HSE and Quality compliance.
•    Prepare baseline performance plans and develop metrics for assigned projects to include baseline costs and planned gross margin, baseline schedule and milestone dates, and projected cash flow.
•    Financial performance and reporting of assigned projects including monthly forecasting, managing commitments, and monitoring costs incurred. Responsible for delivering the project for as-bid gross profit or more.
•    Safety performance to ensure compliance with corporate policy and site-specific health and safety plan, incident reporting, and implementing corrective actions as necessary. Responsible for endorsing a zero-tolerance environment on site.
•    Quality performance to ensure compliance with roles and responsibilities are understood, contract documents are adhered to, and the delivered project meets the contractual and design requirements.
•    Client Management to ensure the owner is always informed and current on the project status and open issues are resolved promptly.  Responsible for owner satisfaction with the end-product leading to repeat work and exceptional project references.
•    Manage the project team with the pre-qualification, selection, and contracting of design professionals and directing the design process, and monitor their progress in terms of design appropriateness, design to budgets, and schedule to meet the needs of the project.
•    Manage the project team with the pre-qualification, selection, and subcontracting of construction trade subcontractors and with the procurement of vendor equipment as necessary.
•    Manage the development and implementation of a project risk register and change order log to identify, track, and mitigate potential risks to the successful completion of the project.
•    Manage efforts to obtain the necessary permits, environmental approvals, and licenses necessary to construct the projects.
•    Manage and mentor project team on an ongoing basis. Proactively facilitate in resolving conflicts within the project team.
•    Ensure the project team endorses a partnering environment with Owners, supervisory personnel, contractors, and design professionals to discuss and resolve matters such as work procedures, RFIs, change control and management, and any issues that may come upon the projects.

EDUCATION and/or EXPERIENCE:
•    Bachelor’s degree in construction management, engineering, architecture, or equivalent.  Five years of industry experience and a PMP or CCM certification may be substituted for the degree requirement.
•    Minimum of 5 years’ experience as a Project Manager or Construction Manager.
•    Strong leadership skills that demonstrate the ability to lead a team of individuals to accomplish the project vision, goals, and objectives.
•    Strong communication skills, and the ability to work well with clients.
•    Knowledge of the built environment infrastructure, including buildings and infrastructure.
•    Experience as a Construction Project Manager, which should encompass all aspects of a project or program life-cycle, from planning and design management, procurement, construction management, commissioning, and closeout.
•    Understanding of critical path method scheduling, and ability to direct a planner/scheduler in constructing a CPM schedule.
•    Understanding of Earned Value management procedures.
•    Well versed in managing cash flows, and budgets.
•    Management of Project Controls (Cost, schedule, budget, procurement, document control).
•    Experience in managing general contractors and trade subcontractors.
•    Certified Construction Manager (CCM) from CMAA is a plus.
•    A certificate as a Project Management Professional (PMP) is a plus.

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS:
•    Ability to navigate and move around the construction site, which may involve walking, climbing ladders and scaffolding, and standing for extended periods on uneven surfaces.
•    Ability to lift to 50 pounds.
•    Ability to handle tools, equipment, and perform tasks that require coordination and manual skills.
•    Manual dexterity, hearing, mental acuity, typing, reaching, repetitive motion, speaking, talking, and visual acuity.
•    Ability to operate a motor vehicle.
•    Ability to stand and sit for periods longer than 30 minutes but not to exceed two hours consecutively.
•    Ability to print and draw letters, numbers, words, characters, and symbols that are legible and understood by others.
•    Ability to learn complex tasks and remember how to complete tasks without assistance once trained.
•    Ability to control behavior when encountering stressful situations or short deadlines and to maintain a high level of concentration.
•    Quick thinking and decision-making ability to address issues and challenges that may arise during construction.
•    Endurance to work in various weather conditions and handle the physical demands of supervising a construction project.
•    Strict adherence to safety protocols and the ability to enforce safety standards on the construction site.
•    Adherence to personal protective equipment (PPE) requirements when on the construction site, such as hard hats, safety vests, and steel-toed boots.

jobs.title: Coding Consultant Outpatient - PRN
jobs.description:
Datavant is the data collaboration platform trusted for healthcare. Guided by our mission to make the world’s health data secure, accessible and actionable, we provide critical data solutions for organizations across the healthcare ecosystem - including providers, health plans, researchers, and life sciences companies. From fulfilling a single patient’s request for their medical records to powering the AI revolution in healthcare, Datavanters are building the future of how data is connected and used to improve health.

By joining Datavant today, you’re stepping onto a driven and highly collaborative team that is passionate about creating transformative change in healthcare.

We’re looking for experienced and credentialed outpatient coders to become an integral part of our team. The ideal candidate for this role possesses high attention to detail and a depth of knowledge in medical terminology. This role is fully remote with a flexible schedule, allowing you to help shape the future of healthcare from your own workspace!

We are looking for the following experiences/skills:

• strong ED coder with 5+ years' experience. The ideal candidate will have experience in facility E/M leveling, injections/infusions, and bedside procedures. CCS Required and experience in EPIC and 3M/Solventum required as well.

• experienced Outpatient Same-Day Surgery/Observation (OP SDS/OBS) coder with a minimum of two years of relevant coding experience. A current CCS certification is required, along with experience using Epic and 3M. Experience reviewing and clearing coding edits would be helpful.

• ED/Ambulatory Surgical coder for Level III trauma facility for 15-20 hours/week. Required experience in facility ED E/M leveling, injections and infusions, ortho, urology, pain management, cardiology GI procedures, and endos. Interventional radiology a plus but not required.

• Observation coder with extensive injection and infusion experience. Academic or trauma level 1 experience preferred. Carving out experience preferred but not required. Surgery coding experience would be very helpful

• Outpatient Same-Day Surgery/Observation (OP SDS/OBS) with 3+ years of experience. Surgery expertise includes, but not limited to, General Surgery, Ortho, Plastics and Reconstruction, including breast reconstruction, revision, augmentation, mastectomy, Otolaryngology, Spinal fusions and injections, Cardiology including pacemakers, Transesophageal Echocardiogram, Interventional Radiology, OB/Gyne, Nephrology, Endoscopy, US guidance, and Robotic Procedures. Must be able to code both SDS and OBS and be familiar with Rev Code assignment for surgeries. No injections and infusions or OBS time carveouts. CCS required and experience with EPIC/3M required as well.

• Outpatient Coder with expertise in Emergency Department (ED), I&I, procedures, modifiers, and facility leveling coding. Minimum of 3+ years of outpatient coding with experience. Experience with Epic and Clintegrity strongly preferred.

• Outpatient Claim Edits coder. A minimum of 3 years of experience with Hospital Billing(HB) Claim edits is a requirement. Experience with Parallon, Cerner, and Optum would benefit a candidate in this role. Additionally, experience with use of Microsoft Office suite, primarily excel is a plus.

What You Will Do:

• Assign the appropriate discharge disposition.

• Possess strong organizational and teamwork skills.

• Comply with all HIM Division Policies.

What You Need to Succeed:

• AHIMA certified credentials (RHIA, RHIT, CCS) or AAPC certified credentials (CPC, CPC-H, COC, CIC or CRC).

• 2+ years of coding experience in a hospital and/or coding consulting role.

• Proficiency with most or all of these coding specialties (Same Day Surgery, Observation, Injections/Infusions)

• Proficiency with most or all of these coding specialties (Ancillary, Emergency Department, Injections/Infusions, E/M leveling)
