jobs.title: Director, Hardware Quality Engineering
jobs.description:
Bevi is on a mission to transform how beverages are delivered and consumed. Our connected beverage platform eliminates the need for single-use bottles and cans, making it easy, fun, and sustainable to stay hydrated. As the category leader in IoT-enabled beverage technology, we're building a future where Bevi machines are everywhere people live, work, and connect. We've raised over $160M in venture capital, serve thousands of customers across the US, Canada, UK and Ireland, and we've been rapidly growing year over year, saving over 1 billion bottles from waste. In addition to driving hypergrowth with our current product line, Bevi is heavily investing in new product development.

We are seeking a strategic and hands-on Director, Hardware Quality Engineering to build and lead Bevi's hardware quality organization and shape the company's quality strategy across our product portfolio. This leader will develop a strong, self-sufficient team and drive the long-term roadmap for product reliability, supplier quality, and field performance, ensuring Bevi's systems deliver an exceptional customer experience and operational excellence at scale.

You'll lead and grow a team of quality engineers and technicians, including hiring into open roles, and work closely with senior leaders in Hardware Engineering, Software, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, and Operations. The ideal candidate is a builder and a coach who has a track record of growing engineers into stronger contributors and leaders, combined with deep technical expertise and the ability to influence at the executive level.

Your Day to Day

• Build the team: hire into open roles, set clear roles and career paths, and create a culture of accountability, data-driven decisions, and continuous improvement

• Coach and mentor quality engineers and technicians through regular feedback, stretch assignments, and hands-on guidance, so the team can own problems end to end

• Set the vision and strategy for hardware quality across design, manufacturing, and field performance to support Bevi's growth and product roadmap

• Partner cross-functionally with Engineering (hardware, firmware, and software), Manufacturing, and Supply Chain leadership to ensure quality and reliability are embedded early in product design and supplier selection

• Partner closely with the Director of Test & Reliability so reliability findings feed directly into quality systems, supplier actions, and field improvement

• Own quality deliverables at each NPI phase gate, including quality planning, first article inspection, and launch readiness

• Establish and scale quality systems and processes that enable global manufacturing readiness, including supplier qualification, process capability, and failure analysis

• Drive systemic root cause analysis and corrective/preventive actions (8D, RCCA) for complex product and supplier issues, including issues that cross hardware, firmware, and software, using data to guide prioritization and improvement

• Oversee supplier and contract manufacturer quality performance, including audits, scorecards, and escalation management

• Monitor and drive key metrics for warranty, RMA, and field performance to ensure Bevi's hardware meets and exceeds customer expectations

• Represent Quality Engineering in cross-functional reviews and executive discussions, providing clear, data-backed insights and recommendations

Requirements

• Passion for building world-class products and systems that delight customers and scale reliably

• Proven track record of hiring, coaching, and developing quality engineers, including growing people into larger roles

• Proven success leading hardware quality or reliability engineering at the Director or senior manager level in a high-growth or consumer hardware environment

• Strong foundation in quality engineering principles (FMEA, GR&R, SPC, DOE, reliability growth modeling, etc.)

• Demonstrated experience with electromechanical systems, consumer electronics, or commercial appliances

• Experience leading supplier quality management, including audits, process validation, and NPI launch readiness

• Strong communicator who can influence across functions and levels, translating complex data into business-relevant insights

• 10+ years in hardware quality or reliability engineering, with at least 5 years leading and developing teams

• Bachelor's degree in Engineering (Mechanical, Electrical, or related field)

• Ability to be in the office 3 to 5 days per week and travel up to 30% (domestic and international)

Nice to Have

• Experience with connected (IoT) products where firmware and software drive field performance

• Experience with fluid systems, refrigeration, or commercial beverage equipment

• Experience building quality systems at a scaling company

• ASQ certifications (CQE, CQA)

Compensation

• Base Salary Range: $184,620 – $228,060 per year

• Bonus: Eligible for the Executive Leadership Team (ELT) Bonus Program

#LI-CK1

#LI-ONSITE

Benefits:

• Comprehensive medical, dental and vision insurance plans with BlueCross BlueShield, 95% paid by employer

• 401(k) with company match

• Flexible PTO plus 12 company holidays, and additional paid days for sick leave, etc

• Generous fully paid parental leave for both birth parents and non-birth parents

• Fully employer paid disability and life insurances

• Wellness and fitness reimbursements

• Monthly stipends for cell phone use and commuting costs

• Onsite snacks, weekly catered lunch, and (of course) unlimited Bevi ... plus composting and terra-cycling, too

• Happy hours, team-building events, bagel breakfasts, Values awards - and more.

A note on AI in our hiring process: We use AI to help synthesize interview notes and surface themes from feedback, keeping our process consistent as we grow. Every application is reviewed by a member of our team, and interviews may be recorded to support note-taking, just let us know if you'd prefer we don't. We'll also ask how you're learning and experimenting with AI in your work. Growing our AI fluency is something every Bevi team member is committed to and invested in.

Our commitment to responsible innovation is reflected in our partnership with the Mass AI Coalition, a collaboration that aligns with our dedication to community-driven progress and the future of technology.

We're passionate about supporting career growth and would love to be part of your professional journey. We also know that talent comes in many forms. We value individual accomplishments, specialized knowledge, and genuine passion over simply checking boxes on a requirements list. Whether you're a seasoned expert or an emerging talent, we're looking for people who are ready to build what's next. If any of our open positions interest you, we'd encourage you to apply! A member of the Bevi Talent team 'recruiting@bevi.co' will be reaching out about next steps if we would like to move forward.

Accommodations:

Bevi is committed to an inclusive hiring process and we aim to provide accommodations for persons with disabilities. If you need any accommodations for the application or throughout the interview process please contact recruiting@bevi.co.

jobs.title: Director, Intellectual Property
jobs.description:
Amylyx has an audacious mission to usher in a new era for treating diseases with high unmet needs. Where others see challenges, we see opportunities that we pursue with urgency, rigorous science, and unwavering commitment to the communities we serve. We are a clinical-stage company currently focused on post-bariatric hypoglycemia (PBH), Wolfram syndrome, and amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS).

Our mission is powered by our people. Our core values – be audacious, be curious, be authentic, be engaged, and be accountable – creating a culture of caring. Amylyx has assembled an experienced team ready to take action because the communities we serve have no time to wait. If you share our passion and are determined to tackle some of medicine’s toughest problems, we encourage you to read the opportunity below and apply.

The Opportunity

The Director, Intellectual Property, will be a key team member in the company’s growing IP function and support the development of the company’s IP portfolio. Reporting to the Vice President, Head of Intellectual Property, this role will develop and execute strategies towards building durable IP protections on the company’s molecules and programs. The ideal candidate will have a strong core expertise in patent enforcement of therapeutics, with end-to-end experience in patent matters from early R&D stage portfolio building to post-approval dispute resolution with generics. The role will also advise on trademark and IP-related contractual matters and is ideal for a patent-focused candidate seeking to grow into an IP generalist role.

Responsibilities

• Lead strategic patent portfolio development and litigation readiness strategies related to Amylyx’s clinical and pipeline molecules as assigned

• Support efforts in pursuing regulatory exclusivities, e.g., pediatric exclusivity and orphan drug exclusivity

• Perform IP assessments, including IP diligence in support of business development efforts, freedom-to-operate, patentability, validity, and competitive intelligence as assigned

• Monitor IP case-law and policy development, advise on impact, and develop best practice and/or risk mitigation strategies

• Support transactional efforts, including drafting and direct negotiation of IP-related contractual terms, e.g., in connection with license, collaboration, manufacturing, clinical development, and R&D contracts; advise stakeholders on post-execution impact and compliance of IP contractual terms

• Manage day-to-day patent prosecution efforts related to clinical and pipeline molecules as assigned, including drafting patent applications and managing US and ex-US outside counsel

• Monitor R&D, clinical, and manufacturing activities towards identifying potential IP protection opportunity; review proposed publications, presentations, and other public releases to ensure alignment with patent strategy

• Manage global trademark portfolio through outside counsel and perform clearance assessments as needed

Required Qualifications

• 10+ years of experience overall with ideally 7+ years of demonstrated experience in patent matters, specifically in the pharmaceutical and/or biotech industries and 5+ years law firm experience

• J.D. degree, member in good standing of at least one state bar, and registration to practice before the U.S. Patent and Trademark Office

• Advanced degree, e.g., M.S. or Ph.D., or equivalent industry experience in chemistry, biochemistry, biology, or other life science-related discipline

• Significant demonstrated patent experience in pharmaceutical/biotech therapeutics, e.g., small molecules, peptides, oligonucleotides. proteins, and/or biologic therapeutics

• Supporting or managing Hatch-Waxman patent litigation, litigation readiness efforts, and/or IPRs

• Advising on regulatory exclusivities, e.g., new-chemical entity exclusivity, orphan drug exclusivity, pediatric exclusivity, as well as on patent term extensions

• Conducting patentability, freedom-to-operate, due diligence, and validity assessments

• Global patent prosecution experience, including drafting patent applications and day-to-day prosecution tasks

• Ability to deliver solution-focused and fit-for-purpose guidance on complex matters, drive initiatives and cross-functional alignment, and impact and influence organization

Preferred Requirements

• Ph.D. in life-science-related discipline

• Structuring, drafting and negotiating IP-related aspects of contracts, e.g., license, collaboration, R&D, manufacturing, and/or clinical development contracts

• Patent experience in both brand-side and generic-side therapeutics

• Trademark prosecution

Work Location and Conditions

• At Amylyx, we proudly support remote work opportunities within the United States. However, due to business considerations related to health insurance coverage and state tax regulations, we are unable to hire employees who reside and/or work in certain states. Currently, we are not considering applicants from Alaska and Hawaii.

• You will be expected to travel to our corporate location in Cambridge, MA several times a year and attend other company-related events as necessary and requested.

• You must have access to work in setting which enables meeting all requirements of the role (including privacy, reliable internet access, phone, ability to video conference, etc.) at your remote location.

Compensation

The pay range posted below represents our good faith estimate of compensation for this role, based on market data and internal benchmarks. The final offer may vary depending on a candidate’s experience, skills, and qualifications, as well as considerations of internal equity.

Estimated Pay Range

$245,000—$276,000 USD

jobs.title: Cart Builder
jobs.description:
SHIFT:1PM-9:30PM

Job Code: D23

Career Level: D1

Supervisor: No

Reports To: DC Supervisor

What's the Short Version?

A Cart Builder is responsible for efficiently building restock carts by separating cases of product from pallet onto designated carts as directed by a voice and/or radio frequency (RF) unit. They build/prepare pulling carts using voice and/or RF unit in accordance to ship times, size of orders and customer's requests, and Dynamics.

What Will You Be Doing?

• Build carts by following standard operating procedures.

• Move product with a pallet jack and/or hand truck.

• Relocates product from Slow Bay using RF unit.

• Use Radio Frequency (RF) unit in combination with Internal Operating System to perform daily work.

• Perform other duties as assigned.

• Comply with all policies and standards.

What Are We Looking For?

• High School Diploma or equivalent Preferred

• Demonstrates ability to follow directions and change priorities or job duties as business needs require.

• Ability to learn Internal Operating System and operate Radio Frequency (RF) unit.

• Ability to work in high-demand, high-volume environment and meet deadlines.

• Comprehend verbal and written instructions.

• Demonstrated verbal and written communication skills.

• Strong attention to detail.

• Able to work both independently and within a team.

• Essential days or overtime may be required.

• Ability to read, write and have sufficient ability to identify colors, sizes, quantity, label and SKU information.

• Basic math skills in counting and quantity required.

What Should You Expect?

DC Warehouse (Non-Equipment): While performing the duties of this job, the employee is constantly required to stand, walk, talk and hear. The employee frequently lifts and/or moves up to 50 pounds, occasionally up to 60 pounds. The employee frequently uses both hands as well as full range of motion of the neck, head and back. The employee is frequently required to reach with hands and arms, grasp and perform repetitive hand, wrist and arm motions. The employee is frequently required to climb stairs, kneel/squat, bend and carry. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception and ability to adjust focus. Employee may be required to wear a headset covering one or both ears. Basic literacy is required for operation of machines and necessary daily paperwork. Work environment is moderately noisy. The employee is occasionally required to work near conveyor systems. There is exposure to dust and changes in weather conditions. Work is performed under typical warehouse conditions. Potential hazards exist with regard to machinery such as forklifts, pallet jacks, mechanized systems, etc. Work environment is hectic and fast-paced. The employee is regularly exposed to ambient lighting and can be exposed to extreme heat and extreme cold including climates consistent with outside weather conditions.

jobs.title: Technical Talent Acquisition Partner
jobs.description:
Do you thrive in fast-paced environments where priorities shift quickly and hiring needs evolve alongside business growth?

Join Artefact, a global data and AI consulting firm helping organizations turn data into business impact. With 2,000+ employees across 34 offices worldwide, we partner with leading organizations such as Samsung, L'Oréal, and LVMH to accelerate digital transformation through data and AI.

About the role

Artefact is growing quickly across the US and Canada, and we’re looking for a Technical Talent Acquisition Partner to help us identify, attract, and hire exceptional talent across consulting and technical disciplines.

This is a hands-on recruiting role for someone who can move quickly, source creatively, partner closely with hiring managers, and maintain a high hiring bar in a competitive market. You’ll own searches from intake through offer, build strong candidate pipelines, and help ensure a high-quality experience for both candidates and hiring teams.

As the organization scales, you’ll also be responsible for campus recruiting and contribute to broader talent acquisition initiatives, including talent pipelining, workforce planning, and recruiting process improvements.

What you’ll do

• Own the full recruitment lifecycle across the US, Canada, and Latin America, leading searches across both consulting and technical functions.

• Serve as the primary Talent Acquisition partner for the region, independently managing the recruiting function across multiple business lines, hiring managers, and competing priorities.

• Partner with hiring managers and chapter leads to define hiring strategies, workforce needs, role requirements, and ideal candidate profiles.

• Recruit across consulting and technical disciplines, including AI, data science, analytics, data engineering, machine learning, and other specialized roles.

• Lead campus recruiting, including building university partnerships, representing Artefact at career fairs and campus events, and managing the intern and graduate hiring pipeline from sourcing through offer.

• Build proactive, diverse talent pipelines using modern sourcing techniques, direct outreach, referrals, networking, talent communities, market mapping, and AI-powered recruiting tools.

• Deliver an exceptional candidate experience from the initial conversation through onboarding while ensuring a high-quality and efficient hiring process.

• Act as a trusted advisor to leaders on hiring decisions, interview quality, candidate evaluation, compensation positioning, and talent market trends.

• Balance day-to-day recruiting execution with broader talent acquisition initiatives, including employer branding, recruiting operations, interview training, and process improvements.

• Analyze recruiting metrics to identify trends, forecast hiring outcomes, and recommend data-driven improvements.

• Design and continuously improve scalable recruiting programs, structured interview processes, hiring documentation, workflows, and recruiting best practices.

• Champion an inclusive hiring process grounded in structured assessments, objective decision-making, and consistent evaluation criteria.

• Build and strengthen the Artefact employer brand through social media, networking events, community partnerships, and talent marketing initiatives.

• Leverage AI and emerging recruiting technologies to streamline sourcing, interview preparation, candidate communications, scheduling, reporting, and recruiting workflows while maintaining ethical and compliant recruiting practices.

What you’ll bring

The ideal candidate must have:

• 3-5+ years of full-cycle recruiting experience within a consulting or professional services environment, with a demonstrated ability to support a fast-paced, high-growth environment.

• Strong technical recruiting experience across AI, data engineering, analytics, data science, machine learning, and other specialized technical roles, as well as experience recruiting for consulting and client-facing positions.

• Proven experience creating Greenhouse workflows, reporting, and dashboards.

• Demonstrated success serving as a trusted talent advisor and building strong partnerships with hiring managers, business leaders, and technical stakeholders.

• Proven ability to independently manage multiple searches across functions, geographies, and levels while balancing competing priorities in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.

• Strong sourcing expertise, with a track record of building diverse, high-quality candidate pipelines through direct sourcing, referrals, networking, market mapping, talent communities, and other sourcing strategies.

• Experience developing and improving recruiting processes, structured interview practices, hiring documentation, hiring manager training, and scalable recruiting programs.

• Strong analytical skills, with the ability to translate recruiting metrics, pipeline data, and labor market insights into actionable recommendations.

• Experience using applicant tracking systems, recruiting analytics, sourcing technologies, and AI-enabled recruiting tools to improve efficiency and hiring outcomes.

• A genuine interest in AI and emerging technologies, with the ability to quickly learn new tools and thoughtfully incorporate them into recruiting workflows.

• Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to establish credibility, influence stakeholders, and build relationships across technical and business teams.

• Strong organizational and project management skills, with the ability to prioritize effectively, navigate ambiguity, and maintain momentum in a rapidly evolving environment.

• A high degree of ownership, sound judgment, adaptability, and a proactive, solutions-oriented approach.

• Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business, Psychology, Communications, or a related field preferred. Equivalent professional experience will also be considered.

Why you should join us

We are united by our values and strengthened by our hybrid expertise.

• There is always a way: We're from the breed of does, of diggers, of makers. Because ideas are valuable only if executed.

• Client trust is won on the field: Addressing client needs flows better hands on at their side.

• If not used, it is useless: Our love for technology translates into a steep desire for adoption, true brilliance is about impact.

• If not shared, our work is not done: Sharing knowledge is the best way to button up a mission, benefitting clients and colleagues.

• We learn everyday: Tech is a land where everything move at the speed of light, you better be ready to challenge yourself.

How We Support Our People

In addition to our values-driven culture, we offer a range of benefits and programs designed to support our employees' growth and well-being, including:

• Learning and Development: Work alongside a multidisciplinary team of AI, data, and consulting experts who are committed to continuous learning, knowledge sharing, and professional growth.

• Hybrid Flexibility: Our hybrid work model gives you the flexibility to balance collaboration, client needs, and personal commitments.

• Comprehensive Benefits: We offer a competitive benefits package that includes medical, dental, and vision coverage, a 401(k) plan with company matching, and paid parental leave.

• Time to Recharge: We believe sustainable performance matters. That's why we offer unlimited paid time off, giving you the flexibility to take the time you need.

• Growth Opportunities: As a rapidly growing organization, you'll have the opportunity to expand your skills, take on new challenges, and help shape the future of the company.

The estimated base compensation for this role is $100,000 - $125,000 (NYC location). Individual compensation is determined by skills, qualifications, and experience. In addition, this role is eligible for competitive benefits.

jobs.title: Coding Consultant Outpatient - Sign On Bonus - $1,000/$1,500
jobs.description:
Datavant is the data collaboration platform trusted for healthcare. Guided by our mission to make the world’s health data secure, accessible and actionable, we provide critical data solutions for organizations across the healthcare ecosystem - including providers, health plans, researchers, and life sciences companies. From fulfilling a single patient’s request for their medical records to powering the AI revolution in healthcare, Datavanters are building the future of how data is connected and used to improve health.

By joining Datavant today, you’re stepping onto a driven and highly collaborative team that is passionate about creating transformative change in healthcare.

*****SIGN ON BONUS OF $1000/$1500 DEPENDING ON SPECIALTY*****

We’re looking for experienced and credentialed outpatient coders to become an integral part of our team. The ideal candidate for this role possesses high attention to detail and a depth of knowledge in medical terminology. This role is fully remote with a flexible schedule, allowing you to help shape the future of healthcare from your own workspace!

We are looking for the following experiences/skills:

• Outpatient Coder with 2+ years of multispecialty experience. The ideal candidate will have experience in facility ED, injections/infusions, Ancillary (Radiology, Labs, Clinic). Recurring therapy services for wound care, US, Radiology, Echo, sleep studies, PT/OT, Dialysis. Experience in EPIC and 3M preferred. Also experience with Denials, NCCI edits, medical necessity and claim edits a plus. While experience in all areas is not required, candidates who possess the majority of this expertise would be strongly preferred.

• Strong SDS/OBS coder with a minimum of 3 years' experience in an academic medical center, including Level 1 Trauma. Facility has a high volume of Urology, Cardiology, Gynecology, and Vascular procedures. Experience with PowerChart, Dolbey Fusion and Trucode strongly preferred.

• FT coder that can code all diagnostic ancillary services to include all Radiology coding including mammos and Maternity diagnosis coding. Coder will need to be able to commit to 40 hours/week, M-F during normal business hours. Cerner/3M360 systems.

• ED coder with 5+ years experience. The ideal candidate will have experience in facility E/M leveling, injections/infusions, and bedside procedures. CCS Required and experience in EPIC and 3M/Solventum required as well.

• Outpatient Same-Day Surgery/Observation (OP SDS/OBS) with 5+ years of experience. Surgery expertise includes, but not limited to, General Surgery, Ortho, Plastics and Reconstruction, including breast reconstruction, revision, augmentation, mastectomy, Otolaryngology, Spinal fusions and injections, Cardiology including pacemakers, Transesophageal Echocardiogram, Interventional Radiology, OB/Gyne, Nephrology, Endoscopy, US guidance, and Robotic Procedures. Must be able to code both SDS and OBS and be familiar with Rev Code assignment for surgeries. No injections and infusions or OBS time carvouts. CCS required and experience with EPIC/3M required as well.

What You Will Do:

• Review medical records and assign accurate codes for diagnoses and procedures.

• Assign and sequence codes accurately based on medical record documentation.

• Assign the appropriate discharge disposition.

• Abstract and enter the coded data for hospital statistical and reporting requirements.

• Communicate documentation improvement opportunities and coding issues to appropriate personnel for follow up and resolution.

• Maintain a 95% coding accuracy rate and a 95% accuracy rate for APC assignment and meet site-designated productivity standards.

• Be responsible for tracking continuing education credits to maintain professional credentials.

• Attend Datavant Health sponsored education meetings/in-services.

• Demonstrate initiative and judgment in the performance of job responsibilities.

• Communicate with co-workers, management, and hospital staff regarding clinical and reimbursement issues.

• Function in a professional, efficient, and positive manner.

• Adhere to the American Health Information Management Association’s code of ethics.

• Be customer-service focused and exhibit professionalism, flexibility, dependability, and a desire to learn.

• Handle a high complexity of work function and decision-making.

• Possess strong organizational and teamwork skills.

• Comply with all HIM Division Policies.

What You Need to Succeed:

• AHIMA certified credentials (RHIA, RHIT, CCS) or AAPC certified credentials (CPC, CPC-H, COC, CIC or CRC).

• 2+ years of coding experience in a hospital and/or coding consulting role.

• Proficiency with most or all of these coding specialties (Same Day Surgery, Observation, Injections/Infusions)

• Proficiency with most or all of these coding specialties (Ancillary, Emergency Department, Injections/Infusions, E/M leveling)

• Strong written and verbal communication skills, adeptness in remote work, and exceptional time management skills.

• Experience in computerized encoding and abstracting software.

• Required to take and pass annual Introductory HIPAA examination and other assigned testing to be given annually

• Experience in computerized encoding and abstracting software

What We Offer:

• Benefits for Full-Time employees: Medical, Dental, Vision, 401k Savings Plan w/match, 2 weeks of paid time off, and Paid Holidays, Floating Holidays

• Benefits for PRN employees: 401k savings plan w/match

• Free CEUs every year

• Stipend provided to assist with education and professional dues (AHIMA/AAPC)

• Equipment: monitor, laptop, mouse, headset, and keyboard

• Comprehensive training led by a credentialed professional coding manager

• Exceptional service-style management and mentorship (we’re in this together!)

jobs.title: General Superintendent
jobs.description:
Company Overview

At JRM Construction, we build more than exceptional spaces - we build talented teams, rewarding careers, and trusted relationships. As a leading employee-owned construction firm, our people take ownership of every project and work collaboratively to deliver outstanding quality and a positive client experience. Guided by integrity, teamwork, continuous improvement, and genuine care for our people, JRM provides an environment where employees can grow and help shape the company’s long-term success.

Role Description
A General Superintendent (GS) is a seasoned field leader who provides planning support, team guidance, complex issue resolution, and Field Operations oversight.  The GS also actively manages Field Staff workforce including logistical scheduling, development, training and mentorship of that workforce.  A GS conducts periodic project visits where additional expertise and oversight are required, acting as a quality and operations checkpoint to help ensure field practices, safety standards, and execution align with company expectations.

A GS works with and reports to a Field Operations Director, working with other GS’s to ensure that projects and managed and executed to JRM standards of excellence.

General Responsibilities

• Direct report, staffing and performance management of assigned Field Staff, including Field Mechanics, Supers, Assistant Supers

• Assist Field Operations Director in interviewing and selecting potential field personnel hires

• Drive project execution success from a JRM and client perspective in conjunction with Project Teams, Director of Project Management (DoPM), and Field Operations Director.

• Implement, champion, and drive adherence to JRM Processes and Procedures.

• Embody and Drive Adoption of JRM Core Values across all field staff

• Act as Field Operations Representative on Projects

Project-level Responsibilities
A GS is responsible for overseeing the path to the overall success of a project.

Communication & Escalation

• Provide timely communication and escalation of any significant safety, schedule, procedural, employee performance, and client/owner perception issues to Project Leadership, BU/Regional Lead, and Field Ops Leadership. Resolve such issues within the project team whenever possible.

Relationship Management

• Maintains relationship with building management by conducting monthly check-ins (at minimum) to ensure satisfaction and support JRM’s reputation for unparalleled client service.

• Maintains relationship with subcontractors to ensure smooth project execution and promote future partnership.

Safety

• Advanced knowledge of JRM Safety program, OSHA standards, specific California requirements and local laws.

• Demonstrates leadership and enforcement of safety compliance and uniformity across multiple projects.

• Champions development and/or review of safety and logistics plans for all phases of a project.

• Reviews safety documentation on high-risk activities and equipment, such as cranes picks/specialty rigging/structural demolition/hoist placement, etc.

• Forecasts hazards and guides team on development of safety mitigation plans.

• Drives Lessons Learned and best practices based on safety data and observations, in coordination with EHS Department.

Pre-Con Phase

• Pre-Plans with project teams to ensure organized project startup. Sets the tone.

• Helps Identify the challenges of the project and assures that the Field Team fully understand those challenges and the best path to overcome them.

• Break the project down into smaller more manageable scopes and identify the correct staffing/roles & responsibilities to supervise each of those smaller scopes.

• Establishes team focus based on critical path to ensure proper prioritization to meet project deadline.

• Works with team to establish General Conditions Projection utilizing experience to maximize use of manpower.

Construction Phase
The GS will work hand in hand with other GSs, the Field Operations Director, and the Director of Project Management (DoPM) in order to ensure project success.  GS conducts weekly site reviews (higher frequency as needed) with Project Team reviewing schedule adherence, proper installation sequence, construction methodology, quality, process efficiency and safety.

GS will coordinate with DoPM. When DoPM recognizes an issue during meetings with PMs, DoPM will notify the GS for that project. The GS is to address the issue with field team and advise DoPM of outcome to close the loop.  Conversely, when the GS notices an issue with Project Management, the GS will notify and coordinate the resolution of that issue with the DoPM.

The GS is to have a pulse on the overall status, health, and success of field activities; focused on the following cornerstone categories:

• Safety

• Schedule Conducts a thorough review of all project schedules offering insightful recommendations on sequencing and constructability to optimize project planning and execution. Ensures that teams hold the line as to Project Schedule

• Field Coordination (quality, constructability, sequence, logistics) Proactively monitors quality of all work. Ensures that general practices described in JRM QA/QC program are being implemented. Assists with interaction / representation w/municipal agencies on behalf of the project.

• Client & Landlord Satisfaction

• Team Interaction & Leadership Oversees field supervision on all field-related procedures and best practices. Provides training/coaching as required. Provides guidance and training to project team on effective time management principles.

• Field Process Reviews field performance to ensure that JRM processes are being implemented and followed. Coaches field staff in the use of JRM processes, including emphasis on both why a process is important and how to use that process to benefit the job.

• Employee Performance Monitors field staff underperformance, gives timely constructive feedback, properly documents and reports PIP to Field Operations & necessary departments when applicable.

• Staffing Monitors General Conditions to ensure effective and proper use of labor to minimize unnecessary labor costs and expenditure overruns and communicate with Project Leadership.

• Issue Resolution and Risk Register Identifies risks and recurring trends and leads team to devise mitigation/recovery plans. Tracks the successful implementation to recover any delays or advance on schedule as needed. Help resolve field issues that cannot be overcome by Field Team, based on level of urgency properly escalates to necessary parties.

Post Construction Phase

• Ensures plan is established for project completion & exit strategy.

• Stays with project through punchlist signoff.

• Understands GC exposure, risk level, and required staffing allocations. Communicates with Project Leadership, BU Lead, & Field Ops Leadership as to the same.

• Manage expectations proactively; navigate competing priorities and tight timelines with clarity

Standards & Process

• Apply and uphold our event and experience execution standards; adapt frameworks for the US market context

• Contribute to the development and refinement of global event standards, playbooks, and the service catalog

• Introduce new event formats and experience approaches that raise the bar for employee programming

• Maintain accurate records: post-event documentation, budget actuals, attendance data, and learnings

Data & Continuous Improvement

• Own the US events measurement approach: collect, analyze, and report on experience quality and employee sentiment

• Produce post-event reports and strategic write-ups; link outcomes to broader employee experience goals

• Analyze trends across the US event portfolio to inform future program investment and priorities

Collaboration & Teamwork

• Work closely with the global Workplace Experience team to align the US event portfolio with broader workplace experience strategy

• Partner with the Experience Design team on integrated experiences where events connect to broader business outcomes

• Represent the Workplace Experience function in US-based cross-functional planning forums

What We're Looking For

Genuine passion for employee experience, the ability to operate independently across a varied and concurrent portfolio, and the credibility to partner with senior leaders on experience strategy.

• Proven track record delivering events and programs from concept through completion- on time, on brand, and on budget

• Strategic thinker who can move between vision and execution without losing either

• Strong stakeholder manager: shapes briefs, manages expectations at leadership level, and advocates for the employee experience

• Comfortable developing playbooks, processes, and standards- both for their own work and as contributions to the broader global team

• Deep knowledge of event production: vendor markets, technical production, and logistics

• Self-directed and adaptable; comfortable owning the full delivery chain independently

jobs.title: Junior Staff Accountant
jobs.description:
Multi-site Dermatology Group Seeks Junio Staff Accountant

Optima Dermatology is recruiting a Staff Accountant to join our Practice Support Center, based in Portsmouth, NH.

Address: 111 NH Ave, Portsmouth, NH 03801

Hours: Full-Time, - Monday - Friday, 9:00AM - 5:00PM

Position Details:

The Junior Staff Accountant role is responsible for the timely and accurate application of incoming cash transactions, managing travel and expense reimbursements, recording inventory, and calculating and filing sales and use taxes as well as property taxes. This role is critical in ensuring the integrity of cash flow data and supporting the financial health of the organization. Key responsibilities include reconciling customer payments, processing cash receipts, and verifying payment accuracy against invoices. By leveraging analytical skills and attention to detail, this position contributes to the overall financial stability and operational efficiency of the company.

Responsibilities:

• Accurately apply cash receipts to customer accounts and invoices.

• Process various payment methods, including checks and electronic transfers.

• Reconcile cash received against recorded amounts and resolve outstanding payment issues.

• Perform daily bank reconciliations to ensure accurate transaction recording.

• Oversee banking transactions, such as wire transfers and ACH payments.

• Monitor cash balances and cash flow for operational liquidity.

• Prepare reports on cash application activities and cash flow analysis.

• Analyze collection trends and communicate insights to management.

• Collaborate with banking partners to resolve issues and enhance processes.

• Process and reconcile credit card transactions related to travel expenses.

• Manage expense reimbursement requests, ensuring compliance with company policies and accuracy in documentation.

• Analyze and allocate prepaid expenses as necessary, ensuring proper recording and compliance.

• Process and record rebates from vendors, ensuring accurate financial reporting and compliance with agreements.

• Review and record accrued expenses, ensuring they are accurately recognized in the correct periods.

• Calculate, file, and ensure compliance with sales and use tax, property taxes, and real estate taxes.

• Ensure compliance with company policies, GAAP and SOX controls.

• Maintain organized documentation of cash transactions and correspondence.

• Identify and implement improvements in cash application procedures.

• Support audits by providing necessary documentation and reports.

• Review financial statements for accuracy, including balance sheets, income statements and cash flow statements.

• Assist in monthly, quarterly, and annual close processes, including journal entries and reconciliations.

• Communicate with customers to resolve payment inquiries and discrepancies.

• Contribute to ad-hoc projects as required.

Qualifications:

• Bachelor’s degree in accounting or finance.

• Prior experience in an accounting role, such as an accounting assistant, AP/AR clerk, or internship.

• Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.

• Proficiency in Microsoft Excel.

• Experience with accounting software, preferably Sage or similar platforms.

• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.

• Ability to work independently and in a team environment.

• Strong attention to detail and accuracy.

About Optima Dermatology

At Optima Dermatology, our mission to revolutionize skin care is made possible by our world class team that is highly engaged, mission-driven, and inspired to set the new standard in dermatology. We are growing rapidly and looking for key team members who believe in our mission and want to make a difference in the lives of our patients. We foster a collaborative environment that is fun and hardworking and promise you will work alongside amazing colleagues you are proud to call your teammates.

jobs.title: VP People & Culture
jobs.description:
About ROLLER

ROLLER is a venue management platform built for the attractions and leisure industry, powering ticketing, point-of-sale, memberships, and guest experience for over 3,500 venue customers worldwide. Raised $110M in funding — including a $50M round led by Insight Partners and J.P. Morgan — we've grown to 300+ employees globally and process billions of dollars in transaction volume each year. We're entering our next stage of growth, and we're looking for a People leader to build the high-performance organisation that will take us there.

About the Role

As VP, People & Culture, you'll own how ROLLER attracts, hires and engages its people and partners with leaders to build a scalable, high performing culture. You'll lead a lean, high-leverage team across People Partnering, Talent Acquisition and People Operations, and be a trusted adviser to the CEO and SLT.

Based in Austin, you'll work from our office three days a week with two flexible remote days, giving you valuable in-person time with your team and cross-functional partners without losing the autonomy experienced leaders expect. If you're drawn to global leadership scope, a growth-stage company where your fingerprints will be on the outcome, and an industry built around genuinely fun employee experiences, we want to hear from you.

What You'll Do

• Strategic leadership — Build the P&C strategy to align with the ROLLER company strategy and commercial outcomes; drive execution to plan with your team;

• People Partnering — Coach and manage our Senior P&C Business Partners and Advisers, enabling them to be proactive, high impact advisers on talent and performance. Be the escalation point for employee relations across AU, US and UK. Advise the CEO and SLT on org design, capability needs and succession to enable scalable growth

• Talent Acquisition — Coach and manage the Head of Talent Acquisition on meeting delivery expectations. Lead annual workforce planning in partnership with Finance.

• People Operations — Coach and manage the Senior Manager, People Ops & Enablement. Set the direction and hold the bar for how our people systems, policy, compliance & WHS scale across AU, US and UK through our next phase of growth. Champion employee experience and engagement at SLT.

• Embed ROLLER's performance identity — a culture that is tenacious, driven and lifts others up where hiring, onboarding and engagement reinforce high performance.

• Lead work redesign for AI — help leaders break roles into skills, decide what the machine does versus people, and lead the change. Use AI and automation to keep P&C lean (sourcing, screening, onboarding, people reporting).

• Retain a high-leverage team — Lead a lean, multi-region P&C team, focused on professional growth and performance through change. Keep the team connected across locations, set a high bar for pace and quality, and lift capability so each person's impact grows as the business scales

What You'll Bring

• 12+ years in People leadership, including 5+ years leading multi-discipline teams (Business Partnering, Talent Acquisition, People Ops) at a high-growth SaaS or tech company.

• Experience scaling a global organisation through 300 to 600+ people, with strong tenure (4+ years) in at least one recent company on a relevant growth curve.

• Demonstrated use of AI and automation in people processes, and experience leading work redesign and change.

• A track record as a trusted adviser to a CEO and executive team, with the commercial acumen to prioritise what moves the business.

• Deep employee relations and employment practice experience across multiple jurisdictions.

• Comfort building process, playbooks and people data in a lean, evolving team rather than inheriting a mature one.

• A high bar for pace and performance in your own team, and a record of lifting a team's capability.

What Success Looks Like

You'll be accountable for the metrics that show P&C is driving business impact: hiring plan delivery, time-to-hire and quality of hire, agency spend, regretted attrition, engagement scores, manager capability uplift. Leaders invite P&C into the room because it brings a valuable perspective — and ROLLER is known in the talent market as a place people aspire to work and grow.

jobs.title: Head of Commercial Process Excellence
jobs.description:
About Re:Build

At Re:Build, our mission is to ensure the next generation of important products are made, at scale, in America. We are laying the foundation for a better future for our customers, employees, and communities by revitalizing America's manufacturing base and creating meaningful jobs across the country, including in historically deindustrialized regions.

We operate a sophisticated, end-to-end manufacturing platform that partners with industrial companies and innovators to take products from first concept to full-scale production in critical verticals including aerospace and defense, electrification, medical, energy and environment, and robotics and automation.

The way we operate is as important as the work we do. It's guided by The Re:Build Way, 16 principles that shape how we collaborate with each other, partner with our customers and vendors, and contribute to the communities where we operate. (link to The Re:Build Way principles)

Who we are looking for

We're looking for an experienced process excellence practitioner who has actually built the kind of processes that teams use — not ones that get drafted, launched, and quietly abandoned. You've spent 7-10+ years deep in commercial operations, GTM operations, or process excellence, and you've learned through hands-on experience that the gap between a well-designed process and a forgotten one usually comes down to adoption, documentation, and continuous reinforcement. You know Lean principles—process flow analysis, consistent procedures, cause investigation, and PDCA—not as theory but as tools you use daily. You are comfortable applying them in a commercial, non-manufacturing context.

What sets you apart is that you treat AI as a working instrument rather than a talking point. You've hands-on deployed LLM-based workflows, automation, and AI-assisted analytics to cut manual effort out of repeatable commercial tasks, and you're genuinely energized by evaluating new tools and figuring out how to make them stick for people with very different levels of technical comfort.

This role sits at the intersection of Lean rigor, commercial strategy, and applied AI, working in close partnership with the VP of GTM Operations, market leaders, Strategic Account Managers, the deal desk, and the Enterprise Lean Team. You'll have real latitude to identify where the organization's commercial processes are breaking down, design the "least waste way" to fix them, and build the institutional memory that keeps the organization improving — treating every gap as a system problem to solve, not people problem to handle.

What you get to do

• Identify commercial process gaps across sales, business development, and deal execution, and design best-in-class workflows grounded in Lean principles and RLOS

• Build and deploy AI-powered workflows — LLMs, automation, and AI-assisted analytics — to reduce manual effort in tasks like proposal generation, CRM hygiene, and documentation

• Serve as the commercial team's go-to expert on practical AI applications, evaluating and recommending new tools as the landscape evolves

• Own standard work and SOPs across the commercial organization, including governance, version control, and accessibility

• Lead organizational change for process transformation — collaborator alignment, resistance management, and adoption planning

• Design and deliver modular, role-specific training that drives lasting adoption, reinforced through ongoing touchpoints

• Monitor process alignment, diagnose drift, and close gaps through coaching and refresher interventions

• Maintain a documented evolution log and run a formal continuous improvement cadence — process reviews, retrospectives, and data-driven prioritization — reporting progress to the VP of GTM Operations

What you bring to the Team

• Proven experience in commercial operations, GTM operations, process excellence, or a closely related function

• Demonstrated, hands-on experience deploying AI tools (LLMs, automation platforms, AI-assisted analytics) in a commercial or operational context

• Working knowledge of Lean methodologies — value stream mapping, standard work, root cause analysis, PDCA — applied in a commercial or non-manufacturing environment

• Experience building SOPs and standard work documentation at an organizational scale

• Strong facilitation and training skills, with comfort delivering to mixed-experience audiences

• Analytical fluency, with the ability to use data to diagnose process problems and measure improvement outcomes

Preferred

jobs.title: Sr Planner/Scheduler
jobs.description:
BRPH is a technically focused, creative architecture, engineering, and construction company with over six decades of expertise in helping mission-driven clients in the aerospace, defense, manufacturing, commercial, education, entertainment, hospitality, and federal markets identify gaps in their program delivery and develop innovative solutions to their most challenging problems across the U.S. and around the world. Consistently ranked among the nation’s top firms, we take pride in solving complex challenges with forward-thinking solutions.

ABOUT BRPH:

BRPH is a nationally recognized, employee-owned architecture, engineering, and construction services firm delivering innovative solutions for clients across the aerospace, commercial, defense, education, entertainment, hospitality, and manufacturing sectors. Our collaborative, multidisciplinary teams partner with clients to solve complex challenges and create facilities that shape communities and industries.

As a Structural Engineer, you will join a team of experienced professionals supporting projects ranging from facility assessments and renovations to complex new construction across a diverse portfolio of market sectors. Working alongside multidisciplinary project teams, you will lead structural design efforts, contribute to project delivery from concept through construction, and help develop innovative solutions for our clients' most challenging projects.

At BRPH, we invest in our people through mentorship, technical training, employee ownership, and progressive project responsibilities that provide meaningful opportunities for professional development and advancement.

Overview

We’re looking for a SR PLANNER/SCHEDULER to join our dynamic team in Orlando, FL office. Hybrid is permitted, with Monday and Friday being the WFH days. Provide technical support and execution of project controls and scheduling functions for project using Deltek VantagePoint. This position includes assisting the Project Manager in the development of project plans, Critical Path Method (CPM) compliance in accordance with client contract documents, accuracy validation of subcontract vendor schedules, including progress and schedule logic conflict management. Forecasting, diagnosing, and planning workarounds and other project tracking needs.

Job Responsibilities

• Create and maintain schedules.

• Develop and maintain all project schedules and coordinate schedules with the client.

• Support the project in the compiling of multiple subproject schedules to establish the status of work on a weekly basis.

• Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly reports and other ad hoc reporting as required by the contract, requested by the Project Manager.

• Support the project with day-to-day administration of the project, including financial control, reporting, monitoring.

• Provide earned value progress and performance reporting for the project.

• Validate variance analysis.

• Develop and maintain all manpower loading for projects in Deltek.

• Maintain project Closeout Tracker on real-time basis.

• Report out project schedule status in staff meetings.

Qualifications:

• Bachelor’s degree in construction management, engineering, project management, or related technical field. Experience in lieu of degree is acceptable. Minimum of 8 years of progressive experience with increasing responsibility.

• Experience with Primavera (P6) is required. It is used on a regular basis for this role.

• 8 or more years of work experience in project controls and scheduling with 5+ years on large scale projects

• 5+ years of experience with earned value management (EVM) and progress measurement approaches for construction phases of work

• Experience with Deltek Acumen software is preferred

• Financial Analysis experience

• 5 or more years of experience (demonstration of proficiency) in administering project schedules

• Experience with directing, planning, and scheduling functions, including schedule development, control, cost loaded schedules, and risk analysis.

• Experience with the MS Office Suite – Specifically Word, Excel, and Power Point Communication skills including the ability to interact with all levels of the project team.

• Ability to plan, organize, document, perform, review project controls and schedule with minimum supervision

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS:

• Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, color vision, depth perception, and the ability to adjust focus.

• Must take and pass a pre-employment drug and background check

jobs.title: Staff AI Developer
jobs.description:
We’re looking for a Staff AI Developer to lead the design and delivery of AI/ML systems. This role is ideal for an experienced developer who thrives on architectural decisions, can confidently own systems end-to-end, and contributes to technical leadership across the team.

In this role, you will work as a key technical leader on a cross-functional team, defining AI architecture, leading model development and optimization, and solving challenging integration problems. You’ll be joining real, in-flight work where reliability, security, and scalability are critical. You’ll establish engineering standards, raise the bar on how we build AI systems, and contribute to the technical decisions that shape how our AI work scales over time.

Why This Role Matters

At Robots & Pencils, we design AI systems for a human world. Our name says it all. Robots and pencils means engineering paired with creativity, because every agent we ship has to work for real people in real workflows. That balance is baked into how we operate.

Every role here contributes directly to that mission. Here, you shape how AI systems integrate into enterprise operations, how teams move at real velocity, and how products create measurable impact for clients and the people they serve. We ship production-ready AI in 30 to 45 days. That pace demands people who take ownership, lead with craft, and care deeply about what they put their name on.

What You’ll Do

Craft & Delivery

• Lead the design and implementation of complex ML/AI systems end-to-end, owning architecture decisions and driving solutions from research through production at scale

• Build and evolve scalable ML platforms, pipelines, and infrastructure that support reliable, repeatable model development and deployment across teams

• Set the standard for AI-forward engineering, using tools like Claude and Cursor with sophistication and helping the team adopt them effectively

Collaboration & Communication

• Partner with product, engineering, and leadership to shape AI strategy and align technical direction with business outcomes

• Translate complex AI tradeoffs, risks, and opportunities into clear narratives that drive decision-making across technical and non-technical stakeholders

• Lead design reviews and technical discussions, raising the bar for engineering rigor and constructive challenge across the team

Leadership & Influence

• Define AI architecture and engineering standards, bringing depth on tradeoffs, long-term implications, and responsible AI practices

• Mentor and grow junior and mid-level engineers, multiplying impact through coaching, code reviews, and pairing on hard problems

• Take ownership of the most ambiguous and highest-stakes pieces of work, driving them through to production with care for reliability, cost, and safety

What You’ll Bring

• 7+ years professional software development experience, with 4+ years focused on AI/ML systems in production and deep hands-on experience with generative AI development

• Expert software development background (Python or similar) with strong design sensibilities for scalable, maintainable systems

• Deep expertise with cloud platforms, including in-depth understanding of AWS services and AWS GenAI offerings

• Proven track record designing and shipping complex agentic systems in production environments

• Mastery of AI frameworks and orchestration tools

• Strong experience with evaluation frameworks and observability tools for LLM apps, including building these capabilities where they don't yet exist

• Deep understanding of AI safety, responsible AI principles, prompt injection defenses, and PII handling

• Extensive experience building RAG pipelines: chunking strategies, embedding models, vector databases, and advanced retrieval techniques

• API design experience, including architecting and integrating with internal and third-party services at scale

• Advanced cost optimization expertise: token economics, caching strategies, model routing, quantization

• Strong working knowledge of Docker and Kubernetes for containerized deployments

• Demonstrable, day-to-day usage and expert knowledge of AI-forward coding tools such as Claude Code and Cursor

Our salary range is $170,000 - $234,000 CAD

jobs.title: Commercial Contracts Business Partner US
jobs.description:
Commercial Contracts Business Partner

Location: Dallas, Texas
Department: Legal & Contracts
Full-time | Permanent

As our consultancy business continues to grow across the US and international markets, the agreements we negotiate are becoming increasingly complex.

We’re looking for an experienced Commercial Contracts Business Partner to join our Legal & Contracts team and take ownership of complex commercial contract negotiations across our consultancy business.

This is not a lawyer, attorney or paralegal position. We are specifically looking for someone with hands-on experience managing and negotiating contracts from a commercial and operational perspective.

You’ll understand how contractual terms impact a business in practice, from financial exposure and service delivery to insurance, payment terms and operational responsibilities. You’ll be comfortable challenging terms, negotiating directly with clients and providers, and finding solutions that protect the business while still allowing deals to move forward.

This is an individual contributor role with plenty of autonomy and the opportunity to become a key commercial partner to our Sales and wider business teams.

What You’ll Be Doing

• Lead negotiations on complex client agreements, particularly with larger enterprise clients or where proposed terms create significant commercial or operational risk

• Review and negotiate Statements of Work (SOWs), ensuring delivery responsibilities, service obligations, acceptance criteria, liabilities and financial commitments are clearly understood

• Identify and challenge contractual risks relating to liability, indemnification, insurance, payment terms, data, information security, audit rights and ongoing monitoring

• Partner closely with Sales throughout negotiations, balancing commercial objectives with appropriate protection for the business

• Review the practical and financial implications of contractual requirements before agreements are signed

• Work with insurance brokers to ensure proposed services and contractual obligations are appropriately covered

• Negotiate commercial agreements with EOR, payroll and other third-party providers

• Ensure appropriate protections are in place around provider liabilities, insurance, audit rights and service requirements

• Review payment terms, billing requirements, additional costs, deductions, termination provisions and other areas of potential financial exposure

• Work cross-functionally with Finance, Billing, IT Security, GRC and other internal teams where contracts contain requirements impacting their areas

• Support commercial disputes involving client and provider agreements, including payment, additional costs and service obligations

• Identify client-specific requirements that need to flow down into contractor or provider agreements

• Help strengthen our commercial contracting processes as the consultancy business continues to scale internationally

What We’re Looking For

We’re looking for someone who understands commercial contracts from a business perspective, not just a legal one.

You’ll ideally bring:

• Strong hands-on experience managing and negotiating B2B commercial contracts

• Experience independently negotiating agreements with clients, suppliers or service providers

• Strong experience reviewing and negotiating Statements of Work and service-based agreements

• A solid understanding of commercial risk, including limitation of liability, indemnification, insurance requirements, payment terms and financial exposure

• The confidence to push back on unreasonable or disproportionate contractual terms

• Experience negotiating with larger or enterprise-level clients

• The ability to understand the commercial and operational consequences of contractual commitments

• Experience partnering with Sales and other commercial teams during negotiations

• Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work across Finance, Operations, Security, Risk and Compliance

• A commercial mindset with the ability to find practical solutions rather than simply identifying contractual issues

• Experience within consulting, professional services, staffing, recruitment or another service-led business would be particularly valuable

• Experience with EOR, payroll, contingent workforce or contractor arrangements would be advantageous

• Experience supporting contracts across multiple jurisdictions would also be beneficial

You don’t need to be an attorney to do this role. In fact, we are not seeking a lawyer, attorney or paralegal. The key thing for us is proven experience owning commercial contract negotiations and understanding how agreements work operationally once they’ve been signed.

Why Join Us?

This is a newly created role with the opportunity to make a genuine impact on how we manage commercial contracts and risk as our consultancy offering continues to grow.

You’ll have the autonomy to lead complex negotiations, partner closely with our commercial teams and help ensure the agreements we enter into are commercially sound, operationally achievable and appropriately protected.

If you’re an experienced commercial contracts professional who enjoys negotiating, challenging terms and finding practical solutions that enable business growth, we’d love to hear from you.

jobs.title: Head of People
jobs.description:
ABOUT PRIME INTELLECT

Prime Intellect is building the open superintelligence stack: the infrastructure frontier AI labs build internally, made available to every ambitious AI team.

Our platform, Lab, unifies compute, environments, evaluations, secure sandboxes, high-performance training, and deployment into one full-stack system for post-training at frontier scale - from SFT and RL to tool use, agent workflows, and continuously improving production models. We are building open frontier AI: open-source models trained end to end for long-horizon tasks like autonomous research, and the full-stack platform our own research team uses to build them. The next generation of AI companies, enterprises, and research teams do not just need more GPUs. They need the ability to turn their own workflows, tools, data, and feedback loops into superintelligence they own.

Prime Intellect has raised $150M in total funding from Founders Fund, Radical Ventures, NVIDIA, and exceptional AI, infrastructure, and enterprise operators, including Andrej Karpathy, Dwarkesh Patel, and leaders and founders from Ramp, Perplexity, Harvey, Mercor, Zapier, Datadog, Cognition, OpenAI, Thinking Machines, Together AI, SemiAnalysis, LangChain, Browserbase, Cloudflare, Sierra, Databricks, Airbnb, OpenRouter, Standard Intelligence, Fleet, Core Auto, and more. We are looking for people who want to build at the intersection of frontier research, real infrastructure, and go-to-market for a category that does not fully exist yet.


ROLE IMPACT

You’ll build the organization behind that mission. Working directly with the founders, you’ll shape how we develop exceptional people, reward their contributions, and grow teams that can do work few companies have attempted.

This is a chance to build the People function from the ground up as our headcount and business scale rapidly. You’ll set direction and stay close to the work, from a consequential compensation decision to closing a great hire.

To start, hands-on and strategic Talent Acquisition will be a key focus, focused on G&A, growth, and marketing roles, alongside our internal talent team and helping scale that team.

This role is based onsite in our San Francisco office.


WHAT YOU WILL DO

 - Shape our approach to performance, development, and reviews, helping ambitious people do their best work and grow with Prime.

 - Partner with the founders, finance, and talent on compensation, equity, leveling, and progression as the company scales.

 - Help leaders build their teams, develop managers, and think ahead about organization design and retention.

 - Personally source and close G&A, growth, and marketing hires, working alongside our internal talent team and helping scale it. Build relationships with investors and recruiting partners who can bring exceptional people into Prime.

 - Lead and scale People Ops as we bring on our first People Operations Coordinator and build out our partnership on onboarding, employee experience, and day-to-day operations.

 - Be a trusted partner to employees and leaders, bringing warmth, discretion, and clear judgment to important conversations.


REQUIREMENTS

 - You’ve built People teams and organizational foundations from scratch at a startup, then helped them scale through rapid growth. You can point to what you personally built and how it held up.

 - You’ve shaped performance and compensation approaches that people understand and leaders actually use.

 - You’ve personally sourced and closed strong G&A, growth, or marketing hires, and enjoy staying involved in recruiting.

 - You’re comfortable working directly with founders, making thoughtful calls with incomplete information, and turning decisions into action.

 - You are deeply excited by our mission: to build open superintelligence and the stack for everyone to build and use it.


WHAT WE OFFER

 - $250-300k+ cash compensation + meaningful equity

 - Visa sponsorship and relocation support

 - Professional development budget for courses and conferences

 - Team off-sites and conference attendance

jobs.title: Senior Medical Director - Oncology
jobs.description:
Job Summary:

The Senior Medical Director, Medical Science, is an experienced physician leader who provides strategic medical, scientific, and operational leadership across clinical development programs while serving as a trusted advisor to sponsors, investigators, and cross-functional teams. This role combines medical monitoring expertise with sponsor-facing leadership, business development support, and study oversight responsibilities, including the potential to serve as a global project lead. The Senior Medical Director is expected to represent the organization as the medical and scientific authority in client interactions, proposal development, bid defense meetings, scientific presentations, and industry conferences. Through proactive client engagement, expert clinical judgment, and collaborative leadership, this individual drives high-quality study execution, contributes to protocol and study design, supports safety oversight and data interpretation, mentors Medical Directors and other colleagues, and identifies opportunities for innovation and process improvement. The Senior Medical Director exemplifies accountability, integrity, and a passion for clinical research and patient care while consistently delivering exceptional value to clients, patients, and the organization.

Main Responsibilities:

• Serve as a senior medical and scientific leader in sponsor interactions, building trusted partnerships through proactive consultation, strategic insight, and exceptional service delivery.

• Represent the organization as the physician and subject matter expert during client meetings, scientific presentations, conferences, proposal discussions, and bid defense activities.

• Provide medical and scientific expertise during client feasibility assessments, including evaluation of study design, patient populations, enrollment strategies, and site selection.

• Serve as Medical Monitor for assigned studies, acting as the primary medical contact for sponsors, investigators, and study teams, providing medical oversight of patient safety, ensuring scientific rigor and operational excellence throughout study execution. Review and interpret laboratory data, adverse events, medical coding dictionaries, and study data outputs, including tables, listings, and figures. Review and provide expert input into the Medical Monitoring Plan, study protocols, statistical analysis plans, case report forms, training materials, investigator brochures, clinical study reports, and other key study documents. Conduct independent medical analyses of emerging study data and effectively communicate findings, risks, and recommendations to sponsors and internal stakeholders. Collaborate with Safety/Pharmacovigilance teams to review safety documentation and support safety signal evaluation and risk management activities. Contribute medical expertise to safety review meetings, data monitoring activities, and governance committees as required. Lead complex global clinical programs and provide oversight and guidance to regional medical leaders and project teams, as appropriate.

• Participate in investigator meetings and scientific advisory discussions as the medical representative for assigned programs.

• Mentor, coach, and develop Medical Directors, Associate Medical Directors, and other colleagues across the organization.

• Identify opportunities to improve processes, efficiencies, quality, and client experience across Medical Sciences and the broader organization, contributing to organizational initiatives that advance scientific excellence, operational effectiveness, and innovation.

Education and Experience:

Minimum Education & Experience:

• MD, DO, MBBS or equivalent education with completion of residency in a medical or pediatric sub-specialty, including completion of a fellowship in hematology and/or oncology

• At least 10 years combined experience in academic and/or industry clinical research in drug development.

• Experience as a Medical Monitor on clinical oncology and/or rare clinical trials is required

• Clinical practice experience of a minimum of 3-5 years preferred

• Board certification in hematology and/or oncology preferred

Knowledge, Skills, and Competencies:

• Lead with integrity, professionalism, and transparency in all interactions.

• Anticipate client needs and provide innovative solutions that consistently meet or exceed expectations.

• Lead medical strategy and scientific discussions in both prepared and extemporaneous settings.

• Demonstrate accountability and ownership for outcomes, proactively identifying root causes of issues and implementing sustainable solutions.

• Model company values and foster a culture focused on patient care, scientific excellence, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

• Effective level of communication (both written and verbal) skills and effective level of salesmanship and presentation skills.

• Proficiency and sensitivity to work in a global company with reports from varied cultures and backgrounds

jobs.title: Sales Development Representative (US - Remote)
jobs.description:
ABOUT DUVO

Duvo helps big companies actually finish the operational work that nobody on their team has time to close. The stuff that lives across an ERP, a few portals, somebody's inbox, three spreadsheets and the occasional phone call.

Our customers include Morrisons, Holland & Barrett, Boden, Notino, Allegro and Rohlik. The buyer is usually a Head of Operations, Supply Chain, Finance or IT at a large retailer or consumer goods brand, and increasingly the same roles in other industries.

We raised a $32M Series A in October 2026, led by Balderton with Index, Northzone and Credo, taking us to $48M raised. The US is where a large share of that goes.


ABOUT THE ROLE

You would be the first SDR in the United States.

Duvo is European by origin and is now building properly in the US. We have Enterprise AEs on the ground and we are live on the Azure Marketplace, which shortens procurement for a lot of enterprise buyers. What we do not have yet is a dedicated outbound motion here. That is the job.

You build it: the target list, the messaging, the tooling, the cadence. You will work directly with our US AEs and with the SVP of Go to Market.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Build pipeline into enterprise retail and consumer goods in the US, and into the industries we are opening up next.

 - Find the right person, not the easy one. Our champions are Heads of Supply Chain, Finance Directors, Commercial Operations leads. They do not answer generic outbound.

 - Research like it matters, because it does. Every company has a specific process that is quietly costing them money. Your job is to work out which one, before you write a word.

 - Run outbound across email, phone, LinkedIn and whatever works next.

 - Use AI properly, not decoratively. Research, list building, personalisation, qualification. If you are doing something fifty times by hand, build the thing that does it.

 - Hand over qualified meetings with a hypothesis attached, so the AE walks into the first call already knowing what the problem probably is.

 - Feed back what the US market actually responds to. The European messaging will not transfer unchanged and we would rather know early.


WHO YOU ARE

 - 2+ years in an SDR or BDR seat selling B2B software, with a track record you can point at. We want to see a full cycle of quota attainment, not three months of promise.

 - You have worked with AI technology, as a user or a seller. This is not a nice to have for us. You should be able to tell us what you use, why, and where it stops being useful.

 - AI-native tooling is how you work. Clay, Lemlist or their equivalents, and an LLM you actually trust. If your answer is that you use ChatGPT to tidy up emails, this will not be a fit.

 - You are a hunter. You build your own list and go after it. You are not waiting on marketing.

 - You can write. Short, specific, about them.

 - You take rejection like a professional. Most people will not reply. The job is doing it well anyway.

 - Comfortable being the first of something, in a company whose head office is five to nine hours ahead of you.


NICE TO HAVE

 - Experience selling into retail, CPG or supply chain operations.

 - Exposure to consumption-based pricing, hyperscaler ecosystems or partner-led selling.

 - Experience selling through a cloud marketplace.

 - You have built something yourself, at work or outside it, that other people use.


WHAT WE OFFER

 - Competitive base with uncapped commission. We share the OTE range on the first call.

 - Equity. Everyone at Duvo has it.

 - A Series A company with real customers, real proof points and the funding to go after a much bigger market.

 - The US outbound motion, to build rather than inherit.

 - Remote from anywhere in the US.

 - Quarterly offsite in Prague.


HOW WE HIRE

 1. Screening call with Talent

 2. Conversation with the hiring manager

 3. Practical exercise, discussed live rather than prepared for weeks

 4. Final conversation

We try to close the loop in under three weeks.

•    Leads and encourages Contractor/Subcontractor participation with Client’s additional Health, Safety, environment, and Security requirements.

Minimum of five years as an on-site SSHO.
