jobs.title: Truck Service Field Technician
jobs.description:
Mid-Atlantic Truck & Equipment

Diesel Field Service Technician – Henrico County, VA

$30–$40/hr + $3/hr Location Differential | No Flat Rate | Monday–Friday | No Weekends

We’re looking for an experienced Diesel Technician to support customers throughout Henrico County, VA.

If you have hands-on experience working on heavy-duty trucks and equipment, take pride in quality workmanship, and enjoy troubleshooting and completing repairs in the field, we’d like to talk with you.

At MATE, you’ll work on a variety of heavy-duty trucks and equipment, including service cranes, roll-offs, street sweepers, dump trucks, and more. You’ll handle everything from preventative maintenance and electrical repairs to hydraulic system troubleshooting and larger mechanical repairs at customer locations.

What We Offer

• $30–$40 per hour + $3/hour location differential, based on demonstrated skill level

• No flat-rate pay

• $250 Quarterly Tool Allowance

• $200 Annual Boot Allowance

• Up to $2,000 Annual Cold-Weather Retention Incentive

• Monday–Friday, 6:30 AM–3:00 PM

• No weekends

• Company-provided uniforms

• Manufacturer and vendor technical training

Benefits That Work for You

• 80 hours of PTO in your first year, increasing with your years of service

• 8 hours of paid Personal Leave each year, in addition to PTO

• Paid holidays

• Medical, dental, and vision coverage

• MATE-funded HRA contribution toward your medical deductible — up to $3,000

• 401(k) with company match: MATE matches 50% of the first 8% you contribute, for a maximum company match of $3,000 per year

• Company-paid $50,000 Basic Life & AD&D Insurance

• Company-paid Short-Term Disability

• Company-paid Long-Term Disability

• Employee Assistance Program and additional support resources for you and your family

What You’ll Do

As a Diesel Field Service Technician, you will:

• Travel to customer locations to diagnose, repair, and maintain heavy-duty trucks and equipment.

• Troubleshoot and repair diesel engines, hydraulic systems, electrical systems, and related mechanical components.

• Perform preventative maintenance and inspections to help keep customer equipment safe and operating reliably.

• Diagnose and repair hydraulic pumps, cylinders, valves, hoses, and other hydraulic components.

• Complete electrical repairs, cooling system maintenance, lubrication, tire service, and other mechanical repairs as needed.

• Use diagnostic tools and technical resources to identify issues and complete repairs accurately.

• Complete electronic work orders, documenting diagnostics, repairs, and additional work recommended.

• Communicate with the Service Manager and team regarding repair needs, parts, and additional support.

• Follow safety procedures and manufacturer guidelines while completing quality repairs at customer sites.

What We’re Looking For

• 3+ years of experience working with hydraulic pumps, cylinders, valves, and hoses.

• 3+ years of automotive electrical troubleshooting and repair experience.

• Diesel engine repair experience preferred.

• MIG and stick welding experience preferred.

• Strong mechanical troubleshooting skills and the ability to use hand tools, power tools, measuring devices, and diagnostic equipment.

• Ability to work independently at customer locations and make sound repair decisions.

• Must have your own tools.

• Valid driver's license required.

Why MATE?

We’re looking for technicians who take pride in their work and bring strong diagnostic and repair skills to the job. You’ll work on a variety of heavy-duty equipment, have access to manufacturer and vendor training, and play an important role in keeping our customers’ businesses moving.

If you’re an experienced technician looking for steady weekday hours, competitive hourly pay, and the opportunity to put your skills to work in the field, we’d love to hear from you.

Physical Requirements

• Ability to work outdoors in varying weather conditions.

• Ability to frequently kneel, bend, squat, push, pull, and reach.

• Ability to lift and move more than 50 lbs. without assistance.

• Ability to safely get into and out of various vehicles and equipment.

• Must pass a DOT physical, including drug screening.

Communication Requirements

This position requires the ability to read, write, speak, and understand English sufficiently to safely perform the essential functions of the job. Effective communication is necessary to understand and follow safety procedures and instructions, communicate with customers and team members, and complete required job-related documentation.

Mid-Atlantic Truck & Equipment is an equal employment opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, and other legally protected characteristics.

jobs.title: FP&A Analyst / Associate
jobs.description:
FP & A Analyst / Associate

Are you an analytical finance professional who enjoys turning complex data into clear business decisions? Join Sand and help shape the financial planning, performance insights and commercial decisions behind a global company using AI to solve humanity’s most pressing challenges.

About Sand

Sand is a global Physical AI company using data and AI to make critical industries work better. We partner with governments, cities and enterprises to improve how essential systems operate across healthcare, water, energy, telecommunications and infrastructure.

Our work delivers proven real-world impact. We have built AI systems that help manage London’s water supply, supported telecom network planning across hundreds of cities, and developed digital healthcare platforms serving tens of millions of people. From intelligent command centers to AI-powered infrastructure platforms, we help organizations sense, analyze and act in complex environments.

Our people are ambitious, curious and relentlessly practical. Our teams work alongside clients in the field, solving hard problems and deploying solutions that last. With colleagues across Africa, Europe, the UK and the US, we operate across the full stack - from research and engineering to deployment and capability building.

Our mission is simple: to harness AI to solve humanity’s most pressing challenges.

Role Summary

Sand is seeking an FP&A Analyst / Associate to serve as the analytical engine of our Finance team. Working closely with the Head of FP&A and CFO, you will help build and maintain financial plans, track performance against budgets, and deliver the insights management and investors need to understand the business and make informed decisions.

You will also partner with commercial teams on pricing, margins and profitability, translating financial analysis into practical recommendations that support sustainable growth.

This is a high-exposure role for someone who combines strong financial modelling skills with curiosity, commercial judgment and attention to detail. Your work will directly inform senior leadership decisions, and you will have the opportunity to improve how Sand plans, measures performance and allocates resources.

Specific Responsibilities

Budgeting, Forecasting and Performance Tracking

• Support the development, maintenance and improvement of annual budgets, rolling forecasts and long-range financial models.

• Track actual performance against budgets and forecasts, explain key variances, and flag risks and opportunities early.

• Prepare timely, decision-ready analysis for the Head of FP&A and CFO, including scenario modelling and sensitivity analysis.

• Update financial plans as business priorities, assumptions and operating conditions change.

KPIs and Management Reporting

• Own the definition, calculation and tracking of key performance metrics used internally and required by investors.

• Support the preparation of monthly management reports, board materials and investor reporting packs.

• Ensure financial models, reports and underlying systems contain accurate, consistent and reliable data.

• Translate financial and operating results into clear insights on business performance and its key drivers.

Commercial Partnering

• Support commercial teams with pricing, margin and profitability analysis across customers, products, segments and individual deals.

• Evaluate the financial impact of pricing changes, discounts and new commercial proposals.

• Develop clear recommendations that help non-finance stakeholders understand trade-offs and make informed decisions.

Process Improvement and Strategic Analysis

• Streamline and automate recurring reporting, budgeting and forecasting processes.

• Improve the structure, flexibility and usability of financial models and reporting tools.

• Support ad hoc strategic analysis, including business cases, fundraising support, and M&A or investment evaluations.

Skill Requirements - Essential

• 3–5 years of experience in FP&A, strategic finance, corporate development or investment banking.

• Strong financial modelling expertise, including the ability to build clear, flexible and well-structured models from scratch and review existing models for accuracy.

• A degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Engineering or a related quantitative field.

• Strong analytical skills, with the ability to identify business trends, understand performance drivers and spot inconsistencies in financial data.

• A curious and creative approach to problem-solving, with the ability to challenge assumptions and explore alternative scenarios.

• Clear written, verbal and presentation skills, including the ability to explain complex analysis simply to senior leaders and non-finance stakeholders.

• The ability to work effectively with finance and commercial teams while managing competing priorities.

• High ownership, strong attention to detail and a proactive approach to delivering accurate work in a fast-moving environment.

Skill Requirements - Preferable

• CFA, ACA/CA or a comparable professional qualification.

Work Environment

This is a remote role involving regular collaboration with colleagues across multiple countries and time zones. The successful candidate will be self-driven, comfortable working independently, and proactive in communicating through virtual collaboration tools and video conferencing.

At Sand, you will be encouraged to continually develop your capabilities and pursue learning opportunities and relevant certifications that support your professional growth.

jobs.title: Inside Sales Representative - HR Solutions
jobs.description:
Paychex is reimagining how businesses manage their workforce by bringing payroll, HR, benefits, and advisory services together into a single connected HCM platform. As Paychex and Paycor come together, we're combining innovative technology, data-driven insights, AI, and human expertise to help organizations work smarter, support their people, and achieve better business outcomes. This is an exciting time to join our team as we continue to invest in innovation, simplify client experiences, and shape the future of work. At Paychex, you'll have the opportunity to grow your career, make a meaningful impact, and be part of something bigger as One Paychex.

Overview

Inside Sales Representatives are responsible for prospecting existing and new clients remotely and managing the entire sales cycle from within a designated Paychex inside sales hub. the inside sales representative engages with customers via phone, email, and other virtual channels, to effectively close deals and meet sales targets.

Responsibilities

• Execute outbound warm calls and activities with existing and new clients to generate leads, qualify opportunities, and build a strong sales pipeline
• Follow up on partnership referrals and strategizing account targeting, to ensure a continuous flow of potential clients ready for the sales process
• Conduct client meetings to analyze needs and develop targeted sales presentations and demos that address specific client requirements
• Address objections by clarifying concerns and reinforcing solution benefits, utilizing closing techniques to secure commitments and finalize agreements
• Inputting and maintaining accurate records of sales activities and client interactions in the crm system to manage the sales pipeline effectively

jobs.title: Manager, Digital Marketing Operations
jobs.description:
We are a healthcare technology company that provides platforms and solutions to improve the management and access of cost-effective pharmacy benefits. Our technology helps enterprise and partnership clients simplify their businesses and helps consumers save on prescriptions.

As a leader in SaaS technology for healthcare, we offer innovative solutions with integrated intelligence on a single enterprise platform that connects the pharmacy ecosystem.  With our expertise and modern, modular platform, our partners use real-time data to transform their business performance and optimize their innovative models in the marketplace.

Position Summary

The Manager, Digital Marketing Operations, keeps SingleCare’s consumer communications running with precision. This role manages CRM operations across email and SMS, runs the creative development process that moves campaigns from brief to launch, and schedules the social calendar. It connects the teams, tools, and vendors behind every message our members and prospects receive, and it looks for smarter ways to do that work.

You will build, schedule, and monitor campaigns in Braze and Twilio, manage our email and SMS vendors, and turn performance data into recommendations that improve results. You will also support the Digital team (SMS, App Install, and Paid Social) with coordination that keeps work moving. We want a coordinator who is curious about AI and willing to put it to work, using it to streamline processes, speed up workflows, and improve campaign outcomes. This is a hands-on role with regular collaboration across Brand, Creative, Analytics, and Performance Marketing.

Key responsibilities

CRM operations

• Build, schedule, and monitor email and SMS campaigns in Braze and Twilio and manage the technical setup of our marketing automation and CRM systems.

• Manage email and SMS vendor relationships, including onboarding, performance, and cost.

• Track and report email and SMS performance to identify opportunities to influence member behavior and increase lifetime value.

• Protect data quality in the marketing database and maintain consistent design and brand standards across all workflows, working with the Brand team.

Creative development process

• Manage the creative development process from request to launch, including briefs, timelines, reviews, and approvals. Creative teams and partners create the work; you keep it organized and moving.

• Maintain a clear intake and prioritization system so every team knows what is in progress, who owns it, and when it is due.

Social media scheduling

• Schedule and manage social campaigns in Hootsuite and Later, coordinating with Brand, Content, and Creative to confirm copy, assets, and approvals are ready ahead of publishing.

• Maintain the social content calendar and report on publishing performance.

Digital team support

• Provide coordinator support to the Digital team (SMS, App Install, and Paid Social), including campaign setup, asset tracking, trafficking, and reporting.

Process improvement

• Review current CRM, creative, and social workflows, and partner with RxSense internal AI resources to automate repeatable steps and improve speed and accuracy.

• Test AI tools for tasks such as campaign QA, reporting summaries, copy and subject line variations, and creative briefs, and share what works so the whole team benefits.

• Use performance data and AI assisted analysis to improve segmentation, timing, and messaging in email and SMS.

• Apply a test and learn approach to campaigns, document results, and share learnings with the team.

What success looks like

• Email and SMS programs that launch on schedule, on brand, and with clean data.

• A creative development process with clear briefs, owners, deadlines, and approvals, so creative teams spend their time creating.

• A reliable social publishing calendar in Hootsuite and Later, with campaigns scheduled ahead of launch.

• Regular performance reporting from Braze and Twilio that shows what is working and what to test next.

• Vendor partners that deliver on time and on budget.

• Digital team coordination that moves faster because requests, assets, and approvals are organized.

• At least one AI enabled improvement adopted into daily workflows, with measured gains in time saved or campaign results.

Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.

• 5+ years of digital marketing experience with a background in email and SMS marketing.

• Hands-on experience with marketing automation, ESP, and SMS tools. Braze and Twilio strongly preferred.

• Working knowledge of HTML and CSS for building email campaigns.

• Experience managing workflows, timelines, and approvals across creative and cross functional teams, ideally with a project management tool such as Asana.

• Experience with social scheduling tools such as Hootsuite and Later preferred.

• Strong analytical skills, including Excel, with experience in reporting and data analysis. Tableau preferred.

• Experience managing vendors and budgets.

• A curious, hands-on approach to AI and automation, with willingness to learn new tools and change how work gets done.

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to work across teams in a fast-paced environment and balance competing priorities.

Salary Range: $86,000- &110,000

RxSense believes that a diverse workforce is a more talented and productive workforce. As such, we are an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. Our recruitment process is free from discriminatory hiring practices and all qualified applicants are considered for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, ancestry, age, or national origin.  Neither will qualified applicants be discriminated against on the basis of disability or protected veteran status.  We believe in the strength of the collaboration, creativity and sense of community a diverse workforce brings.

We specialize in treating substance use disorders, such as opioid use disorder, stimulant use disorders, alcohol use disorder, and cannabis use disorder and we have expanded our services to include high-quality, accessible mental health. By combining mobile technology, counseling, and coordinated medical care, we empower our Members to reclaim their lives in recovery.

• Comfort providing care via telehealth platforms

• Strong documentation and organizational skills

• Private, HIPAA-compliant workspace with reliable internet

Compensation & Benefits

Be part of the Affect mission. Help us reshape the future of substance use disorder care!!!

jobs.description:
Are you a BCBA looking for a workplace that values your expertise, offers strong clinical support, and provides real career growth? At Centria, we prioritize your success by eliminating operational burdens, allowing you to focus on what you do best: delivering exceptional ABA therapy and making a difference in children's lives, in a purpose-built clinical setting.

Compensation & Incentives – Earn a base salary of $85,000–$90,000, plus weekly and monthly bonus opportunities (typically averaging $1,000/month).

What Centria Offers:

• Clinical Quality First – We prioritize outcomes, not billables. Our proprietary CareConnect platform streamlines everything from treatment planning to data collection so you can stay focused on care, not paperwork.

• Assent-Based Care at Scale – Lead meaningful change through our commitment to assent, practical functional assessment, and skills-based treatment, built into every part of our model.

• Real Work-Life Balance – Predictable caseloads, manageable schedules, and dedicated support teams mean no last-minute chaos and no burnout.

• You're Never Alone – With layered support from Clinical Directors, Area Clinical Directors, and our Clinical Excellence Team, you'll always have someone in your corner.

• No Operational Headaches – We handle the logistics. From scheduling to onboarding of technicians, our operations team keeps everything running smoothly behind the scenes.

• Career Growth on Your Terms – Whether you're mentoring the next generation of BCBAs, leading clinical training, or stepping into leadership, we support your growth.

• We Invest in You – From CEU stipends and paid CEU days to exclusive internal training events, we’re serious about keeping you sharp—and helping you level up.

• Perks That Actually Matter – Annual, all-inclusive vacation for two, early wage access, a company car or mileage reimbursement, and full benefits.

• No Non-Compete – We don’t believe in holding people back. If we’re not the right long-term fit, you’ll still leave better prepared for your next step.

Your Role & Impact as a BCBA

• Lead ABA therapy delivery within a collaborative, in-center environment

• Provide daily support and guidance to Behavior Technicians to ensure clinical excellence

• Develop and implement assent-based, individualized behavior plans following ABA principles

• Engage parents during scheduled on-site training sessions to drive meaningful progress

• Maintain high-quality clinical services through regular supervision and data-driven decision-making

At Centria, you’re not just a BCBA - you’re a clinical leader, a mentor, and a changemaker. If you’re ready to grow your career without sacrificing your values, apply today and join a team that invests in your clinical excellence!

Centria is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status.

jobs.title: New Mexico | Mental Health Therapist | Telehealth
jobs.description:
Telehealth Mental Health Therapist – Remote

Please note: This is a state-specific application. If you are not currently licensed in New Mexico, we encourage you to visit www.affect.com to view our active openings by state.

If you do not see a current opportunity in your state, we still welcome you to submit your information through our General Application for Future Openings, also available on our website. We’d love to keep your details on file for future consideration.

About Affect

Building on our success in substance use disorder care, Affect has expanded its services to include high-quality, accessible mental health treatment. Our model brings together licensed therapists, innovative technology, and a deeply human approach to help people manage anxiety, depression, trauma, and other mental health challenges—on their terms.

As we grow, we’re seeking skilled, compassionate licensed mental health professionals to join our remote care team.  If you're a New Mexico licensed LCSW, LPCC, LMFT, or LISW looking to make an impact through virtual care, we’d love to connect.

Our ability to provide supervision for non-independent mental health professionals varies by state and license, but we also encourage you to apply. We try to support non-independent licenses when possible.

Key Responsibilities:

• Conduct diagnostic assessments and collaboratively develop evidence-based treatment plans

• Provide individual psychotherapy sessions via secure telehealth platforms

• Support Members with a wide range of mental health needs, including anxiety, depression, trauma, and relationship challenges with flexibility to work with members with substance use disorders at times.

• Maintain clear and timely clinical documentation in our electronic medical record (EMR) system. Affect provides an AI-powered clinical scribe to assist with documentation, helping reduce administrative burden and allowing clinicians to spend more time focused on member care.

• Coordinate care as needed and contribute to a supportive, multidisciplinary environment

• Participate in clinical team meetings and optional case consultations

• Adhere to HIPAA and all applicable state licensure regulations

Requirements:

• Active and verifiable license from one of the following New Mexico licenses: LCSW, LPCC, LMFT, or LISW as well as your state of residence if it is not New Mexico. All credentials must be verified through the State Board’s website as part of the application process

• Experience providing psychotherapy in outpatient, private practice, or telehealth settings

• Strong communication and clinical skills with a person-centered, trauma-informed approach

• Comfort with EMRs, Google Suite or Microsoft Office, and telehealth tools

• Ability to work independently in a remote setting with professionalism and integrity

• Have a private, HIPAA-compliant workspace and reliable internet

The Benefits of Joining Affect

• The salary range for this full-time position is $60,000 - $80,000 and will commensurate with experience and professional license.

• Full-time employees may enroll in offered medical, dental, and vision coverage and employer paid life and disability insurance also provided. Employees may enroll in Affect's company’s 401k plan.

• Paid vacation, sick time, company observed holidays and parental leave is provided to full-time employees.

• Remote work options with full-time and part-time schedules

• AI-powered clinical scribe technology to streamline documentation and reduce administrative workload

• Opportunities for continuing education and professional development

• Supportive team culture focused on impact, collaboration, and innovation

• Be part of building a modern, inclusive, and accessible mental health care system

Join us as we expand our mission—empowering recovery, healing, and hope through digital-first mental health care.

jobs.title: Associate Director, FP&A
jobs.description:
Studs is a category-defining ear piercing and earring brand named one of “the 10 most innovative companies in retail for 2023” by Fast Company. Studs connects ear piercing with aftercare and earring shopping to create an end-to-end Earscaping® experience. We offer a better retail and digital experience that prioritizes safety and expertise in a cool, fun and welcoming environment, along with a wide earring assortment—all at an accessible price point.

The Associate Director, FP&A owns financial planning and analysis at Studs, with a focus on improving studio profitability, supporting disciplined expansion, and managing cash. Reporting to the CFO, this person builds and runs the annual budget, rolling forecast, and long-term financial plan directly, translating financial and operational results into clear recommendations. This is an individual contributor role with no direct reports at the outset; as the finance team grows, the planning function may report into this role.

This role partners with Retail, Operations, Marketing, Merchandising, and Accounting to connect business decisions to revenue, EBITDA, cash flow, and investment returns. It helps leadership set studio-level performance goals, allocate capital, and identify risks and opportunities early enough to act.

This is a hands-on role for someone who has worked in four-wall retail finance, builds models directly, works through imperfect data, challenges assumptions constructively, and follows through with business partners to improve results.

Salary Range: $155,000 — $175,000 plus equity

Location: HQ (New York, NY) — Hybrid

Key Responsibilities:

Financial Planning, Forecasting & Modeling

• Own the annual budget and rolling forecast process across departments, including timelines, assumptions, and reviews with business leaders.

• Own an integrated P&L, balance sheet, and cash flow forecast; partner with Accounting to assess liquidity, inventory and other working capital needs, and funding requirements.

• Connect studio and e-commerce revenue plans, operating expenses, and capital investments to company profitability and cash targets; identify gaps and recommend adjustments.

• Build scenarios that test growth, profitability, and cash assumptions, making trade-offs and downside risks clear before decisions are made.

• Improve planning tools and processes so forecasts are accurate and assumptions are consistent; use AI, automation, and lightweight software development to streamline recurring work, strengthen reporting, and free up the finance team for higher-value analysis, with appropriate data safeguards and validation.

Performance Analysis & Business Partnership

• Run regular reviews of company, channel, and studio performance against plan and prior periods, explaining the drivers of results and surfacing risks and opportunities.

• Partner with Retail to set and track studio-level targets for revenue, EBITDA dollars and margin, labor productivity, and utilization; analyze performance by studio and cohort to identify opportunities across the fleet.

• Partner with Marketing and Retail to analyze traffic, conversion, customer acquisition and retention, and marketing returns; recommend investments that connect demand generation to studio capacity and profitable growth.

• Challenge plans constructively, agree on actions and owners with business partners, and track whether those actions improve results.

Strategic Planning & Investment Analysis

• Build the long-term financial plan and capital allocation analysis, helping leadership prioritize investment across new studios, existing studio improvements, marketing, and other growth initiatives.

• Underwrite new studio investments with Real Estate and Retail, including buildout costs, sales ramp, operating profitability, cash requirements, and payback; compare actual results with the original investment case.

• Evaluate pricing, assortment, new services, and other strategic initiatives; establish financial success measures and compare actual results with expectations.

Reporting & Executive Visibility

• Prepare monthly, quarterly, and annual management reporting, forecasts, and performance analysis for leadership and the board; partner with Accounting, which owns the close and financial statements, to ensure consistent and reliable reporting.

• Support the CFO in communicating the outlook, key risks, and recommended actions to senior stakeholders, and contribute to financing analysis, lender reporting, and fundraising or transaction diligence as needed.

Requirements:

• Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Business, or a related field.

• 6+ years of relevant experience in FP&A or strategic finance, including hands-on ownership of budgeting, forecasting, and long-term financial planning.

• Four-wall retail experience required: prior finance work in a multi-unit retail business with direct responsibility for store or studio-level P&L, labor, and unit economics.

• Strong financial modeling skills, including building integrated financial forecasts and studio-level investment models from scratch and translating results into business recommendations.

• Sound financial judgment, strong analytical and problem-solving skills, and close attention to detail.

• Experience partnering with senior leaders, challenging assumptions constructively, and influencing decisions across teams.

• Clear, direct communicator in writing and in person; comfortable explaining financial performance and recommendations to executive and board audiences.

• Advanced Excel skills and proficiency with financial planning and reporting tools; experience working with ERP, point-of-sale, and operational data to build consistent performance reporting.

• Comfortable building analyses directly, working through imperfect data, and holding business partners accountable for agreed actions; acts with integrity and responds openly to feedback.

• Ability to set priorities in a fast-paced, high-growth environment while staying hands-on and keeping the big picture in view. AI fluency preferred: comfortable using AI tools in daily work and building practical automations, scripts, or internal applications that improve the finance team’s speed and effectiveness.

• Based in New York, NY and able to work in the office three days per week.

Benefits & Perks

• Flexible Work Environment (3 days in office, 2 days work from home)

• Comprehensive Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance (including a plan option with $0 in-network mental health visits)

• Access to Mental Health and Work/Life Resources including Online Therapy, Gender Affirmation Support Services, and Employee Assistance Program (EAP)

• Voluntary Life Insurance

• Health and Commuter Tax-Advantaged Accounts

• Stock Options in connection with the Company’s Equity Incentive Plan

• 401(k) Retirement Savings Plan

• Paid Time Off, Paid Safe & Sick Leave, and Paid Parental Leave

• Paid Sabbatical After 4 Years of Service

• Exclusive Employee Discounts on Piercings and Jewelry (we’ve got your friends and family covered too!)

• Access to PerkSpot and additional benefits such as pet insurance, discounted tickets, personal finance coaching, healthy rewards, and more!

Studs is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to providing a work environment that fosters diversity, inclusion, and equal opportunity without regard to race, color, gender, age, creed, sex, religion, national origin, disability (physical or mental), marital status, citizenship, ancestry, sexual orientation, gender identity and gender expression, or any other legally protected status. Studs considers qualified applicants with criminal histories. We comply with applicable state and local laws prohibiting discrimination in employment in every jurisdiction in which we operate. If you require an accommodation for the application process, please fill out this form.

Massachusetts Applicants: It is unlawful in Massachusetts to require or administer a lie detector test as a condition of employment or continued employment. An employer who violates this law shall be subject to criminal penalties and civil liability.

jobs.title: Auto Mechanic II - ADESA Mira Loma
jobs.description:
Pay Range: $37.05-$37.05 hourly

About Us
ADESA, a Carvana owned company, currently operating over 50 locations throughout the US. Our Auto Auctions, some up to 200 acres, provide a wide array of vehicle services including repair & reconditioning, auction remarketing, and many of our sites serve as market hub distribution centers. Our inventory comprises hundreds of thousands of vehicles across North America from retail to commercial, OEM & more.
We work in a service industry and embrace a “we” versus “I” culture – help others, and they will help you. Our industry is fun, fast-paced, and competitive – and filled with the best people who are passionate about what they do.
We’re excited about the future! As an industry leader, ADESA is poised for a multi-year expansion including huge investments in facilities, massive sales growth, and an ever-increasing inventory of vehicles! We are looking for great people who want to take this journey with us! Get a sneak peek into life at ADESA!

Role and Team

Reporting to the Mechanical Services Manager or designated manager, the Mechanical Technician II will perform proper diagnosis, repairs and maintenance to vehicles as assigned.  Maintain consistently high standards for technical efficiency, make quality repairs and diagnostics while observing all safety requirements.  Perform all duties assigned.  Must know, practice and ensure that company policies and procedures and state or federal laws are followed always.

Function (Department Roles)

The Mechanical Technician II will perform proper diagnosis, repairs and routine maintenance to vehicles as assigned under little or no supervision. The T2 Technician must be assigned to work/train with a T3 or T4 when working a higher classification. Maintain consistently high standards for technical efficiency, make quality repairs and diagnostics while observing all safety requirements.

Purpose (End Results)

This position performs identified maintenance and repair service on different types of vehicles. Task assignments are directed by shop management to encourage development in a productive manner.
Responsibilities and Duties (Key Roles) technician tasks including, but not limited to the following:

• Provide prompt and courteous service:

• Demonstrate friendliness and greet every person with whom they come in contact.

• Maintain a professional appearance and a neat work environment consistent with the Company’s Policies and Procedures.

• Return customer’s vehicles in clean condition with radios, seats, mirrors and other convenience items in the same position as when the customer brought the vehicle in. No smoking in customer vehicles.

• Make sure customers receive prompt, efficient and courteous attention from all employees. Notify Manager of any delays or discrepancies in repair estimates.

• Resolve any customer complaints in a friendly, courteous manner and advise Management of all serious complaints or incidences.

• Perform assigned diagnostic repair or maintenance to the standards of the service center and factory specifications. Obtain clearance from Management whenever this cannot be done.

• Look up parts to perform the service. Use parts in stock when possible and notify admins of parts that need to be saved and tagged.

• Test and recheck all repairs and road test all comebacks as assigned by the Manager. Request assistance on repairs or diagnosis as needed.

• Properly complete all Repair Orders including notifying admins what needs to be done.

• Assist the Manager in creating a proper estimate by informing them as to discrepancies or abnormalities in time required to perform the service and parts required for the job. Recommend additional repairs needed or maintenance to the Manager (verbal or written recommendations are required).

• Maintain and improve technical expertise through technical bulletins, trade publications and training seminars.

• Practice and promote teamwork always. Set a good personal example of attitude and performance.

• Advise the Manager or designee of all equipment breakdowns and maintenance immediately.

• Make sure work area conditions do not threaten employee or customer safety. Keep work area clean and free of clutter. Sweep and pick up work area daily and dispose of junk parts and their containers appropriately. Respond to and follow proper procedures on employee and customer accidents, injuries, and loss or damage to any property. Report all incidents to the Manager or designee.

Qualifications (Education and Experience):

• High School Diploma or GED preferred

• Must be able to perform all lower classifications, (Mechanic Tech I)

• Required – Two (2) of three (3) Certifications A-4, A-5 or A-7

• Require two (2) to three (3) years of experience in the field or a related area.

• Must be qualified to operate a motor vehicle and possess a valid driver’s license.

• Must be able to drive vehicles with either standard or automatic transmissions.

• Ability to understand and adhere to Company policies in all areas.

• Effective Interpersonal communication skills.

• Must have the ability to interact positively with others

• Computer literacy preferred

Major Activities:

Skill Area: A/C & Heater

• Operate the system and recognize if the system is cooling or not (PM related)

• Perform basic system checks such as power to compressor, visual inspection of condenser, belt tension, etc.

• Identify Freon and oil leaks

Skill Area: Brakes-Air

• Identify components of air brake system

• Operate brakes and identify irregular noises, air leaks

• Perform simple air system tests

• Measure lining thickness

• Adjust brakes

• Measure drums, rotors, cam braking

Skill Area Brakes: Hydraulic

• Road test for proper operation

• Make visual inspections for leaks

• Check park brake operation

• Check fluid level

• Measure lining thickness

• Adjust service brakes

• Perform brake repair

• Adjust park Brakes

Skill Area: Charging Systems (electrical)

• Visually inspect batteries

• Clean connections

• Check condition of belts

• Test batteries

• Check alternator mounting and pulley

• Replace and adjust belts

• Perform basic charging system check

Skill Area: Clutch

• Lubricate throw-out bearing, linkage, shafts and cables

• Identify proper clutch operation

• Identify proper clutch brake operation

Skill Area: Cooling Systems

• Check and adjust coolant levels

• Visually inspect system for leaks

• Make minor repairs such as hose replacements, fan shrouds, leaking fittings

• Recognize permanent antifreezes and their requirements

• Use refractometer

• Use pressure tester

• Flush and refill systems

Skill Area: Cranking System (electrical)

• Inspect and test batteries

• Visually inspect cables and cranking motor

• Clean the battery cables, connections and starter

• Replace batteries

• Charge and check batteries

• Replace or repair defective cables

Skill Area: Lighting System and Electrical Accessories

• Repair minor wiring problems

• Replace bulbs, lenses and simple light assembles

• Repair minor lighting problems

• Replace and adjust sealed beams

• Install or replace accessories such as heated mirrors, fans, and spotlights

Skill Area: Drive Axles

• Inspect housings for leaks

• Change oil and filter, if required, and clean breathers

Skill Area: Driveline

• Lubricate drive line

• Inspect components for wear or damage

Skill Area: Gas Engines – All Engines

• Check and adjust oil levels

• Identify unusual noises, oil leaks

Skill Area: Fuel Systems

• Replace and prime fuel filter

• Check gas and diesel fuel system components such as fuel lines, pickup tubes, return lines, etc. for proper integrity and condition.

Skill Area: Preventive Maintenance

• Proper lube techniques

• Minimal tire inspection

• Brake check/applied stroke

• Battery check

• Under vehicle check/check/lose components

• Initial Fault code identification

Skill Area: Tire and Wheel Maintenance

• Perform air pressure checks

• Check tread depth

• Identify tires that need to be changed or repaired

• Perform tire P.M. Checks

• Replace tire and wheel assembles

• Mount/dismount and rotate tires

• Perform tire/wheel checks/repairs

Mechanic Tech I -  Responsibilities and Duties

Provide prompt and courteous service:

• Demonstrate friendliness and greet every person with whom they come in contact.

• Maintain a professional appearance and a neat work environment consistent with the Company’s Policies and Procedures.

• Return customer’s vehicles in clean condition with radios, seats, mirrors and other convenience items in the same position as when the customer brought the vehicle in. No smoking in customer vehicles.

• Make sure customers receive prompt, efficient and courteous attention from all employees. Notify Mechanical Services of any delays or discrepancies in repair estimates.

• Resolve any customer complaints in a friendly, courteous manner and advise Management of all serious complaints or incidences.

• Perform light mechanical, tire and inspection services to the standards of the Mechanic Shop.

• Inform the Mechanical Services Manager or designee when a job is started, finished, interrupted or delayed. Keep the Manager informed as to the progress and/or problems with work load. Request assistance with repairs or inspections as needed.

• Look up parts to perform the service; use parts in stock when possible and communicate with admins of items needed.

• Properly complete all work orders. Check off each job and return the work order to the Manager if all work has been completed.

• Recommend additional repairs needed or maintenance to the Manager (verbal or written recommendations are required).

• Practice and promote teamwork always. Set a good personal example of attitude and performance.

• Advise the Mechanical Services Manager of all equipment breakdowns and maintenance immediately.

• Make sure work area conditions do not threaten employee or customer safety. Keep work area clean and free of clutter. Sweep and pick up work area daily and dispose of junk parts and their containers appropriately. Respond to and follow proper procedures on employee and customer accidents, injuries, and loss or damage to any property. Report all incidents to the Manager.

Qualifications (Education and Experience):

• High School Diploma or GED preferred.

• Must be qualified to operate a motor vehicle and possess a valid driver’s license.

• 1 to 2 years of experience in the field or a related area.

• Must be able to drive vehicles with either standard or automatic transmissions.

• Must be tire and wheel qualified within six months of getting this position

• Ability to understand and adhere to Company policies in all areas

• Effective interpersonal communications skills

• Must have the ability to interact positively with others

• Computer skills preferred

• Customer interaction is required

Major Activities:

• Will perform tire service, including proper entry on repair orders, parts stocking, mounting and dismounting of assembled wheels on vehicles.

• Will be responsible for the Company’s Tire program at the employee’s assigned locations.

• Will assist with tire inventory, stocking levels, ordering inventory and maintaining customer specific tire matrix.

• Oil changes, brakes, hoses, belts,

• Light bulb change and Misc.

• Ability to understand and adhere to Company policies in all areas

• Effective interpersonal communications skills

• Must have the ability to interact positively with others

Note: This position will not perform any major mechanical or structural repair work.

Physical Requirements:

The physical activity requirements of the position are from Medium to Heavy Physical Work.

• Constant – standing, watching, touching and fingering, listening

• Frequent – walking, talking, reaching, feeling, grasping, pushing, pulling, kneeling, stooping, crouching, lifting

• Occasional – climbing, balancing, crawling

• Potential – running, jumping, yelling, or other rapid or forceful movement in emergency situations

Physical Working Condition:
This position is subject to both inside and outside environmental working conditions, including temperature changes, outside weather conditions, slightly elevated ambient noise levels, minor potential physical hazards, such as electrical current , moving mechanical parts, exposure to hot equipment and cleaning and pesticide chemicals; and minor atmospheric conditions affecting skin or respiratory systems, such as fumes, odors and dusts associated with internal and external service station/convenience food and petroleum dispensing operations..

Note:  This job description in no way states or implies that these are the only duties to be performed by the employee(s) incumbent in this position.  Employee(s) will be required to follow any other job-related instructions and to perform any other job-related duties requested by any person authorized to give instructions or assignments.   The requirements listed in this document are the minimum levels of knowledge, skills or abilities.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Education
jobs.description:
CrossFit is seeking a Senior Product Manager, Education. You will own product strategy and execution for CrossFit's Education line of business, including the learner experience, course registration, content authoring and delivery, learning platforms, and credentialing. This is a hands-on, individual contributor role: you are the dedicated product specialist for Education, translating the needs of Education leaders, program owners, instructors, and learners into a clear product vision, roadmap, and priorities.
You will partner closely with Engineering, Design, Marketing, Operations, and Education leadership, and coordinate with product owners for adjacent products (for example, the mobile app) to align strategy and sequencing across the broader product surface. Education is central to CrossFit's identity and has significant room to grow. The foundation is an older, layered stack of in-house software and vendor tools.
This role requires someone resilient and responsive, strong at strategy, and disciplined about tight feedback loops: a person who can bring structure and clarity to ambiguity, make disciplined trade-offs, and deliver measurable results.
Responsibilities
Product Strategy & Roadmap:Define and own the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for Education, in alignment with company priorities and business objectives.Establish clear product goals, success metrics, and KPIs, and regularly evaluate performance against expected outcomes.Use customer insights, product analytics, market trends, and business data to identify opportunities and guide product decisions.Balance learner experience, business impact, technical investment, and available resources, and make and communicate clear trade-off decisions when priorities compete.Bring an informed point of view on where online learning is heading, then commit fully to the direction the business chooses.
Product Execution:
Lead the product lifecycle from discovery and validation through development, launch, adoption, measurement, and iteration.
Guide product decisions for Education's learner experience, course registration, content authoring and delivery, learning platforms, and credentialing, including integrations across existing systems.
Evaluate build, buy, modernize, or replace options for legacy platforms and vendor tools, considering user needs, technical dependencies, migration costs, and long-term value.
Ensure requirements clearly define the customer problem, business need, expected outcome, and measures of success.
Partner with Engineering and Design to scope initiatives and sequence work across quick wins, foundational fixes, and new capabilities.
Support launches with go-to-market, communication, training, and adoption plans in partnership with business stakeholders.
Contribute to foundational platform capabilities that cut across products, such as data privacy and consent, localization, and marketing enablement.
Customer & Business Impact:
Partner with Education leaders and program owners to identify learner and instructor pain points, distinguish underlying problems from proposed solutions, and prioritize improvements across the learner journey.
Establish and improve instrumentation for enrollment, course completion, conversion, learner retention, and revenue per learner, including where existing data is incomplete.
Run experiments across acquisition, activation, upgrades, and re-engagement, using results to refine product and growth priorities.
Build tight feedback loops through research, analytics, and direct engagement with learners, instructors, and staff, and turn what you learn into decisions quickly.
Tie product investments to measurable customer and business outcomes rather than feature delivery alone.
Collaboration & Influence:
Serve as the key Product partner to Education leadership, and communicate strategy, roadmap decisions, progress, risks, and results to executives and other stakeholders.
Establish operating rhythms that create visibility into roadmap progress, dependencies, risks, and decisions.
Identify and resolve barriers to execution across teams and functions.
Model strong product practices, including discovery, prioritization, and measurement, and share them with peers.
Coordinate with product owners for adjacent products to align strategy and sequencing.
Knowledge and Skills
Strong product judgment, with the ability to connect customer needs, business strategy, technology, and financial outcomes.
Knowledge of education technology, including learning management systems, content authoring, course delivery, credentialing, and learner-facing experiences, and/or deep experience in growth: funnel analysis, experimentation, activation, conversion, and retention. Depth in both is ideal.
Ability to define meaningful funnel and learning metrics, improve measurement capabilities, and use experimentation to inform product decisions.
Experience navigating legacy systems, vendor integrations, and fragmented data environments, with sound judgment on technical and migration trade-offs.
Strong strategic thinking, paired with resilience and responsiveness. You turn feedback into decisions quickly and stay steady when plans change.
Ability to prioritize investments and make difficult trade-offs in a resource-constrained environment.
Skill at finding the real problem behind a stated request, and at saying no in a way that keeps the relationship intact.
Strong understanding of modern software development and experience partnering closely with Engineering and Design.
Uses modern AI tools (e.g., Claude) fluently to accelerate discovery, requirements, analysis, and delivery.
Experience with lifecycle marketing and personalization tooling preferred.
Excellent communication and executive presentation skills, with demonstrated ability to influence senior stakeholders and create alignment across functions.
Comfortable operating in an evolving environment, bringing structure and clarity to ambiguity.
Strong ownership, accountability, and bias toward execution.
Understanding of the CrossFit ecosystem, Affiliate model, or fitness industry preferred.
Education and Experience
Bachelor's degree or equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.
7+ years of product management experience for Senior, or 10+ years for Principal, including significant ownership of digital products or platforms.
Experience with education technology, certification or credentialing, online learning, or learner growth products, and/or growth product experience across acquisition, activation, conversion, and retention.
Familiarity with learning standards (such as SCORM or xAPI), international localization, registration and payment flows, or membership-based education models preferred.
Demonstrated success launching and improving products that delivered measurable customer and business outcomes, ideally in an older or complex technology environment.
Experience partnering closely with Engineering, Design, and senior business leaders.
Experience with consumer, B2B, marketplace, membership, subscription, fitness, or community-based digital products preferred.

jobs.title: Account Director, Influencer Marketing, (US, Fully-Remote, EST Hours)
jobs.description:
ABOUT KYRA

Kyra is an enterprise influencer marketing platform working with brands like SharkNinja, Coach, H&M, Ray-Ban, and Converse. Our platform manages the full lifecycle — creator discovery, campaign management, content review, payments, analytics, and AI-powered intelligence across TikTok, Instagram, and YouTube.

Campaign Director
📍 EST hours. Reports to the Chief Strategy Officer who oversees the entire delivery team.


🎯 The role
You own a portfolio of client accounts and the team that delivers them. On the client side you are the senior point of contact, accountable for net revenue retention: renewals, expansion, and revenue at risk. On the delivery side you build and lead a team of Campaign Managers and own what they produce: quality, timelines, margin, and the standards they work to.


🔑 What you own

 - Net revenue retention across your portfolio: renewals, expansion, revenue at risk.

 - The senior client relationship, from day-to-day marketing contacts up to budget holders.

 - Campaign delivery across the portfolio: on time, in scope, against KPIs.

 - Building the Campaign Manager team: hiring, onboarding, standards, coaching and progression.

 - Gross profit margin and cost management on your accounts.
   

📊 The numbers you carry

 - Gross profit margin on every account, against target.

 - Team utilisation and throughput per head.

 - Cost per brief, and the direction it’s moving.

 - Renewal rate and expansion revenue on your portfolio.
   

🤝 Owning the client

 - Map stakeholders across functions and regions.

 - Own all communications.

 - Set account strategy: the roadmap, the expansion case, the renewal plan.

 - Own commercial terms, scope and budget.

 - Own executive reporting, QBRs and EBRs.

 - Manage account risk.
   

👥 Leading the team

 - Hire well and onboard fast. You build the team, you don’t just inherit it.

 - Set the production standard: casting, negotiation, brief workflow, escalation.

 - Track Campaign Manager performance against clear, measurable expectations. Coach, give regular feedback, own progression and performance conversations.

 - Plan resourcing and workload.

 - Own the numbers behind delivery: budgeting, forecasting, reconciliation, GPM, throughput per head.

 - Set influencer strategy: casting direction, negotiation and rates, re-engagement of high performers.

 - Act as senior escalation on complex campaign and influencer issues.
   

🔁 Reporting and working across Kyra

 - Lead post-campaign analysis, internal post-mortems and PCA decks.

jobs.description:

🌍 ABOUT US

NPX https://www.npx.ca/ partners with nuclear utilities and new reactor projects to unlock performance through innovation. We combine decades of nuclear operation expertise with AI, digital tools, and lean processes, to help plants run safer, smarter, and more cost-effectively. Our Digital Transformation team scales this expertise through both NPX-developed and industry-leading products, delivering solutions to clients across Canada, the U.S., and globally.




🧠 THE ROLE

We’re looking for a Data Analyst to turn complex operational data into reporting that nuclear clients rely on. You’ll build pipelines in Databricks, shape the data into solid models, and design Power BI dashboards that give plant and project teams a clear, trusted view of how their work is performing.

You’ll work directly with clients and alongside our developers, product managers, and designers, owning your work from the first requirements conversation through to a dashboard people actually use.

Salary Range: $105-135k (Exact compensation may vary).




🎯 WHAT YOU’LL DRIVE

 - Collaborate with clients to understand how they work and what they need to know, then turn that into clear reporting requirements and a practical technical approach.

 - Build and maintain data pipelines in Databricks that bring data from client systems together into clean, reliable, well-documented models.

💙 WHY NPX

 - Flexibility: Flexible hours and a hybrid model, so you can plan your work around your life and your clients’ schedules.

 - Learn from the inside: Work alongside nuclear industry veterans, data specialists, and developers who know how plants really operate.

jobs.title: Director - Sales Operations Americas
jobs.description:
About Us

Axelera AI https://www.axelera.ai is not your regular deep-tech company. We are creating the next-generation AI platform to support anyone who wants to help advancing humanity and improve the world around us. 

In just five years, we have raised a total of $450 million and have built a world-class team of 250+ employees (including 60+ PhDs with more than 40,000 citations), both remotely from 20 different countries and with offices in Belgium, France, Switzerland, Italy, the UK, headquartered at the High Tech Campus in Eindhoven, Netherlands.

We have also launched our Metis™ AI Platform, which achieves a 3-5x increase in efficiency and performance, and have visibility into a strong business pipeline exceeding $100 million.

Our unwavering commitment to innovation has firmly established us as a global industry pioneer.

Are you up for the challenge?



Position Overview

The Director, Sales Operations – Americas is the operational backbone of Axelera AI's Americas business, owning how product reaches customers, how customers get started, how our CRM stack scales, and how we measure revenue. This leader makes sure the Americas sales team can promise what we can deliver, deliver what we promise, and forecast it accurately.

We're looking for a strategic, analytical, and execution-focused leader with deep experience in B2B hardware or semiconductor go-to-market operations. You will work hand in hand with our Global Operations and Finance teams in Europe, report to the VP of Sales, Americas, partner closely with sales and CST leaders across the Americas, and build the processes and systems that fuel predictable, sustainable growth as we scale.

This is a high-impact role for someone who thrives in fast-growing organizations, is equally comfortable in the weeds of logistics and in the architecture of a CRM, and takes pride in running the business on accurate data.



Key responsibilities:

1) Lead Americas Operations & Logistics

 - Direct product availability in the Americas local warehouse, including inventory planning, replenishment requests, and allocation against the sales pipeline.

 - Give the sales team timely, accurate visibility into product availability, lead times, and logistics options so commitments to customers are realistic.

 - Manage the logistics needed to get product to customers: shipping, customs and trade compliance coordination, and carrier and 3PL relationships.

 - Engage customers directly after sale to communicate order status and product arrival, and resolve delivery issues quickly.

 - Maintain deep alignment with the Global Operations team in Europe on supply, build schedules, and fulfilment priorities.

 - Partner with Global Finance, Legal, and Operations to set up the entities, tax registrations, and import/export arrangements needed to sell and ship into new countries across the Americas as the business expands.

2) Lead Americas Customer Onboarding

 - Develop, document, and continuously improve the Americas customer onboarding process, from closed deal through first shipment and initial use, and contribute Americas requirements to the global onboarding process as the company scales.

 - Engage directly with customers to onboard them: collect required information, set expectations, and keep them informed.

 - Partner closely with Global Finance and Global Operations on credit and payment terms, invoicing, order entry, and fulfilment handoffs.

 - Coordinate with sales, field applications engineering, and support so customers move smoothly from purchase to productive use.

3) Run the Americas Business Cadence and Revenue Reporting

 - Lead the weekly Americas Business Meeting, setting the agenda, driving accountability, and following up on actions.

 - Partner with the strategy team and across regions to build and evolve the tools, dashboards, and processes that give an accurate end-to-end view of revenue, from pipeline through order, shipment, and recognition.

 - Deliver accurate, predictable revenue forecasts and pipeline metrics that leadership uses to run the business.

 - Act as a change agent, improving cross-functional collaboration and accountability across Sales, Operations, Finance, and Marketing.

4) Influence Scalable Sales Processes

 - Influence the design of CRM and customer onboarding processes as the company scales, partnering with regional sales leaders, the strategy team, Global Finance, and Global Operations.

 - Define and enforce data standards, stage definitions, and required fields so pipeline and forecast data is trustworthy.

 - Ensure sales teams use the tools correctly through onboarding, training, ongoing coaching, and regular data-quality reviews.

 - Evaluate and provide feedback on new tools in areas such as automation, analytics, and quoting.



What Success Looks Like

 - Sales has accurate, current product availability and delivery timelines, and customers are told when product ships and arrives.

 - Every new Americas customer follows a documented onboarding process with clear handoffs to Global Finance and Operations.

 - The weekly Americas Business Meeting runs on one trusted set of revenue and pipeline metrics, and forecasts are consistently reliable.

 - CRM data is clean and consistently used, and a published roadmap guides tool and process investments, with Americas input reflected in global CRM and onboarding processes.



Qualifications:

 - 10+ years in sales operations, revenue operations, or supply chain and fulfillment operations at a B2B technology company; semiconductor or hardware experience strongly preferred.

 - Experience scaling sales operations in a growth company, ideally having seen the business grow from small to large, or having worked at both a scale-up and a large company.

 - Hands-on experience managing product logistics, including inventory, international shipping, and customs and trade compliance.

 - Proven experience with CRM stacks and administration (Salesforce preferred), including forecasting, pipeline management, and reporting. Exposure to a range of CRM platforms and integrated sales tools is a bonus.

 - Experience building and running customer onboarding or order-to-cash processes alongside finance and operations teams.

 - Strong analytical skills with the ability to turn data into clear insights and decisions for executives.

 - Excellent communication skills, comfortable engaging customers directly and collaborating across time zones with teams in Europe.

 - A builder's mindset: structured, hands-on, and able to drive change in a fast-growing, matrixed organization.

 - Bachelor's degree in business, operations, engineering, or a related field; MBA a plus.



Location

This is a remote position based in the US.

Please note that we don't offer visa sponsorship at this time.



What we offer 

This is your chance to shape and be part of a dynamic, fast-growing, international organization. We offer an attractive compensation package, including a pension plan, extensive employee insurances and the option to get company shares.   

An open culture that supports creativity and continual innovation is awaiting you. Collaborative ownership and freedom with responsibility is characteristic for the way we act and work as a team. 



At Axelera AI, we wholeheartedly embrace equal opportunity and hold diversity in the highest regard. Our steadfast commitment is to cultivate a warm and inclusive environment that empowers and celebrates every member of our team. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds to join us in shaping the future of AI.

jobs.title: Customer Partner, Special Projects
jobs.description:
OUR MISSION:

Omnea is the agentic operating system for procurement.

Procurement touches every pound a business spends, yet requests still stall for weeks and approvals get lost in inboxes. Our AI-first platform changes that: our agents capture requests, route approvals, onboard suppliers, flag risk and track every renewal, while anyone in the business can ask a question and get an answer grounded in their own company’s data. Buying becomes painless for everyone, procurement gets a seat at the table, and our customers have saved more than 100,000 hours of manual work so far.

Companies like Spotify, PayPal, T. Rowe Price, JustEat, Adyen and S&P Global run procurement on Omnea. We’re backed by $75M from Khosla Ventures, Insight Partners and Accel, and we’ve been named the UK’s number one startup in the Startups 100, ranked 11th on Sifted’s 2026 list of Europe’s fastest-growing companies, and recognised as one of Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies.

Talent density matters more to us than almost anything else. We keep the bar high in every team, so everyone here has real ownership and real impact. Our team is full of former founders and operators who’ve scaled unicorns, and we’re looking for people who want to do the best work of their careers alongside them.



Find out more about the team and life at Omnea here https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLpjeHyocsu3ZoDn3sfODjqIR2L_DW3dgb.




WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

We are looking for a Customer Partner, Special Projects to run projects that don’t yet have a natural owner, from acquisitions and fundraises to exec hiring, PR, and building out new teams/business lines. It’s a genuinely cross-functional Office of the CEO role, sitting at the intersection of product, GTM, and business building more broadly.

This person will not be a back-office operator. You’re a builder and a doer -- someone who thrives on ambiguity, wants to learn how to run a company from the inside, and can turn ideas into results at speed. It is also not glamorous work: You will need a ‘no job is too small’ attitude and to thrive from executing and making an impact, not strategising.

You’ll get an unmatched view into how a category-defining AI-driven business scales from $10M to $100M+ ARR at great speed, working directly with the CEO and leadership team. It’s the perfect role for someone who wants to be a future founder, GM, COO or commercial leader; compressing 10 years of experience into two.

The spike we’re looking for is commercial judgment and operator muscle, not process. The best candidates will have lived the chaos of a start-up/scale-up and learned how to bring order without slowing things down. You’ll be trusted with some of the most important company initiatives, and your fingerprints will be on some of Omnea’s most strategic moves.

In short: This is the CEO’s right hand on the initiatives that drive growth, visibility, and scale. If you succeed, the company moves faster, hires better, and shows up in the world with the ambition of a generational business.


 


WHAT CAN YOU EXPECT?

You’ll own and deliver CEO-level special projects end-to-end. You’ll take a rough idea, scope it in days (not weeks), and drive to a clear finish line. One quarter that might be running an exec search end-to-end (outreach, screening calls, and all!); the next it could be exploring an acquisition, launching a new GTM motion, or helping unblock a critical customer need.

You’ll drive partnerships and strategic GTM bets. You’ll identify leverage points, pilot new GTM plays, and coordinate across Sales, Product, and Marketing to unlock revenue -- from enterprise lighthouse customer pursuits to ecosystem partnerships.

You’ll lead executive and critical hiring. You’ll source, run, and close senior searches. You’ll build the brief, map the market, run a tight process, and bring elite operators to the table and filter candidates before our CEO speaks with them.

You’ll operate with founder-level ownership, at pace. You’ll decide what matters, what doesn’t, and in what order. You’ll keep momentum through ambiguity, clear blockers, and communicate crisply so busy people can move.

You’ll learn fast and earn trust. You’ll work directly with the CEO and leadership team, gaining exposure to how product, GTM, capital, and hiring intersect -- and you’ll be trusted with all internal company matters.


 


ABOUT YOU

You’ve likely spent 4–10 years in high-growth companies (ideally B2B SaaS), in roles spanning BizOps, BD/revenue generation, or GM-style leadership. You understand how sales, marketing, and capital decisions drive growth, and you can turn strategy into action without much direction.

You are entrepreneurial and motivated to help build a business, not just observe one. You’re happiest when working hard and solving challenging problems. You know this requires dedication and some sacrifice, and you think it’s worth it.

You have a track record of exceptional performance -- whether in academia, work, or elsewhere -- and evidence of sticking it out through tough environments. You’ve thrived in 0→1 or growth-stage companies, helping to build the playbook while executing it.

You’re commercially minded and can run projects end-to-end: hiring execs, working deals, or launching GTM initiatives. You’ve learned what great execution looks like and bring that standard everywhere you go.

You communicate crisply and with purpose. You can craft CEO-grade narratives -- board decks, competitive positioning, external comms -- and represent Omnea and our CEO with confidence and discretion.

You’re trusted, pragmatic, and able to move quickly when needed. You thrive in ambiguity, act with judgment & taste, and bring momentum to everything you touch.

Dealbreakers: This is not for pure consultants/VCs without operating experience. It’s not for people who need heavy structure, or who want process over progress. If you don’t get energy from being in the weeds & making an impact (often requiring unglamorous work), you will not enjoy this rol
