jobs.title: Account Director, Influencer Marketing, Sports & Entertainment (Fully Remote)
jobs.description:
ABOUT KYRA

Kyra is an enterprise influencer marketing platform working with brands like SharkNinja, Coach, H&M, Ray-Ban, and Converse. Our platform manages the full lifecycle — creator discovery, campaign management, content review, payments, analytics, and AI-powered intelligence across TikTok, Instagram, and YouTube.



👋 ABOUT THE ROLE

Permanent · Full-Time · US-based · EST Hours
Target Start Date: November 2026

We're hiring an Account Director for one of our biggest sports and entertainment clients. The work covers sportsbook, fantasy and live events, and the campaigns are judged on views, CPV and how quickly we can get from brief to live post.

You'll own this one account end to end, with two Campaign Managers reporting into you.

The account is newly won and growing quickly into the end of the year. An interim lead is running it until then, so you'll get a proper handover and join with campaigns already live.

We're looking for someone who has spent at least five years agency-side running creator programmes in sports betting, DFS or around the NFL and NBA, and who can show us the numbers behind that work.




🏟️ WHAT MAKES THIS ROLE DIFFERENT

One account, in depth. Most Account Director roles, run a portfolio of clients and build CM teams underneath them. This role is responsible for one is a single client. We need someone who understands sports, betting and the US creator space properly.

Senior and hands-on. You're the client's senior contact and you're also across the detail every day: who has been outreached, what's stuck in contracting, which draft is late, whether spend is on pace. You run the operations yourself.

Structure matters. This client tracks delivery milestones, feedback windows and their own dependencies against a timeline. You bring the process, keep the client to their side of it and keep everyone on top of dates.

Speed matters. Campaigns are built around games and moments. Turnaround from brief to live is one of the things we measure you on.

The category has rules. Sportsbook and fantasy content comes with age gates, state restrictions and platform policies. You need to already know how these work.

It moves fast. Briefs land with short lead times, priorities change with the sports calendar, and the client expects answers the same day. You need to be comfortable working at that pace without letting quality slip.

We are an AI-native business. Kyra is Claude-first and our campaign workflows run through our own proprietary platform, built with AI at the core. On top of that there is plenty of room to use AI tools to make your own working day more efficient. We are not looking for someone who is open to AI. We are looking for someone who is already getting real value from it: building their own workflows, automating the repetitive parts of the job and using the time saved to think harder about the client. You will be expected to bring that with you.




🏈 WHAT YOU'LL DO: THE GAME PLAN

Grow the client relationship. Grow the client relationship. You own the client relationship and retention on this account, and you’re measured on net revenue retention (NRR). You are the client’s senior contact at Kyra, accountable for strategy, approvals, escalations and commercial conversations. You keep them informed, manage their expectations and identify what we should be doing next with them. 🏆

Agree how the account runs. You own the operating playbook: casting, outreach, contracting, briefing, review, approval, go-live and reporting. You keep it current, and when a process is slowing delivery you change it. 📋

Make the casting calls. You set the casting strategy for every campaign: creator profile, tier, mix and volume. You set the negotiation approach on fees and usage rights and approve deals before contracting. You are responsible for compliance: 21+, state restrictions, platform policy and disclosure. 🎯

Execute delivery every day. You oversee every live campaign from first outreach to the moment content goes live. You know the status of every workstream, surface risk early and protect the quality of what we put out. ⚡

Pace the budget. You track creator spend and delivery against the contracted plan, flag variances early and adjust allocation to protect both performance and margin. 💸

Lead the team. You manage two Campaign Managers. You set priorities, review their work, give direct and constructive feedback and develop their skills. 🤝

Analyse performance. You agree KPIs with the client before launch, monitor performance in flight and adjust creator mix, creative or distribution when the data calls for it. 📊

Next campaign, stronger. Every campaign ends with a debrief. You take what we learned into the next brief so the account keeps improving. 🔁




📈 HOW WE'LL KNOW IT'S WORKING

We measure success by what the brand gets from us. 

The brand hits its moments. Content is live when the game, the fixture or the launch happens. Creators are contracted, posts are delivered and volumes are met on the timelines the client has planned around.

The brand gets the reach it paid for. Blended CPM and CPV come in at or better than the agreed rate on every campaign.

The brand can react quickly. Turnaround from brief to live is short enough that the client can respond to a result, a trade or a trending moment with creator content.

The brand trusts the delivery. The account runs on a documented playbook, feedback windows and dependencies are tracked, and issues leave meetings with an owner and a date. The client does not need to chase us.

The brand brings us the next brief. The client renews because the work is good and the relationship is easy, and comes to Kyra first with new ideas. Revenue growth is shared with Client Solutions. The client's confidence in delivery sits with you.

What good looks like by month six. The account is running to plan without the interim lead, the client has signed off the operating cadence, rates are being met or beaten, and your two Campaign Managers can each run a campaign end to end on their own.




🙋 WHO THIS ROLE IS FOR

 - 5+ years agency-side running creator programmes for sportsbook, DFS or fantasy brands, or US league partnerships (NFL, NBA)

 - Real numbers: CPV targets you've hit, creator and post volumes per month, typical turnaround from outreach to live

 - You've owned a senior client relationship yourself, including the difficult conversations

 - You've managed Campaign Managers while staying close to the work

 - You're fluent in views, CPV and CPM and can turn performance data into clear recommendations

 - You know FTC disclosure and the compliance rules around betting content

 - US-based, working EST hours

 - Not currently working on a competing sportsbook, DFS or betting brand

 - Organised, direct and calm when plans change at short notice

 - Experience in a fast-growing business or account, where the scope, the team and the client's expectations have scaled quickly and you have had to keep delivery steady through it

 - Already using Claude or similar AI tools to do real work, with your own workflows for casting, research, reporting or client comms, and able to show what they have saved you or improved
   


📅 WEEKEND WORK

Campaigns go live around games, fixtures and events, so this role involves some weekend work. Please only apply if you're open to that.

Kyra reserves the right to amend your duties from time to time in line with the needs of the business.

💟 Support

If you have a condition or require an adjustment to our interview process - please let us know so we can make adjustments to support you. Please note that when you submit an application or resume, your data will be processed in line with our privacy policy https://www.bamboohr.com/legal/privacy-policy.

jobs.title: Sales Development Representative
jobs.description:
About Kaseya

Kaseya is the leading provider of AI-powered IT management and cybersecurity software, serving Managed Service Providers (MSPs) and internal IT organizations worldwide. Our comprehensive platform helps organizations efficiently manage, secure, and automate their IT environments, driving operational efficiency and long-term business success.

Backed by Insight Partners, a leading global software investor, Kaseya has experienced sustained double-digit growth and continues to expand its global footprint. Today, Kaseya supports customers in more than 20 countries and manages over 15 million endpoints worldwide.

Founded in 2000, Kaseya was built by builders - and we're still building. We look for people who create rather than wait, who see a hard problem and lean in, and who treat challenges as raw material. At Kaseya, everyone plays a role in shaping the future of IT: whether you're in engineering, product, sales, marketing, customer support, or operations, your work helps protect, defend, and optimize IT environments across the globe.

We're building teams that grow, perform, and make an impact. If you're driven by the itch to make things better - a product, a process, a career - you'll fit right in.

At Kaseya, we don't just raise the bar. We build it.

Position Summary

Kaseya is seeking motivated, results-driven Sales Development Representatives (SDRs) to support our continued growth by generating qualified sales pipeline for our global Account Executive team. This role is responsible for executing high-volume inbound and outbound sales activities, engaging prospective customers, reactivating dormant leads, and identifying new business opportunities.

Designed for high-potential, entry-level talent, including recent graduates and individuals looking to transition into technology sales, this position offers hands-on training, ongoing coaching, and opportunities for career advancement. Successful SDRs will develop the sales skills, product knowledge, and prospecting expertise needed to pursue future opportunities in Account Executive or Account Management roles, with a potential progression timeline of 12–18 months based on individual performance and business needs.

Key Responsibilities

• Execute high-volume inbound and outbound prospecting campaigns using tools such as LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Outreach, and other sales engagement platforms.

• Generate 100+ meaningful outbound connections per day through phone calls, emails, and social selling to engage prospective customers and identify new business opportunities.

• Generate at least two qualified discovery calls or Sales Qualified Leads (SQLs) per day by engaging prospects, qualifying interest, and scheduling meetings for Account Executives.

• Utilize AI-powered tools, including Microsoft Copilot and ChatGPT, to research prospects, personalize outreach, identify high-potential leads, and improve sales productivity.

• Deliver effective sales messaging by following established call scripts, tailoring outreach to specific buyer personas, and maintaining timely, professional follow-up.

• Partner with Account Executives, Sales, and Marketing teams to align prospecting activities with ideal customer profiles, campaign strategies, and pipeline generation goals.

• Maintain accurate and up-to-date records of prospect interactions, lead qualification, and pipeline activity in Salesforce.

• Develop a strong understanding of Kaseya's products, solutions, target markets, and customer pain points to communicate value effectively to prospective customers.

• Consistently execute sales campaigns across assigned market segments and industry verticals while meeting established activity, conversion, and pipeline targets.

• Participate in onboarding, sales training, coaching sessions, and ongoing professional development to strengthen prospecting, communication, and qualification skills.

Required Qualifications

• Strong interest in building a career in sales, business development, or technology sales.

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to engage prospects and communicate value clearly and professionally.

• Comfortable initiating conversations with prospective customers through phone calls, email, and social outreach.

• Highly motivated, goal-oriented, and resilient, with the ability to work in a fast-paced, performance-driven environment.

• Coachable and receptive to feedback, with a demonstrated willingness to learn, adapt, and continuously improve.

• Strong organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to manage multiple outreach activities and maintain consistent follow-up.

• Familiarity with AI tools and an interest in leveraging technology to improve productivity and sales effectiveness.

Preferred Qualifications

• Previous experience in sales, customer service, lead generation, retail sales, or a customer-facing role.

• Experience with outbound prospecting, cold calling, email campaigns, or social selling.

• Familiarity with CRM platforms such as Salesforce and sales engagement tools such as Outreach or LinkedIn Sales Navigator.

• Experience using AI tools to support research, communication, or workflow efficiency.

• Interest in technology, SaaS solutions, cybersecurity, or IT management software.

#IND525

Additional information
Kaseya provides equal employment opportunity to all employees and applicants without regard to race, religion, age, ancestry, gender, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, citizenship status, physical or mental disability, veteran status, marital status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

jobs.title: Data Scientist - Growth
jobs.description:
ABOUT US

Legora is redefining how legal work gets done. Not built for lawyers, built with them. We work alongside the world’s best legal teams, who expect excellence, precision, and speed, and we hold ourselves to the same bar.

Our AI-native workspace lets legal professionals move faster, think more clearly, and operate with sharper precision. By analysing thousands of documents in minutes and powering end-to-end workflows, we cut through complexity, teams can focus on what matters: judgment, strategy, and outcomes.

2,100+ customers across 80+ countries trust us, including Cleary Gottlieb, Goodwin, Linklaters, White & Case, Dentons, and Barclays. We’ve scaled to $200M+ in ARR, with teams across Europe, North America and APAC, and continue to expand through acquisitions including Qura, Walter AI, Graceview, Cadastral, and Wexler.

We partner with world-class performers: including Aaron Judge and the New York Yankees, Ludvig Åberg (and his caddie), and campaigns featuring Jude Law.

Joining Legora means three things.

 - We lean in: ownership over titles, outcomes over intentions.

 - We fight for excellence: high standards, direct, ego-free feedback.

 - We grow together: as a team and with our customers.

Mission before ego. Everyone contributes. No one coasts.

If you’re driven by impact, pace, and raising the bar. This is the place.

As a Data Scientist for Growth at Legora, you'll build the data foundations that help our go-to-market teams make better decisions. You'll work end-to-end: connecting data from business systems, building reliable pipelines and dbt models, defining shared metrics, and answering questions about how we grow.

Your background may be in analytics engineering, data science or data engineering. You enjoy building data models that others can trust and reuse, and working closely with business teams to put that data to use.

You'll be based in our New York office, sitting with the Growth data team. Our go-to-market data is spread across a CRM, marketing automation and messaging platforms, sales engagement and call tools, support tooling, and our own product. Making those systems agree with each other, and with what customers actually do in Legora, is the heart of this job.

We're an AI-first data team. We believe the data function should be redesigned around what AI now makes possible, not retrofitted with it, and we want someone excited to help define what that looks like in practice.

We're a small, centralised team supporting the whole company. This seat is for Growth. Working closely with RevOps and the GTM teams, you'll help answer questions like:

 - Marketing: acquisition funnels, attribution and CAC, campaign measurement, and what actually moves enterprise legal buyers.

 - Sales & RevOps: what drives pipeline, sales performance and pilot-to-customer conversion.

 - Customer Success: account health, expansion and churn signals, and renewals in a category that didn't exist three years ago.

 - Lifecycle: getting modelled data back into the CRM and messaging tools, so teams act on it where they already work.


You'll partner directly with leaders across Marketing, Sales, RevOps and Customer Success who are data-fluent and eager to act on the wealth of data across our business. Your role is to bring structure to that data, uncover insights together, and build the tools and foundations that let them explore questions for themselves, shaping how we sell, where we spend, how we price, and which customers we invest in.



WHAT YOU WILL BE DOING

 - Own the Growth data model: turn raw data from our CRM, marketing, messaging, sales engagement and support systems into trusted, documented dbt models that join cleanly to product usage.

 - Bring new GTM sources into the warehouse when you need them, and partner with data engineering on anything that needs to scale beyond your immediate use case.

 - Work with RevOps and GTM leaders on the metrics that matter (pipeline, conversion, attribution, CAC, retention and expansion), so each has one trusted definition across teams.

 - Together with RevOps and Marketing Ops, get modelled data back into the business systems, so Sales, Marketing and Customer Success can act on it in the tools they already use.

 - Flag the field and process gaps that make CRM data hard to trust, and help RevOps and Marketing Ops fix them at the source.

 - Run the deep dives that move the business: where pipeline leaks, which campaigns create revenue, what wins a pilot, which accounts are at risk or ready to grow. Proactively surface the questions nobody is asking yet.

 - Build dashboards and reporting that scale beyond you, so GTM teams can answer their own questions where possible.

 - Help shape how the data team operates as we scale: standards, tooling, ways of working.



WHAT YOU'LL NEED

 - Strong proficiency in SQL and Python.

 - Genuine depth in data modelling and analytics engineering: dbt, dimensional modelling, testing, semantic layers, and the judgement to build models others trust and reuse.

 - Hands-on experience modelling data from growth-side business systems, for example:
   
   - CRM (Salesforce, HubSpot)
   
   - Marketing automation and messaging (Customer.io http://Customer.io, Braze, Marketo, Iterable)
   
   - Sales engagement and conversation intelligence (Outreach, Salesloft, Gong)
   
   - Support and in-app messaging (Intercom, Zendesk)

 - You know these systems' quirks: overwritten fields, missing history, duplicate contacts, and opportunity stages that mean different things to different teams.

 - A solid grasp of GTM analytics: funnels, attribution, pipeline and forecasting, cohort retention, and net revenue retention.

 - Excellent communication skills and the confidence to influence decisions through data storytelling, including pushing back when the data doesn't support what someone wants to do.



NICE TO HAVE

 - Experience in B2B SaaS with an enterprise, sales-led motion.

 - Hands-on experience with our stack: Snowflake, dbt, Hex, Dagster, dlt, Salesforce.

 - Experience with reverse ETL or data activation, whether a tool like Hightouch or Census or syncs you built yourself.

 - Experimentation or modelling on GTM questions: campaign holdouts, uplift, propensity or forecasting models.

 - Prior experience as an early data hire at a fast-growing company, i.e. you've built the muscle, not inherited it.



MOST IMPORTANTLY, YOU ARE SOMEONE WHO

 - "Gets stuff done" and understands building a $10bn company isn't always glamorous and takes hard work and long hours.

 - Someone who thrives in an onsite environment, this is where we get the most out of our day 

 - Thrives in a fast-paced environment where the answers aren't always clear and processes are few.

 - Is genuinely domain-curious. You don't need to have sold to law firms before, but you should be excited to learn how they buy.

Legora is an Equal Opportunity Employer

At Legora, we believe great teams are built on diversity of thought and experience. We’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer and committed to creating an inclusive, high-performance culture where everyone can do their best work. We welcome people of all backgrounds and don’t discriminate based on race, color, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

jobs.title: Experimental Quantum Engineer
jobs.description:
ABOUT US 


QuantWare is building the world’s most powerful quantum processors to solve humanity's greatest challenges. We do this with our unique VIO™ technology, the only QPU architecture that breaks the hardware barriers that have held quantum computing back, unlocking the path to MegaQubit quantum processors.

With VIO, we are paving the way for the hyper-scale quantum computers that will change the world. And delivering on that vision demands people who don’t shy away from tackling the hardest challenges of our time. That’s where you come in! 



QuantWare is seeking an Experimental Quantum Engineer to join our growing Operations team. The mission of QuantWare’s Operations team is to consistently deliver high quality quantum hardware and make advanced quantum technologies accessible to customers all over the world.

Together with your colleague Experimental Quantum Engineers, you will be in charge of several state of the art cryogenic setups. You’ll use these setups to perform advanced qubit measurements and guarantee the quality of all devices before they are shipped to customers. Whenever you spot abnormalities, you’ll search for root causes and countermeasures, together with your colleagues from Fabrication or Design. Product volume and complexity of our products increase - so the challenge is to stay one step ahead by continuously improving our measurement setups, software and processes.




WHAT YOU WILL BE DOING 

 - Own QuantWare’s cryogenic measurement setups: purchase and build them, and keep them state-of-the-art (maintenance, upgrades).

 - Manage the hands-on physical operation of cryogenic quantum hardware, working directly with the dilution refrigerators.

 - Develop measurement code to implement and refine Python-based routines for device characterization.

 - Characterize quantum chips to evaluate and improve the performance of superconducting qubits and amplifiers - to guarantee QuantWare’s customers receive perfect devices and to support new product development and research.




YOUR PROFILE

 - Education: master’s degree in physics or electrical engineering, preferably with a focus on quantum computing.

 - Experience: Hands-on experience with programming, preferably Python.

 - Knowledge: Experience with superconducting circuits and microwave measurement techniques is a plus, but not required.

 - Skills: you are tech-savvy, learn fast and get things done: regardless if that means getting your hands dirty or deep in the python code. You enjoy solving problems and methodically improving our processes.



Don't tick every box? Apply anyway! Research shows women often self-select out if they don't meet every requirement. Here's our take: nobody ticks every box. This is a description of our ideal candidate, not a filter. If most resonates and you're keen to learn the gaps, apply. We hire for trajectory, not perfection. 

What We Offer:

At QuantWare, you’ll be part of a high-performing team of world-class experts in an ambitious, fast-moving environment. From day one, you’ll have the trust, tools, and support to do your best work. Here’s what you can expect:

Competitive salary - A salary that reflects the impact and importance of the role (and of course 8% holiday allowance)

Pension that’s built to last - A generous and future-proof pension plan that includes partner and dependent coverage.

Flexibility built on trust - We focus on outcomes. Work flexibly, in a hybrid setup, with an open vacation policy that lets you manage your time

Personal growth - We invest in your L&D, with a budget available to each team member, dependent on their individual ambitions, development needs, and performance

A connected team - We make space to celebrate wins together, with team events, offsites, and spontaneous moments that bring us closer

Diversity & Inclusion at QuantWare

We’re an ambitious company, not only for our goals but also to become an even more diverse and inclusive team. We know great candidates don't always follow a straight path, and we value diverse experience, perspectives, and ways of thinking. We know this helps us make better decisions, drives more innovation, and strengthens our culture. 

As part of our recruitment process, candidates may be required to undergo pre-employment screening.

jobs.title: Technical Product Manager - AI Stockbroking
jobs.description:
ABOUT BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

 


THE ROLE

BJAK is building a AI Stockbroking Superapp for Southeast Asia across payments, remittance, insurance, wealth, and trading.

 

These products move real money. Reliability, regulatory requirements, and third-party financial rails are fundamental to the product - not considerations around the edges.

 

The Technical Product Manager owns a product vertical end-to-end, from strategy and outcomes through technical design, delivery, and launch.

 

We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where AI genuinely improves an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted.

 


WHAT YOU'LL OWN

 - Owning a product vertical end-to-end, including strategy, metrics, roadmap, priorities and delivery.

 - Shaping technical design with engineering across APIs, data flows, ledgering, reconciliation, failure handling, security and scalability.

 - Driving trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability, regulatory requirements and user experience.

 - Building regulatory requirements into the product across KYC, transaction monitoring, limits, privacy and licensing.

 - Applying AI where it improves outcomes, with clear evaluation, safeguards, human oversight and failure handling.

 - Shipping products around external dependencies, including regulatory approvals, financial rails and third-party partners.

 - Aligning Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance around clear product decisions and launch requirements.
   
    


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - 5+ years of product management experience, including ownership of complex technical products from strategy through production.

 - Strong technical foundation across system architecture, APIs, databases, workflows, failure modes and distributed systems.

 - Experience working closely with engineers and ability to review, challenge and contribute to technical designs.

 - Experience in payments, banking, remittance, insurance, trading or another regulated, high-consequence product domain.

 - Strong product judgment and ability to make difficult trade-offs under technical, regulatory and operational constraints.

 - Experience building with LLMs or AI products, including evaluation, reliability and understanding when AI should not be used.
   
    


NICE TO HAVE

 - Engineering or highly technical product background.

 - Experience building zero-to-one fintech or consumer products.

 - Experience defining evaluation frameworks for ML or LLM-powered products.
   
    


OUTCOME

 - Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap

 - Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch

 - Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds

 - AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted

 - Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged

 - Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction
   
    


LOCATION

This is a remote role. We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones. 

 

Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.

 


LANGUAGE

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

 


INTERVIEW PROCESS

Our process is designed to move fast:

 1. Online assessment or practical task

 2. Technical interview

 3. CEO / final round

 

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

jobs.title: Data Center Network Operations Engineer
jobs.description:
About Us

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.

Available Locations: Singapore or Sydney

About the department

In this role, you will be focused on maintaining the Cloudflare global network. You'll work closely with Cloudflare’s SRE (Site Reliability Engineering) team, Network Engineering team, Network Deployment Engineering team and with various vendors and partners (including hardware vendors, datacenter and network providers, and ISPs) to maintain and improve our global infrastructure. You will further be responsible for the development and implementation of consistent processes and visibility measurements for consistent and effective management of our infrastructure. This is a highly visible position that requires deep technical understanding of datacenter infrastructure, networking (physical), and basic experience with data analysis and project management.

To be successful in this position, you should have excellent technical skills, communication skills, and be able to navigate a range of challenges and constraints (e.g. schedule adherence, time zones, and cultures). You will have the opportunity to (literally) build a faster, safer Internet for our millions of users and the billions of web surfers that visit their sites each month.

Who you are

You will thrive in a hypergrowth engineering environment and be self driven with a keen attention to detail. You will come with a deep technical understanding of Data Center colocation environments, network architecture and server technologies. You will be used to working through partners to support infrastructure delivery to a number of remote locations. You will have had experience managing operational environments, and used to developing new approaches to improve delivery efficiency or operational stability.

What you'll do

• Collaborating with internal teams (Infrastructure, Network Engineering and SRE). Create documentation and manage remote contractors to complete datacenter tasks, working with hardware manufacturers, datacenter and network providers, logistics partners and other service providers in support of our 330+ cities and 125+ countries

• Maintain Data Center environment operational availability

• Leverage AI tools to automate repetitive operational tasks, accelerate documentation, and speed up troubleshooting and root-cause analysis

• Creating and maintaining documentation, plans, SOP’s, MOP’s etc.

• Support and configure network infrastructure where required

• Providing feedback to internal teams to support internal tools and external vendor partnerships

Required Experience

• Experience with Juniper, Cisco and DWDM network equipment

• Minimum of 4 years experience of Linux systems administration

• Experience managing and instructing remote contractors

• Familiarity with work required to stand up infrastructure in remote colocation facilities

• Experience running and improving operational processes, including automation tooling, in a rapidly changing environment

• Familiarity with day-to-day tasks and projects common to Data Center Operations (deployment, migration, decommissioning etc.)

• Comfortable handling basic program management responsibilities (prioritization, planning, scheduling, status reporting) such as JIRA

• Participate in a shared on-call rotation to maintain 24×7 operational availability of the global network.

Other Responsibilities May Include

• Aggressively seek opportunities to introduce cutting-edge technology and automation solutions that are effective, efficient and scalable in order to improve our ability to deploy and maintain our global infrastructure

• Assist with the definition, documentation and implementation of consistent processes across all region

• Limited travel

Examples of desirable skills, knowledge and experience

• Bachelor’s degree; technical background in engineering, computer science, or MIS

• Direct experience executing on complex data center/infrastructure projects

• Previous experience installing / maintaining data center (and other IT) infrastructure and DCIM tools

• Experience running and improving operational processes in a rapidly changing environment

• Strong verbal and written communication skills, problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and interpersonal skills

• Must be proactive with proven ability to learn fast and execute on multiple tasks simultaneously

• Ability to manage Microsoft Excel and Google Sheets

• Comfortable handling basic program management responsibilities (prioritization, planning, scheduling, status reporting) such as JIRA

• Must be a team player

Bonus Points

• Experience working with infrastructure in multiple countries

• Comfortable with remote “lights-out” and out-of-band access to data center resources

• Linux certifications (RHCSA etc.)

• Network certifications (CCNA, JNCIA or higher)

• Configuration management systems such as Saltstack, Chef, Puppet or Ansible

• Scripting or software development experience in Bash, Python or Go-lang

• Familiarity with load balancing and reverse proxies such as Nginx, Varnish, HAProxy, Apache

• Experience in working within a large scale SaaS vendor

What Makes Cloudflare Special?

We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.

Project Galileo: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.

Athenian Project: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.

1.1.1.1: We released 1.1.1.1 to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our privacy commitment and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.

Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!

Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.

This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.

Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.  We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness.  All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer.

Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities.  Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job. Examples of reasonable accommodations include, but are not limited to, changing the application process, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment.  If you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job, please contact us via e-mail at hr@cloudflare.com or via mail at 101 Townsend St. San Francisco, CA 94107.

jobs.title: Senior Backend Engineer, US Activation & Retention
jobs.description:
About Gigs

At Gigs, we're building the operating system for mobile services—a platform that lets tech companies embed global connectivity into their products effortlessly.

Just as Stripe lets any business add a payment button in seconds, Gigs empowers platforms to weave in connectivity—bridging the traditional world of telecom with modern tech. From fintechs launching mobile services to HR platforms offering work phone plans, we automate provisioning and remove telecom complexity.

Our team of around 150 people across the US and Europe, backed by nearly $100 million in funding from Ribbit Capital, Google, and Y Combinator. As one of the fastest-growing tech companies, bringing together early-stage engineers, product builders, and business athletes from companies like Stripe, Airbnb, and Shopify. We’re tackling deep technical and regulatory challenges to make connectivity truly seamless.

If you’re driven by curiosity, creativity, and the chance to shape the future of telecom, we’d love to hear from you.

Things We Care About

We are building in a highly complex space and tackling a massive problem. We want people who lean in when things get hard.

• Speed. We move and we ship. We set bold deadlines and treat every week like it matters.

• Ownership. If you see something broken, fix it. We don't wait for permission.

• Customer Obsession. Our customers' product is our product.

• Ambiguity. We're building frontier technology in a complex domain. You'll need sound judgement and good instincts to make decisions without complete information.

• First principles. We don't ask how things have been done before. We ask why they were done that way at all.

The Role

The US is a key market for Gigs, and US Activation & Retention (USAR) is the team that helps it grow. We work directly with our US partners, some of the biggest brands in the market, to build what they need. The features you build have a direct impact on how fast Gigs grows.

This is not a role where you stay in one corner of the codebase. To get a feature live for our US partners, the team works across many domains of our platform. If you want broad ownership, direct contact with partners, and a clear line from your work to the company’s growth, this team is for you. Once here, you will:

• Own complex problems end-to-end, working with our talented team to design and build robust, scalable solutions.

• Develop innovative products that empower our customers to bring world-class connectivity services to their users with ease.

• Uphold our high engineering standards, improving tooling and processes where necessary.

• Design, build and maintain best-in-class APIs and services. Our primary codebase is a Ruby on Rails monolith, complemented by a number of services written in Go, Elixir and TypeScript. You don’t need to have deep expertise in all of our languages; we will give you plenty of room to learn and grow with your team.

• Keep our platform reliable. You’ll build services with observability in mind from the start and take part in incident response.

You can find more about how we work on our engineering page.

Salary range for Senior Engineer: $205,000 - $235,000 (base salary) + equity

(The final offer depends on your background, skills, and how you perform through the process. We're open to considering mid, senior and staff-level candidates, which may result in an adjustment to the scope and compensation)

What We Are Looking For

• You have experience designing APIs and building backend services. You enjoy thinking about systems, and you care about the quality of the software you produce.

• You use AI as a core part of how you work, not an occasional shortcut. That means prompting agents with context and intent, reviewing what they produce critically, and knowing when to push back. You can explain the code an agent wrote, catch when it oversteps the ask, and form your own opinion on whether the output is actually good. You're curious about how the tooling is evolving and actively working to get better at it.

• You enjoy building products from scratch. You care about finding the right solution to customer needs, and you’re comfortable taking ownership and delivering.

• You love learning technologies as you go. You always want to find the right tool for the job, and don't only follow what you already know.

• You care about more than just engineering. You need to see the business impacts of everything you do. You know how to make speed/quality trade-offs.

Work At Gigs

At Gigs, we value in-person collaboration. We believe the best ideas, decisions, and relationships are built when teams spend meaningful time together, and our culture is designed around that belief. We support flexibility where it makes sense. Some focused work can be done remotely, and not every role or week looks the same. You should expect regular time in one of our hubs, as well as occasional travel for team workshops, customer meetings, and Gigs Republic, our bi-annual company off-site. Our offices are designed to feel like home-inspired workspaces, with plants, thoughtful tools, and small, tight-knit teams that make collaboration feel natural, energizing, and effective.

What We Offer

At Gigs, we believe in rewarding excellence. We offer competitive compensation and stock options because we see you as a true partner in our growth. We also provide stipends for your home office or work setup, a budget for learning and development to fuel your career, and of course, a free phone and international data plan

Want to learn more about our benefits, hubs, and what it’s like to work at Gigs? Check out our Careers page.

Contentsquare is the all-in-one experience intelligence platform designed to be easily used by anyone who cares about digital journeys. With our flexible and scalable platform, organizations quickly get a deep understanding of their customers’ whole online journey.
 
We are a global leader in the experience analytics space, with a growing presence across 15 offices worldwide. We’re here to stay—and we’re looking for team members who are excited to drive impact and help us scale even further.
 
Our aim is to create an inclusive workplace where everyone learns and succeeds. Contentsquare has built a community of individuals who are daring, understanding, and deliberate. We invite you to join us in making the complex simpler—for our customers, their customers, and each other.
 
Important note: Be careful of scammers pretending to be from Contentsquare. We will never ask for money or contact you through random texts. Any communication from our in house Talent Acquisition team will only ever come from our contentsquare.com or @contentsquare-ext.com domain. For more information, visit our careers blog.


About the job
Reporting to the Senior GL Accountant in Cairo, you are responsible for various General Accounting tasks for the Contentsquare entities in accordance with IFRS gaaps. 
 
What you’ll do
General Ledger Accounting
Support day-to-day general ledger operations, including journal entries and account reconciliations
Assist with monthly, quarterly, and year-end close activities in accordance with IFRS Gaps
Maintain accurate records of prepaid expenses, accruals, and fixed assets
Practical experience with VAT and withholding tax is preferred.
Support the preparation of internal and external financial reports and assist with internal and external audit requirements.

Travel & Expense Management

Be the go-to person for T&E support through our ticketing system
Empower employees through practical training sessions that simplify the T&E process
 
What you’ll need to succeed
Degree in Accounting
3–5 years of relevant experience in General Ledger and Accounts Payable accounting.
You must be able to speak English fluently, as you will evolve in a truly international environment
Highly developed analytical and technical accounting skills
Proactive self-starter who is disciplined, organized, thorough and has the ability to work with autonomy, attention to detail and proactivity in a team environment. 
Excellent communication and motivational skills.
Proven ability to multitask and prioritize in a fast-paced environment, to perform under pressure and meet non-negotiable deadlines
 
Nice-to-have
Experience working in the Tech / SAAS sector is beneficial but not essential.
Proficiency in Microsoft Excel including VBA
Experience working on Workday Financials

jobs.title: Body Repair Operations Manager - Europe
jobs.description:
About Lucid

At Lucid, we are creating exceptional mobility experiences through innovation to drive the world forward. Built on Lucid’s proprietary technology and software-defined vehicle architecture, our award-winning vehicles bring our “Compromise Nothing™” approach to the global automotive market. That means refusing to choose between performance and sustainability, design and engineering, ambition and integrity. In Lucid Air and Lucid Gravity, we have designed and built vehicles that have redefined their segments, combining exceptional range, performance, design, and expansive space in a single experience.

We achieve this through deep vertical integration, with design, engineering, and production happening in-house across our global offices and manufacturing facilities. Our teams come from industries around the world, united by a shared commitment to excellence. By refusing to settle, you can help redefine what’s possible and shape the future of mobility.

About the Team

The European Service organization is responsible for delivering a premium ownership experience across Lucid’s growing European footprint. Within this organization, the Body Repair program ensures customers have access to a high-quality network of approved repair partners that meet Lucid’s standards for safety, repair quality and customer experience. The team works cross-functionally with Service Operations, Technical Support, Quality, Warranty and Training to continuously strengthen Lucid’s body repair capabilities across Europe.

About the Role

We are looking for a Body Repair Operations Manager Europe to own the development, performance and continuous improvement of Lucid’s European body repair network. This is a hands-on network management role combining deep body repair expertise with partner development, operational performance and quality management. You will expand network coverage where needed, develop existing partners and ensure Lucid’s repair standards are consistently implemented across Europe. You will also act as a key escalation point for complex body repair and partner-related cases, using operational data and network insights to drive continuous improvement. Based in Amsterdam, this role requires regular travel across Europe.

What You Own

• Network Development: Identify, assess and onboard new body repair partners based on market coverage and business needs, ensuring technical, operational, tooling and training readiness before activation.

• Partner Performance: Own relationships with existing body repair partners, using KPIs such as repair quality, cycle time, first-time-right and customer experience to identify gaps and drive measurable improvements.

• Repair Standards: Drive consistent implementation of Lucid body repair standards, procedures and repair requirements across the European network, addressing compliance gaps and maintaining a high level of repair quality.

• Complex Escalations: Act as the European escalation point for complex body repair and operational cases, connecting partners with the appropriate internal teams and driving issues through to resolution.

• Performance Insights: Monitor network performance, identify trends and risks through operational data, and turn recurring issues into broader network improvement initiatives.

• Cross-Functional Alignment: Partner with Service Operations, Technical Support, Quality, Warranty, Training and other functions to ensure the body repair network has the support required to operate effectively.

• Tools & Systems: Coordinate the European rollout and effectiveness of body repair systems, diagnostic equipment and specialized tooling, including the Technical Information Portal and Network Management System.

What You Bring

You combine strong technical knowledge of collision and body repair with the ability to build trusted relationships with external partners. You are comfortable working across countries and functions, know how to use operational data to improve performance, and can move between hands-on problem solving and broader network development. You work independently, communicate clearly and are comfortable operating in a fast-moving, international environment.

Minimum Qualifications

• 5+ years of automotive experience, including significant experience in body repair, collision repair and/or vehicle painting.

• Strong understanding of body shop operations, repair processes, quality standards and repair performance.

• Proven experience in partner, network or multi-site management, with the ability to manage performance and drive corrective actions.

• Strong stakeholder management, communication and problem-solving skills, with confidence using digital applications, reporting tools and performance data.

• Fluent English and willingness to travel regularly across Europe, up to approximately 50%.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience working with a premium automotive or electric vehicle brand, or within an OEM-approved or certified collision repair network.

• Experience operating across multiple European markets and within a matrix organization.

• Additional proficiency in German, French, Italian and/or Spanish.

Lucid Motors is committed to maintaining a safe and trustworthy environment. As such, a background check may be required during the hiring process. Our Company
At Quantum, we connect global brands with high-intent consumers. We turn intent into action and complexity into clarity.

With in-house tech, full-stack analytics, and a compliance-first mindset, we give our partners an edge. We drive confident decisions and growth in regulated and high-growth sectors. We’ve helped ambitious brands grow faster, smarter, and globally.



The Role

Our Customer Service team is growing! We’re looking for a Customer Service Executive to join our team in London.

In this role you will look after our rewards customers from first question to final payout. You’ll own the payment runs that get cashback into members’ accounts accurately and on time, and raise the speed and quality of every reply we send.

About You

 - Good judgement and a fair-minded approach with sensitive cases

 - Comfortable with numbers and basic reporting in Google Sheets

What’s the next step?

Our hiring process ensures we're recruiting the right people for the role. We ensure that people are as suitable for us as we are for them.

If you like the sound of what we're all about at Quantum and want to join a team where you can make an impact, please apply or contact us at careers@quantum.media.

jobs.title: Support Engineer (DevTools & AI Reliability, remote)
jobs.description:
(Remote, US East Coast or the same time zone. Series B. DevTools SaaS. Synthetic monitoring. 40h/week)

The best developers don’t wait for a customer to tell them something’s broken.

They catch it first, in the pull request, in staging, or in the checkout flow at 3am, before a single user notices. That instinct is Checkly’s whole reason to exist. Now that agents write and ship more and more code, they can carry that instinct too. Agents write, run, and maintain the monitoring setup that guards production, while developers stay in control. Everything is defined as code, powered by OpenTelemetry and Playwright, and versioned and reviewed like everything else that ships. From pull request to post-mortem, in one place.

AI agents are shipping more code than any team can review, and reliability is lagging behind. Checkly closes this gap. As a Support Engineer, you’ll support our most valuable customers, from modern AI companies like Mistral and resolve.ai to large engineering orgs like LinkedIn, Citi, and 1Password on that journey.

In 2024 we raised $20M in Series B https://www.checklyhq.com/blog/announcing-20m-to-enable-engineers-to-detect-and-r/ funding from Balderton, CRV and Accel. We’re a remote-first startup that is low on meetings, high on productivity, and always shipping. If you love actually listening to and working with customers, working async, and keeping it lean, you’ll fit right in!

We care about building a team where people of all backgrounds are encouraged to do their best work. To achieve this we built a flexible and async-first https://blog.checklyhq.com/how-to-build-a-leading-remote-first-company-while-exceeding-company-goals-do-this/ startup environment with inclusive benefits https://www.notion.so/ad474bec3a5d4d17bfbb43ebae3fec9c?pvs=4 and full transparency about how we pay.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

Support has always been about solving real problems for real people. What’s changing at Checkly is how we do it: AI lets us automate routine work and assist us with troubleshooting, so we can go deeper on hard cases and bring what customers tell us straight back to the product. Here’s where you come in:

 - Resolve customer issues. Debug Playwright tests (flaky selectors, timeouts, auth flows). Dig into API check failures with packet captures (PCAPs), traceroutes and timing breakdowns. Set up single sign-on (SSO) and SAML. When it’s a bug, bring engineering a clean reproduction, or open the pull request (PR) yourself.

 - Build an outstanding AI support process. Our internal and external support agents already resolve 80% of tickets. You’ll help lift the bar: what the agent answers, when it hands off to a human, and how good those answers are.

 - Turn tickets into product. Spot patterns across customers and bring product and engineering a reproduction. Your work becomes bug fixes and features.

 - Own the docs. If you’ve answered something twice, it belongs in the docs and in the agent, so customers and AI get the same right answer.

 - Work with modern tooling. We are continuously updating our workbench, and you’ll have modern tools like Plain, Linear, and Mintlify.




THIS WON'T BE THE RIGHT ROLE IF YOU...

 - Want a clear process for every situation before you act.

 - Would rather code all day than talk to customers.

 - See AI tools as something you’ll get around to eventually.

 - Want the structure and pace of a large company.




WHAT YOU SHOULD HAVE

You will often speak with developers who need assistance understanding if their applications work well and if not, what caused the issue. This requires a solid technical background and a genuine motivation to help and learn.

 - Empathy: You love working with customers and solving their problems. Checkly is critical to them, and we genuinely want to unblock them.

 - Some experience in a technical role, for example, as a developer or in technical support.

 - You can read and debug JavaScript, TypeScript and Node.js code.

 - You’re comfortable with HTTP, REST APIs, browser dev tools, git and CI/CD practices.

 - AI is already how you work. Claude Code, Codex, Cursor or similar are part of your day. You’ve built your own workflows.

 - You write and speak clear, friendly English.

 - You can run your own day remotely and still enjoy working with your team.

 - You're based on the US East Coast or the same time zone.




WHY US?

 - Transparent salary because your salary shouldn't be dictated by how good a negotiator you are. (more info below)

 - Async-first https://app.notion.com/p/b9dd37bec51d436bae6635ffce8c6730?pvs=21 (low meeting, high productivity) and transparent culture https://app.notion.com/p/Meetings-communication-transparency-b130664febf94ae9b320bd4a78370f2e?pvs=21

 - Stock options

 - Flexible paid vacation

 - Paid sick leave & up to 14 weeks of paid parental leave

 - US: Medical, Dental, Vision, FSA, long- and short-term disability, life insurance, 401(k) and more

 - Annual company off-site

Find out more here https://app.notion.com/p/Benefits-Perks-ad474bec3a5d4d17bfbb43ebae3fec9c?pvs=21.




WHAT WE PAY

Fair, competitive, and transparent pay is very important for us. Therefore we work with a standardized salary calculator https://app.notion.com/p/Our-Pay-Calculator-How-we-pay-our-team-f3c42feab82b444a9cbf8fed545cb727?pvs=21 that includes several factors such as seniority level as well as location.

For this role, the range is

 - $57,500 - $70,000 for someone in the US

 - $71,910 - $87,000 for someone in US Tier 1 locations like NYC, Boston

 - $43,000 - $52,000 for someone in e.g. South America




APPLY

If this sounds interesting, please apply! Studies by several different sources have shown that on average men will apply for a job if they meet 60% of the application requirements. Women, non-binary people and POC will seek to match a much higher percentage of requirements before applying. If you're not sure you're the right fit, apply anyway and let us know what you bring to the table. We'd love to hear from you!

We're all about being transparent and setting clear expectations. That's why we've put together our hiring playbook https://app.notion.com/p/Checkly-Hiring-Playbook-54bc05178d3b4118a15effe885f96d1a?pvs=21 and open-sourced our employee handbook https://app.notion.com/p/Checkly-s-Employee-Handbook-f262e36a64d641af8588a1c09bc0ff48?pvs=21. There you'll find a sneak peek of who we are, how we work and what you can expect in our hiring process.

jobs.title: Pharma Sales Director
jobs.description:
Develop Health is on a mission to use AI to radically accelerate access to life-saving medications. By automating complex, manual healthcare processes—like benefit verification and prior authorization— we've been growing rapidly and over the past couple of years have helped over 2.5 million patients!

We’re partnering with some of the largest pharmacy benefit managers and payers in the nation, revolutionizing how healthcare interactions occur by eliminating human delays and inefficiencies. Our small, elite team of founders and engineers have previously launched and exited successful healthcare startups including Rupa Health and Canvas Medical. We are now scaling rapidly following a major funding round.




ABOUT THE ROLE

We're hiring a Pharma Sales Director to win and grow partnerships with pharmaceutical manufacturers and their brand teams. You carry a number and run your own deals, from the first conversation to a signed agreement and the expansion that follows.

Manufacturers work with us to get more patients started and kept on therapy. We automate benefit verification and prior authorization inside their HUB, specialty pharmacy, and direct-to-patient programs, which shortens time to therapy and cuts abandonment. Several manufacturer programs are already live and more are in contracting. Buyers sit across Brand, Marketing, Patient Services, Market Access, Trade, and Commercial. Every deal goes through procurement, legal, and compliance, and a typical cycle runs several months.

This is an individual contributor role. You'll report to our Head of Life Sciences & Partnerships and work closely with product, operations, data, and engineering, plus the HUBs and pharmacies we deliver through.

Three things define success in this role:

 1. You build the pipeline. You open new manufacturer accounts, qualify them fast, and keep every deal current in our CRM so the forecast holds up.

 2. You close. You shape the offer, write the business case, and take MSAs and work orders through procurement, legal, and compliance to signature.

 3. You grow the accounts. Your pilots go live cleanly, and you expand them into new brands and therapeutic areas within the same manufacturer.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

Win new accounts

 - Source and qualify manufacturer opportunities through your own network, outbound, and industry events.

 - Build senior relationships across Brand, Marketing, Patient Services, Market Access, Trade/Channel, and Commercial.

 - Find and coach internal champions who can carry the deal through their buying committee.

 - Represent Develop Health at industry conferences to build relationships, generate leads, and keep up with competitors.

Run the deal

 - Own each deal end to end: discovery, partnership design, pricing proposal, negotiation, and signature.

 - Build presentations, proposals, and business cases tied to brand goals like patient acquisition, time to therapy, adherence, and HUB cost. Use our data to make the case.

 - Travel regularly for onsite meetings and planning sessions with manufacturer teams.

 - Keep the pipeline, stages, and forecast accurate every week.

Grow existing accounts

 - Find new opportunities inside live manufacturer accounts, including additional brands, therapeutic areas, and programs.

 - Hand closed deals to account management with a clean scope, success metrics, and go-live plan, and stay close to the account after launch.

Work across the company

 - Bring market feedback to product and operations as clear requirements, and pull in the right people for solutioning and security reviews.

 - Work with marketing on case studies, playbooks, and other sales materials built around what manufacturers need.

 - Follow trends in patient support programs, pharma commercialization, and access technology, and share what you learn with the team.




WHAT YOU'LL BRING ON DAY 1

 - 5+ years selling to pharma manufacturers. Partnerships, business development, account management, or enterprise sales in patient services, market access, HUB services, specialty pharmacy, or digital health.

 - You've closed complex manufacturer agreements yourself. You can walk us through one from first meeting to signature, including who blocked it and how you got past them.

 - You know how manufacturers buy. Who owns the budget across brand, market access, and patient services, how procurement, legal, and compliance work, and how long it really takes.

 - You know the patient journey. From diagnosis and treatment start through adherence and ongoing support, and where access delays lose patients. You've sold solutions that move patient acquisition, adherence, or retention.

 - Working knowledge of specialty medication access. HUB workflows, benefit verification, prior authorization, affordability, and reimbursement.

 - Consultative selling with data. You turn data into a value story a brand lead can take to their leadership.

 - Pipeline discipline. You forecast honestly and keep your CRM current without being asked.

 - Clear writing and executive presence. Your proposals and follow-ups are short and easy to act on, and you're comfortable presenting to VPs.

 - Willing to travel. About 50% for client meetings and conferences.




WHAT YOU'LL NEED TO LEARN QUICKLY

 - Our product: how our benefit verification and prior authorization automation plugs into HUBs, pharmacies, and provider EHRs.

 - Our channel: how we deliver through HUB and pharmacy partners, and where a manufacturer program fits.

 - Our commercial model: setup and transaction pricing, pilots, and how programs expand.




BONUS POINTS

 - Existing relationships with brand, patient services, or market access leaders at pharma.

 - You've helped launch a brand's access program or HUB.

 - You understand the regulatory and compliance landscape in pharma, including the Anti-Kickback Statute, HIPAA, and FDA promotional rules, and how they shape patient support programs and manufacturer partnerships.

 - Early-stage startup experience.




THIS MIGHT NOT BE THE RIGHT FIT IF

 - You want to manage a team. This is an individual contributor role. You run your own deals.

 - You need pipeline handed to you. You'll source much of your own, especially early.

 - You want short sales cycles. Manufacturer deals take months and involve many stakeholders.

 - You need a set playbook. We're still building our pharma motion, and you'll help write it.




WHAT WE OFFER

 - Competitive base salary, commission on closed revenue, and meaningful early-stage equity.

 - A direct line to our Head of Life Sciences & Partnerships and company leadership.

 - Work that directly accelerates access to medication for hundreds of thousands of patients.

jobs.title: Commercial Legal Counsel
jobs.description:
A LITTLE ABOUT US

incident.io http://incident.io is the AI software reliability platform trusted by engineering teams at Netflix, Etsy, and 2,000+ companies who can't afford downtime.

The stakes are real, the talent is insane, and somehow it's a genuinely lovely place to work. We all pull our weight, go the extra mile, and put in the bit of magic most companies don't have time for, all while having fun and never taking ourselves too seriously.

We've raised $100+ million from Index Ventures, Insight Partners, and Point Nine, and we're growing fast. There's never been a better time to join.




THE ROLE IN ONE LINE

Be a trusted partner to our US teams, helping us close deals faster, navigate complex legal challenges, and build a legal function that scales with the business!




WHAT THAT LOOKS LIKE DAY TO DAY

The legal team partners with every team at incident.io http://incident.io, from Sales and Marketing to Engineering and Finance.

As the fifth member of our legal team, you'll join our existing US commercial counsel in San Francisco. Together, you'll help develop localized processes and shape a world-class legal function while enabling the business to scale at pace.

This role is ideal for a commercially minded lawyer with a strong background in SaaS commercial contracts and data protection who thrives on autonomy and high-impact work.

 - Trusted Advisor: Act as a strategic partner to our US GTM teams, providing pragmatic, high-velocity advice to manage risk and unblock complex commercial challenges.

 - Deal Lead: Own the drafting, review, and negotiation of a wide range of commercial contracts (primarily SaaS agreements), balancing robust legal safeguarding with the need for commercial momentum.

 - Privacy Specialist: Navigate US and international data protection and privacy issues, including negotiating DPAs and advising on associated business risks.

 - Function Builder: Partner with the legal team to create "self-serve" legal tools, standard forms, and US-specific templates that empower the business to move faster.

 - US Legal Expert: Serve as an internal subject matter expert on US legal nuances, including providing foundational guidance on US employment matters as we scale our local headcount.
   
   


WHO YOU ARE

 - Licensed Attorney: You are a US licensed attorney, with relevant experience, ideally gained in-house at a fast-paced SaaS or startup environment.

 - Negotiation: You have excellent drafting and communication skills, with a proven ability to transform complex legal concepts into clear, actionable commercial advice.

 - Privacy: You are comfortable dealing with data protection and privacy issues and understand their impact on the sales cycle.

 - High Autonomy: You thrive when working independently, while remaining a proactive collaborator with the wider legal team.

 - Comfort in Ambiguity: You enjoy the "builder" phase of a company. You are comfortable navigating a degree of ambiguity and can pivot quickly when new information or priorities are introduced.






SUPPORTING YOU

We work hard and we think life outside work matters just as much. Our benefits pack is built to support both.

 - Market-leading private medical insurance. The proper kind, so you're never weighing up your health against a bill.

 - Competitive PTO. Showing up at your best requires switching off, and we make sure you have time to do that.

 - First Friday of every month off. Yes, seriously.

 - Enhanced 401k. We put real money in, because future-you deserves better than an afterthought.

 - Meaningful equity. We're rapidly scaling, and everyone who helps shape the outcome should share in it.

 - Unlimited AI spend. For everyone, not just engineers. We're all-in on AI across the company, and we expect you to be too.

 - Generous parental leave. The early days with a new baby matter more than anything we're doing here, and we want you to be present for them.

 - Two budgets that have your back. $1000 to invest in your setup, $500 a year to invest in yourself.
