jobs.title: Data Science Tech Lead Manager, Model Experience
jobs.location: New York City, NY; San Francisco, CA; Seattle, WA
jobs.description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role
As part of our growing Data Science and Analytics team, you will play an instrumental role in our company's mission of building safe and beneficial artificial intelligence by driving data-informed decision making across our organization. You bring experience from high-bar teams and are eager to help shape the norms and best practices of a growing data science team as Anthropic continues to scale. In this unique company, technology, and moment in history, your work will be critical to informing our strategy as we deploy safe, frontier AI at scale to the world.

You'll be the senior data science leader for Model Experience and a strategic thought partner to product, engineering, and research leaders. Working where frontier AI research reaches the public, you'll help shape model roadmap and launch decisions, bringing a point of view on how users experience our models and what good looks like beyond benchmark scores. As a tech lead manager, you'll also hire and manage a team of data scientists, setting their agenda, personally leading the highest-stakes analyses, and raising the bar for how data shapes model and product decisions.

Responsibilities:

• Act as a strategic thought partner to product, engineering, and research leaders, helping shape model roadmap priorities, launch decisions, and the major bets the team makes

• Set the data science agenda for Model Experience, deciding where the team can have the most impact on model development and launch decisions and what it should deprioritize

• Hire, manage, and develop a team of data scientists, coaching them to move from answering questions to shaping decisions

• Frame the most important and ambiguous questions about model quality and user experience, size the opportunities, and make clear recommendations, including when they challenge the current direction

• Define how Model Experience measures success, establishing the core metrics and measurement frameworks across external products and internal testing that align teams and leadership on what matters

• Set the standard for experimentation and causal inference across Model Experience, including where launches lack a clean A/B test, and personally lead the highest-stakes analyses

• Turn complex analyses of model and user behavior into clear narratives and recommendations that drive decisions with senior leadership and cross-functional partners

• Establish foundational data practices and shape the analytics infrastructure Model Experience needs to support rapid iteration and decision-making as our models and products evolve

You may be a good fit if you:

• Have extensive experience in data science, including leading analytics for a product or research area at significant scale

• Have 3+ years managing data science teams, including setting team direction, hiring, and developing senior data scientists

• Have been a trusted partner to senior product, research, and business leaders, with clear examples of changing a roadmap or high-stakes decision

• Bring strong product sense and business judgment, including the ability to frame the right question and take a position with incomplete information

• Have deep expertise in experimental design, causal inference, and statistical modeling at high scale, with enough fluency in Python and SQL to stay hands-on and guide others' technical work

• Communicate clearly in writing and in presentations, including to executive audiences

• Have a bias for action and thrive in ambiguous, fast-moving environments where you must create clarity and drive progress

• Care about the company's mission of building helpful, honest, and harmless AI

• Strong candidates may also have:

• Experience with AI/ML products, large language models, or developer tools in the AI/ML ecosystem

• Experience as a tech lead manager or player-coach, balancing hands-on technical work with people management

• Experience building or scaling a data science team in a fast-growing organization

• Experience working closely with Product or Research teams, especially on LLM or AI products

• Comfort working with unstructured data

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary:

$380,000—$460,000 USD

Logistics

Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed.  Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How we're different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

Why Cast AI?

Cast AI is an automation platform that operates cloud-native and AI infrastructure at scale. By embedding autonomous decision-making directly into Kubernetes and cloud environments, Cast AI continuously optimizes performance, reliability, and efficiency in production.

The old way doesn't work. As Kubernetes and AI environments grow, manual decisions don’t. Cast AI replaces tickets, alerts, and manual tuning with continuous automation that adapts infrastructure as conditions change. Efficiency and cost savings follow naturally from that automation.

Over 2,100 companies already rely on Cast AI, including Akamai, BMW, Cisco, FICO, HuggingFace, NielsenIQ, Swisscom, and TGS.

Global team, diverse perspectives
We're headquartered in Miami, but our impact is international. We take a global and intentional approach to diversity. Today, Cast AI operates across 34 countries spanning Europe, North America, Latin America, and APAC, bringing a wide range of perspectives into how we build and lead.

Unicorn momentum
In January 2026, we achieved unicorn status with a strategic investment from Pacific Alliance Ventures, the corporate venture arm of Shinsegae Group (a $50+ billion Korean conglomerate). Our valuation now exceeds $1 billion, and we're just getting started.

Join us as we build the future of autonomous infrastructure.

About the role

San Francisco is where cloud-native gets built. The engineering teams running the biggest Kubernetes and AI workloads in the world sit within a few miles of each other, and every one of them is wrestling with the same problem: infrastructure that grows faster than humans can tune it.

That's the conversation you'll own. As an Enterprise Account Executive in the Bay Area, you'll sell to CTOs, VPs of Engineering, and FinOps leaders at companies where cloud spend is a board-level topic and automation is the only answer that scales.

We're in build mode across the Americas. You won't be inheriting a tidy territory and a playbook to follow - you'll be sourcing your own pipeline, shaping how we win enterprise deals in the most competitive tech market there is, and helping define what excellence looks like for our US go-to-market. If you're an entrepreneurial seller who wants a product that genuinely sells itself once the right people see it, this is the seat.

What'll You Own?

• Ensuring Value Delivery through careful implementation and measurement of results, alongside Customer Success.

What'll You Need?

• A strong track record as an enterprise Account Executive, consistently closing large, complex deals.

• Proven experience in Opportunity Assessment, Value Discovery, Value Demonstration, and Value Delivery.

• Demonstrated ability to navigate multi-threaded deals involving CTOs, VPs of Engineering, and FinOps leaders at the same time, including running executive business reviews, leading technical discovery, and building champions across IT, Finance, and Procurement.

• The ability to translate complex technical products (cloud infrastructure, DevOps, platform engineering) into clear business ROI narratives, including business cases, ROI calculators, and executive-level proposals tailored to each account's cloud spend and engineering maturity.

• Strong collaboration with Sales Engineering, Customer Success, and Marketing, plus rigorous pipeline hygiene: accurate forecasting, CRM discipline, and the confidence to present pipeline reviews to leadership.

• A history of identifying key contacts, understanding client needs, and tailoring proposals to match, with demonstrated success in negotiation and closing and a commitment to long-term customer satisfaction.

• An outbound obsession.

• A builder's mindset: you bring solutions, not problems, and want to help build excellence in the Americas GTM.

What Makes You Stand Out?

• Experience selling cloud SaaS in Cloud Infrastructure, Cloud Cost Control, Cloud Security, or DevOps tools.

• Hands-on familiarity with Kubernetes and the cloud-native ecosystem.

What’s in it for you?

• Join a fast-growing company at the forefront of cloud-native automation and Kubernetes technology.

jobs.title: Partner Success Manager, Manufacturer & Specialty Partnerships
jobs.description:
ABOUT LEAP

Leap is one of the fastest-growing benefits solutions and a category-defining pioneer in employer specialty pharmacy. We are reshaping how life-changing therapies are delivered and financed, ensuring patients get the treatment they need while employers finally get a fair deal.

Specialty drugs and infusions represent nearly 10% of all healthcare spend and are the fastest-growing cost category for employers. Leap tackles this challenge with a novel approach: eliminating hidden markups, expanding access to high-quality infusion providers, and bringing clarity and fairness to how therapies are priced and paid for.

We’re proud to partner with numerous Fortune 500 companies and leading TPAs. Each patient we serve creates immediate ROI: lower costs, improved access, and better care. Join us as we redefine what’s possible in specialty care.




ABOUT THE ROLE

Leap Health is building the industry's only transparent infusion benefit. Its network includes specialty pharmacies, manufacturers, home nursing agencies, and ambulatory infusion centers through the Leap Transparency Network (LTN). As we sign new partners, each agreement needs a dedicated owner to get it live, keep it healthy, and grow it.

The Partner Success Manager is that owner. The role combines two responsibilities:

 1. Account management: acting as the day-to-day relationship lead for a book of manufacturer and specialty pharmacy partners.

 2. Implementation: running operations for every new contract Leap signs, from kickoff through go-live and steady state, including specialty pharmacy, manufacturer, and infusion center agreements.

This role suits someone who builds strong relationships and is just as comfortable owning the details: timelines, pricing loads, workflows, and follow-through that turn a signed agreement into a partnership that performs.




KEY RESPONSIBILITIES


PARTNER ACCOUNT MANAGEMENT

 - Serve as the primary day-to-day contact for assigned manufacturer and specialty pharmacy partners. Build trusted relationships at the operational and leadership levels.

 - Run regular partner check-ins and quarterly business reviews covering referral volume, pricing position, service levels, and patient experience.

 - Monitor partner performance against agreed standards and escalate issues quickly, including scheduling, communication, fulfillment, and invoice gaps. Drive each one to resolution with internal teams.

 - Spot opportunities to grow each partnership, such as rebids, new therapeutic areas, added sites of care, or expanded product access. Bring them to the VP and SVP.

 - Support manufacturer engagements with the materials, data, and follow-ups partners need. Coordinate with the analytics and pricing team so information shared externally is accurate and consistent.


CONTRACT IMPLEMENTATION & ONBOARDING

 - Own the implementation plan for every newly signed agreement, whether specialty pharmacy, manufacturer, or infusion center. Turn contract terms into a launch checklist with owners, milestones, and go-live dates.

 - Lead partner kickoff calls. Align Leap's clinical, operations, revenue cycle, and pricing teams with the partner's teams on workflows, contacts, and expectations.

 - Coordinate pricing exhibit loads and updates in Pond, Leap's pricing system, and confirm rates match the executed agreement and any amendments.

 - Make sure partners are trained on Leap's referral, prior authorization, white-bag, shipment, and billing workflows before their first patient.

 - Track implementation status across all partners in flight. Report progress, risks, and blockers to leadership.


CONTRACT OPERATIONS & COMPLIANCE

 - Maintain the master contract repository, including agreements, BAAs, DUAs, pricing exhibits, and amendments. Track effective dates, rate-lock periods, renewal windows, and key obligations.

 - Partner with Legal to route redlines, track approvals, and make sure fully executed copies are filed and accessible.

 - Monitor compliance with contracted service levels, quality requirements, and audit rights. Flag upcoming renewals, expiring terms, and unmet obligations.

 - Work with Revenue Cycle Management and Finance to reconcile invoices against contracted pricing and fees, and resolve discrepancies with partners.


PROCESS & COMMUNICATION

 - Build and maintain standard operating procedures for partner onboarding, issue escalation, pricing updates, and data requests.

 - Keep the internal LTN and specialty pharmacy update channels current with new partners, site additions, pricing changes, and implementation milestones.

 - Serve as the internal point of contact for partner questions from Clinical Operations, Care Guides, Finance, Legal, and Sales.




WHAT YOU BRING

jobs.title: 005-10-2026/GD-RDC/Associate Engagement Communautaire Lukula Kongo Central
jobs.description:
About GiveDirectly

What if the most effective way to fight poverty was also the simplest: give people money and trust them to decide what they need?

Since 2011, GiveDirectly has proven that idea at scale. We’ve delivered more than $1B in cash directly to 2+ million people living in poverty and crisis across 15 countries, and rigorous research shows the results: healthier kids, stronger businesses, sturdier homes, and more resilient families and local economies. Cash is now widely recognized as one of the most scalable, cost-effective, and dignified forms of aid.

Our ambition goes beyond our own programs. We want cash to become the benchmark for aid, much as the index fund became the benchmark for investing, so that every aid dollar is held to one question: is this doing more good than giving the money directly to people living in poverty?

We’re growing fast, and this is a rare and important moment to join.

We expect to hit $1B in revenue in 2026 with significant growth forecast for 2027. At the same time we are building a new technology stack and operating model designed for a roughly 10x change in scale, and we are actively pursuing partnerships with major funders to move even more money in bigger ways, to people who need it. We are known for our extensive integration of technology into field processes; our quantitative approach to performance measurement; and our commitment to rigorous, independent, experimental evaluation of our impact, with multiple Randomized Control Trials completed and others in progress.

How we work

Our team spans 20+ countries and 69 languages. Our culture is candid, analytical, and non-hierarchical. We expect high ownership and give people real responsibility early. Our values are central to how we hire, work, and grow, and they are deliberately opinionated:

• Recipients first. Recipients’ preferences come before those of donors or ourselves.

• Team next. We optimize for organizational success, not individual success.

• Be proactively candid. We say what we believe and share information openly.

• Create positive energy. We aim to be a source of energy for colleagues, not a drain.

• Think rigorously; act quickly. We reason from first principles, then act rather than debate.

• Know yourself and grow. We own our imperfections and seek feedback to grow.

• Accept reality. Propose solutions. We focus on what can change and bring solutions, not just problems.

• Be productively ambitious. We take risks for step-change impact, not incremental progress.

If they describe how you like to work and they energize you, this could be a great fit.

Want to learn more? Read and listen:

We are one of Time100’s Most Influential Companies of 2026, and our work has been covered by The Economist, NPR, TED, and The Washington Post. We're now preparing to deliver billions of dollars a year to people in extreme poverty, if funding allows. Read our CEO's essay on what that will take.

À propos de GiveDirectly

GiveDirectly envoie de l’argent directement aux personnes en situation d'extrême pauvreté , afin qu’elles décident elles-mêmes de ce dont elles ont le plus besoin , notre culture est franche , analytique, rapide et non hiérarchique.

Depuis 2018, GiveDirectly est présente en RDC et transfert de l’argent par téléphone mobile au menages vulnerables , en vue de promouvoir la sécurité alimentaire, la réduction de la pauvreté et l’inclusion financière.

Pour en savoir plus sur notre action et nos resultats ,visitez : www.givedirectly.org

a.Responsabilités

• Soutenir la distribution de supports d’information (dépliants, messages clés, etc.) et mener des campagnes de sensibilisation sur le projet auprès des populations ciblées, en adaptant les messages à un public urbain ( des zones populaires) diversifié (niveau d’alphabétisation, genre, âge, vulnérabilités).

• Collaborer avec les leaders communautaires, les organisations locales et les membres des communautés pour améliorer la compréhension du recensement, encourager la participation et lever les obstacles éventuels.

• Organiser et animer des réunions communautaires au niveau des quartiers, avenues, avec l’appui des leaders communautaires et relais locaux.

• Identifier les risques potentiels (opérationnels, sociaux, sécuritaires ou liés à la perception) auxquels GD pourrait faire face avant le démarrage des activités de recensement et de mobilisation au Kongo Central.

• Mettre à jour les outils de suivi de l’engagement et de la mobilisation communautaire avec les résultats issus des activités de terrain.

• Soutenir la Responsable de l’Engagement Communautaire et de la Communication dans le développement et la mise en œuvre de la stratégie d’engagement communautaire adaptée au contexte du milieu.

• Établir et maintenir de bonnes relations avec les communautés à travers des visites régulières sur le terrain, afin de recueillir des informations sur la connaissance du projet, l’accessibilité, la confiance, l’appropriation, ainsi que la pertinence des messages et des canaux utilisés.

• Recevoir et traiter les commentaires et plaintes des bénéficiaires, et orienter les personnes vers les mécanismes d’assistance appropriés (centre d’appel, canaux de feedback).

• Soutenir l’AFM/FM dans l’identification et la résolution des problématiques liées aux FAQ du programme, afin de garantir leur pertinence et leur mise à jour continue selon l’évolution du programme.

• Mener des entretiens avec les bénéficiaires pour documenter leurs expériences et

b. Profil Recherché

• Licence dans un domaine professionnel pertinent (sciences sociales, santé publique, communication, psychologie, développement, etc.).

• Expérience dans le secteur de la santé, de la psychologie et/ou de la protection souhaitée.

• Toute formation en psychologie, protection, nutrition ou santé maternelle constitue un atout.

• Excellentes aptitudes à la communication, avec capacité à adapter les messages à des publics variés en milieu urbain (populaire) (jeunes, femmes, populations vulnérables, différents niveaux d’alphabétisation).

• Alignement sur les valeurs fondamentales de GiveDirectly et engagement à faire progresser la mission de GD.

• Attitude positive, forte éthique de travail et esprit d’équipe, avec un intérêt marqué pour le travail de terrain dans un environnement urbain (populaire) dynamique et exigeant.

• Capacité avérée à travailler de manière très indépendante et proactive, tout en communiquant efficacement sur les défis, lacunes et risques.

• Solides compétences en matière d’établissement de relations et capacité à interagir efficacement avec une diversité d’acteurs (leaders communautaires, autorités locales, organisations locales, groupes de jeunes, des femmes etc.).

• Capacité à évoluer dans des environnements complexes et densément peuplés, avec une bonne gestion des priorités et du temps.

• Bonne compréhension et utilisation de différents canaux de communication adaptés au contexte de Kongo Central (réunions communautaires, radios locales, réseaux sociaux, WhatsApp, etc.) est un atout.

• Compétences analytiques et techniques, incluant une maîtrise intermédiaire de Google Docs, MS Word, MS Excel et outils de communication virtuelle (ex : Google Meet)

• Une expérience confirmée dans l’engagement communautaire, la sensibilisation, la mobilisation sociale et/ou la communication.

• Excellente connaissance des dynamiques communautaires et des acteurs locaux au Kongo Central, notamment dans les zones d’intervention de GiveDirectly.

C.Valeurs de GiveDirectly

• Priorité aux bénéficiaires : Nous privilégions les préférences des bénéficiaires, pas celles de nos donateurs ni même les nôtres.

• L’équipe avant l’individuel : Nous œuvrons pour le succès de l’organisation, pas celui des individus.

• Être proactivement franc : Nous parlons et communiquons les informations en toute franchise.

• Créer une énergie positive : Nous nous efforçons d’apporter de l’énergie positive à nos collègues, et pas de la leur prendre.

• Réfléchir rigoureusement, agir rapidement : Priorité à la rigueur et à l’action, pas au débat interminable.

• Se connaître et se développer : Nous sommes conscients de nos défauts, mais nous les exploitons.

• Accepter la réalité, Proposer des solutions : Nous ne nous attardons pas sur les problèmes. Nous créons des solutions.

• Être ambitieux de manière productive : Nous prenons des risques qui pourraient révolutionner le secteu

d.Comment postuler

Les candidatures se font uniquement en ligne, les intéressés sont priés d’aller sur le https://boards.greenhouse.io/givedirectly chercher les offres de la RDC, et soumettre leurs candidatures au plus tard le 05 Novembre   2026 à 17h00 précises Heure de Kinshasa.

Si les pièces ne sont pas demandées sur le portail de candidatures , le dossier contient ( Un CV à jour avec 3 références, une lettre de motivation , la copie du diplôme et le certificat de fin de service du dernier employeur, Les dossiers incomplets ne seront pas examinés)

En cas de difficulté technique écrire à drc-recruitment@givedirectly.org

Les attestations fournies sont toutes vérifiées ; en cas de fausse information votre candidature sera rejetée.

• Les attestations de services fournies dans votre dossier pour ce recrutement, seront vérifiées, scrupuleusement, et toute fausse information y relative entraînera un rejet immédiat de votre candidature.

• ATTENTION : NE PAS ENVOYER VOTRE CANDIDATURE À L'ÉMAIL : whistleblower@givedirectly.org

Nos engagements

GiveDirectly applique une politique de tolérance zéro à l'égard de l'exploitation, des abus et du harcèlement sexuels (SEAH) et attend de toute personne qui travaille avec nous qu'elle place la protection des bénéficiaires en priorité.

Le recrutement est entièrement gratuit. GiveDirectly ne demande ni frais, ni pot-de-vin, ni faveur d'aucune sorte, ni information bancaire, à aucune étape du processus.

Si l'on vous formule une telle demande, ou si vous estimez subir une pression ou une discrimination injuste, écrivez à whistleblower@givedirectly.org  Cette adresse sert uniquement à signaler un problème, jamais à postuler.

Working at GiveDirectly

GiveDirectly is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants are considered for employment without regard to the person’s race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Flagging for US applicants: We invite you to "Know Your Rights" as an applicant.

Commitment to Safeguarding

As a global organization working with communities to eliminate extreme poverty, GiveDirectly takes the safeguarding of its recipients, staff, and partners seriously. To that end, GiveDirectly is a member of the Misconduct Disclosure Scheme, and will systematically check with previous employers about any abuse or misconduct related matters involving potential new hires. We may also employ other robust pre-hire screens, including in-depth reference checks, criminal background checks, and sanctions screens.

These efforts help us continue to build and maintain trust with the communities we work with, and prevent abuse to our recipients and staff.

**GD is committed to observing all local, national and international laws that protect people and basic human rights of all. GD is committed to a policy of “zero tolerance when it comes to preventing,  reporting, or responding to any form of abuse or  exploitation.” and expects anyone who works for GD to uphold the protection and safeguarding of our recipients as a priority.**

Reasonable Accommodations

We are committed to fostering an inclusive and accessible work environment. If you require any accommodations during the application or interview process, or to perform the essential functions of the role, please email us at careers@givedirectly.org with the email subject “Accommodation Needed”. We will work with you to ensure reasonable accommodations are made to support your needs.

Want to put your best foot forward on your GiveDirectly application? Take a look at our Candidate Application Prep Guide!

Referrals

Know the right person for this role? Please consider referring them. We offer a reward of $3,000 for a Senior Manager or above role, and $500 for a Manager role, paid if we end up hiring your referral. Thank you for sending great people our way!

jobs.description:
ABOUT BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.




THE ROLE

Secure BJAK's AI-enabled products and agent workflows using third-party models. Focus on customer data shared with model providers, agent permissions, user data isolation, and prompt injection through uploaded documents and other untrusted content.




WHAT YOU WILL BUILD

 - Assess customer data sent to third-party model vendors, including minimization, vendor controls, retention, logging, and approved use.

 - Design controls limiting AI agent permissions, tools, actions, and system access using least privilege and explicit authorization.

 - Implement and test tenant and user data isolation across prompts, conversation history, retrieval, memory, and AI-connected services.

 - Threat model and test prompt injection and indirect injection through uploaded documents, retrieved content, links, and other untrusted inputs.

 - Partner with Product and Engineering on safe document ingestion, content handling, output validation, and approval for sensitive actions.

 - Support SC TRM and BNM RMiT for AI technology risks, including assessments, third-party oversight, control evidence, and remediation.

 - Build security tests, monitoring, and response procedures for AI misuse, data exposure, unauthorized actions, and vendor incidents.




WHAT WE LOOK FOR

 - Degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, AI, or related field, or equivalent experience.

 - 3+ years in application security, product security, security engineering, or AI system security.

 - Experience implementing or owning SC TRM and BNM RMiT controls, technology risk, or regulatory control evidence.

 - Understanding of third-party LLM integrations, model APIs, agent tools, RAG, and AI application architectures.

 - Knowledge of prompt injection, indirect injection, cross-user data leakage, excessive agent permissions, and vendor data disclosure risks.

 - Programming or scripting skills, preferably Python and TypeScript/Node.js, plus APIs and AWS or GCP.

 - Able to collaborate with Product, Legal, Compliance, Data, and Engineering on practical controls and risk communication.




LANGUAGE

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

jobs.title: Head of AMER Startups (AI Sales)
jobs.description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies, from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups, use Stripe to start their business, accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

The AMER Startups team is responsible for Stripe's fastest-growing and highest-potential customer segment. Within this organization, the AI Sales team focuses specifically on the breakthrough ecosystem of AI - spanning foundation model builders, AI infrastructure platforms, agentic workflows, and AI-native SaaS applications.

AI startups represent an unprecedented paradigm shift: they achieve hyper-growth at velocities previously unseen in software, operate complex token- or consumption-based monetization models, and face unique infrastructure and scaling demands from day one. You will tackle the challenge of building dedicated coverage, specialized technical go-to-market motions, and intelligent automation systems to support thousands of AI companies as they scale from seed stage to market dominance.

What you’ll do

As Head of AMER Startups (AI Sales), you will lead the dedicated organization responsible for acquiring, expanding, and partnering with high-growth AI startups across North America. This role acts as both an expansion engine and a strategic acquisition vector for the most transformational segment in tech.

You will be a second-line leader managing frontline managers across specialized Account Executives who grow distinct AI stages (e.g., early-stage AI labs, scaling AI infra, and enterprise-grade AI native apps). You will partner cross-functionally with product managers, solutions architects, risk specialists, and AI ecosystem venture partners to build GTM motions around usage billing, multi-product platform adoption, and AI-native monetization patterns.

This role reports to the Head of AMER Startups.

Responsibilities

• Vision & Strategy: Develop the overarching GTM vision, sub-team structure, and operating model for Stripe’s AI Startup organization across North America.

• Specialized AI Coverage: Design coverage models optimized for non-linear, hyper-growth trajectories—balancing high-touch high-velocity sales engineering for breakout AI labs with signal-driven, automated coverage for emerging AI developers.

• Monetization & Product Attach: Drive adoption of core Stripe financial infrastructure—including Metered/Usage-Based Billing, Connect, Financial Connections, and Global Payouts—tailored specifically to consumption and token-based pricing models.

• Breakout Detection Systems: Create data-driven systems and signals to identify early breakout AI companies (e.g., sudden compute expansion, API usage spikes) and rapidly deploy specialized resources to capture and retain market share.

• Ecosystem Leadership: Partner closely with leading AI venture funds, incubators, AI compute providers, and cloud marketplaces to position Stripe as the default financial stack for AI startups.

• Team Building & Management: Recruit, hire, and develop top-tier frontline managers and Account Executives, defining specialized AI sales profiles and fostering an environment of deep domain expertise.

• Product Feedback Loop: Serve as the strategic voice of AI founders to Stripe’s Product and Engineering teams, shaping roadmap priorities for billing engine scalability, usage metering, and AI agent payment capabilities.

• Forecasting & Operations: Own pipeline health and revenue forecasting for a volatile, hyper-growth segment using specialized leading metrics (usage volumes, API calls, compute commit signals).

Who you are

Minimum requirements

• 10+ years of experience leading high-growth technology sales or GTM organizations, with 3+ years as a second-line manager leading multiple specialized sales sub-teams.

• Demonstrated experience with usage-based, consumption, or complex SaaS billing and monetization models.

• Proven track record of driving multi-product platform adoption and cross-sell growth in fast-moving technology environments.

• Strong quantitative, analytical, and systems thinking skills to model portfolio economics, coverage ratios, and signal-driven investment decisions.

• Demonstrated ability to recruit, develop, and retain high-performing frontline leaders and Account Executives.

Preferred qualifications

• Deep domain knowledge of the AI landscape, including LLMs, generative media, AI agent frameworks, and AI cloud infrastructure.

• Active connections within the startup and venture capital ecosystem (AI founders, investors, and startup communities).

• Prior sales leadership experience at a high-growth developer-focused, infrastructure, or fintech platform.

• Experience designing incentive and compensation structures aligned with consumption and usage-driven revenue models.

• Track record of leveraging AI and automated signal workflows internally to scale sales productivity and coverage beyond linear headcount growth.

Leadership Style

You are a "player-coach" who can dive deep into the technical architecture of a generative AI startup's billing stack while stepping back to execute long-term strategic plans for the overall AMER market. You thrive in rapid, dynamic environments, embrace ambiguity, and lead through cross-functional influence across Product, Marketing, Risk, and Engineering.

You will embody Stripe’s core operating principles in your day-to-day leadership:

• User First: You advocate relentlessly for the AI founder, ensuring our products solve the unique payment and monetization friction points of AI-native software. Stay Curious: You continuously study emerging AI architecture patterns, new business models, and founder needs to keep Stripe ahead of market shifts. Collaborate Egolessly: You work seamlessly across Stripe, prioritizing the overarching success of the Startups mission and the broader AI ecosystem over individual or team-specific metrics.

jobs.title: Data Engineer, Marketing
jobs.description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today, SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of making life multiplanetary and expanding consciousness to the stars.

SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to help humanity understand the universe. Our teams are building the full Super Intelligence stack: from our Colossus supercomputers, to Grok models, to our suite of applications, including Grok Bot, Grok Build, Grok Imagine, Grok Voice, and X. We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next.

About the role

The Data team at SpaceXSI is a small team that works across the company to inform business and product decisions, and we’re hiring the first member of our team to focus fully on marketing. Performance Marketing at SpaceXSI drives scaled acquisition across 10+ channels for Grok, Grok Bot, and our full portfolio of AI products, across consumer, SMB, startup, and enterprise audiences.

This role will sit in the central Data team and partner directly with Marketing leadership to own the measurement and analysis of performance marketing, growth marketing programs, and overall marketing measurement. You'll use your expertise to inform where the next dollar goes as we scale paid acquisition, while building the foundations of a world class marketing data team. Your job is to help us understand the impact of our activities and what we should do next.



What you'll do

 - Build and own the measurement layer for performance marketing: economics and performance by channel, campaign, audience, geo, and creative, across both PLG and Sales-Led revenue lines

 - Design incrementality tests (geo, audience, and conversion lift) with channel owners, and use the results to move budget and calibrate attribution, not just to fill a slide

 - Stand up and maintain our media-mix model, and pair it with test results to answer the big allocation questions: which channels to scale, which to cut, and where we're hitting saturation

 - Own the quality of the predictive LTV signal we send to Meta, Google, and the other networks: validate it against realized revenue, catch drift and breakage early, and partner with Data and Engineering to improve it

 - Keep pipeline source and campaign attribution separate and clean, so self-reported source, promo codes, click-based attribution, and CRM pipeline each answer their own question without double counting revenue



You may be a fit if

 - You have 7+ years of experience in marketing analytics, marketing science, or data science supporting paid acquisition

 - You have strong SQL and python skills and are comfortable building both data pipelines and predictive models

 - You've run hold-out or incrementality tests and worked with MMM and attribution models in production, and you know the limitations of each

 - You understand how ad platforms report, optimize, and ingest conversion signals, and you don't take platform-reported numbers at face value

 - You communicate clearly with channel managers, Finance, and leadership, and you're honest about what the data does and doesn't support

 - You're self-directed, comfortable owning ambiguous problems end to end

At StarTree we're a group of passionate individuals that desire to improve the lives of many by developing tools and technologies that support availability and speed in the world of real-time analytics.

Our aim is to make it simple for every company to delight their users - external and internal - and create new revenue streams from their data, by building the world’s most comprehensive and accessible cloud analytics system.

At StarTree we're a group of passionate individuals that desire to improve the lives of many by developing tools and technologies that support availability and speed in the world of real-time analytics.

Our aim is to make it simple for every company to delight their users - external and internal - and create new revenue streams from their data, by building the world’s most comprehensive and accessible cloud analytics system.

Team and Responsibilities

Apache Pinot is a distributed analytics database built for real-time applications at massive scale. It powers mission-critical workloads at companies including Splunk, Meesho, CrowdStrike, Together AI, and Charter Telecom, where milliseconds matter and scale is measured in millions of events and tens of thousands of queries per second.

CrowdStrike processes up to 120K events/sec and serves 25K queries/sec; Together AI analyzes billions of LLM token events per hour with sub-second latency; and Charter Telecom operates Pinot at an ingestion scale of 120M events/sec. These aren't just benchmarks—they are production systems powering real customer experiences.

At StarTree, you’ll work on the distributed systems behind this scale—solving hard problems in performance, reliability, concurrency, and data infrastructure. You’ll have the opportunity to make an impact from day one, take ownership of meaningful problems, and grow rapidly in a high-ownership startup environment.

You Will

• Own and drive impactful distributed systems problems end-to-end, from inception through production launch.

• Collaborate with a strong engineering team to identify and prioritize the most impactful problems and projects for the company.

• Raise the quality bar across engineering while helping keep our systems reliable and operationally lean.

• Mentor and grow engineers while learning from experienced, battle-tested engineers around you.

Skills & Experience

• Experience- 0-2 Years.

• Strong distributed systems fundamentals and experience solving problems at scale. Our platform is Java-based, so Java experience is a plus, but not a hard requirement.

• Bias toward execution — able to take an idea from concept through implementation and deliver it to production.

• Deep ownership of quality and customer experience, with a strong focus on reliability, observability, performance, and ease of use.

• Adaptability and flexibility — willing to take on whatever is most important for the company and adjust to changing priorities.

• Curiosity, positivity, and resilience — comfortable navigating ambiguity and uncertainty while maintaining a constructive, problem-solving mindset.

AI-First Mindset - Comfortable using AI tools in everyday engineering workflows and eager to continuously learn and integrate AI into how you build, debug, test, and solve problems.

StarTree is a cloud-based software company that enables business customers to derive advanced insights from real-time and historical data. StarTree was founded by the core software engineering team and inventors of Apache Pinot, which currently powers hundreds of user-facing applications at companies across industries, including LinkedIn, Uber, Target, 7Eleven, Etsy, Walmart, WePay, Factual, Weibo, and more. StarTree Cloud has enabled even more companies to deploy and operate real-time analytics at scale, including Stripe, Sovrn, Roadie, Just Eat Takeaway.com, Dialpad, Guitar Center, Blinkit, and more.

jobs.title: Senior Design Lead (Bangkok based, relocation provided)
jobs.description:
About Agoda

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.

Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.

No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

A bit about the Brand team

Agoda’s Brand team brings together, brand managers, media planners, project managers, designers, and creatives. We shape how consumers, business partners, and employees experience Agoda, building recognition and brand trust. Working as an internal agency, we develop brand campaigns and marketing communications across digital channels, events, presentations, and other brand touchpoints.

About the role

We are looking for a Senior Design Lead who combines exceptional design craft with experience managing and developing designers. This role carries both individual contributor and people management responsibilities. You will personally develop concepts and design key work, while guiding the team and raising the quality of its output.

A central focus will be making Agoda’s distinctive brand assets more recognizable, versatile, and effective through repeated use. You will shape how these assets appear across campaigns, channels, and markets, building familiarity while finding fresh, purposeful ways to express the brand.

You bring a refined eye for impactful design and a strong understanding of visual and message hierarchy. You can demonstrate your thinking through your own work, coach others to strengthen theirs, and use AI confidently in visual design and campaign development.

In this role you’ll get to

• Personally concept and design. Own design projects from brief through final execution, producing original work and contributing actively to the team’s everyday creative output.

• Strengthen Agoda’s distinctive brand assets. Develop consistent, inventive applications that make our assets more recognizable, versatile, and effective across touchpoints and over time.

• Lead and develop designers. Manage and coach the team, set clear expectations, and run constructive creative reviews. Give actionable feedback and demonstrate solutions through your own design work.

• Shape visual and message architecture. Work with copy, creative, and marketing partners to establish what audiences should notice first, understand next, and act on.

• Evolve our design guidelines. Develop practical principles, examples, and reusable resources that help teams and external partners use our brand assets consistently and imaginatively.

• Connect creative quality to business objectives. Present a clear rationale for design decisions, use audience insights and performance feedback to improve work, and balance priorities and deadlines. Collaborate with production specialists to carry the creative vision through delivery.

• Use AI to elevate design and brand campaigns. Apply AI tools confidently to develop campaign concepts, explore visual directions, and create and refine layouts and brand imagery. Guide the team in integrating AI into everyday design work while maintaining strong craft, clear message hierarchy, and consistent use of Agoda’s distinctive assets.

What you’ll need to succeed

• 10+ years of design experience within creative, branding, or advertising agencies, with a strong record of personally delivering high-quality brand and marketing communications.

• Proven experience managing and developing a team of designers, alongside an active individual contribution to concept development and execution.

• An outstanding portfolio that clearly distinguishes your own design work from projects you directed, demonstrating exceptional craft and your ability to elevate the work of others.

• A refined eye for typography, composition, imagery, color, and spacing, with the ability to create elegant, distinctive work suited to the brand and audience.

• Strong command of visual hierarchy and message architecture, including the ability to simplify complex information and create a clear relationship between headlines, supporting content, and calls to action.

• Experience developing brand guidelines and distinctive assets, with an understanding of how consistent, repeated use builds recognition across campaigns and formats.

• The ability to explain why a design works and translate your judgment into specific feedback that helps designers improve their craft and confidence.

• Excellent collaboration and presentation skills, with experience aligning stakeholders and balancing creative ambition with business objectives and delivery requirements.

• Strong practical proficiency in core design tools such as Figma, Adobe Illustrator, and Photoshop.

• Proficiency in using AI tools for visual design and brand campaign development, with practical experience creating and refining layouts, imagery, and campaign concepts. A strong eye for evaluating and improving AI outputs, ensuring they meet the brief and reflect the brand’s identity.

It’s great if you have

• Experience working with global brands and adapting creative across markets, languages, and cultural contexts.

• Experience using brand research or creative testing to strengthen the recognition and effectiveness of distinctive brand assets.

• Experience collaborating with motion, film, and automation specialists, providing clear creative direction throughout production.

• Experience bringing agency standards of craft and creative development into an internal brand team.

What we offer

• The opportunity to shape Agoda’s visual expression and strengthen the impact of its distinctive brand assets.

• A role combining personal design ownership with the opportunity to develop a team and influence creative quality across the business.

• A collaborative environment with colleagues and specialist creative partners across disciplines.

• Opportunities to advance the use of AI and emerging creative tools while building on strong design foundations.

jobs.title: Electrical Engineer VI
jobs.description:
Voyager is an innovative space, defense, and national security technology company committed to advancing and delivering transformative, mission-critical solutions. We tackle the most complex challenges to unlock new frontiers for human progress, fortify national security, and protect critical assets to lead in the race for technological and operational superiority from ground to space.

Forge the Future: Join Voyager Technologies

The future belongs to those who build it. At Voyager Technologies, we’re building technologies that protect lives, expand frontiers and prepare us for what’s next. And we’re doing that with people who are wired to solve, build, adapt and lead. These roles are not for the faint of heart.

You’ll help lay the foundation for humanity's future. Join a culture where innovation thrives, curiosity is rewarded, and impact is real. We’re a company of doers, thinkers and builders, united by purpose and grounded in reality.

If you want to put your skills to work where the stakes are real and the mission is bigger than any one person, forge the future with Voyager.

Valley Tech Systems (VTS), a wholly owned subsidiary of Voyager Technologies, is an innovative engineering company that is leading the way in controllable solid propulsion and open architecture airborne intelligence, surveillance, and reconnaissance (ISR) technologies. VTS’ innovative solutions address technology needs across the U.S. Government and commercial space industry. reentry systems, missile defense, commercial and DoD space launch systems, small launch vehicles, and payloads.

At VTS our mission is to supply the most advanced and innovative solutions to complex problems found in the Department of Defense weapon systems. We approach these problems using a “mission-focused”, “customer first” engineering approach. Working at VTS means you will be engaging with industry pioneers at a small company who all work collaboratively to make big things happen.

Position Description:

The Electrical Engineer VI reports to the Systems Engineering Manager and is part of the Strategic Systems department, which is based in Folsom, CA. This role can also be based in the Reno, NV office. The position serves as a senior technical authority responsible for the architecture, design, integration, and qualification of complex electronic hardware systems supporting advanced DoD missile defense and aerospace applications. The role emphasizes high-reliability system design and technical leadership for controllable solid propulsion technologies such as divert attitude control systems. The engineer provides technical direction across programs and works closely with systems, mechanical, and propulsion teams to ensure electrical system architectures meet DoD and MDA performance, safety, and mission assurance standards.

Responsibilities:

• Serve as senior electrical engineering lead for hardware development on DoD and MDA programs involving controllable solid propulsion systems

• Provide technical leadership and mentorship to electrical engineering teams throughout design, integration, and test phases

• Define electrical system architecture and guide development of controller electronics, high-reliability interconnects, and sensor interfaces

• Lead electrical design execution, technical risk assessment, and resolution of complex engineering issues

• Ensure compliance with applicable electrical and electromagnetic standards including MIL-STD-461, MIL-STD 464, IPC J-STD-001, IPC-2221, and MIL-PRF-38534/38535

• Support architecture development and trade studies for divert attitude control system configurations and other propulsion systems

• Lead mission assurance activities including FMEAs, fault tree analyses, and worst-case circuit analyses

• Provide oversight for hardware qualification, EMI/EMC certification, and electrical test strategies with suppliers and test facilities

• Represent electrical engineering at internal and customer design reviews (e.g., SRR, PDR, CDR, TRR)

• Prepare and review technical documentation including ICDs, test reports, and qualification packages

• Support integration and test campaigns including system bring-up and troubleshooting

• Support proposal development and future program capture activities related to propulsion control and missile defense systems

Experience:

• 15+ years of electrical hardware design experience, preferably in aerospace, defense, missile, or interceptor systems

• Demonstrated experience leading electrical engineering teams through full hardware development lifecycle

• Experience with actuation systems, propulsion controls for missiles or interceptors, and related subsystems including actuators and initiation systems

• Experience supporting qualification of flight hardware to applicable military and aerospace standards

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related engineering discipline from an accredited college or university

• Strong technical leadership and mentoring skills within electrical engineering teams

• Advanced expertise in design and analysis of analog and digital circuits, including schematic creation and interpretation

• Background in actuation system control, motor drive circuits, or power conditioning for missile systems

• Skilled with Altium Designer, OrCAD, PSPICE, or similar schematic/layout and simulation tools

• Knowledge of signal integrity, grounding/shielding, and EMI/EMC best practices

• Proficiency with laboratory instrumentation and hardware verification methods

• Understanding of safety-critical design practices including redundancy, fault isolation, and mission assurance

• Ability to develop and present technical documentation to DoD and MDA customer standards

Preferred Qualifications:

• US Citizenship required due to program security requirements

• Ability to obtain and maintain a DoD Secret clearance; active clearance preferred

• Familiarity with the DoD acquisition lifecycle, particularly for Missile Defense Agency (MDA) and other Department of Defense (DoD) programs

• Demonstrated ability to lead electrical engineering teams within a structured product development environment

• Strong technical communication skills, including presenting complex engineering concepts to internal leadership and government stakeholders

Other:

• Familiarity with MDA MAP and PMAP requirements (preferred)

• Must be able to travel approximately 10% of the time

The good faith base salary range for this role is $162,696 - $261,690 at the time of this posting. Where you fall within the range depends on your experience, skills and location. This range reflects base salary only and does not include benefits or bonus/incentive. This range may be adjusted in the future.

Voyager offers a highly competitive total compensation package designed to support the well-being, growth, and success of our employees. Employees benefit from a flexible and comprehensive rewards program that supports both professional and personal well-being.

• Flexible Time Off (FTO), empowering employees to take the time they need to recharge and maintain a healthy work-life balance

• Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage for employees and their families, with a significant portion of premiums covered by the company and many benefits paid at 100% for employees

• Flexible, affordable gym memberships with 12,700+ options nationwide, including 24 Hour Fitness, EoS Fitness, Crunch Fitness, Anytime Fitness, Blink Fitness, Chuze Fitness, and more! No long-term contracts and FREE on-demand workout videos before you enroll

• 401(k) retirement plan with a 50% company match on contributions up to 8%, supporting long-term financial security

• Company wellness programs that support physical and mental well-being

• Additional voluntary benefits and employee support resources

• The opportunity to work alongside a highly talented team in an innovative, mission-driven environment

Voyager is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, national or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, protected veteran status, or other characteristics protected by law.

jobs.title: Land and Data Center Development
jobs.description:
About the Team

OpenAI’s Compute organization builds the infrastructure that powers frontier AI training and inference. This work brings together commercial, technical, strategy, and operations teams to secure and develop the sites and capacity needed for large-scale compute deployment.

We partner across real estate, power, engineering, legal, finance, and delivery to connect infrastructure needs with viable development opportunities and executable commercial agreements.

About the Role

We’re looking for a commercial real estate (CRE) development professional to help secure land and data-center capacity for OpenAI’s compute infrastructure. This is a combined role spanning land acquisition and development, data-center leasing, and real estate acquisitions. The ideal candidate is particularly strong in land and can also contribute across data-center transactions.

You’ll source and evaluate opportunities, structure and negotiate agreements, and coordinate commercial and technical diligence. Working with legal, finance, engineering, and development partners, you’ll connect transaction decisions with infrastructure requirements and carry opportunities through agreement execution and handoff.

Responsibilities

 - Lead sourcing, evaluation, and commercial execution of land acquisition opportunities for data-center development.

 - Support data-center leasing and real estate acquisitions, working across land and data-center transactions as priorities require.

 - Build relationships with landowners, brokers, developers, and data-center counterparties to source opportunities.

 - Structure and negotiate land acquisition, site-control, and data-center lease agreements with legal and business partners.

 - Coordinate diligence with legal, finance, engineering, and development partners, translating site constraints and readiness risks into commercial decisions.

 - Evaluate deal economics and present clear recommendations on costs, terms, tradeoffs, and next steps.

 - Manage the transaction pipeline, keep stakeholders aligned, and resolve issues that affect decisions and execution.

 - Drive transactions through agreement execution and coordinate clear handoffs to the teams responsible for development and delivery.

Qualifications

 - Strong commercial real estate development experience, with depth in land acquisition, site control, and development feasibility.

 - A record of sourcing, structuring, and negotiating complex real estate agreements.

 - Ability to work across land transactions and data-center leasing, with sound judgment about their different commercial and development requirements.

 - Sound commercial judgment and the ability to assess deal economics, identify risks, and make practical recommendations.

 - Experience working across legal, finance, engineering, and operations teams to move transactions forward.

 - Clear communication and strong ownership of complex negotiations, competing priorities, and uncertain timelines.

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Embedded Experiences
jobs.description:
WHY HARVEY

At Harvey, we’re transforming how legal and professional services operate. By combining frontier agentic AI, an enterprise-grade platform, and deep domain expertise, we’re reshaping how critical knowledge work gets done for decades to come.

This is a rare chance to help build a generational company at a true inflection point. We have strong product-market fit and world-class investor support. We’re scaling fast and defining a new category in real time. The work is ambitious, the bar is high, and the opportunity for growth — personal, professional, and financial — is unmatched.

Our team moves fast, takes ownership, and is deeply committed to the mission — operating with intensity, staying close to our customers, and pushing each other for excellence. We live by three values: Decisiveness, Simplicity, and Job's Not Finished. We act quickly on clear judgment over perfect information, we believe simplicity is what scales, and we're never satisfied with where we are. If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who share that drive, we'd love to build with you.

At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today — and we’re just getting started.




ROLE OVERVIEW

We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to own some of Harvey's most important embedded experiences, starting with the Word Add-In and expanding to the other tools where legal work gets done. You'll take a product customers already love and rely on to many more lawyers, make Harvey's agents useful for complex drafting and review work, and help bring Harvey to new surfaces.

This role is for someone who has built a product people use every day. You know adoption comes from meeting users where they are, inside the tools and habits they already have. You pair a clear vision for what AI makes possible with a deep drive to understand how your users actually work.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Own key embedded experiences in Harvey: Define the vision, strategy, and roadmap for Harvey for Word and the other drafting tools lawyers work in, taking problems from discovery through launch and iteration.

 - Build for the jobs lawyers do in documents: Ship purpose-built tools for drafting, reviewing, proofreading, and finalizing documents that lawyers trust enough to send.

 - Grow daily use: Improve onboarding, activation, entry points, and repeat usage. Turn occasional users into people who reach for Harvey every day.

 - Drive product quality: Partner with Design, Engineering, and our AI platform teams to make the experience fast, polished, and reliable, and define what good AI output looks like in a document.

 - Stay close to customers: Spend meaningful time with lawyers at law firms and in-house teams. Use what you learn, and the usage data, to make opinionated product decisions.

 - Work across Harvey: Partner with adjacent product teams, PMM, and GTM so Harvey for Word fits naturally with the rest of Harvey and lands well with customers.




WHAT YOU HAVE

Must have qualifications:

 - 5+ years of product management experience, including ownership of a user-facing product people use every day, in B2B or B2C.

 - A track record of building habits: you can explain how you got users to adopt a new workflow, what made it stick, and what you changed when users didn't behave as you expected.

The future belongs to those who build it. At Voyager Technologies, we’re building technologies that protect lives, expand frontiers and prepare us for what’s next. And we’re doing that with people who are wired to solve, build, adapt and lead. These roles are not for the faint of heart.

VTS’ innovative solutions address technology needs across the U.S. Government and commercial space industry. reentry systems, missile defense, commercial and DoD space launch systems, small launch vehicles, and payloads.

At VTS our mission is to supply the most advanced and innovative solutions to complex problems found in the Department of Defense weapon systems. We approach these problems using a “mission-focused”, “customer first” engineering approach. Working at VTS means you will be engaging with industry pioneers at a small company who all work collaboratively to make big things happen.

Position Description:

The Electrical Engineer V reports to the Systems Engineering Manager and is part of the Strategic Systems department, which is based in Folsom, CA. This role can also be located in Reno, NV. This individual will lead the design, integration, and qualification of complex electronic hardware systems in support of advanced DoD missile defense and aerospace applications. The role emphasizes high-reliability system design, with a focus on controllable solid propulsion technologies such as divert attitude control system. The engineer will work closely with systems, mechanical, and propulsion engineering teams to ensure alignment with DoD and MDA performance, safety, and mission assurance standards.

• Perform FMEAs, fault tree analyses, and worst-case circuit analyses to meet mission assurance goals

• Interface with suppliers and test labs for hardware qualification, EMI/EMC certification, and electrical test protocols

• Prepare technical documentation for customer delivery including ICDs, test reports, and qualification packages

• Present design approaches, risks, and readiness at internal and customer design reviews (e.g., PDR, CDR, TRR)

• Support integration and test campaigns including system bring-up and troubleshooting

Requirements:

• U.S. Citizenship required due to program security requirements

• Ability to obtain and maintain a DoD Secret clearance; active clearance preferred

• Familiarity with the DoD acquisition lifecycle, particularly for Missile Defense Agency (MDA) and other Department of Defense (DoD) programs

• Proven ability to lead electrical engineering teams in a structured product development environment

• Strong organizational and technical communication skills, including presenting to internal and government stakeholders

• 10+ years of electrical hardware design experience, preferably in aerospace, defense, or missile systems

• Proven experience leading electrical engineering teams through full development lifecycle

• Experience with actuation systems, propulsion controls for missiles or interceptors, and related subsystems including actuators and initiation systems

• Hands-on experience with qualification of flight hardware to applicable military and aerospace standards

Skills:

• Effective leadership and mentoring skills within an electrical engineering team

• Proficient in design and analysis of analog and digital circuits, including schematic creation and interpretation

• Background in actuation system control, motor drive circuits, or power conditioning for missile systems

• Skilled with Altium Designer, OrCAD, PSPICE, or similar schematic/layout and simulation tools

• Experience with signal integrity, grounding/shielding, and EMI/EMC best practices

• Proficient with lab instrumentation and test automation tools for hardware verification

• Understanding of safety-critical design practices, including redundancy, fault isolation, and mission assurance

jobs.title: Mechanical Lead
jobs.description:
About the Team

OpenAI's data center construction teams work with engineering, supply chain, safety, quality, commissioning and operations partners to deliver the infrastructure that supports our computing needs. Mechanical delivery brings together cooling equipment, plant, piping and controls interfaces so that systems are installed, tested and ready for commissioning.

About the Role

As a Mechanical Lead, you will lead mechanical field delivery for data center construction, including cooling infrastructure, mechanical yards, piping and data hall fit-out. You will oversee general contractors, specialist installers and service providers, combining practical mechanical expertise with hands-on field leadership. Your focus will be safe installation, contractor performance, coordinated interfaces and complete evidence for commissioning and operational handover.

Key Responsibilities

OpenAI's Industrial Compute organization delivers the infrastructure that powers frontier AI models. Within Infrastructure Delivery, we turn engineering concepts into safe, reliable, and operational AI campuses by working across design, construction, utilities, commissioning, operations, and external partners.

You will establish design criteria, review complex fire protection systems, coordinate with authorities and delivery partners, and ensure that fire and life-safety requirements remain clear from early design through construction, commissioning, and operational handover.

About the Role

Lead OpenAI’s site network infrastructure delivery, coordinating the physical installation and readiness of network systems with the central network team and contracted installation providers.

You will be OpenAI’s accountable on-site lead for physical network infrastructure construction and deployment, directing and overseeing the work of general contractors, specialist contractors and other service providers within your discipline. You will combine practical subject-matter depth with hands-on field leadership, managing contracted support to deliver safe, high-quality work to the integrated construction plan.

Reporting and scope

Report to the Site Construction Manager, who reports through the applicable project-management leadership. Maintain functional alignment with the Network Infrastructure leader and central network engineering team.

Own day-to-day discipline execution and contractor performance within the assigned site scope and delegated authority. Coordinate priorities and interfaces through the Site Construction Manager; escalate material cost, schedule, design and acceptance decisions to the appropriate owners.

This is a senior site delivery role, suited to an experienced superintendent, supervisor, manager or trade lead. Accountability is for an assigned discipline and site work packages. Site assignment, duration and any shared coverage follow project phase, workload and the staffing plan; effective on-site coverage is required during critical activities.

Key Responsibilities

 - Manage structured-cabling contractors, fiber installers, network installation partners and other service providers against the site delivery plan.

 - Translate approved network designs into executable field packages and coordinate bills of materials, material availability and installation sequencing with the central network team.

 - Oversee pathways, duct banks and building-entry interfaces, fiber and copper cabling, racks, patching, labeling and network-equipment installation as applicable.

 - Direct fiber and cabling quality assurance, review test results and traceability, and drive correction of defective or incomplete installations.

 - Coordinate power, cooling, space and physical access readiness with electrical, mechanical and CSLA leads and hardware deployment teams.
