jobs.title: Communication Administrator
jobs.description:
Verra Mobility is a global leader in smart mobility. Verra Mobility Commercial Services creates smart roadways, serving the world's largest commercial fleets and rental car companies to manage tolling transactions and violations. Arizona-based Verra Mobility Corp. currently operates in 15 countries and in 22 languages.

We believe there is significant opportunity to further expand into Europe. We have established our European headquarters in Amsterdam, from which we have launched our tolling and violation management solution business in Europe in 2019. We further have offices in London, Paris, Madrid, and Budapest, with a workforce of close to 100 people.

Our European tolling business has established relationships with tolling authorities throughout Spain, Portugal, France, Italy and Ireland, through which we offer interoperable electronic tolling directly to consumers, through white-label partnerships and to RAC customers, depending on location.

Additionally, our European violations business specializes in the identification, notification, and collection of unpaid traffic, parking and public transport related fees, charges, and penalties issued to foreign registered vehicles or persons on behalf of issuing authorities in more than 17 European countries. We provide our services in more than 20 languages and more than 10 currencies and to leverage existing connections with approximately 30 vehicle licensing authorities and over 600 toll and ticket-issuing authorities for whom we bill violators in more than 135 countries.

Position Overview

The Communication Administrator is a key member of the Euro Parking Collection (EPC) Customer Care Department, providing critical support across all customer and client communication channels.

This role ensures the efficient handling of complex, multi-language correspondence in a highly regulated environment, supporting more than 450 issuing authorities across 15 European countries and complying with over 350 distinct business rules.

This role plays a pivotal role in coordinating and managing all forms of internal and external communication across the organisation. This includes the effective handling of incoming and outgoing correspondence, translation services, and managing enquiries received via phone, email, post, and fax. The role is responsible for delivering timely, accurate, and compliant responses aligned with client group business rules, requirements, and applicable regulatory standards.

Fluency in multiple languages is essential, along with a high level of attention to detail and the ability to confidently navigate multiple systems and business areas that offers various products. A thorough understanding of and adherence to General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) requirements is fundamental to the role.

The Communication Administrator will also contribute to cross-functional initiatives, support the development and maintain of Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), and ensure the consistency and compliance of all client communications. This position demands a proactive approach, excellent organisational skills, and a collaborative mind-set to uphold communication standards across the organisation

Ideal for candidates with 1–3 years of relevant experience in customer service, technical help desk roles, or administrative functions, this position offers the opportunity to develop expertise in multi-system navigation, regulatory compliance, GDPR management, and client engagement in a dynamic, international environment.

Essential Responsibilities

· Efficiently manage all incoming and outgoing written correspondence, ensuring accuracy, compliance with business rules, and adherence to service level agreement (SLA) deadlines.

· Handle representations in multiple languages, tailored to the specific requirements of individual clients.

· EPC currently is working with 450 issuing organisations following their individual business rules in 22 languages across 15 European countries. Administrator is required to understand, follow and apply up to 350 distinct business rules per client group when handling representations.

· Maintain and manage individual email inboxes, ensuring timely action is taken on all communications.

· Promptly escalate high-priority or sensitive matters to appropriate internal or external stakeholders.

· Act as a representative of issuing authorities in formal processes, including challenges raised with independent adjudicators, by preparing and submitting accurate evidence packs in a timely manner.

· Manage inbound and outbound calls in designated language(s), providing clear, professional communication aligned with business rules.

· Draft and issue client-facing responses in native languages where applicable, maintaining cultural appropriateness and consistent tone.

· Record accurate and detailed case notes following calls and other key contravener interactions, ensuring case histories are up to date.

· Share relevant client updates with the Customer Care Manager, other key stakeholders and other team members; maintain accurate and up-to-date client records in internal systems (e.g., Vendor Cards).

· Translate, edit, and proofread documents as required, ensuring linguistic accuracy and timely delivery.

· Contribute to internal communication initiatives, including the development of FAQs, standard operating procedures (SOPs), public website content, response templates, and communication audits.

· Collaborate with senior team members and provide feedback on opportunities for improving communication processes and internal systems.

· Support the onboarding and development of new team members through the preparation of training materials, delivery of training sessions, and provision of coaching and feedback.

· Contribute to various language- and system-based projects, including Enterprise (EHI), Pagatelia, Debt Collection, Hungary Domestic, and pilot schemes such as Violations – Europcar Denmark.

· Ensure all communication-related tasks—routine and project-based—are completed within established deadlines and in line with organizational quality standards.

Qualifications

Education & Experience

· Minimum High School Diploma (GCSEs or A-levels) or equivalent required.

· 1–3 years of relevant work experience.

· Familiarity with CRM systems useful.

Languages

· Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English with the ability to convey complex information clearly and professionally.

· Proficiency in additional European languages—such as French, German, Dutch, Spanish, Italian or Nordic languages—are highly desirable.

Skills & Competencies

· Proven ability to interpret and apply complex legislation and varied client-specific business rules across multiple issuing authorities while handling representations.

· Strong organizational and time management skills, with the ability to prioritize effectively and meet multiple competing deadlines.

· Confident in working across a variety of internal & external systems, often switching between platforms daily to meet differing businesses entity requirements (e.g. Navision, Admin Panel, CSR, Azure, client-facing portals, and document management systems).

· Proficient in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Word, Outlook, Excel, and Adobe Acrobat, with the ability to use these tools in a professional and efficient manner.

· Exceptional attention to detail and a high degree of accuracy, especially in handling legal documentation or data-sensitive communications.

· Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, with a collaborative team-oriented approach.

· Self-driven and capable of working independently while managing individual responsibilities to a high standard.

· Open to continuous improvement, with a proactive attitude toward contributing to process enhancements and participating in cross-functional feedback.

Behavioral Criteria

· Professional Communication & Stakeholder Service: Demonstrates clear, professional and timely communication with internal stakeholders and external vendors to ensure accurate and service-focused delivery.

· Learning Agility & Technical Development: Demonstrates the ability and willingness to acquire and apply new systems knowledge, digital tools and automation technologies (including AI-supported processes) relevant to the role.

· Accuracy & Accountability: Maintains high levels of attention to detail in high-volume communication workflows and takes responsibility for quality and error resolution.

· Adaptability & Operational Flexibility: Responds effectively to changing priorities, workload fluctuations and evolving regulatory or client requirements to maintain service continuity.

· Team Collaboration & Contribution: Works constructively within the team environment, supporting shared objectives and contributing to efficient operational delivery.

· Continuous Improvement Orientation: Identifies and supports process enhancements to improve efficiency, accuracy and automation within communication and vendor workflows.

Verra Mobility Values

An ideal candidate for this role naturally works in alignment with the Verra Mobility Core Values:

• Own It. We focus on high performance and drive toward breakthrough outcomes. Our employees ensure accountability, optimize and align work, focus on the customer, and cultivate innovation.

• Do What’s Right. We champion integrity and good character. Our team members model ethical behavior, demonstrate good judgment and are courageous.

• Choose Courage Over Comfort. We lean into the conversations, decisions and actions that move the business forward, even when they feel uncomfortable. We challenge assumptions, address issues early and prioritize progress over ease.

• Win Together. We believe in growing and inspiring people together. We seek people who collaborate, value differences, think and act globally, foster an engaging work environment, and recognize and develop others.

In no event will we retain such data more than two (2) years following the closure of the recruitment process relating to the role for which you applied or in the event other related job opportunities arise within the company. jobs.title: Senior Manager, Content Marketing
jobs.description:
ABOUT COGENT SECURITY

Cogent is an Applied AI Lab building the next generation of AI agents for cybersecurity. AI has fundamentally changed how attacks happen, allowing malicious actors to operate at unprecedented speed and scale. Cogent's "AI Taskforce" assesses petabytes of enterprise data to remediate these issues before critical breaches occur.

To stay at the cutting edge, we blend frontier research with real-world execution. Alongside our core product work, Cogent Research serves as our applied AI lab, providing the research horsepower needed to make truly agentic security workflows a reality.

Since coming out of stealth, Cogent has experienced rapid growth. We partner with Fortune 500 companies to secure some of the most complex production environments in the world.

We're backed by Greylock and we've built a team with the best minds in applied AI. Our team is comprised of people from:

 - Top universities like Stanford, Berkeley, Penn, Duke, Carnegie Mellon, Waterloo

 - Unicorn, high-growth companies like Scale AI, Databricks, Stripe, Tesla, Coinbase

 - World class cybersecurity experts from Wiz, Abnormal AI, Zscaler

 - Preeminent ML research labs like Deepmind and SAIL




ABOUT THE ROLE

Cogent is building a world-class marketing team, and we're looking for smart, fast, exceptional people who are committed to our mission and bring a spark of creativity that sets us apart from traditional B2B marketing. As Senior Manager of Content Marketing, you'll write the content that introduces security teams to Cogent and carries them through a buying decision: blog posts, whitepapers, ebooks, research reports, social series, and scripts for short video. This is a writing-heavy role. Most of your week goes to interviewing experts, drafting, and shipping. The rest goes to making sure the work gets found in search, AI answers, and social. You'll take raw material (product insight, original research, customer outcomes, breaking security news) and turn it into content that security practitioners read and share.




WHAT YOU'LL DO



Content Production

 - Write the blog posts, whitepapers, and ebooks that build awareness with security practitioners and engage buyers at each stage of the buying process.

 - Interview Cogent's researchers, engineers, and field team for raw material, and get every technical detail right.

 - React fast when security news breaks: write and ship the POV piece while the story still matters.



Social & Video

 - Execute Cogent's social strategy: regular series (weekly VM insights, AI security myths, remediation playbooks) that keep a steady drumbeat of Cogent's point of view in front of practitioners.

 - Write scripts for short videos and explainers, and work with contractors who shoot and edit them.



Search & AEO

 - Run the SEO and AEO program: research what buyers search for and ask ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, and Claude, then structure each piece so it ranks and gets cited.

 - Track how your content performs in search and AI answers, and refresh the pieces that slip.



Research & Story Packaging

 - Work with the research team on Cogent's flagship research report: dig into the data, shape the findings into a story, and write the report.

 - Project manage the report through launch, then turn it into derivative content: blog series, social posts, short video, and sales assets.

 - Repurpose the strongest research, product insight, and customer stories in Cogent's library into formats that reach new audiences.



AI-Native Production

 - Use AI across your workflow (research synthesis, drafting, editing, repurposing) to ship at the pace of a small team without losing accuracy or voice.

 - Build systems that make the work faster, like prompt libraries, voice guides, and a living archive of positioning, proof, and research.




WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR



Must-Have

 - 5-7 years in B2B content roles, with at least three of them writing for security practitioners and buyers.

 - Excellent writing and editorial judgment. You can explain complex security topics simply and credibly.

 - A track record of content that earned attention: organic traffic and rankings, citations in AI answers, social engagement, and downloads of long-form assets.

 - Hands-on SEO and AEO experience, with tools like Semrush, GA4, Profound, and AirOps.

 - You've shipped at a fast-moving company without a big team behind you.

 - Fluent with AI in the actual work. You can walk through a content workflow you built, where it broke, and what you changed.



Nice-to-Have

 - Experience writing about vulnerability management, exposure management (CTEM), AppSec, cloud security, or AI in security operations.

 - Experience writing or project managing a research report (threat report, benchmark, or survey) and turning it into a campaign's worth of derivative content.

 - Production ability beyond writing: short video, explainers, visual assets, or the judgment to direct contractors who make them.

 - Experience growing a practitioner audience on LinkedIn.




WHY COGENT

Cogent is redefining how AI can proactively defend organizations against evolving threats. Our mission is to empower security teams with cutting-edge AI agents and clear, actionable insights. You'll join a world-class GTM team where your work directly impacts the safety of some of the world's most sophisticated organizations.

Check out our latest coverage by Business Insider https://www.businessinsider.com/opusclip-softbank-vision-fund-2-funding-valuation-2025-3 featuring our product and funding milestones, and our recognition as one of The Information's 50 Most Promising Startups in 2024.  https://www.linkedin.com/posts/yzopus_opusclip-has-been-recognized-by-the-information-activity-7255358200395243520-zhOz/?utm_medium=member_desktop&utm_source=share

Headquartered in Mountain View, we are a team of 100 passionate and experienced AI enthusiasts and video experts, driven by our core values: 

 - Be a Champion Team 

 - Prioritize Ruthlessly 

 - Ship fast, Quality Follows 

 - Obsess over customers 

Be a part of this exciting journey with us!


ABOUT THE ROLE

OpusClip is the world's #1 AI video agent for social media, used by 20M+ creators and businesses to turn raw footage into viral-ready clips. We're hiring an AI Product Manager, based in Mountain View, to own the core product roadmap that shapes how millions of creators experience OpusClip every day. Your job is to keep raising the bar on what our product can do and how good it feels, at the pace of a team that ships constantly.

This role sits at the AI end of that roadmap. You'll own the features where model capability is the product, which means going deeper than most PMs do on what the models can actually deliver and on how we measure whether the output is any good.

You'll work out of our headquarters, in the same market as most of our creators and business customers. The people you build for are a coffee away rather than a time zone away, and we expect you to use that.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Own a Direction, Not a Backlog: Set the strategy for your surface, commit to the metrics it should move, and be the one accountable when they don't move.

 - Own the AI Quality Loop: Define what "good output" means for a generative feature, build the evaluation that measures it, and use that eval to decide what ships and what doesn't. On an AI product, taste alone isn't enough and a benchmark alone isn't either.

 - Be the Taste and Quality Bar: Act as the filter for what "good" looks like on a product used by millions. Every feature should feel considered, polished, and worth the user's trust.

 - Ship at Scale and Breadth: Run multiple feature workstreams in parallel without losing depth or craft. Know when to go deep on one feature and when to parallelize across several.

 - Codify a Repeatable Playbook: Turn your instincts into a method for how to scope, validate, and ship AI-powered features fast, and use it to raise the bar for the broader PM team, not just your own roadmap.

 - Partner Deeply with Engineering and Design: Work shoulder-to-shoulder with a high-caliber team to translate frontier AI capabilities (multimodal models, agents) into features creators reach for daily.

 - Go Deep with Users: Use direct research, data, and hands-on product use to find the gap between what the product does today and what creators actually need next.
   
   


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - 5+ years of product management experience, with a track record of owning and shipping complex, high-usage features on a consumer or prosumer product

 - Deep, hands-on fluency with AI. You judge a model's real capability from your own testing rather than from its benchmark scores, and you can tell a model problem from a prompt problem from a product problem.

 - Comfort with evaluation. You've had to decide whether a generative output is good enough to ship when there was no obvious metric, and you built something repeatable to answer it rather than relying on vibes.

 - Goal-oriented and ruthless about priority. You work backward from the outcome you own, not the backlog. You can say why the top three things on your roadmap are the top three, and why everything else waits.

 - Ownership by default. You chase the loose ends nobody assigned to you, and you close the loop yourself: ship it, read the data, decide to iterate or kill it.

 - Defensible taste. You can name what is wrong with the products you admire most, not only what is good about them.

 - Experience building consumer-facing (B2C) products and a habit of direct user research

 - Based in the Bay Area and able to work on-site in Mountain View; comfortable partnering daily with our Shanghai and Vancouver teams across time zones
   
   


BONUS IF YOU HAVE

 - Built evals for a generative feature, or worked with fine-tuned or post-trained models in production

 - Background taking a product from early PMF to a mature, high-scale stage

 - Experience with short-form video, content creation, or creator tools

 - Direct experience shipping AI/LLM-powered features

 - Ability to prototype using code or no-code tools
   
   


THIS ROLE PROBABLY ISN'T RIGHT FOR YOU IF…

 - You're energized by 0-to-1 ambiguity but lose interest once a product has real scale and real constraints

 - Your experience with AI is mostly reading about it. This role needs someone who has put their hands on the models.

 - You'd rather define strategy from a slide than get hands-on with the craft of a specific feature

 - You need a large team or established process to feel effective. This role expects you to build the playbook, not just follow one.

 - You haven't used a video editing or content creation tool yourself in the past year

 - You're uncomfortable operating with ambiguity and rapid iteration

 - You want remote or hybrid

EEO

OpusClip is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. OpusClip considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Opus Clip is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures.

jobs.title: Director of Content Marketing
jobs.description:
ABOUT COGENT SECURITY

Cogent is an Applied AI Lab building the next generation of AI agents for cybersecurity. AI has fundamentally changed how attacks happen, allowing malicious actors to operate at unprecedented speed and scale. Cogent's "AI Taskforce" assesses petabytes of enterprise data to remediate these issues before critical breaches occur.

To stay at the cutting edge, we blend frontier research with real-world execution. Alongside our core product work, Cogent Research serves as our applied AI lab, providing the research horsepower needed to make truly agentic security workflows a reality.

Since coming out of stealth, Cogent has experienced rapid growth. We partner with Fortune 500 companies to secure some of the most complex production environments in the world.

We're backed by Greylock and we've built a team with the best minds in applied AI. Our team is comprised of people from:

 - Top universities like Stanford, Berkeley, Penn, Duke, Carnegie Mellon, Waterloo

 - Unicorn, high-growth companies like Scale AI, Databricks, Stripe, Tesla, Coinbase

 - World class cybersecurity experts from Wiz, Abnormal AI, Zscaler

 - Preeminent ML research labs like Deepmind and SAIL




ABOUT THE ROLE

Cogent is building a world-class marketing team, and we're looking for smart, fast, exceptional people who are committed to our mission and bring a spark of creativity that sets us apart from traditional B2B marketing. As the founding content leader, you'll own how Cogent sounds: the editorial point of view, the executive and founder voice, and the research and stories we put into the world. You'll take raw material (product insight, original research, customer outcomes) and turn it into content that travels and moves pipeline. This is a builder's seat. Production runs on AI, contractors, and a small team, so you set the editorial standard, orchestrate the output, and still write the pieces that matter yourself. A separate Director of Communications owns press and analyst relations; you build the material worth covering, they land it.




WHAT YOU'LL DO



Narrative & Content Strategy

 - Own Cogent's content engine end to end:the calendar, and content series that compound over time (weekly VM insights, AI security myths, remediation playbooks) across LinkedIn-first social, blog, video, and long-form.

 - Own SEO and AEO so the work gets found by the buyers and by the models that now shape how people discover it.

 - Tie content to pipeline. Track which pieces move deals and do more of what works.



Content Production

 - Write the top- and middle-of-funnel pieces that pull practitioners in and move buyers toward a decision: blog posts, ebooks, and whitepapers.

 - Own the social strategy: regular series and point-in-time posts that keep a steady drumbeat of Cogent's point of view in front of practitioners.



Executive & Founder Voice

 - Ghostwrite for the CEO, CTO, and technical leaders with a real point of view and a consistent voice.

 - Build repeatable systems to capture raw material: leader interviews, Slack mining, call notes, research briefs.

 - Turn that raw material into thought leadership that security practitioners actually read and share.



Research & Story Packaging

 - Turn Cogent Research, threat findings, and product insight into original analysis that travels and generates pipeline.

 - Own the flagship research report and the programs around it, with the research team and the CTO.

 - React fast when security news breaks: ship the POV piece while the story still matters.



AI-Native Production

 - Use AI across the workflow and orchestrate contractors and tools so a small team ships like a big one, without losing accuracy or voice.

 - Build systems that make the whole engine faster, like a living archive of positioning, proof, and research the whole company can draw from.




WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

Must-Have

 - 8-10+ years in content roles in B2B tech, with cybersecurity strongly preferred.

 - A track record of content that moved real numbers: content-sourced pipeline, organic traffic and rankings, and engagement that turned into meetings.

 - You've done it at a small company where you were the engine: shipping weekly without a big team, a big budget, or someone else's strategy to execute.

 - Excellent writing and editorial judgment. You can build a point of view and explain complex security topics simply and credibly.

 - Proven ghostwriting for executives, with a real system for capturing their voice.

 - Fluent with AI in the actual work. You can walk through a content workflow you built, where it broke, and what you changed.



Nice-to-Have

 - Experience packaging research: threat reports, benchmarks, original analysis that earned attention.

 - Experience running SEO through agencies or contractors, and a working point of view on AEO.

 - Production ability beyond writing: short video, explainers, visual assets, or the judgment to direct contractors who make them.

 - Familiarity with vulnerability management, exposure management, or AppSec/CloudSec adjacencies.




WHY COGENT

Cogent is redefining how AI can proactively defend organizations against evolving threats. Our mission is to empower security teams with cutting-edge AI agents and clear, actionable insights. You'll join a world-class GTM team where your work directly impacts the safety of some of the world's most sophisticated organizations.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Cogent is building a world-class marketing team, and we're looking for smart, fast, exceptional people who are committed to our mission and bring a spark of creativity that sets us apart from traditional B2B marketing. As the founding communications leader, you'll own how Cogent shows up beyond our own channels: in the press, on podcasts and stages, with the creators and newsletters practitioners follow, and in the moments that define a company's reputation. Cogent has unusual raw material for a company this size: original research, Fortune 500 customers, and an engineering team drawn from the frontier AI labs. Your job is to turn that substance into steady coverage, a founder the market recognizes, and a reputation that helps us sell and hire. The AI security news cycle moves in hours, so this is a hands-on seat: you'll set the angles, run the agency, prep executives, and move fast when a story breaks.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

Media & Narrative

 - Own Cogent's earned media strategy: the angles, the story calendar, and the coverage plan for launches, research, and company milestones.

 - Run the PR agency: set its priorities, sharpen the pitches, and hold the bar on everything that goes out under Cogent's name.

 - Translate Cogent's work for two audiences at once: security practitioners who will test every claim, and business and AI press who need the stakes in one sentence.

 - Run rapid response. Watch the conversation across press, X, LinkedIn, and security communities, and when a breach, disclosure, or AI-security story breaks, get Cogent's take into the story while it's live. Content ships the POV piece; you get it cited.



Beyond the Press

 - Build Cogent's presence where security buyers and AI builders now pay attention: newsletters, podcasts, creators, and the handful of voices each community trusts.

 - Run creator and influencer partnerships that put Cogent's research and point of view in front of audiences we don't own. Content runs our channels; you get us into everyone else's.

 - Shape how the AI research community sees Cogent, so the engineers and researchers we want to hire already know the story. Partner with recruiting on the talent narrative.



Executive Visibility

 - Build the CEO's external presence: podcasts, conference stages, and press interviews that tie a founder to a category.

 - Build a spokesperson bench beyond the CEO, starting with the CTO and Cogent Research, and media-train each of them.

 - Book and prep every moment: secure the slot, write the briefing doc, and sharpen the message for the room.



Moments & Milestones

 - Own announcement strategy: funding, marquee customers, partnerships, research drops, and the awards worth winning. Sequence them so each builds on the last.

 - Partner with Product Marketing on launches: they own the product story and positioning, you own the coverage plan.

 - Write the playbook for hard moments before they arrive: a vulnerability in our own product, a customer breach, a competitor's attack. Security companies get tested on this, usually on short notice.



AI-Native Execution

 - Build the comms workflow on AI: media monitoring, briefing docs, first drafts, and coverage analysis, so a small function covers what used to take a team.

 - Keep a living source of truth for approved claims, proof points, spokesperson briefs, and coverage history, so every announcement starts from what's already verified.

 - Measure what the work moves: share of voice against the companies we compete with, coverage in the outlets buyers read, and executive audience growth.




WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR



Must-Have

 - 8-10+ years in communications or PR for B2B tech, with cybersecurity strongly preferred. In-house, or a mix of in-house and agency.

 - Led communications for funding rounds, acquisitions, and major partnerships for a growth-stage startup.

 - A record of coverage you drove: launches, funding, and research turned into stories in the security trades and the business press.

 - You've built a comms program at a small company: wrote the materials yourself, ran the agency, and got real results without a big team or budget.

 - Sharp news judgment. You know what's a story, what isn't, and how to make one out of real substance without overreaching.

 - Trusted counsel to executives. You've prepped CEOs for hard interviews and talked them out of the wrong ones.

 - Strong writing across the communications surface: pitches, briefing docs, talking points, announcements.

 - Fluent with AI in the actual work. You can walk through how you use it for monitoring, research, and drafting, where it broke, and what you changed.



Nice-to-Have

 - Crisis or incident communications experience, ideally in security.

 - Experience turning original research into earned coverage.

 - Built creator, podcast, or influencer programs, or grew an executive's audience on X or LinkedIn.

 - Familiarity with vulnerability management, exposure management, or AppSec/CloudSec adjacencies.




WHY COGENT

Cogent is redefining how AI can proactively defend organizations against evolving threats. Our mission is to empower security teams with cutting-edge AI agents and clear, actionable insights. You'll join a world-class GTM team where your work directly impacts the safety of some of the world's most sophisticated organizations.

Our designers bring expertise across design systems, visual design, interaction design, content design, and product design. At ServiceNow, design has an intentional seat at the table, and we partner with engineering and product management from the outset.

ServiceNow’s customers and partners are at the forefront of delivering great experiences for their users, and we’re looking for a UX expert to help facilitate and enable their success. Internally, we have resources, guidance and best practices that help our designers, product managers and engineers deliver great experiences, but enabling external folks takes more than just making resources available.  It requires a proactive, strategic, and relationship-based approach.

jobs.title: Senior Recruiter
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE TEAM

Anduril's Maritime Division is responsible for planning and executing Anduril's product and revenue roadmap for maritime missions. Working across product, engineering, business development, logistics, and operations, the Maritime team develops, tests, deploys, and sustains the Anduril maritime capabilities in a challenging operational environment worldwide.

As a key member of Anduril's recruiting team, you will be responsible for the company's talent management as we continue to rapidly grow. Your work will be hands-on and involve collaborating with leaders and individual contributors to define the hiring needs of the company. To achieve this, you will be given the autonomy and tools to execute on our strategy to build and develop Anduril's world class team. We are looking for someone who can handle high levels of ownership while tackling every aspect of recruiting and is excited to be part of team where no task is too big or too small.

We are searching for a Senior Recruiter who will be working directly with hiring across our Maritime Division. The ideal candidate is someone with startup, tech, and relevant domain experience.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

• Move fast, with a process for consistently sourcing, tracking and maintaining a high volume of candidates while maintaining open lines of communication with stakeholders

• Establish deep trust and partnership with business leaders to help influence talent strategy while executing on hiring deliverables

• Build trust through consistency and a strong operating rhythm in partnership with cross-functional stakeholders to help scale and manage company growth

• Embed yourself into the business and into your teams to understand the product positioning and market fit, technical roadmap, and culture of the team

• Develop a strong understanding of the mission while learning how to effectively pitch the team and opportunity, ultimately closing exceptional technical talent for the organization

• Track and analyze pipeline and performance data to gain insights into areas of opportunity and translate that into a data-driven narrative that enables increased momentum

• Build recruiting strategies that contribute to the long-range growth of the company, implementing best practices around referrals and process improvements where needed

• Act as a subject matter expert in prospecting techniques and tools used for information retrieval, data extraction, web-scraping, continuous process improvement, process automation, and candidate management

• Conduct interviews of potential candidates, demonstrating ability to anticipate hiring manager preferences through high interview-to-offer ratios

• Engage passive candidates using LinkedIn Recruiter, Gem, Boolean strings, and referral campaigns

• Provide a consistent and positive candidate experience throughout the entire recruiting process with proactive communication and engagement

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Experience hiring candidates within all facets of engineering - either software, hardware or both.

• 6+ years experience recruiting and sourcing for technical roles and closing top tier engineering talent (startup/software experience preferred)

• 4+ years of client interaction experience, including working with Hiring Managers and Directors, taking new requirements, reviewing profiles and updating pipeline progress

• Experience acting in a consultative manner where your guidance has led to improved outcomes, and a positive candidate experience, while earning the respect of your peers and clients

• Strong understanding of the technical skills and experience required for Engineering positions within the business

• Clear and effective communication with candidates to understand motivation, drivers, and fit within the organization

• Experience managing various funnels of candidates and keeping track of their progress throughout the recruitment process

• Working knowledge of applicant tracking and HRIS systems

• Working knowledge of interview techniques and applicant screening methods

• Familiar with a wide variety of sourcing avenues

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Experience in Startup, Tech, and relevant domain experience

• Are self-sufficient and are able to work with little direct supervision

• Resilient and creative - ideal candidates will be flexible enough to face routine obstacles, trouble shoot, and create a solution on the fly

• Attention and Communication - ideal candidates will be direct and succinct. They will share information in a timely and efficient manner, improving collaboration and productivity, while practicing active listening and engagement with intent

• Ownership - be accountable for your universe and in tune with the business. Everyone on this team takes full responsibility for helping Anduril achieve its mission. That means seeking to improve all aspects of our company even in ways that are not explicitly part of our job while leveling up anything you can directly impact in realtime

• Low ego, high curiosity - value learning over being right. Embraces delivering and receiving candid feedback, and see every setback as an opportunity to iterate and improve

US Salary Range

$146,000—$194,000 USD

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

Benefits

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

• No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

• Please always verify communications: Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address. Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com.

• Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.

• What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

Data Privacy

To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant-privacy-notice/.

By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third-party service provider to conduct pre-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. This third-party service provider provides risk-intelligence services that may include analysis of sanctions and watchlists, adverse media, public-record information, and other lawful open-source or commercial data sources. This third-party service provider does not act as a consumer reporting agency. Use of this provider helps to ensure compliance with applicable laws and protect technology, intellectual property, and organizational security.

jobs.title: Retail Keyholder, Maje, Scottsdale Fashion Square, Arizona
jobs.description:
SMCP - Sandro, Maje, Claudie Pierlot

FT Keyholder at SMCP (Maje)

Location: Scottsdale Fashion Square, Scottsdale, Arizona

About SMCP:

At SMCP, we embody the essence of Parisian elegance with our renowned brands, Sandro and Maje. With a commitment to accessible luxury, we bring high-fashion designs and sustainability together, crafting exceptional products and memorable experiences. Operating in over 47 countries, we are financially stable and in an exciting phase of growth, led by a strong and experienced senior leadership team. Our culture thrives on engagement, inclusivity, and corporate social responsibility, ensuring that our success is built on both innovation and care for our planet. By 2030, we aim to meet ambitious sustainability goals, all while offering Parisian chic with a modern twist. Our collections reflect the dynamic interplay of casual elegance and evening sophistication, created for individuals who value both style and sustainability.

Why SMCP:

SMCP is more than just a fashion house—it's a forward-thinking company where innovation and sustainability come together. As we continue to lead the accessible luxury market, we focus on growth, stability, and prioritizing internal mobility for our people. With a dedicated senior leadership team guiding us, we offer a culture that fosters creativity, engagement, and meaningful career opportunities. Our collections from Sandro and Maje blend timeless Parisian style with a contemporary edge, allowing individuals to express their unique personality through fashion. Joining SMCP means becoming part of an evolving story, where passion, creativity, and sustainability are at the forefront. Together, we will continue shaping the future of fashion with a strong foundation of growth, stability, and engagement.

To learn more about our global presence and values, visit our website at SMCP Global.

At SMCP, We Style Happiness at Work—Join Our Fashion-Forward Team!

As a Keyholder, you’ll support the store leadership team to ensure the smooth operation of the store and deliver an exceptional customer experience every day. You’ll use your passion for fashion and your customer service skills to create memorable moments for our clients. Your leadership will shine through as you assist with opening and closing procedures, lead by example, and take on key responsibilities such as cash reconciliation, distribution of sales goals, team motivation, and problem resolution.

You’ll also play a pivotal role in building lasting relationships with our customers, providing styling advice, and delivering personalized service in an inclusive and welcoming environment. Whether you’re guiding clients to the perfect outfit or ensuring store operations run seamlessly, you’ll help create a shopping experience that’s as chic as Paris itself.

What You’ll Do:

Leadership & Supervision

• Lead and supervise the team in the absence of the Store Manager/Assistant Manager.

• Assist with daily operations, including cash handling, opening/closing, and KPI tracking.

Customer Service & Sales

• Provide exceptional customer service with product knowledge and personal recommendations.

• Build and maintain a client book, fostering relationships and loyalty.

• Achieve sales targets through outstanding service and brand values.

• Address customer service issues promptly and professionally.

Store Operations & Visual Merchandising

• Maintain high store standards, ensuring a welcoming and organized environment.

• Oversee stock replenishment to align with demand and visual standards.

Team Collaboration & Development

• Support new hires and encourage team development, promoting a growth-focused culture.

• Motivate the team to meet sales goals, fostering a results-oriented environment.

Brand Experience & Client Engagement

• Create an inclusive, personalized shopping experience, welcoming clients to our collections.

• Guide clients through their shopping journey, meeting their unique needs.

Who You Are:

• 1+ year of experience in retail or customer service, with supervisory experience preferred.

• Enthusiastic about providing exceptional customer service and working in luxury retail.

• Knowledgeable and passionate about fashion trends.

• Excellent communication skills, with a friendly, approachable, and persuasive demeanor.

• Adaptable and open to pursuing a career in retail management.

• Social media presence is a plus but not required.

• Flexible availability, including evenings, weekends, and holidays, is required.

Join a Career That Fits Your Lifestyle:

At SMCP, we provide more than just a job—we provide a path to grow, thrive, and be part of something exceptional.

Your talent and dedication are rewarded with competitive base hourly pay, individual commission, and sales incentives. With our 50% shopping discount and seasonal wardrobe offering, you’ll always feel confident in the latest collections—because style starts with you. We also provide a cell phone contribution.

We know that balance and well-being matter. That’s why we provide a voluntary health plan, 401(k), and paid time off, including holiday pay—plus paid parental leave and pet benefits. You’ll also have access to resources like our Employee Assistance Program (EAP), which includes personalized guidance, expert care, and mental health support through every stage of life, along with MAVEN Family Planning, providing additional support for family planning and wellness.

Through extensive product knowledge training, industry insights, and the opportunity to participate in our Retail Stylist Program, you’ll refine your expertise, elevate your skills, and make a lasting impact on the client experience. With mentorship and professional development support, plus a dynamic, engaging workplace where your contributions truly matter, you’ll discover a career that’s as fulfilling as it is inspiring.

At SMCP, you’re not just an employee, you’re a valued part of a team that celebrates passion, creativity, and excellence. With a dynamic, engaging workplace and a people-first culture, you’ll find a career that’s as rewarding as it is inspiring.

Ready to take your love for fashion to the next level? Apply today and become part of the SMCP Dream Team!

jobs.title: Senior Talent Acquisition Manager – Strategic Initiatives & Talent Insights
jobs.description:
The role

We hire roughly 3000-5000 people a year across four continents — manufacturing technicians, early-career engineers, corporate professionals, and executives. Behind every one of those hires is a decision: where to invest, which pipelines to build, which programs to scale. We're looking for the leader who turns our hiring data into those decisions and turns those decisions into programs that ship.

This is not a recruiting role. You won't carry requisitions. You'll own the strategy, insight, and program engine that makes our recruiters, hiring leaders, and executives better at what they do.

About the team

Global Talent Acquisition and Mobility Insights & Programs serves as the strategic arm of our global Talent Acquisition organization. Rather than recruiting directly, we design and implement programs, processes, and hiring practices that help recruiting teams and hiring leaders attract, engage, and hire exceptional talent.

The function has two teams. Strategic Offerings — the team you'll lead — owns insight, workforce intelligence, strategic programs and talent brands. Talent Success partners with our recruiting teams and hiring managers, customer-success style, to make sure what we build is adopted and delivers.

Our FY27 agenda is organized around five capabilities: Workforce & Talent Intelligence; Critical & Future Skills Pipeline; Scalable Delivery & RPO; Recruiting Motions & Talent Pathways; and Client & Hiring Manager Enablement. You'll own the first outright and shape the rest.

What you'll do

Turn hiring data into executive insight

• Own the quarterly business overviews (QBOs) and business reviews (QBRs) that Talent Acquisition presents to the CEO and executive team — and that may reach the board. Decide what matters, cut what doesn't, and make the story land at that altitude.

• Build our workforce and talent intelligence capability: hiring demand, pipeline health, time-to-fill, cost, quality and labor-market signals across Direct Labor, Early Career, Indirect Labor and Executive hiring.

• Partner with Finance and HR on annual operating plan (AOP) headcount planning, so hiring capacity matches business demand before reqs open.

Lead the strategic initiatives portfolio

• Run a multi-program portfolio end to end — intake, prioritization, business cases, roadmaps, governance and benefits tracking.

• Drive cross-regional programs across the US, APAC and EMEA, from RPO scale-up to new talent pathways for critical and future skills.

• Bring a point of view on where AI and automation should take on high-volume, repeatable work, and where human judgment must stay.

Build and lead the team

• Lead three direct reports: a Talent Insights & Workforce Planning Lead, a Program Manager and a Talent Brand Manager.

• Set clear priorities and standards, coach for growth, and build a team known for rigor and follow-through.

• Keep talent brand connected to the data — what candidates see should reflect where we need to hire.

Required

• Bachelor’s degree in Business, HR, Analytics, Industrial/Organizational Psychology, Economics or a related field, or equivalent experience.
• 10+ years of progressive experience across TA, HR, people analytics, workforce planning, strategy or operations, including 4+ years leading people.
• Proven ownership of workforce or headcount planning in a global, matrixed organization of 10,000+ employees.
• Hands-on analytics fluency: metric frameworks, forecasting models and executive dashboards (Power BI, Tableau or Workday reporting).
• Track record leading multi-region, cross-functional programs from charter to adoption.
• Executive presence: able to brief VP and C-level leaders with a clear recommendation, not just data.

Preferred

• Experience developing new offerings, practices, or process design in manufacturing, semiconductor or high-tech environments with large direct labor populations.
• Experience with talent insights site selection, labor market mapping or location strategy.
• Working knowledge of Workday (HCM, Recruiting or Adaptive Planning) and modern ATS platforms.
• Employer brand or EVP experience, or close partnership with marketing.
• Design thinking, Agile, PMP, PgMP, Prosci or similar certification.
• Experience with RPO models, vendor economics or shared services design
• Experience with AI and automation

jobs.description:
Are you ready to unlock intelligence?

If you don’t think you meet all of the criteria below but are still interested in the job, please apply.  Nobody checks every box - we’re looking for candidates that are particularly strong in a few areas, and have some interest and capabilities in others.



Why Kong?
Every enterprise building microservices, cloud-native architectures, and generative AI workloads runs on APIs. Kong is the cloud-native API and AI connectivity company, trusted by Fortune 500s and millions of developers worldwide.

If you sell infrastructure, dev tools, or data platforms, you know what developer mindshare is worth. At Kong, you aren’t evangelizing unproven tech from scratch. You’re monetizing an existing open-source groundswell and partnering with enterprise architecture, security, and engineering leaders to power mission-critical API traffic.

What makes this role high-leverage

 - A proven land-and-expand engine: Convert open-source and developer adoption into strategic, multi-year enterprise platform commitments (Kong Konnect, AI Gateway, Service Mesh).

 - High-impact deals: Run complex, multi-threaded enterprise cycles (100k–1M+ ACV) across CTO, VP of Platform/Architecture, and CISO personas.

 - Modern AI and cloud relevance: Put Kong at the center of the enterprise stack, securing, managing, and routing LLM traffic alongside traditional microservices.

 - True cross-functional support: Backed by world-class Solutions Engineers, dedicated SDRs, Customer Success, and an active developer community.

 - Full-cycle ownership: Your territory, your pipeline, your deals. You run everything from first outreach through negotiation to close.

 - A voice in the product: What you hear from customers goes straight to product and marketing, and it shapes what we build and how we take it to market.

 - Visibility: Represent Kong at industry events, conferences, and customer meetings.

What you bring

 - Enterprise software track record: 5+ years of full-cycle closing with mid-market and enterprise logos (>1,000 employees), and consistent quota overachievement.

 - Ecosystem literacy: Direct experience in modern B2B SaaS or infrastructure, ideally across commercial open source (COSS), developer platforms, cloud/networking, APIs, Kubernetes, or observability.

 - Multi-persona discovery: You can work bottoms-up with technical champions (engineers, architects) and top-down with executive economic buyers (CTO, VP Eng, CISO).

 - Strategic territory ownership: A disciplined MEDDPICC or Command of the Message approach to pipeline generation, accurate forecasting, and deal execution.

 - Consultative selling: You find the customer’s actual problem, tie the solution to a business outcome, and tailor every demo to match.

 - Negotiation under pressure: You’re comfortable in high-stakes conversations and build relationships that last past the signature.

 - Account planning and CRM discipline: You research accounts and industry trends before you call, and you keep Salesforce (or similar) current enough to forecast from.

 - Builder mindset: You thrive in a fast-moving, early-stage environment, take ownership of your territory, and adjust when the market shifts.

Why top sellers join us

 - Clear category winner: Gartner Leader with top-tier adoption metrics and continuous product momentum.

 - Uncapped upside: Highly competitive base/variable structure, accelerators, and equity.

 - Culture of execution: Autonomous, fast-moving, and low on bureaucracy. Built for builders and closers.



About Kong: 

Kong Inc., the AI Connectivity Company, is building the connectivity layer of AI. Trusted by the Fortune 500® and AI-native startups alike, Kong’s unified API and AI platform enables organizations to secure, manage, accelerate, govern, and monetize the flow of intelligence across APIs and AI traffic — on any model, any cloud. For more information, visit www.konghq.com http://www.konghq.com.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Firmware Development
jobs.description:
Position Summary

The Senior Manager, Firmware Development leads a team of firmware engineers responsible for the design, development, integration, debug, and delivery of embedded firmware for complex storage products. This role combines people leadership, technical judgment, execution discipline, and cross-functional collaboration to ensure high-quality firmware delivery aligned with product, program, and business objectives.

The Senior Manager will manage engineers with varying levels of firmware development experience, building team capability through clear direction, coaching, prioritization, and performance management. The role partners closely with hardware, systems, validation, program management, quality, and manufacturing teams to develop robust firmware solutions and resolve technical issues across the product lifecycle.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

• Lead, develop, and retain a team of firmware engineers working across architecture, design, implementation, integration, debug, and sustaining activities.
• Set clear goals, priorities, and execution plans for the team, ensuring alignment with product roadmaps, schedule commitments, and quality expectations.
• Drive firmware development using disciplined engineering practices, including design reviews, coding standards, defect management, test strategy, and release readiness.
• Provide technical and organizational leadership for embedded firmware development, including data structures, software algorithms, drivers, control paths, and hardware interfaces.
• Guide the team in debugging complex issues across firmware, hardware, system, and platform interactions; support root-cause analysis and corrective action closure.
• Partner cross-functionally with ASIC, hardware, systems, validation, manufacturing, reliability, and program teams to deliver complete solutions.
• Balance near-term execution with longer-term improvements in team capability, development processes, tools, and technical roadmap.
• Review technical designs, development plans, and engineering analyses to ensure sound decisions, clear tradeoffs, and effective risk management.
• Establish a high-accountability, collaborative team environment that supports engineers at different experience levels and enables growth in technical depth and ownership.
• Manage resource planning, work allocation, hiring, onboarding, and succession planning for the firmware organization.
• Communicate status, risks, dependencies, and key technical decisions clearly to the Director of Firmware Development and other stakeholders.
• Ensure documentation is complete and maintained throughout the firmware development lifecycle, including requirements, design artifacts, investigations, and release materials.

Required Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field; advanced degree preferred.
• 10+ years of embedded or firmware development experience, with meaningful experience leading engineering teams.
• 3+ years of people management or equivalent leadership experience, including performance management, coaching, and career development.
• Strong technical foundation in embedded systems and firmware development using C/C++; experience with low-level software, device control, drivers, and hardware/software integration.
• Experience leading teams through full product development cycles from concept through release and sustaining support.
• Demonstrated ability to manage engineers with a broad range of experience and skill levels.
• Strong problem-solving, debugging, and root-cause analysis skills in complex system environments.
• Effective written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate technical and execution topics to both engineering and management audiences.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience with storage, data-path, controller, or other performance-sensitive embedded systems.
• Experience with firmware development tools, lab debug environments, emulation, simulation, and automated test frameworks.
• Working knowledge of structured development methodologies, CI/CD practices, code review discipline, and quality-oriented release processes.
• Experience operating in global, cross-functional product development organizations.

Leadership Expectations

• Builds an inclusive, respectful team culture grounded in accountability, technical rigor, and consistent execution.
• Adapts leadership approach to support senior engineers, mid-level contributors, and early-career team members effectively.
• Makes timely, well-reasoned decisions with appropriate consideration of technical, schedule, and business tradeoffs.
• Raises issues early, escalates appropriately, and drives closure on critical dependencies and risks.
• Develops talent intentionally through coaching, feedback, stretch assignments, and succession planning.

Every enterprise building microservices, cloud-native architectures, and generative AI workloads runs on APIs. Kong is the cloud-native API and AI connectivity company, trusted by Fortune 500s and millions of developers worldwide.

If you sell infrastructure, dev tools, or data platforms, you know what developer mindshare is worth. At Kong, you aren’t evangelizing unproven tech from scratch. You’re monetizing an existing open-source groundswell and partnering with enterprise architecture, security, and engineering leaders to power mission-critical API traffic.

What makes this role high-leverage

 - A proven land-and-expand engine: Convert open-source and developer adoption into strategic, multi-year enterprise platform commitments (Kong Konnect, AI Gateway, Service Mesh).

 - High-impact deals: Run complex, multi-threaded enterprise cycles (100k–1M+ ACV) across CTO, VP of Platform/Architecture, and CISO personas.

 - Modern AI and cloud relevance: Put Kong at the center of the enterprise stack, securing, managing, and routing LLM traffic alongside traditional microservices.

 - True cross-functional support: Backed by world-class Solutions Engineers, dedicated SDRs, Customer Success, and an active developer community.

 - Full-cycle ownership: Your territory, your pipeline, your deals. You run everything from first outreach through negotiation to close.

 - A voice in the product: What you hear from customers goes straight to product and marketing, and it shapes what we build and how we take it to market.

 - Visibility: Represent Kong at industry events, conferences, and customer meetings.
   
   

What you bring

 - Enterprise software track record: 5+ years of full-cycle closing with mid-market and enterprise logos (>1,000 employees), and consistent quota overachievement.

 - Ecosystem literacy: Direct experience in modern B2B SaaS or infrastructure, ideally across commercial open source (COSS), developer platforms, cloud/networking, APIs, Kubernetes, or observability.

 - Multi-persona discovery: You can work bottoms-up with technical champions (engineers, architects) and top-down with executive economic buyers (CTO, VP Eng, CISO).

 - Strategic territory ownership: A disciplined MEDDPICC or Command of the Message approach to pipeline generation, accurate forecasting, and deal execution.

 - Consultative selling: You find the customer’s actual problem, tie the solution to a business outcome, and tailor every demo to match.

 - Negotiation under pressure: You’re comfortable in high-stakes conversations and build relationships that last past the signature.

 - Account planning and CRM discipline: You research accounts and industry trends before you call, and you keep Salesforce (or similar) current enough to forecast from.

 - Builder mindset: You thrive in a fast-moving, early-stage environment, take ownership of your territory, and adjust when the market shifts.
   
   

Why top sellers join us

 - Clear category winner: Gartner Leader with top-tier adoption metrics and continuous product momentum.

 - Uncapped upside: Highly competitive base/variable structure, accelerators, and equity.

 - Culture of execution: Autonomous, fast-moving, and low on bureaucracy. Built for builders and closers.



About Kong: 

Kong Inc., the AI Connectivity Company, is building the connectivity layer of AI. Trusted by the Fortune 500® and AI-native startups alike, Kong’s unified API and AI platform enables organizations to secure, manage, accelerate, govern, and monetize the flow of intelligence across APIs and AI traffic — on any model, any cloud. For more information, visit www.konghq.com http://www.konghq.com.

jobs.title: Business Development Director, International
jobs.description:
Spacecraft represent the most pressing unmet need across the entire aerospace industry. As more launch vehicles come online and the cost to orbit decreases, more companies launching payloads to space continue to emerge.

For the first time in history, this influx of payload companies combined with reduced launch costs has resulted in a massive increase in need for commercial spacecraft platforms, known as satellite buses. These buses hold the payloads of our customers and are flown on launch vehicles.

Apex manufactures these satellite buses at scale using a combination of software, vertical integration, and hardware that is designed for manufacturing. Our spacecraft enable the future of society: ranging from earth observation to communications and more.

We’d love for you to join us on our mission of providing humankind access to the galaxy beyond our planet. 




ABOUT THE ROLE

As BD Director, International, you will be responsible for driving Apex’s growth in international markets with a focus on the assigned international territory.

This is a high-ownership, high-impact, high-reward role which is accountable for bookings in a strategic important region for Apex. In addition, you will be responsible for ensuring that Apex develops and advances strategic relationships amongst stakeholders within the aerospace market.

This position owns full-cycle deal management, from opportunity identification through contract close. You will be responsible for pipeline development, sales execution, and new business bookings across both new and existing accounts.

Responsibilities:

 - Identify, qualify, and close new business opportunities in the regional market. Own and drive deals from open to close.

 - Develop market and account strategies and clear and well defined engagement plans for all pursuits.

 - Develop and maintain a strong, healthy pipeline of qualified opportunities; ensure disciplined pipeline management and forecasting accuracy.

 - Build strong customer relationships across working and executive levels.

 - Represent Apex at industry events, trade shows, and key customer meetings to drive awareness and build relationships.

Requirements:

 - Proven track record (5+ years) in a business development or sales role with experience in international space markets.

 - Experience developing and executing account and deal strategies to manage and close enterprise transactions with multiple stakeholders.

 - Deep understanding of the satellite market landscape, including customer funding processes, acquisition models, and prime/subcontractor dynamics.

 - Understanding of the market dynamics and sovereign interests within the region and align the company to leverage these opportunities

jobs.title: Manager, Firmware Development
jobs.description:
Position Summary

The Manager, Firmware Development leads a team of firmware engineers responsible for the design, development, integration, debug, and delivery of embedded firmware for complex storage products. This role combines people leadership, technical judgment, execution discipline, and cross-functional collaboration to ensure high-quality firmware delivery aligned with product, program, and business objectives.

The Manager will manage engineers with varying levels of firmware development experience, building team capability through clear direction, coaching, prioritization, and performance management. The role partners closely with hardware, systems, validation, program management, quality, and manufacturing teams to develop robust firmware solutions and resolve technical issues across the product lifecycle.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

• Lead, develop, and retain a team of firmware engineers working across architecture, design, implementation, integration, debug, and sustaining activities.
• Set clear goals, priorities, and execution plans for the team, ensuring alignment with product roadmaps, schedule commitments, and quality expectations.
• Drive firmware development using disciplined engineering practices, including design reviews, coding standards, defect management, test strategy, and release readiness.
• Provide technical and organizational leadership for embedded firmware development, including data structures, software algorithms, drivers, control paths, and hardware interfaces.
• Guide the team in debugging complex issues across firmware, hardware, system, and platform interactions; support root-cause analysis and corrective action closure.
• Partner cross-functionally with ASIC, hardware, systems, validation, manufacturing, reliability, and program teams to deliver complete solutions.
• Balance near-term execution with longer-term improvements in team capability, development processes, tools, and technical roadmap.
• Review technical designs, development plans, and engineering analyses to ensure sound decisions, clear tradeoffs, and effective risk management.
• Establish a high-accountability, collaborative team environment that supports engineers at different experience levels and enables growth in technical depth and ownership.
• Manage resource planning, work allocation, hiring, onboarding, and succession planning for the firmware organization.
• Communicate status, risks, dependencies, and key technical decisions clearly to the Director of Firmware Development and other stakeholders.
• Ensure documentation is complete and maintained throughout the firmware development lifecycle, including requirements, design artifacts, investigations, and release materials.

Required Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field; advanced degree preferred.
• 7+ years of embedded or firmware development experience, with meaningful experience leading engineering teams.
• 1+ years of people management or equivalent leadership experience, including performance management, coaching, and career development.
• Strong technical foundation in embedded systems and firmware development using C/C++; experience with low-level software, device control, drivers, and hardware/software integration.
• Experience leading teams through full product development cycles from concept through release and sustaining support.
• Demonstrated ability to manage engineers with a broad range of experience and skill levels.
• Strong problem-solving, debugging, and root-cause analysis skills in complex system environments.
• Effective written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate technical and execution topics to both engineering and management audiences.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience with storage, data-path, controller, or other performance-sensitive embedded systems.
• Experience with firmware development tools, lab debug environments, emulation, simulation, and automated test frameworks.
• Working knowledge of structured development methodologies, CI/CD practices, code review discipline, and quality-oriented release processes.
• Experience operating in global, cross-functional product development organizations.

Leadership Expectations

• Builds an inclusive, respectful team culture grounded in accountability, technical rigor, and consistent execution.
• Adapts leadership approach to support senior engineers, mid-level contributors, and early-career team members effectively.
• Makes timely, well-reasoned decisions with appropriate consideration of technical, schedule, and business tradeoffs.
• Raises issues early, escalates appropriately, and drives closure on critical dependencies and risks.
• Develops talent intentionally through coaching, feedback, stretch assignments, and succession planning.

jobs.description:
Axsome Therapeutics is a biopharmaceutical company leading a new era in the treatment of central nervous system (CNS) conditions. We deliver scientific breakthroughs by identifying critical gaps in care and develop differentiated products with a focus on novel mechanisms of action that enable meaningful advancements in patient outcomes. Our industry-leading neuroscience portfolio includes FDA-approved treatments for major depressive disorder, agitation associated with dementia due to Alzheimer’s disease, excessive daytime sleepiness associated with narcolepsy and obstructive sleep apnea, and migraine, as well as multiple novel product candidates addressing a broad range of serious neurological and psychiatric conditions that impact over 150 million people in the United States. Together, we are on a mission to solve some of the brain’s biggest problems so patients and their loved ones can flourish. For more information, please visit us at www.axsome.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

This role serves as a key member of the LTC field leadership and primary commercial lead for key stakeholders within LTC pharmacy networks, integrated delivery systems, regional healthcare organizations, skilled nursing facilities, behavioral health organizations and affiliated healthcare providers.

The KAM will collaborate cross functionally with Sales, Market Access, Medical Affairs, Trade, Marketing and Operations to drive performance and strengthen strategic partnerships in the LTC channel.

Job Responsibilities and Duties include, but are not limited to, the following:

• Develop and execute strategic account plans for targeted LTC customers and pharmacy organizations.

• Identify opportunities to expand product utilization and increase market share within accounts.

• Deliver compelling customer engagement activities across both virtual and live settings.

• Build and maintain executive level relationships with key decision makers including: LTC Pharmacy Leadership Medical Directors Consultant pharmacist Health system administrators Behavioral health leadership IDN Stakeholders

• Deliver compelling clinical and business presentations tailored to customer needs.

• Promote within our approved labeling in a comprehensive, fair, and ethical manner that is consistent with industry- and company-specific legal and regulatory guidelines and policies

• Operate in full compliance with company policies, industry regulations, and healthcare laws.

• Develop strong customer relationships by better understanding the customer’s needs

• Serve as a resource to customers and staff regarding payer policies and processes (i.e., eligibility and benefit verification, prior-authorization, and appeals/denials)

• Support education and awareness of market access and reimbursement dynamics, including payer requirements, pharmacy fulfillment processes, patient access programs, and reimbursement tools.

• Communicate territory activity in an accurate and timely manner as directed by management

• Provide feedback to sales and commercial leadership, LTC sales colleagues, marketing, market access, and other internal departments about changing environment and results

• Successfully complete all training classes in a timely manner

• Complete administrative duties in an accurate and timely fashion

• Manage efforts within assigned promotional budget

jobs.description:

At SentinelOne, we are driven by a clear purpose: to give the advantage to those who secure our future. When you join SentinelOne, your work helps protect global enterprises, critical infrastructure, and the technologies shaping tomorrow. If you are motivated by meaningful challenges and want your impact to be real, measurable, and global, you will find purpose here.

About Us

SentinelOne is a company at the intersection of AI and security, pioneering a new operating model for cybersecurity. Our AI-native platform unifies protection across endpoint, cloud, identity, data, and AI systems to deliver autonomous detection and response with clarity and speed. By combining real-time analytics, intelligent automation, and a unified data foundation, we reduce noise, simplify complexity, and empower security teams to focus on what truly matters.

Our teams are builders, problem-solvers, and innovators committed to shaping the future of security. If you are excited to solve hard problems alongside talented, mission-driven people, we invite you to help us build a safer future for humanity.
