jobs.description:
General Job Duties For All Store Team Members

· Operate all equipment.

· Stock ingredients from delivery area to storage, work area, walk-in cooler.

· Prepare product.

· Receive and process telephone orders.

· Take inventory and complete associated paperwork.

· Clean equipment and facility approximately daily.

Training

Orientation and training provided on the job.

Communication Skills

· Ability to comprehend and give correct written instructions.

· Ability to communicate verbally with customers and co-workers to process orders both over the phone and in person.

Essential Functions/Skills

· Ability to add, subtract, multiply, and divide accurately and quickly (may use calculator).

· Must be able to make correct monetary change.

· Verbal, writing, and telephone skills to take and process orders. Motor coordination between eyes and hands/fingers to rapidly and accurately make precise movements with speed.

· Ability to enter orders using a computer keyboard or touch screen.

Work Conditions

EXPOSURE TO

· Varying and sometimes adverse weather conditions when removing trash and performing other outside tasks.

· In-store temperatures range from 36 degrees in cooler to 90 degrees and above in some work areas.

· Sudden changes in temperature in work area and while outside.

· Fumes from food odors.

· Exposure to cornmeal dust.

· Cramped quarters including walk-in cooler.

· Hot surfaces/tools from oven up to 500 degrees or higher.

· Sharp edges and moving mechanical parts.

SENSING

· Talking and hearing on telephone. Near and mid-range vision for most in-store tasks.

· Depth perception.

· Ability to differentiate between hot and cold surfaces.

TEMPERAMENTS

The ability to direct activities, perform repetitive tasks, work alone and with others, work under stress, meet strict quality control standards, deal with people, analyze and compile data, make judgments and decisions.

JOB REQUIREMENTS

You must be 16 years of age or older.

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS, including, but not limited to the following:

Standing

Most tasks are performed from a standing position. Walking surfaces include ceramic tile "bricks" with linoleum in some food process areas. Height of work surfaces is between 36" and 4".

Walking

For short distances for short durations

Sitting

Paperwork is normally completed in an office at a desk or table

Lifting

· Bulk product deliveries are made twice a week or more and are unloaded by the team member using a hand truck.

· Deliveries may include cases of ingredients and supplies weighing up to 50 pounds with dimensions of up to 3' x 1.5'.

· Cases are usually lifted from floor and stacked onto shelves up to 72" high.

Carrying

· Large cans, weighing 3 pounds, 7 ounces, are carried from the workstation to storage shelves.

· Occasionally, pizza sauce weighing 30 pounds is carried from the storage room to the front of the store.

· Trays of pizza dough are carried three at a time over short distances, and weigh approximately 12 pounds per tray.

Pushing

· To move trays which are placed on dollies.

· A stack of trays on a dolly is approximately 24" - 30" and requires a force of up to 7.5 pounds to push.

· Trays may also be pulled.

Climbing

Team members must infrequently navigate stairs or climb a ladder to change prices on signs, wash walls, perform maintenance.

Stooping/Bending

· Forward bending at the waist is necessary at the pizza assembly station.

· Toe room is present, but workers are unable to flex their knees while standing at this station.

· Duration of this position is approximately 30 - 45 seconds at one time, repeated continuously during the day.

· Forward bending is also present at the front counter and when stocking ingredients.

Crouching/Squatting

Performed occasionally to stock shelves and to clean low areas.

Reaching

· Reaching is performed continuously; up, down and forward.

· Workers reach above 72" occasionally to turn on/off oven controls, change prices on sign, and lift and lower objects to and from shelves.

· Workers reaching down to perform such tasks as scooping cornmeal from a plastic barrel, or washing dishes.

· Workers reach forward when obtaining topping ingredients, cleaning work surfaces, or answering phones.

Hand Tasks

· Eye-hand coordination is essential. Use of hands is continuous during the day.

· Frequently activities require use of one or both hands. Shaping pizza dough requires frequent and forceful use of forearms and wrists.

· Workers must manipulate a pizza peel when removing pizza from the oven, and when using the rolling cutter.

· Frequent and/or forceful pinching is required in the assembly of cardboard pizza boxes.

· Team Members must be able to grasp cans, the phone, the pizza cutter and pizza peel, and pizza boxes.

Machines, Tools, Equipment, Work Aids

Team Members may be required to utilize pencils/pens, computers, telephones, calculators, TDD equipment, pizza cutter and pizza peel.

Job Duties and Responsibilities

jobs.title: GNC Performance Engineer I
jobs.description:
At Relativity Space, we’re building rockets to serve today’s needs and tomorrow’s breakthroughs. Our Terran R vehicle will deliver customer payloads to orbit, meeting the growing demand for launch capacity. But that’s just the start. Achieving commercial success with Terran R will unlock new opportunities to advance science, exploration, and innovation, pioneering progress that reaches beyond the known.

Joining Relativity means becoming part of something where autonomy, ownership, and impact exist at every level. Here, you're not just executing tasks; you're solving problems that haven’t been solved before, helping develop a rocket, a factory, and a business from the ground up. Whether you’re in propulsion, manufacturing, software, avionics, or a corporate function, you’ll collaborate across teams, shape decisions, and see your work come to life in record time. Relativity is a place where creativity and technical rigor go hand in hand, and your voice will help define the stories we’re writing together. Now is a unique moment in time where it’s early enough to leave your mark on the product, the process, and the culture, but far enough along that Terran R is tangible and picking up momentum. The most meaningful work of your career is waiting. Join us.

About the Team:

The Guidance, Navigation, and Control (GNC) and Performance teams are responsible for defining and analyzing how Terran R flies, from liftoff to landing. The work combines a variety of disciplines such as advanced modeling, orbital mechanics, software development, and dynamic systems to optimize every phase of flight. You’ll develop flight algorithms, simulate trajectories, and model Terran R’s dynamic behavior across mission profiles. Whether you're early in your career or a seasoned expert, you’ll have the opportunity to own critical pieces of the system, influence design, and see your work fly. The department is part of the Integrated Performance team, uniting key disciplines to drive performance at every stage of the mission.

About the Role:

• Carry out analysis for engineering design trades and driving design decisions based on the results.

• Implement, maintain, and improve software tooling in a variety of languages, ranging from core simulation capabilities to peripheral analysis utilities.

• Maintain, establish, and sometimes lead cross-functional collaboration with key teams across Vehicle Engineering.

About You:

• An undergraduate or graduate degree (BS/MS/PhD) in Engineering, Computer Science, Physics, or a related field with

• Prior experience doing heavy cross-functional collaboration in a fast-paced environment.

• Notable modern programming language coding experience (e.g. Python, Julia, Rust, C++).

• Demonstrated experience in taking complex analysis results and clearly communicating conclusions and recommendations to facilitate rapid decision-making.

• Familiarity with architectural design and analysis of launch vehicle or space systems.

• Familiarity with trajectory design and optimization.

Nice to haves but not required:

• Experience working with advanced software development practices such as Docker, Continuous Integration/Continuous Deployment (CI/CD), and dependency management.

• Prior work in a startup or agile development environment.

At Relativity Space, we are committed to transparency and fairness in our compensation practices. Actual compensation will be determined based on experience, qualifications, and other job-related factors.

Compensation is only one part of our total rewards package. Relativity Space offers competitive salary and equity, a generous PTO and sick leave policy, parental leave, an annual learning and development stipend, and more! To see some of the benefits & perks we offer, please visit here.

jobs.description:
ABOUT THE JOB

Do you know why Domino's Pizza hires so many drivers? Well, aside from the fact that our delicious pizza is the perfect solution for dinner for families all across the nation - we do it because we can. What do we mean by that, you ask? We mean that we offer a great flexible schedule that offers the hours you're looking for. That means you're free when you need to be. You'll have plenty of time left over for school, to hang with your friends, or whatever. Even if you need a second job for some extra cash, Domino's Pizza is the perfect place for you.

Right now Domino's is looking for qualified drivers to staff stores in your area. We're growing so fast it's hard to keep up, and that means Domino's has lots of ways for you to grow (if that's what you want), perhaps to management, perhaps beyond. Whether it's your hobby, main-gig, or supplemental job, apply online. We're bound to have just the thing for you.

JOB REQUIREMENTS AND DUTIES

You must be 18 years of age and have a valid driver's license with a safe driving record meeting company standards as well as access to an insured vehicle which can be used for delivery. You should possess navigational skills to read a map, locate addresses within designated delivery area and must be able to navigate adverse terrain including multi-story buildings.

ADVANCEMENT

Many of our team members began their careers as delivery drivers and today are successful Domino's franchise owners. From delivery driver to management, general manager to franchisee or Manager Corporate Operations, our stores offer a world of opportunity.

DIVERSITY

Our mission is to recognize, appreciate, value and utilize the unique talents and contributions of all individuals. To create an environment where all team members, because of their differences, can reach their highest potential.

SUMMARY STATEMENT

We take pride in our team members and our team members take pride in Domino's Pizza! Being the best pizza delivery company in the world requires exceptional team members working together. At Domino's Pizza, our people come first!

General Job Duties For All Store Team Members

· Operate all equipment.

· Stock ingredients from delivery area to storage, work area, walk-in cooler.

· Prepare product.

· Receive and process telephone orders.

· Take inventory and complete associated paperwork.

· Clean equipment and facility approximately daily.

Training

Orientation and training provided on the job.

Communication Skills

· Ability to comprehend and give correct written instructions.

· Ability to communicate verbally with customers and co-workers to process orders both over the phone and in person.

Essential Functions/Skills

· Ability to add, subtract, multiply, and divide accurately and quickly (may use calculator).

· Must be able to make correct monetary change.

· Verbal, writing, and telephone skills to take and process orders. Motor coordination between eyes and hands/fingers to rapidly and accurately make precise movements with speed.

· Ability to enter orders using a computer keyboard or touch screen.

· Navigational skills to read a map, locate addresses within designated delivery area.

· Must navigate adverse terrain including multi-story buildings, private homes, and other delivery sites while carrying product.

Work Conditions

EXPOSURE TO

· Varying and sometimes adverse weather conditions when removing trash and performing other outside tasks.

· In-store temperatures range from 36 degrees in cooler to 90 degrees and above in some work areas.

· Sudden changes in temperature in work area and while outside.

· Fumes from food odors.

· Exposure to cornmeal dust.

· Cramped quarters including walk-in cooler.

· Hot surfaces/tools from oven up to 500 degrees or higher.

· Sharp edges and moving mechanical parts.

· Varying and sometimes adverse weather conditions when delivering product, driving and couponing.

SENSING

· Talking and hearing on telephone. Near and mid-range vision for most in-store tasks.

· Depth perception.

· Ability to differentiate between hot and cold surfaces.

· Far vision and night vision for driving.

TEMPERAMENTS

The ability to direct activities, perform repetitive tasks, work alone and with others, work under stress, meet strict quality control standards, deal with people, analyze and compile data, make judgements and decisions.

Valid Driver License (2 Years)

Valid Proof of Automotive Insurance

Valid Vehicle Registration

Valid Food Handler's Permit

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS, including, but not limited to the following:

Standing

Most tasks are performed from a standing position. Walking surfaces include ceramic tile "bricks" with linoleum in some food process areas. Height of work surfaces is between 36" and 48".

Walking

For short distances for short durations

Delivery personnel must travel between the store and delivery vehicle and from the delivery vehicle to the customer's location.

Sitting

Paperwork is normally completed in an office at a desk or table

Lifting

Bulk product deliveries are made twice a week or more and are unloaded by the team member using a hand truck.

Deliveries may include cases of ingredients and supplies weighing up to 50 pounds with dimensions of up to 3' x 1.5'.

Cases are usually lifted from floor and stacked onto shelves up to 72" high.

Carrying

Large cans, weighing 3 pounds, 7 ounces, are carried from the workstation to storage shelves.

Occasionally, pizza sauce weighing 30 pounds is carried from the storage room to the front of the store.

Trays of pizza dough are carried three at a time over short distances, and weigh approximately 12 pounds per tray.

During delivery, carry pizzas and beverages while performing "walking" and "climbing" duties.

Pushing

To move trays which are placed on dollies.

A stack of trays on a dolly is approximately 24" - 30" and requires a force of up to 7.5 pounds to push.

Trays may also be pulled.

Climbing

Team members must infrequently navigate stairs or climb a ladder to change prices on signs, wash walls, perform maintenance.

During delivery of product, navigation of five or more flights of stairs may be required.

Stooping/Bending

Forward bending at the waist is necessary at the pizza assembly station.

Toe room is present, but workers are unable to flex their knees while standing at this station.

Duration of this position is approximately 30 - 45 seconds at one time, repeated continuously during the day.

Forward bending is also present at the front counter and when stocking ingredients.

Crouching/Squatting

Performed occasionally to stock shelves and to clean low areas.

Reaching

Reaching is performed continuously; up, down and forward.

Workers reach above 72" occasionally to turn on/off oven controls, change prices on sign, and lift and lower objects to and from shelves.

Workers reaching down to perform such tasks as scooping cornmeal from a plastic barrel, or washing dishes.

Workers reach forward when obtaining topping ingredients, cleaning work surfaces, or answering phones.

Driving

Deliver pizzas within a designated delivery area. A Team Member may make several deliveries per shift.

Machines, Tools, Equipment, Work Aids

Team Members may be required to utilize pencils/pens, computers, telephones, calculators, TDD equipment, pizza cutter and pizza peel.

Driving Specific Job Duties

Deliver product by car and then to door of customer.

Deliver flyers and door hangers.

Requires

Valid driver's license with safe driving record meeting company standards.

Access to insured vehicle which can be used for delivery.

jobs.title: Program Manager, Data Transformation
jobs.description:
Our mission at Oura is to empower every person to own their inner potential. Our award-winning products help our global community gain a deeper knowledge of their readiness, activity, and sleep quality by using their Oura Ring and its connected app. We've helped millions of people understand and improve their health by providing daily insights and practical steps to inspire healthy lifestyles.

Empowering the world starts with living our values and empowering our team. As a quickly growing company focused on helping people live healthier and happier lives, we ensure that our team members have what they need to do their best work — both in and out of the office.

As Program Manager, Data Transformation, you will run the day-to-day program engine that turns Oura's business data into governed, trusted, decision-ready metrics. You will work inside the Data Transformation program, alongside the Staff Program Manager, and own the delivery rhythm for your assigned data domains: intake, prioritization, tracking, ownership, certification, and reporting. Early focus areas include Hardware and Supply Chain, where the need for structure is greatest.A core part of the job is metric certification and intake discipline. You will enforce the three-path model for every request and metric: Directional (fit for use, fast), Governed (executive, board, investor, or external numbers, with a certification path), and Not ours (operational or application work rerouted to the owning business team). You will also drive the work itself, including sprints where they help, so certification and delivery commitments actually land.Hardware and supply chain data, for example, spans manufacturing, quality, logistics, sourcing, planning, and new product introduction. This role connects those teams to Data Engineering and Analytics so that the numbers executives, finance, and auditors rely on (for example warranty rate, click-to-delivery, and yield) have one definition, one owner, and a clear path from directional to governed to certified.This role is ideal for a program manager who is comfortable in ambiguity, can read a data pipeline diagram as easily as a project plan, and likes bringing structure to fast-moving, cross-functional work.

What You Will Do:

• Take business metrics from informally tracked to fully certified, each with a locked definition, a single accountable owner, and documented lineage and controls

• Make sure every key metric in your domains has a clear owner and approver, and keep that ownership current as the business changes

• Triage incoming data requests by their intended use and level of rigor, and route work that belongs to other teams to the right place

• Run a structured intake process with clear priorities, business justification, and reliable response times

• Drive cross-functional programs to completion across Data Engineering, Finance, Supply Chain, Hardware, and IT, using agile practices where they help

• Keep program plans accurate and visible, with named leads, dates, and status that stakeholders can trust

• Track data issues and metric regressions through to resolution, and support documentation for internal and external audit

• Communicate progress and data health clearly to senior leaders, and drive adoption of standardized metric definitions

This is a hybrid role out of our San Francisco office.

What you'll bring

• 5 to 8 years of experience in program management, technical program management, or business operations, including time supporting data, analytics, or operations teams

• Experience running cross-functional programs with many stakeholders and competing priorities, without formal authority

• Experience with metric governance or controls work: definitions, ownership, documentation, and formal sign-off

• Comfortable working in Databricks or a similar lakehouse: can navigate the catalog, read a SQL query or model to understand how a metric is computed, and spot-check numbers against source tables

• Working understanding of data pipelines and transformation layers (dbt or equivalent): can follow lineage from source system to reported number and explain where a metric is computed

• Experience with data quality controls: defining validation tests, reading test results, and tracing failures to root cause

• Comfort holding a process line with senior stakeholders, including redirecting requests, while keeping relationships intact

• Hands-on experience with work tracking tools such as Jira, and with running sprints or lightweight agile cadences

• Clear written and verbal communication, including status reporting for senior audiences

Nice to have:

• Experience with hardware, manufacturing, quality, logistics, sourcing, or supply planning

• Background in consumer hardware, wearables, medical devices, or another regulated hardware business

• Exposure to financial reporting, SOX-style controls, audit preparation, or IPO readiness

• Experience at a high-growth or pre-IPO company

• Experience working with distributed teams across US and European time zones

• Comfort using modern AI tooling to speed up analysis, documentation, and reporting

Benefits

At Ōura, we care about you and your well-being. Everyone here at Ōura has a ring of their own and we are continually looking to improve employee health.

What we offer:

• Competitive salary

• Lunch benefit

• Wellness benefit

• Flexible working hours

• Collaborative, smart teammates

• An Ōura ring of your own

• Wellness Time Off

Oura takes a market-based approach to pay, which may vary depending on your location. US locations are categorized into tiers based on a cost of labor index for that geographic area. While most offers will be closer to the starting range, successful candidates' pay will be determined based on job-related skills, experience, qualifications, work location, internal peer equity, and market conditions. These ranges may be modified in the future.

• Region 1 $172,550 - $203,000

• Region 2 $158,950 - $187,000

• Region 3 $147,900 - $174,000

A recruiter can determine your zones/tiers based on your U.S. location.

Oura is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. Individuals seeking employment at Oura are considered without regard to age, ancestry, color, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, mental or physical disability, national origin, protected family care or medical leave status, race, religion (including beliefs and practices or the absence thereof), sexual orientation, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. We will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics.

We will work to ensure individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment.

Disclaimer: Beware of fake job offers!
We’ve been alerted to scammers posing as ŌURA recruiters, especially for remote roles. Please note:

• Our jobs are listed only on the ŌURA Careers page and trusted job boards.

• We will never ask for personal information like ID or payment for equipment upfront.

• Official offers are sent through Docusign after a verbal offer, not via text or email.

Stay cautious and protect your personal details.

To all recruitment agencies: Oura does not accept agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to our jobs alias, Oura employees, or any other organization's location. Oura is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

jobs.title: Sr. Product Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
ABOUT COGENT SECURITY

Cogent is an Applied AI Lab building the next generation of AI agents for cybersecurity. AI has fundamentally changed how attacks happen, allowing malicious actors to operate at unprecedented speed and scale. Cogent’s "AI Taskforce" assesses petabytes of enterprise data to remediate these issues before critical breaches occur.

To stay at the cutting edge, we blend frontier research with real-world execution. Alongside our core product work, Cogent Research serves as our applied AI lab, providing the research horsepower needed to make truly agentic security workflows a reality.

Since coming out of stealth, Cogent has experienced rapid growth. We partner with Fortune 500 companies to secure some of the most complex production environments in the world.

We’re backed by Greylock and we’ve built a team with the best minds in applied AI. Our team is comprised of people from:

 - Top universities like Stanford, Berkeley, Penn, Duke, Carnegie Mellon, Waterloo

 - Unicorn, high-growth companies like Scale AI, Databricks, Stripe, Tesla, Coinbase

 - World class cybersecurity experts from Wiz, Abnormal AI, Zscaler

 - Preeminent ML research labs like Deepmind and SAIL




ABOUT THE ROLE

Cogent is building a world-class marketing team, and we're looking for smart, fast, exceptional people who are committed to our mission and bring a spark of creativity that sets us apart from traditional B2B marketing. As an early member of product marketing, you'll have an immediate, highly visible impact on how Cogent shows up in a crowded market. If you like crafting content that is clear, specific, and actually resonates with security practitioners (without the typical "marketing speak"), you'll fit in well here. You'll build the assets that carry Cogent's positioning into the field: battlecards and competitive intel, sales enablement, product and solution pages, and launch content. Your job is to translate product differentiation into stories, proof, and sales tools that win enterprise deals, with room to grow as the function scales.




WHAT YOU'LL DO



Messaging & Content

 - Develop and refine positioning for new products and capabilities within Cogent's core narrative.

 - Sharpen and tailor the Cogent story for specific audiences, such as partners, media, and more

 - Write product pages, solution pages, datasheets, blog posts, and whitepapers that security practitioners actually read.



Launch Execution

 - Drive tier 1 launches end to end: internal readiness, stakeholder alignment, release messaging, web updates, and enablement.

 - Bring tier 2 and 3 capabilities to market on a regular cadence to show momentum.



Competitive Intelligence

 - Run the competitive program day to day: track vendors, source product insights, documentation, and demos, and keep battlecards current and field-ready.

 - Ensure that sales is armed with the latest market understanding and knows how to apply it

 - Turn win/loss patterns into objection handling and sales plays.



Sales Enablement

 - Build and maintain solution briefs, one-pagers, and demo storyline inputs.

 - Work with sales to understand friction points and figure out ways to solve those

 - Support POCs and technical evaluations with guides, operationalization docs, and ROI/value frameworks.



AI-Native Execution

 - Use AI to accelerate drafts, variants, and repurposing while holding the bar on accuracy and quality.




WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR



Must-Have

 - 4-7+ years in B2B product marketing with cybersecurity domain expertise

 - Excellent writing. Clear, specific, and credible to security practitioners.

 - Strong verbal communication. You present well to sales, product, and customers.

 - High output and initiative. Fast, responsive, self-directed.

 - A high bar for your own work. Good isn't good enough.



Nice-to-Have

 - Experience in vulnerability management, exposure management, ASM/CAASM, AppSec/CloudSec adjacencies.

 - Hands-on competitive intel experience: sourcing products, documentation, and demos.

 - Experience supporting technical evaluations/POCs and security review processes.





WHY COGENT

Cogent is redefining how AI can proactively defend organizations against evolving threats. Our mission is to empower security teams with cutting-edge AI agents and clear, actionable insights. You’ll join a world-class GTM team where your work directly impacts the safety of some of the world’s most sophisticated organizations.

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, Dashboard Product
jobs.description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

The Dashboard Product team is committed to providing world-class user experiences for Stripe merchants. We focus on perfecting the Dashboard Stripe’s main interface for merchants - by infusing meticulous attention to detail and craft. We take immense pride in our work and deeply care about the quality of the products we deliver. We’re dedicated to building a team with an acute focus on detail, nurturing a level of craftsmanship that makes us proud to share our work with the world.

We serve two core user groups. First, is real merchants using the Dashboard. We own the most critical, first-touch surfaces, such as the homepage, which we drive to set the benchmark for intuitive, reliable software. This work directly informs our second set of users, internal product teams. We distill our front-line insights into shared components and paradigms, empowering the entire organization to build a consistent, holistic Dashboard experience.

We're a mentorship-forward team where staff engineers work directly alongside early-career engineers to raise the quality bar across everything we ship. We're also actively exploring how AI agents can unlock new creative possibilities for how merchants interact with their products, and we're excited to bring that same spirit of invention to the frontend craft.

What you'll do

As a Frontend Engineer on the Dashboard Product team, you’ll collaborate with skilled designers and engineers to drive UX excellence in the Stripe Dashboard. You’ll craft experiences that simplify complex tasks for merchants, ensuring high performance, seamless information architecture, and intuitive discoverability. You’ll work on inventing new paradigms and elevating existing ones, with an eye toward broader use cases on the Dashboard. Working closely with designers and cross-functional groups, you’ll craft experiences that help merchants understand their business and execute essential tasks with surprising levels of ease and delight.

You’ll also mentor early-career engineers to raise our collective quality bar, all while exploring how emerging AI agents can unlock new, creative ways for merchants to interact with their business.

Responsibilities

• Own the frontend quality, consistency, and visual craft of the Stripe Dashboard's highest-traffic pages, with particular focus on core logged-in surfaces

• Identify and execute opportunities to improve consistency, performance, and polish across the Dashboard

• Partner closely with Design and Product,, serving as the technical voice on frontend feasibility, quality standards, and implementation approach

• Contribute to and advocate for the Stripe design system, ensuring components and patterns work well across the Dashboard and other product surfaces

• Establish frontend quality standards for the team, including patterns, code review practices, and implementation guidance for junior engineers

• Prototype and explore AI-powered experiences that change how merchants discover and interact with Stripe products

• Collaborate with backend engineers on integration points while keeping frontend craft as your core focus

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

• This is a Staff-level role - that typically means 10+ years of experience building and shipping complex, user-facing web applications at large scale

• Deep expertise in modern frontend development, with strong opinions on UI quality and the ability to execute to a high level of visual precision

• Track record of driving measurable improvements to UI consistency and polish across large, distributed products

• Experience working closely with Design teams and translating design intent into high-quality production implementation

• Demonstrated ability to work across a large codebase and bring coherence to high-traffic product surfaces

Preferred qualifications

• Passion for crafting beautiful experiences on the web, demonstrated through a design portfolio and frontend code showcasing engaging microsites, Figma plugins, creative code, design systems, or other similar endeavors

• Familiarity with frontend performance engineering, including profiling, instrumentation, and optimization

• Interest in AI-driven user experiences, with experience prototyping or shipping AI-powered features

• Experience mentoring early-career engineers and contributing to team-wide quality standards

• Comfort working across the full stack when needed, with a clear preference and passion for frontend craft

• Advanced proficiency with React, with an emphasis on interactions, animation, performance, and refinement

• Experience with A/B testing, synthetic monitoring, or accessibility testing

jobs.title: Part-Time NY Licensed  Mental Health Therapist - Campus (Hybrid)
jobs.description:
Employment Type: Part-Time W-2

Compensation: $60/hour for onsite work, FFS $87 Intake and $65 Follow-up for virtual sessions

Location: Onsite at campus (250 Joralemon Street, Brooklyn, NY 11201), with additional virtual therapy hours

Anticipated Onboarding: Week of January 4, 2027

Anticipated Onsite Start: Week of January 11, 2027

About Us:
At Mantra Health, we're dedicated to revolutionizing student mental health care. Partnering with universities and colleges across the country, our mission is to provide universal access to high-quality mental health services for students.

Since our founding in 2018, we've built a comprehensive treatment service for young adults with various mental health conditions. We've raised over $34 million to work with students at universities and colleges across the country. We're particularly proud that nearly two-thirds of students with access to Mantra report that our program helped them stay in school.

From comprehensive teletherapy to wellness coaching to telepsychiatry, our diverse team is dedicated to ensuring that students not only survive but thrive.

Join us in paving the way for a brighter, healthier future for students everywhere.

What Our Clinicians Say About Working at Mantra Health:

• "Very supportive and informative administration team!"

• "They have a great EHR and the upper management seems very supportive."

• "Mantra's collaborative MDs are well trained to train others with respect. I am impressed by one of the most common goals in common among all staff is to promote mental health among students! Great model!"

Who We're Looking For:
We are seeking independent NY licensed therapists to provide a combination of in-person and virtual therapy to college students. This part-time opportunity is ideal for clinicians who enjoy working directly with students on campus while also providing virtual care outside their onsite hours.The role offers flexibility in how you structure your schedule, balancing time on campus for non-session responsibilities with a hybrid approach to care that includes both in-person and virtual sessions.

As a Mantra Licensed Therapist, You Will:

• Deliver high-quality, meaningful in-person and virtual therapy using evidence-based interventions such as Motivational Interviewing (MI), Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT), and Dialectical Behavior Therapy (DBT).

• Provide dedicated therapy appointments during scheduled campus hours.

• Build relationships with students and help them navigate mental health concerns, academic stress, and personal challenges.

• Collaborate with campus partners, treatment providers, supervisors, and peers to support coordinated care.

• Maintain timely and accurate documentation of all clinical interactions.

• Partner with our support team to facilitate student outreach, referrals, and resource coordination.

• Identify and manage escalating risk scenarios in accordance with clinical protocols.

• Participate in administrative activities and campus initiatives as appropriate.

• Provide virtual therapy outside onsite hours as part of the agreed-upon FFS commitment.

• Become familiar with Mantra Health's care model and contribute to a supportive, student-centered clinical environment.

Who You Are:

• Hold an active, independent clinical license, such as LCSW, LMFT, LPC, LMHC-D in NY.

• Have experience conducting comprehensive biopsychosocial intakes and diagnostic assessments.

• Develop thoughtful, evidence-based treatment plans tailored to individual student needs.

• Demonstrate an ability to work effectively with students from diverse backgrounds.

• Have strong clinical judgment and the ability to identify and respond to risk appropriately.

• Communicate effectively with campus partners and multidisciplinary care teams.

• Are comfortable providing both in-person and virtual therapy.

• Can commit to the assigned onsite schedule and some additional FFS virtual hours.

• Have experience working with law school students (preferred).

• Speak Spanish or Mandarin (preferred).

Work Schedule and Onsite Expectations:

We are looking to hire three primary onsite providers to support students on campus.

• Provider 1: Two onsite days per week.

• Providers 2 and 3: One onsite day per week each.

• Virtual therapy: In addition to onsite responsibilities, providers are expected to commit to a minimum of 4-hours fee-for-service (FFS) virtual therapy hours outside their onsite schedule. Friday, evening, and weekend availability is preferred to help meet student demand.

Academic-Year Schedule:

Monday through Thursday

The typical daily schedule is:

• 10:00am - 12:00pm: Flexible time for administrative responsibilities, campus activities, coordination, and other student support needs.

• 12:00 - 12:30pm: Break.

• 12:30 - 6:30pm: Dedicated time for therapy appointments.

Onsite days will be coordinated based on campus needs and the provider's assigned schedule.

Summer Schedule:

Tuesdays and Thursdays

The summer schedule will focus on Tuesdays and Thursdays, with onsite coverage and therapy hours coordinated according to campus needs and student demand.

Planned Breaks and Campus Closures:

The campus schedule includes planned breaks during which regular onsite services will not be provided. You may see students virtually during these times.

• Winter holiday: December 21, 2026 - January 11, 2027.

• Spring break: March 8 - 12, 2027.

• Other scheduled office closure days, as applicable.

Employment Type and Compensation:

This is a part-time W-2 position.

• Accrued personal time off and sick time off.

• No additional employee benefits are included.

• Providers are also expected to maintain some FFS virtual therapy hours outside their onsite schedule.

Why Choose Mantra Health?

• Meaningful impact: Support college students during a pivotal stage of their lives.

• Collaborative care: Work alongside campus partners and Mantra's clinical and operational teams.

• Consistent schedule: Follow a defined onsite schedule aligned with the academic calendar.

• Professional support: Access clinical consultations and administrative support.

• Flexible virtual work: Supplement onsite care with agreed-upon virtual therapy hours.

If you have any questions, please feel free to email us at recruiting@mantrahealth.com.

Mantra Health is an equal-opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

Protect Your Information: Mantra Health has been made aware of fraudulent recruitment activities where individuals pose as our hiring team. Please note that all official communications will come from an @mantrahealth.com email address. Click here to learn more.

jobs.title: Senior Brand Designer
jobs.description:
About Brightai

BrightAI is a physical AI company for the world's essential services. Water, power, oil and gas and industrial operators run aging assets with stretched crews and periodic inspections that miss problems as they develop. BrightAI helps them see the condition of their assets, understand what it means and act before problems reach the people who depend on them. Stateful devices and existing telemetry capture what's happening in the field. Foundation models predict failures and guide people, control systems and robots, and field outcomes help improve the models. The Stateful platform operates across 50,000+ operational locations. The aim is reliable, safe infrastructure and safer crews.

The Role

BrightAI's work happens at pipelines, substations and treatment plants, but most buyers first meet it through a deck, a web page or a diagram. As Senior Brand Designer, you'll own and evolve the visual brand and make it work everywhere it shows up: presentations, collateral, the website, digital campaigns and events. Much of the job is making physical AI understandable, showing how field devices, data and models connect to real outcomes for complex enterprise buyers. You'll partner closely with product marketing and growth, and you'll build the templates that let a small team move quickly.

This role is AI-native by design. Our ambition is for AI to expand what one senior designer can produce, up to 10x the output of a traditional workflow, while the quality bar stays where it is. You remain the art director, personally accountable for concept, typography, hierarchy, distinctiveness, product truth and final quality.

Responsibilities

• Own and evolve BrightAI's visual system, including typography, color, layout, iconography and brand standards.

• Design sales decks, presentations, one-pagers and other collateral that hold up in both technical and executive conversations.

• Design accessible, responsive website and landing pages, and QA them through implementation.

• Create ads, social and digital assets with growth, including variants for testing.

• Build diagrams and explanatory visuals that show how BrightAI observes, predicts and acts in the field.

• Design customer-proof visuals and event materials.

• Maintain a template and asset library so teammates can produce on-brand work quickly, and check exported files before they ship.

jobs.title: Tooling Engineer, Starship Components (Materials Engineering)
jobs.description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

TOOLING ENGINEER, STARSHIP COMPONENTS (MATERIALS ENGINEERING)

SpaceX continues to revolutionize the launch industry by combining advanced technological developments with pragmatic and lean manufacturing. Materials used on SpaceX vehicles are designed to withstand the extreme environments of launch, on-orbit operations, and reentry. This role will lead a team responsible for the support of advanced welding and joining processes on follow control devices and mechanisms that drive critical capabilities on Starship/Super Heavy - from regulators and butterfly valves to flap/fin actuators. We design, manufacture, and test valves, regulators, and actuators for maximum reliability in extreme environments, compatibility with various fluids, temperatures ranging from 80 to 800K, and pressures beyond 800 bar.

This position will own manufacturing and development of Tooling and Equipment for SpaceX’s Starship components welding. The person in this position will help develop,  build, and certify designs to optimize tooling related to welding and inspection processes The Tooling Engineer in this role will interface daily with design, automation, welding, NDE, and test engineers to make the machine that builds the machine and enforce standardized practices and procedures on multiple welded assemblies.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Design and manufacture of welding fixtures for processes including, but no limited to, electron beam welding, laser beam welding, gas tungsten arc welding, and orbital tube welding.

• Collaborate with design engineering to ensure tooling can work with assemblies without damaging critical features.

• Create detailed models and engineering prints in NX.

• Perform hand calculations and analysis to size structures and mechanisms.

• Create manufacturing planning for scope performed by internal welding and toolmaking teams.

• Scope equipment procurement for welding processes.

• Create and evaluate asset maintenance schedules.

• Support machine activation with welding engineering team and perform development testing.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

• Bachelor’s degree in mechanical, manufacturing, or another engineering discipline.

• 1+ years of experience in one or more of the following: designing and building mechanical structures, GD&T, fabrication of mechanical assemblies, weldments, or CAD software design package (e.g. Solidworks, NX, CATIA, or ProE).

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

• Demonstrated ability to prioritize and execute tasks in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.

• CNC and/or Robot programming experience for automated welding solutions.

• Tooling design experience for welded assemblies to reduce part distortion and improve part consistency.

• Self-motivated engineer with keen attention to detail.

• Hands-on experience in a high-production manufacturing environment.

• Mechanical component and/or tooling design and analysis experience using 3D CAD software.

• Experience with design for manufacture and assembly (DFMA).

• Experience writing work instructions and procedures for critical components.

• Expertise and engineering knowledge in tooling, automation, welding engineering, components design, and/or components manufacturing.

• Experience in software development in SQL, Python or C#.

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

• Must be able to work extended hours and weekends as needed.

• Must be able to travel for business needs – up to 25%.

COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS:

Pay Range:
Level 1: $100,000.00 - $130,000.00
Level 2: $115,000.00 - $160,000.00

Your actual level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience.

Base salary is just one part of your total rewards package at SpaceX. You may also be eligible for long-term incentives, in the form of company stock or long-term cash awards, as well as potential discretionary bonuses and the ability to purchase additional stock at a discount through an Employee Stock Purchase Plan. You will also receive access to comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, short and long-term disability insurance, life insurance, paid parental leave, and various other discounts and perks. You may also accrue 3 weeks of paid vacation and will be eligible for 10 or more paid holidays per year. Employees accrue paid sick leave pursuant to Company policy which satisfies or exceeds the accrual, carryover, and use requirements of the law.

ITAR REQUIREMENTS:

Learn more about the ITAR here.

jobs.title: Associate Director, Data Standards and EDC Programming
jobs.description:
Revolution Medicines is a global, commercial-state oncology company dedicated to discovering, developing and delivering innovative medicines for patients with RAS-addicted cancers. Leveraging its differentiated RAS(ON) tri-complex inhibitor platform, the company is advancing a broad, integrated portfolio of oral RAS(ON) inhibitors designed to directly target the active, cancer-driving state of RAS. Founded on rigorous scientific inquiry and a willingness to challenge long-held assumptions, Revolution Medicines is committed to changing the trajectory of disease for patients with RAS-addicted cancers worldwide.

Our people are united by a shared way of working: follow the science, challenge assumptions, act with urgency and hold ourselves to a high standard of rigor—all in service of patients.

The Opportunity:

The Associate Director of Data Standards and EDC Programming is responsible for clinical data collection standards and Medidata Rave programming at Revolution Medicines. The role manages the continued development of the Rave Global Library and oversees study builds, core system configurations, and programming work performed by external partners.

Reporting to the Senior Director, Clinical Data Systems & Ops Ex, the Associate Director works with Clinical Data Management, IT, Statistical Programming, Clinical Operations, and other study team members to plan and deliver EDC work. Responsibilities include maintaining standards, resolving technical issues, managing vendor performance, and overseeing testing and controlled system changes.

This position requires practical experience building studies in Medidata Rave and the judgment to decide when a standard should be used, revised, or adapted for a study. The Associate Director is expected to reduce repeated programming work, improve build quality, and help study teams meet their timelines.

Responsibilities

• Manage EDC programming staff and external programming partners. Assign work, review deliverables, provide technical guidance, and support staff development.

• Set priorities and resource plans for EDC programming and data standards work. Agree on timelines with study teams, manage competing requests, and bring delivery risks and resource needs to management.

• Maintain and expand the Medidata Rave Global Library, including core and oncology eCRFs, edit checks, derivations, custom functions, dictionaries, and study templates.

• Oversee Rave study builds, protocol amendments, database migrations, and production changes. Work with Data Management to confirm requirements and assess the effect of changes on existing data and study processes.

• Review build specifications and programming deliverables and provide hands-on support for complex Rave configurations and C# custom functions.

• Manage core Rave configurations and coordinate user access, site administration, security settings, and study archival activities with IT, Data Management, and vendors.

• Serve as the primary EDC programming contact for Medidata and programming vendors. Review proposals, budgets, contracts, and invoices with the appropriate internal teams, and monitor vendor performance against agreed deliverables.

• Maintain data collection standards aligned with CDASH, CDISC controlled terminology, and downstream SDTM requirements. Work with Statistical Programming and Biostatistics on data structures, annotated CRFs, and mapping considerations.

• Coordinate standards governance reviews, including requests for new forms, changes to existing standards, and study-specific exceptions. Document decisions and track implementation across internal and vendor study builds.

• Oversee testing and validation of library components, study builds, integrations, and system changes. Ensure defects are resolved and required approvals are in place before release.

• Maintain version control, change records, release documentation, and traceability for the Global Library and study configurations.

• Work with Data Management, Statistical Programming, IT, and external data providers to resolve issues with data transfers, integrations, and reconciliation, including laboratory, imaging, eCOA, and IRT data.

• Work with study teams to define EDC reports, metrics, and dashboards. Review requests for report changes and support development of tools that help teams monitor data and study progress.

• Assess Medidata releases and changes to industry standards for their effect on existing configurations and library components. Plan testing and updates with the relevant teams.

• Develop and maintain EDC programming SOPs, work instructions, specifications, and training materials. Help study teams and vendors apply the standards correctly.

• Track use of library standards, build timelines, rework, and recurring defects. Use the findings to improve programming practices and evaluate automation or other tools that reduce manual work.

• Support audits, inspections, and regulatory submissions as the EDC programming subject matter expert, including providing system documentation and explaining programming and validation decisions.

Required Skills, Experience and Education:

• Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Systems, Life Sciences, Statistics, or a related discipline with at least 10+ years of relevant pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or CRO experience; or a master’s degree with at least 8+ years of relevant experience.

• At least 8 years of hands-on Medidata Rave programming experience, including at least 4 years building, configuring, and implementing clinical study databases.

• Experience maintaining a Rave Global Library and applying reusable forms, edit checks, custom functions, and other standards across studies.

• Strong working knowledge of Rave Architect, eCRF design, study configuration, edit checks, derivations, and C# custom function programming.

• Experience leading programming teams or managing external programming partners, including planning work, reviewing quality, mentoring staff, and addressing delivery issues.

• Experience working with study teams to translate protocol requirements into EDC specifications and manage study builds, amendments, testing, and production changes.

• Knowledge of CDASH, SDTM, CDISC controlled terminology, and the relationship between data collection, data structures, and submission requirements.

• Working knowledge of GCP, ICH guidelines, 21 CFR Part 11, computerized systems validation, and clinical data integrity requirements.

• Understanding of clinical data flow, external data transfers, reconciliation, and technical troubleshooting across clinical systems.

• Ability to manage several studies and standards projects, make practical technical decisions, and explain issues and options clearly to technical and nontechnical colleagues.

Preferred Skills:

• Medidata Rave Study Builder Certification or advanced training in Rave custom functions and Global Library development.

• Sponsor-side experience managing EDC standards, system configurations, vendor relationships, and programming budgets.

• Oncology experience, particularly early-phase studies, complex visit schedules, and Phase I through Phase III development programs.

• Experience with metadata repositories, CDISC ODM, CDISC Library APIs, or Rave Web Services.

• Experience using SQL, SAS, Python, or reporting tools to support data review, programming, or automation.

• Experience with Rave Safety Gateway or other EDC integrations supporting safety reporting.

• Experience supporting regulatory submissions, audits, or inspections.

jobs.title: Head of Company Operations
jobs.description:
About Tutor
We believe robots are the biggest lever we have to making the physical world a better, more affordable place. But robots are a rounding error in our society: nearly nine out of ten American factories and warehouses don’t even have a single robot, and robots have yet to make their way into our homes or places of business.
Tutor Intelligence is changing that.
Tutor is a robotics research and deployment company, building generally capable robot hardware and artificial intelligence to enable robots to go where no robots have gone before. Sonny is a semi-humanoid robot with frontier dexterity approaching the human form. Cassie does back-breaking work, moving boxes, pallets, and bulk goods for businesses from family-owned manufacturers to some of the largest brands in the world. Tutor robots are manufactured at scale and operate as a network, combining the whole fleet’s learned experience to train ever more capable robot artificial intelligence.
Founded at MIT and headquartered in Watertown, MA, our team is full stack: we design and manufacture robot hardware, train our own models, work directly with the smallest and largest end-customers, and maintain our fleet across the United States. We’re a team of researchers, engineers, technicians, operators, and sellers who love building things and solving hard problems.
Our mission is grand: robots everywhere, for the common good, raising the standard of living across North America, and then the world.

jobs.title: Senior Total Rewards Partner
jobs.description:
ABOUT AIRWALLEX

Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. More than 675,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own.

We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,700 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles https://www.airwallex.com/en-us/operating-principles to see it in full.

 


HOW YOU'LL MAKE IMPACT

Total Rewards is central to how Airwallex attracts, motivates and retains talent across the Americas. As the first Total Rewards team member based in the region, you'll build the operating model for Americas rewards while partnering with a small, globally distributed team.

 - Own the Americas Total Rewards program across the US and Canada, Brazil and Mexico, with end-to-end responsibility for compensation, benefits design and equity programs.

 - Lead compensation planning, benchmarking and pay decisions, including salary structures, geographic differentials, market positioning, merit and bonus cycles, and offer guidance.

 - Design benefits programs and lead plan renewals, broker negotiations and transition project management with local People Operations partners, balancing employee value, cost and regional requirements.

 - Partner with the global Total Rewards team on US stock plan administration, including RSUs, ISOs, ESPP mechanics, vesting, taxation, grant execution, plan governance and clear employee communications.

 - Lead global and regional Total Rewards projects, including the Americas rollout of the equity framework and IPO-readiness initiatives, from scoping and design through stakeholder alignment and implementation.

 - Use market data, benchmarking and financial modeling to make recommendations, influence decisions and translate complex analysis for leaders, managers and employees.

 - Partner closely with Talent Acquisition, People Partners, Payroll, Finance, Legal, Equity and executive leadership on compensation, organization decisions, systems, equity budgets, compliance and strategy.

 - Build practical processes and documentation for Americas Total Rewards while working independently across time zones and helping establish a local operating model.



You'll work from our San Francisco office Mondays, Wednesdays & Thursdays.




WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR




ESSENTIALS

 - 5+ years of experience in total rewards, compensation or benefits, including experience supporting employee populations across the Americas.

 - Experience owning or building a complete Total Rewards program spanning compensation, benefits and equity.

 - Experience designing benefits programs and managing plan renewals, including broker and insurance carrier negotiations; hands-on benefits administration isn’t the focus of this role.

 - Strong compensation analytics capability, including market benchmarking, salary range architecture, geographic pay differentials, compensation cycles, modeling and projections.

 - Experience making and communicating compensation decisions with senior leaders, People Partners, recruiters and employees.

 - Working knowledge of US equity compensation and stock plan administration, including RSUs, ISOs, ESPP, vesting mechanics and the ability to explain these concepts plainly to non-specialists.

 - Experience at a late-stage private, pre-IPO or recently public company, particularly through changes to an equity program or increased governance requirements.

 - A track record of leading complex Total Rewards projects from design through implementation, bringing stakeholders with you and influencing without formal authority.

 - Strong business partnering, judgement and communication skills, with the confidence to challenge decisions when they don’t align with strategy, data or compliance requirements.

 - A builder mindset and the ability to work independently across time zones when there isn’t an established local playbook.




PREFERRED

 - Experience supporting multi-region Total Rewards programs where the global framework is set outside your own time zone.

 - Familiarity with compensation, equity and HR systems such as Carta, Shareworks, BambooHR or Workday.

 - Experience using survey and benchmarking sources such as Radford, Compensia, Mercer or Aon.

 - Experience with 401(k), ERISA, US pay transparency, benefits compliance or related US rewards requirements.

 - Experience supporting IPO readiness, equity plan governance, tax reporting or SEC-related considerations.

 - Experience building a Total Rewards function or major program from the ground up in a high-growth technology, fintech or payments company.




YOU'LL THRIVE HERE IF

 - You're comfortable owning the roadmap yourself.

 - You're comfortable making decisions with incomplete information and moving quickly anyway.

 - You enjoy working closely with people across multiple countries and time zones as part of one connected, global team, including flexing your hours occasionally to make that connection work.

 - You connect dots across functions and hold the big picture without losing grip on the details.

 - You come to the table with a point of view, not just a problem.




LEARN MORE ABOUT YOUR TEAM

People and Talent is where the people infrastructure of a genuinely global company gets built. Our company is growing fast across multiple regions, hiring in highly competitive markets, while many of the systems and programs themselves are still being designed. That means the job is not to run established processes well — it is to define what great looks like for a global fintech at this stage of growth, and then build it.

This is a team for the ambitious who want the resources and scope of a scaled business combined with the creative latitude of one still being shaped. If you want to influence how a truly global company hires, grows, and builds a talent dense organization, this is where people work becomes company-building work.


APPLICANT SAFETY POLICY: FRAUD AND THIRD-PARTY RECRUITERS

To protect you from recruitment scams, please be aware that Airwallex will not ask for bank details, sensitive ID numbers (i.e. passport), or any form of payment during the application or interview process. All official communication will come from an @airwallex.com http://airwallex.com email address. Please apply only through careers.airwallex.com http://careers.airwallex.com or our official LinkedIn page.

Airwallex does not accept unsolicited resumes from search firms/recruiters.  Airwallex will not pay any fees to search firms/recruiters if a candidate is submitted by a search firm/recruiter unless an agreement has been entered into with respect to specific open position(s).  Search firms/recruiters submitting resumes to Airwallex on an unsolicited basis shall be deemed to accept this condition, regardless of any other provision to the contrary.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY

Airwallex is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and anyone seeking employment at Airwallex is considered based on merit, qualifications, competence and talent. We don’t regard color, religion, race, national origin, sexual orientation, ancestry, citizenship, sex, marital or family status, disability, gender, or any other legally protected status when making our hiring decisions. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know.

jobs.title: H&M Visual Merchandiser - North Star Mall
jobs.description:
About the Role

As a Visual Merchandiser, you contribute to an inspiring, elevated, and consistent customer experience by implementing visual standards and commercial excellence. You will be responsible for executing the visual, commercial, and styling curation according to visual & commercial guidelines for the store. You will also use your trend and competitor awareness to provide colleagues with the correct information, coach, upskill and develop the store team to contribute to a great customer experience.

A Day in the Life

Working at H&M means no two days are ever the same, but a typical day will include the following responsibilities*

Customer Sales & Profit

• Contribute to the total OMNI customer experience in your store by ensuring visual and commercial curation according to guidelines (In-direct)
• Representing yourself and the H&M Brand positively during customer interactions (Direct)
• Organize and plan your workload according to store activation plan and adapt based on business needs in collaboration with your Store Management team and Area Visual Manager
• Launch and maintain the latest global campaigns and sale activities on time according to H&M Brand Standards
• Ensure good garment care, stock levels, and give input on allocation to Store Management and Area teams
• Perform sales report (KPIs) follow-up, identify and prioritize visual & commercial opportunities in collaboration with Store Management team
• Create efficient and effective actions to increase customer satisfaction to reach sales targets, store goals, budget, and follow-up actions in collaboration with Store Management team
• Follow all procedures, best practices for OMNI services, operational routines, legal requirements, and communication in all areas of the store with Store team

Fashion & Trend Awareness

• Keep up-to-date with fashion scene, trends, tendencies, styles, products, brands, competitors, and relevant influencers etc.
• Plan time for fashion & trend awareness to understand trend theory and mood boards for styling techniques and product presentation to anticipate our customer’s needs and enhance our shopping experience in store

Team & Development

• Share, inspire and educate your store teams, keep them updated with seasonal changes, fashion trends, relevant visual & commercial information, in-store communication, including price perception
• Coach and develop the Store team´s visual and commercial skills to secure high quality of product & commercial presentation according to guidelines
• Support & develop daily routines and best practices for your Store team to always ensure a consistent level of visual & commercial standard while maintaining customer service engagement
• Develop and coach talents and provide onboarding training to new colleagues
• Organize, provide, and carry out the visual & commercial upskilling for you and your colleagues
• Complete Visual Competencies & Commercial 4 All trainings based on Regional & Sales Market learning and development goals
• Support Sales Market and Area teams with expansion (store projects) needs

Visual & Commercial Execution

• Execute the visual & commercial curation & styling for the store based on commercial calendar, allocation, store activation plan and fashion trends according to mood boards and direction from the visual & commercial guidelines
• Carry out sample picking best practice routines including stockroom garment quantities, accessories, and shoes to ensure you create clear trends and stories according to inspiration from the visual & commercial guidelines
• Secure window & styling execution according to visual & commercial guidelines to create inspirational and commercial customer experience
• Provide good customer flow by maintaining commercial layout, fixtures, to secure the best trend story placement
• Secure a strong balance and the maintenance of price signs in windows and throughout the store following guidelines according to Global strategy and Sales Market requirements
• In collaboration with Facilities Management ensure all lighting is working correctly, aimed to highlight our products and display forms in windows and throughout the store
• Maintain and care for all display forms and interior material (fixtures & fittings) with sustainability in mind
• In collaboration with Area Visual Manager ensure your store navigation is maintained and kept up to date according to latest guidelines and store layout
• Ensure your store has enough quantities of sale and other activity including POS material according to local routines
• Keep sales floor and back of house clean, organized, and safe according to local security guidelines

Who You Are

• For you to be a successful Visual Merchandiser, you must be curious and creative; always looking for inspiration, proactive, solution focused, flexible, with effective communication skills to achieve results cross functionally.
• We look for individuals with fashion interests and leadership skills who can apply their visual and commercial experience working in a dynamic environment to the role.
• Experience with being solution focused to improve product presentation and commercial execution in store
• Good knowledge of visual, commercial, and operational best practises, routines, and tools
• Know how to manage, follow-up and act on selling equation and weekly sales reports

Why You’ll Love Working at H&M

• We value diverse backgrounds, including but not limited to race, ethnicity, gender, age, religion, sexual orientation, and disability
• We pride ourselves on being a values-driven organization, guided by our 7 unique values that have been part of our success story for over 75 years
• You’ll have access to our Colleague Resource Groups (CRGs) to find community and networking opportunities among colleagues
• We are an inclusive company where you’re encouraged to be yourself at work
• You will have access to a large global talent community, where career growth and aspirations have no limits
• We believe in supporting your overall wellbeing and offer comprehensive benefits inclusive of health insurance, wellness and family support programs, company match retirement plan, paid leave programs, and paid time off, including a community day to serve your local community
• You’ll be able to express your personal style with our employee discount at H&M, & Other Stories, and COS

Compensation: expected base salary range is $16.50 - $18.98 hourly**

EEOC Code: SLS

Pay Status: Non-Exempt, Hourly

*This job posting highlights the most critical responsibilities and requirements of the job and is not all-inclusive. There may be additional duties, and responsibilities assigned for this job at the company’s discretion.

**H&M, in good faith, has assessed this posted range of compensation as the accurate range for this role and location at the time of this posting. H&M may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range depending on candidate qualifications. This range may be modified in the future.

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for applicants with disabilities. If you require assistance or accommodation during the application or interview process, please contact us at https://hm.ethicspoint.com, and use Ask a Question.

Benefits:

We offer all our employees at H&M Group attractive benefits with extensive development opportunities around the globe. All our employees receive a staff discount card, usable on all our H&M Group brands in stores and online. Brands covered by the discount are H&M (Beauty and Move included), COS, Weekday, Monki, H&M HOME, & Other Stories, ARKET, Afound. In addition to our staff discount, all our employees are included in our H&M Incentive Program – HIP. You can read more about our H&M Incentive Program here.

In addition to our global benefits, all our local markets offer different competitive perks and benefits. Please note that they may differ between employment type and countries.

We offer: 25% Staff Discount - Medical, Pharmacy Vision and Dental Coverage – Employee Assistance Program - Vacation, Wellness, Holiday and Parental Pay – 401K – Commuter Benefits, Health and Dependent Care FSA. Plus, additional Voluntary Benefits.

Inclusion & Diversity:

H&M is a part of H&M Group. At H&M Group, we’re determined to create and maintain inclusive, diverse and equitable workplaces throughout our organisation. Our teams should consist of a variety of people that share and combine their knowledge, experience and ideas. Having a diverse workforce leads to a positive impact on how we address challenges, on what we perceive possible and on how we choose to relate to our colleagues and customers all over the world. Hence all diversity dimensions are taken into consideration in our recruitment process.

We strive to have a fair and equal process and therefore kindly ask you not to attach a cover letter in your application as they often contain information that easily can trigger unintentional biases.

Company Description:

H&M is a fashion brand that offers the latest styles and inspiration, from fashion pieces and unique designer collaborations to affordable wardrobe essentials. Our business idea is fashion & quality at the best price in a sustainable way.  Learn more about H&M here.
