jobs.title: Principal, Strategic Finance & Analytics - Membership
jobs.description:
Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.

The Community You Will Join:

As a Strategic Finance & Analytics Principal supporting Membership, you will partner closely with leaders across business operations, product, analytics, data science, and adjacent Strategic Finance teams to help build and grow the Membership program. This team is responsible for developing and scaling new growth levers for Airbnb. This is a high-visibility, high-impact role.

The Strategic Finance & Analytics team sits at the intersection of finance, strategy, and the business, partnering directly with leaders to decide where Airbnb invests, how we grow, and what we do next. We expect every member of the team to bring a CFO mindset to budget management, producing actionable insights, owning our performance story, and supporting day-to-day execution.

Why join us:

• A seat at the table. We're advisors, not just analysts. Our work shapes real decisions, not just decks.

• A steep learning curve. Small, lean teams and a focus on internal mobility means broad exposure across product and business areas.

If you like ambiguity, moving fast, and building the answer instead of just reporting it, you'll fit right in.

The Difference You Will Make

You will be the strategic finance and analytics lead for Membership, helping leadership decide where to invest, how to size programs, and which levers are worth scaling. You will become the subject matter expert on the economics of these programs: how they drive guest and host behavior, what they cost, and what they return. Because many of these programs are early-stage, the financial and analytical foundation often does not yet exist, so you will define and build it.

This role requires a strong commercial mindset, with the ability to size opportunities, evaluate returns, and translate performance and data insights into clear business implications and strategic recommendations for senior leadership.

The ideal candidate brings a combination of sharp analytical instincts, business acumen, and the ability to distill complex information into crisp executive-ready stories. You relish the opportunity to roll up their sleeves, and are a self-starter comfortable embracing the adventure of a fast-paced, ambiguous environment.

A Typical Day:

• Strategic Insights: Conduct analytical and financial deep dives to inform and shape key decisions. You should be comfortable both leading the work independently and partnering with the cross-functional teams to deliver a joint output.

• Investment Decision Support: Build the business cases behind program investments. Size the opportunity, model the returns, and frame tradeoffs so leadership can decide where to place bets and how large they should be.

• Performance Management: Own performance measurement for Membership programs, including defining KPIs, setting goals and OKRs, and building reporting and forecasting that connect early signals to guest and host outcomes, revenue, and long-term value. Support the planning cadences (annual planning, long-range planning, and monthly or quarterly forecasts).

• Program Economics and ROI: Develop and pressure-test the economics of programs, including incentive and benefit costs, guest and host response, and incremental impact.

• Presentations to Leadership: Synthesize complex data into clear narratives and recommendations for senior leadership. Influence cross functional stakeholders to drive alignment on high impact investment and operating decisions.

Your Expertise:

• Ideally you have 10+ years of relevant finance and analytical experience across a mix of strategic finance, investment banking, private equity, strategy/management consulting, and/or business operations.

• Superb financial modeling skills and extensive experience with quantitative and qualitative financial analysis, including building business cases and ROI frameworks.

• Highly proficient in business analytics. You will need to independently extract, analyze, and synthesize large datasets.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills with audiences at various levels. You enjoy working with fragmented data and insights and synthesizing them into a story with recommendations.

• Proven ability to influence cross-functional partners and drive alignment in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment where frameworks are still being built.

• High ownership, strong judgment, and attention to detail.

• AI proficient or able to become AI proficient (Claude or Gemini).

• Experience with growth strategies, evaluating ROI, and scalability of marketplaces, loyalty, incentive, or growth programs is a big plus.

Your Location:

This position is US - Remote Eligible. The role may include occasional work at an Airbnb office or attendance at offsites, as agreed to with your manager. While the position is Remote Eligible, you must live in a state where Airbnb, Inc. has a registered entity. Click here for the up-to-date list of excluded states. This list is continuously evolving, so please check back with us if the state you live in is on the exclusion list  If your position is employed by another Airbnb entity, your recruiter will inform you what states you are eligible to work from.

Our Commitment To Inclusion & Belonging:

Airbnb is committed to working with the broadest talent pool possible. We believe diverse ideas foster innovation and engagement, and allow us to attract creatively-led people, and to develop the best products, services and solutions. All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply.

We strive to also provide a disability inclusive application and interview process. If you are a candidate with a disability and require reasonable accommodation in order to submit an application, please contact us at: reasonableaccommodations@airbnb.com. Please include your full name, the role you’re applying for and the accommodation necessary to assist you with the recruiting process.

We ask that you only reach out to us if you are a candidate whose disability prevents you from being able to complete our online application.

Equal Employment Opportunity:

Airbnb values diversity & belonging and is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. All individuals seeking employment at Airbnb are considered without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, age, gender, sex, marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, or any other legally protected characteristic.

How We'll Take Care of You:

Our job titles may span more than one career level. The actual base pay is dependent upon many factors, such as: training, transferable skills, work experience, business needs and market demands. The base pay range is subject to change and may be modified in the future. This role may also be eligible for bonus, equity, benefits, and Employee Travel Credits.

Pay Range

$168,000—$206,000 USD

Reasonable Accommodations: We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the recruitment process for applicants with disabilities. If you need assistance, or an accommodation, please let your recruiter know once you are contacted about a role.

A Note on Recruiting Scams: Scammers sometimes pose as Airbnb recruiters to get money or personal information from candidates. A few things that will always be true for Airbnb’s hiring process: our open roles are posted on Airbnb’s Career’s Page at careers.airbnb.com, and our recruiters correspond only from @airbnb.com or @ext.airbnb.com email addresses. Our recruiters will never ask for your Social Security number, bank account details, passport, or payment app information while you are interviewing.  We’ll also never ask you to pay a fee, send money, deposit or cash a check, or purchase work-related equipment (such as a company laptop) during the interview process. We encourage candidates to remain vigilant of these recruiting scams and not share sensitive information if you do not believe an individual is actually affiliated with Airbnb.

This role decides where KICK’s next revenue comes from. As our Business Development Lead in the US, you’ll win new agency groups, verticals and enterprise clients, and shape the offers that win them.

What you’ll build with us:
We are looking for a Business Development Lead to grow KICK's advertising business in the US. You will find and win clients that are new to KICK, make the case for advertising on the platform, and close the first deals that become long-term partnerships.

This is a full-time opportunity based in New York. You’ll work from home, but you won’t be working alone. You’ll be out in the market with agencies and advertisers, working closely with our US commercial team and connected to our Australian and Serbian teams as we build KICK’s US presence together.

Who is Easygo and KICK?
Easygo is a high-growth, high-velocity tech company with millions of eyeballs on us every day. We’re building the future of fearless tech. We’re the creators behind some of the most popular brands, including Stake, KICK and Easygo Games. These brands have a fierce global following, but our crew is employed directly by Easygo, and that’s where the real fun happens.

KICK is our live streaming platform, built to put creators and their communities first. It gives content creators 95% of their streaming income and has redefined what a live streaming platform can be. KICK started as a disruptor challenging the status quo. Since launching in 2022, it has grown to more than 100 million accounts, and 81.7% of its audience is aged 18 to 34. Creators stream on KICK across gaming, talk shows, podcasts, IRL, sport and events.

We’re always looking for people who are hungry, humble and move fast, and who are ready to Unify, Disrupt and Evolve with us. With us you’ll grow faster and go further. Your work has impact, and that gives you an edge you can’t get anywhere else.

The impact you’ll make:

• Win and onboard new agency groups, vertical offerings and enterprise clients against the US net new number

• Own the new business pipeline and forecast, from prospect to close

• Work on cross-functional projects that take new offerings to market.

• Build launch packages for new verticals and events, and decide which markets and clients we go after first

Here are our benefits and perks:

Sharpening your edge

We play fair. We hire fair.

Your race, religion, nationality, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, marital, veteran, or disability status won’t affect our hiring decision, or your trajectory here. Come as you are and get the Easygo edge.

jobs.title: Strategic Insights Lead
jobs.description:
ABOUT HANDSHAKE

Handshake was founded on a simple belief that everyone deserves a path to a great career, regardless of where they went to school or who they know. Today, we power 25 million job seekers, 1 million+ employers, and 1,600 educational institutions.

In 2025, we started Handshake AI and built the fastest-growing AI data business in history. We work directly with frontier AI lab researchers to create evaluations, publish benchmarks, and push the boundary of data. We’ve grown from $0 to ~$1B run rate and pay ~$60M to over 30K individuals every month.

Why join Handshake now:

 - Shape how every career evolves in the AI economy, at global scale, with impact your friends, family and peers can see and feel

 - Partner hand-in-hand with world-class AI labs, Fortune 500 partners and the world’s top educational institutions

 - Work together with engineers, scientists, operators, and more from Palantir, Meta, Scale AI, and former YC founders

 - Build a massive, fast-growing business with billions in revenue

 


ABOUT THE ROLE 

Operations group. You act as the data expert and strategist for our go-to-market (GTM) teams and corporate employer customers. You partner with Sales, Account Management, and Customer Success to turn Handshake’s proprietary data on jobseekers, employers, and universities into bespoke narratives and strategic recommendations for customers. You own the full arc of an insights project, from understanding a customer’s challenge to presenting a polished, client-ready deliverable to the customer.

Examples of what you’ll do

 - Deliver Insights Pro engagements: Insights Pro is Handshake’s premium offering for custom data engagements that help employers shape early-career hiring strategy. You work with enterprise customers on strategic priorities such as which schools they should recruit from, how they can build pipelines in hard-to-fill locations, and what the hiring landscape looks like for their emerging roles.

 - Expand Insights Pro with existing customers: Help account managers and account executives show what Insights Pro can do, with examples of how we partner with other employers.

 - Tell the ROI story for existing customers: Support account managers and customer success managers for business reviews, on-site customer meetings, and at-risk renewals.

 - Support new business: Build data-led examples around a prospect’s use case to help AEs win enterprise deals.

 


DESIRED CAPABILITIES 

 - 6+ years in a client-facing advisory, consulting, or quantitative strategy role, with experience presenting to senior-level audiences

 - Strong data fluency: you gather context, pull and analyze data, and turn the results into a clear story. The topic might be employer strategy, the value of a partnership with Handshake, or keeping a customer at renewal

 - You own deliverables from start to finish, including decks and HTML reports, and hold them to a client-ready standard for accuracy, data integrity, and polish

 - You use AI tools, such as Claude, to speed up and improve your work, and can automate workflows that repeat or need to scale

 - You can lead working sessions with senior leaders and earn their trust as a strategic advisor

 - Strong cross-functional partnership across GTM: you lead with empathy, understand the goals of the teams you support, help them use data, and guide them to the right data resources for what they’re trying to achieve

 - You are curious about how AI is changing hiring and workforce strategy

 - You structure open-ended problems into clear steps, learn quickly, and are comfortable pivoting when priorities shift
   
   


EXTRA CREDIT 

 - Experience in HR tech or recruiting technology
   
   


PERKS 

Handshake delivers benefits that help you feel supported and thrive at work and in life.

The below benefits are for full-time US employees.

🎯 Ownership: Equity in a fast-growing company

💰 Financial Wellness: 401(k) match, competitive compensation, financial coaching

🍼 Family Support: Paid parental leave, fertility benefits, parental coaching

💝 Wellbeing: Medical, dental, and vision, mental health support, $500 wellness stipend

📚 Growth: $2,000 learning stipend, ongoing development

💻 Remote & Office: Internet, commuting, and free lunch/gym in our SF office

🏝 Time Off: Flexible PTO, 15 holidays + 2 flex days

🤝 Connection: Team outings & referral bonuses

Explore our mission, values, and comprehensive US benefits at joinhandshake.com/careers http://joinhandshake.com/careers.

jobs.title: Laboratory Analyst II - GCMS VOA (2nd Shift) - Eurofins Environment Testing, Arvada, CO

Eurofins Environment Testing is searching for an Analyst II in Arvada, CO.

The Analyst II prepares and analyzes environmental samples using both standard and complex testing according to scientific and EPA methodology in compliance with Eurofins Environment Testing’s Quality Assurance programs and SOP’s. Validates and reviews data for accuracy through Level I reviews. Uploads laboratory data into LIMS system to generate data packages for delivery to clients. Must be knowledgeable of a broad range of laboratory testing equipment requiring the exercise of discretion and judgment in its operation.

Analyst II responsibilities include, but are not limited to, the following:

• Performs laboratory procedures requiring knowledge of scientific methods and testing procedures including:Batching and prepping samples for analysis taking into account special and varied client and QA requirementsMaking reagents for sample analysisAliquots extracted samples to maximize laboratory productivityPreparing appropriate standards to ensure compliant dataDetermining appropriate routine and complex analysis methods for a wide variety of organic and inorganic samplesOperation, calibration, and maintenance of laboratory instruments
• Uploads data into LIMS system for review.

• Maintains logbooks.

• Orders supplies.

• BS or BA in chemistry or related field; 3 years laboratory experience may substitute for degree.
• Minimum 1 year of experience operating laboratory GC/MS instrument.
• Minimum 2 years’ experience in routine and complex laboratory procedures and instruments, preferably in a production environment
• Previous production-oriented work is a plus
• Authorization to work in the United States indefinitely without restriction or sponsorship
• Professional working proficiency in English is a requirement, including the ability to read, write and speak in English

The ideal candidate would possess:

• Strong reading, writing and speaking skills
• Ability to problem solve
• Team participation and meeting management skills
• Time management and organization skills
• Ability to use calculator/mathematical formulas and concepts
• Complete work within time and quality constraints
• Work independently following written or verbal instructions
• Cooperate and coordinate both orally and in writing

The work schedule is for Monday - Friday, 3:00pm - 12:00am with possible overtime when needed.  This position is full-time and non-exempt from overtime pay.

Compensation Range: $23.00 - $25.00 USD per hour depending on experience plus a 10% shift differential when working the 2nd shift or weekend schedules.

Eurofins Environment Testing (USA) provides a compensation range for informational purposes, the actual base compensation may vary based upon, but not limited to, relevant experience and skill set, base compensation of internal peers, business section, and geographic location

We support your development! Do you feel you don’t match 100% of the requirements? Don’t hesitate to apply anyway! Eurofins companies are committed to supporting your career development.

We embrace diversity! Eurofins network of companies believe in strength and innovation through diversity, being an Equal Opportunity Employer. We prohibit discrimination against employees or applications based on gender identity and/or expression, race, nationality, age, religion, sexual orientation, disability, and everything else that makes employees of Eurofins companies unique.

Sustainability matters to us! At Eurofins, we believe sustainability is at the heart of everything we do. Guided by our vision to be the Global Leader in “Testing for Life,” our mission to contribute to a healthier and safer world, and our core values, we are building a strong foundation for Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) initiatives. Eurofins’ commitment to sustainability begins within our own companies through a shared responsibility to people and the planet. With climate change posing an imminent threat, Eurofins and its many companies recognize their duty to proactively reduce or offset the environmental impact of essential operations while also helping our clients do the same—serving as a true ESG Enabler.

Find out more in our career page: https://careers.eurofins.com/

Company description: Eurofins Scientific is an international life sciences company, providing a unique range of analytical testing services to clients across multiple industries, to make life and our environment safer, healthier and more sustainable. From the food you eat, to the water you drink, to the medicines you rely on, Eurofins laboratories work with the biggest companies in the world to ensure the products they supply are safe, their ingredients are authentic and labelling is accurate.

The Eurofins network of companies is the global leader in food, environment, pharmaceutical and cosmetic product testing and in discovery pharmacology, forensics, advanced material sciences and agroscience contract research services. It is one of the market leaders in certain testing and laboratory services for genomics, discovery pharmacology, forensics, advanced material sciences and in the support of clinical studies, as well as having an emerging global presence in Contract Development and Manufacturing Organisations. It also has a rapidly developing presence in highly specialised and molecular clinical diagnostic testing and in-vitro diagnostic products.

In over 35 years, Eurofins has grown from one laboratory in Nantes, France to 61,000 staff across a decentralised and entrepreneurial network of ca. 900 laboratories in 61 countries. Eurofins companies offer a portfolio of over 200,000 analytical methods to evaluate the safety, identity, composition, authenticity, origin, traceability and purity of biological substances and products.

In 2025, Eurofins generated total revenues of EUR 7.296 billion, and has been among the best performing stocks in Europe over the past 20 years.

Eurofins is a M/F, Disabled, and Veteran Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer.

Eurofins USA Environment Testing is a Disabled and Veteran Equal Employment Opportunity employer.

jobs.title: Test Infrastructure Engineer
jobs.description:
About Etched

Etched is building hardware for frontier intelligence. We co-design chips, racks, software, and manufacturing to deliver best-in-class throughput and latency across both prefill and decode workloads. Our first products are heavily focused on inference. Backed by hundreds of millions from top-tier investors and staffed by leading engineers, Etched is redefining the infrastructure layer for the fastest growing industry in history.



Job Summary

Etched is seeking a Test Infrastructure Engineer to build and run the infrastructure behind factory testing of our AI systems, from new product introduction through mass production.

You will join a new, small central team that owns making factory testing reliable, repeatable, and scalable. A factory test floor looks a lot like a small datacenter: hundreds of boards, servers, and racks under test at once, all running our test software and reporting results back. You will own that layer: the systems that provision and run test stations, move test results and logs into one reliable source of truth, and roll out new test software safely across factories. You will work closely with hardware, firmware, software, and production teams, and with our contract manufacturing partners.



Key Responsibilities

 - Build and operate the test execution platform that runs factory tests across stations, servers, and racks, and keep it running reliably during factory hours.

 - Provision and manage the Linux fleet on the factory floor: OS imaging and network boot, configuration management, and lifecycle automation for test stations and systems under test.

 - Design and maintain the networking that test stations and racks depend on, working with factory partners on site.

 - Build data pipelines that reliably capture every test run, its logs, and hardware genealogy into a central view of test history, yield, throughput, and unit history.

 - Own versioned release, canary, and rollback of factory test packages so new test software reaches production safely and traceably.

 - Build monitoring and alerting across factory infrastructure, and lead debugging when infrastructure issues block production.

 - Integrate with contract manufacturers' factory systems (MES/SFIS) and with shared internal data platforms.

 - Automate repetitive debug work, such as gathering evidence and grouping repeated failure signatures, and help build toward AI-assisted failure triage.



You may be a good fit if you have (Must-have qualifications)

 - 3+ years of experience building and operating production infrastructure.

 - Strong Linux administration skills: boot process, package management, systemd, storage, and debugging from the command line.

 - Solid networking fundamentals: TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, VPNs, and how networks are laid out in server rooms or datacenters.

 - Experience with distributed systems: services that run across many machines and keep working when some of them fail.

 - Strong coding skills in Python, C++, or Rust. You build real tools and services, not only configuration.

 - Experience with automation and configuration management (e.g. Ansible, Terraform) and CI/CD.

 - Experience with monitoring and observability tools (e.g. Prometheus, Grafana) and debugging production issues.

 - Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.

 - Willingness to work onsite in San Jose or Taiwan and travel to manufacturing partners as needed.



Strong candidates may also have experience with (Nice-to-have qualifications)

 - Bare-metal server fleets, lab or datacenter automation, or HPC clusters (e.g. PXE, Slurm).

 - Server management interfaces such as BMC, IPMI, or Redfish.

 - Manufacturing test infrastructure, test automation platforms, or factory software (MES, SFIS).

 - Data pipelines for test results, yield analysis, or hardware genealogy.

 - AI servers, GPU or accelerator systems, or other high-performance compute platforms.

 - Working with contract manufacturers; Mandarin is a plus for Taiwan-based candidates.

 - Bringing first-generation hardware into production at a fast-paced startup.



Benefits

 - Competitive compensation packages including generous equity packages

 - Comprehensive insurance coverage and other top-of-market benefits
   
   

How we’re different

Etched believes in the Bitter Lesson http://www.incompleteideas.net/IncIdeas/BitterLesson.html. We are the first inference-focused frontier AI system. Our addressable market is the entirety of inference, unlike many of our competitors.

We are a fully in-person team in San Jose and Taipei, and greatly value engineering skills. We do not have boundaries between engineering and research, and we expect all of our technical staff to contribute to both as needed.

jobs.title: Brand Designer
jobs.description:

Neros is a defense technology company building America’s drone industrial base. We design and manufacture high-performance unmanned systems that are tested in combat, iterated at startup speed, and built at massive scale. Our team culture is fast, hands-on, and obsessed with closing the gap between design and deployment.

As drones transform the character of warfare, Neros is delivering the systems America and its allies needs to compete on the modern battlefield and deter future conflicts, or else win them. jobs.title: Quality Inspector II, 3rd Shift, Site 2
jobs.description:
AST SpaceMobile and our global partners are building the first and only space-based cellular broadband network to be accessible by standard smartphones. Called SpaceMobile, this ultra-powerful network is being designed to provide connectivity at 4G/5G speeds everywhere on the planet – on land, at sea and in flight.

POSITION OVERVIEW

The Quality Inspector II – Composites Integration performs advanced in-process and final inspections of composite structures, bonded assemblies, mechanical integrations, and avionics-related hardware utilized in satellite manufacturing and integration activities. This position works closely with Manufacturing, Engineering, Production Control, and Quality Engineering teams to ensure product compliance with engineering drawings, specifications, work instructions, and aerospace quality standards.

The ideal candidate will possess experience in aerospace manufacturing, aircraft structures, composites fabrication, satellite integration, avionics manufacturing, or other high-reliability production environments where quality and precision are critical to mission success.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

• Perform detailed in-process and final inspections of composite structures, bonded assemblies, satellite hardware, avionics components, and mechanical integrations.

• Verify compliance with engineering drawings, 3D models, specifications, manufacturing travelers, work instructions, and inspection plans.

• Inspect composite layups, cured components, bonded joints, inserts, fastener installations, and structural assemblies for dimensional and visual conformance.

• Conduct receiving, in-process, First Article Inspection (FAI), and final acceptance inspections.

• Review manufacturing documentation, inspection records, certifications, and supplier quality records for completeness and accuracy.

• Utilize precision measuring equipment including calipers, micrometers, height gauges, bore gauges, pin gauges, and specialty inspection tools.

• Ensure measurement and inspection equipment is being utilized correctly and remains within calibration requirements.

• Identify, document, and process nonconforming material reports (NCMRs) and related quality discrepancies.

jobs.description:
The Phlebotomist reflects the mission, vision, and values of NM, adheres to the organization’s Code of Ethics and Corporate Compliance Program, and complies with all relevant policies, procedures, guidelines and all other regulatory and accreditation standards.

The Phlebotomist provides expert phlebotomy services and must demonstrate excellent customer service and communication skills. The phlebotomist must have the ability to function as part of a highly effective team that consistently puts “Patients First”.

The Phlebotomist is responsible for venipuncture collection and specimen processing. Other responsibilities include but are not limited to order entry in multiple systems, verification of test result receipt, patient information retrieval and lab reception/clerical duties and functions

Responsibilities:

· Performs phlebotomy and other lab specimen collections per age related standards and in accordance with departmental policies, protocols and procedures.

· Demonstrates AIDET model and optimizes patient safety to reduce the likelihood of medical/health care errors.

· Receives and reviews physician orders; ensures that all necessary information is included for appropriate lab services. Enters accurate orders for lab tests in accordance with department policies, protocols and procedures.

· Patient communication model and provides appropriate post-phlebotomy patient care.

· Processes specimens in a timely manner to ensure stability and integrity of samples including labeling, centrifuging, aliquoting, freezing and packaging specimens for transport in accordance with established protocols and policies.

· Reviews/Records refrigerator temperature(s) and QC/QA records. Areas of concern are recorded through the Corrective Action Log and reported to maintenance for repair. Findings are reported to supervisor or manager.

· Understands the operation and maintenance of equipment pertinent to the job. Follows up with all outstanding orders on manifest log, and communicates all timed, completed or uncompleted draws/charges/results as appropriate

· Communicates and notifies Laboratory and/or Physician of problems with specimen procurement for optimal care

· Maintains a safe work environment, holds self-accountable for safe work practices; including adhering to biohazard waste procedures and ensuring proper storage and timely pickup of biohazardous waste.

· Performs lab-related clerical duties include but not limited to order entry, verification of test result receipt, patient information retrieval as well as utilization of email, medical record systems, handheld and desktop devices, ordering and maintaining supply inventory, filing and sanitizing equipment as necessary

· Uses department’s resources efficiently; participates in efforts to reduce costs and streamline work processes.

· Adheres to continuing education expectations; completes and signs-off on competency assessments

· Demonstrates the value of teamwork on a consistent basis; interacts with and assists others in a professional manner

· Applies critical thinking, sound decision making and judgment to investigate and resolve challenging situations

· Complies with all organizational policies regarding ethical business practices.

· Performs other duties as assigned

Minimum Requirements:

Education:

• High School diploma or equivalent.

Certification:

• ·Phlebotomy certification through a nationally recognized organization or training from a phlebotomy school or medical institution or one or more years of phlebotomy experience in a healthcare setting or CMA certification.

Preferred:

· Experience performing phlebotomy on a broad range of patient’s types.

· Experience with processing lab specimens, transferring specimens, and handling a centrifuge.

· Familiar with medical EMR systems.

· Knowledge of medical terminology.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Bare Metal Infrastructure – DGX Cloud
jobs.description:
NVIDIA DGX Cloud builds large-scale GPU infrastructure that powers the world’s most demanding AI workloads. Our Bare Metal Infrastructure team owns the software that turns newly racked hardware into reliable, validated production capacity. We’re looking for a software engineer with deep systems engineering instincts — someone who writes production code and understands how servers, firmware, BMCs, and networks actually behave. You’ll work across the full bare-metal lifecycle: new platform introduction, firmware qualification, automated provisioning, validation, remediation, and handoff to production. We use AI agents and LLM tools heavily in how we build software, and we want someone excited to push that further.

What you’ll be doing:

• Designing, building, and maintaining production services for bare-metal discovery, provisioning, hardware validation, firmware upgrades, auditing, and repair across large GPU fleets.
• Developing integrations with Redfish and vendor BMC interfaces to manage server state, collect inventory and health data, enforce configuration, and drive recovery — handling vendor differences in code.
• Contributing to and reviewing code in our Rust codebase, and building supporting tools and services in Go and Python.
• Turning recurring hardware, firmware, and connectivity failures into automated detection, validation, and repair workflows.
• Defining and implementing automated validation and handoff criteria for new platforms, firmware releases, and rack-scale deployments.
• Debugging complex failures across hardware, firmware, Linux, networking, and provisioning services, and feeding what you learn back into the software.
• Partnering with server and component vendors and with internal platform, networking, datacenter, and production engineering teams to resolve cross-boundary issues.
• Using AI agents and LLM tools daily to write, review, and test code and to investigate failures, and helping shape how the team builds with AI.

What we need to see:

• BS or MS in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or equivalent experience.
• 5+ years building production infrastructure software, automation, or services, including substantial hands-on work with bare-metal server systems.
• Strong programming skills in Rust, Go, or Python, with a track record of designing, testing, shipping, and maintaining production code and willingness to work in Rust regularly.
• Deep knowledge of enterprise server hardware from multiple vendors (Dell, Supermicro, Lenovo, HPE), including BMCs, BIOS/UEFI, and firmware management.
• Direct experience with Redfish and IPMI for provisioning, health inspection, power management, or fault diagnosis, and with network boot (PXE/iPXE, DHCP, HTTP boot).
• Strong Linux knowledge: boot process, kernel and driver interactions, hardware discovery, and low-level failure analysis.
• Solid datacenter networking fundamentals with the ability to trace connectivity problems across host, management, and infrastructure networks.
• Demonstrated, regular use of AI agents and LLM tools in software development, with strong interest in improving and the judgment to validate what they produce.

Ways to stand out from the crowd:

• Production experience writing Rust.
• Experience with NVIDIA DGX or NVL72 systems, NVLink, InfiniBand, Spectrum-X, or BlueField DPUs.
• Background in hardware qualification, rack-scale bring-up, firmware certification, or new product introduction, including safe, scalable workflows for fleet firmware upgrades, configuration enforcement, hardware replacement, and recovery.
• Experience with Kubernetes, GitOps/Argo CD, or fleet-management platforms.
• Examples of AI-driven tooling or workflows you’ve built that measurably changed how you or your team ships software.

Join us and be part of something bigger – helping to simplify health care one person, one family and one community at a time.

Job Purpose and Summary:

At CVS Health, we are focused on transforming health care for our customers and making our company a great place to work.  We help people navigate the health care system – and their personal health care – by improving access, lowering costs and being a trusted partner for every meaningful moment of health. Within our Retail locations, we bring this promise to life with heart every day. Our District Support Pharmacists (DSPs) play a critical role in cultivating a culture of excellence within each pharmacy worked by acting as a role model for all, demonstrating genuine care, and setting the bar for the pharmacy team.

As a DSP, you have a critical role at the forefront of delivering our purpose, modeling our values, and demonstrating genuine, authentic care for our patients. You will work within the district to cover pharmacist scheduling gaps, under the direction of the Pharmacy Manager (PM) and Rx District Leader (DL) to support our pharmacy teams. While working in stores throughout the district, you are accountable for supporting the management, oversight, and operation of the pharmacy and pharmacy team.

The DSP’s responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

• Living our purpose by helping to manage and improve patient health through safe and appropriate dispensing, counseling, and immunizing practices
• Traveling the district to fill pharmacist shifts as scheduled by the District Performance Coordinator (DPC); overseeing the pharmacy and serving as the Pharmacy Manager’s proxy during bench shifts without overlap
• Supporting safe and accurate prescription fulfillment by following—and directing the pharmacy team to follow—pharmacy workflow procedures and utilizing the safety guardrails at every workstation
• Assumes Pharmacy Manager’s day-to-day duties when serving as the only or the primary pharmacist-on-duty
• Contributing to positive patient experiences by showing empathy and genuine care and coaching the pharmacy team to do the same: demonstrating compassionate care, collaborating with the patient’s total healthcare team, and proactively resolving insurance and/or medication issues
• Proactively offering and delivering immunizations to keep patients healthy; engaging and supporting Pharmacy Technicians to learn to immunize
• Supporting the effective management of pharmacy inventory in all pharmacies worked by following—and guiding the pharmacy team to follow—all inventory best practices, with a special focus on protecting cold chain products for our patients and our business
• Remaining flexible for both scheduling and business needs, while contributing to a safe, inclusive, and engaging team dynamic
• Maintaining relevant clinical and technical skills for the job as the industry evolves (including but not limited to company-required trainings and CMEs); actively seeking opportunities to expand knowledge to better support patients
• Supporting access to care and helping to improve patient outcomes through pharmacist delivered clinical care such as testing and prescribing services (e.g., COVID/Flu, Hormonal Contraception, etc.) where permissible; empowers the pharmacy team to provide holistic care at every step in the patient care journey
• Understanding and complying with all relevant federal and state laws, regulations, professional standards, and ethical principles; complying with CVS Health policies and procedures to help support patient safety and complying with controlled substance dispensing and recordkeeping, to protect patient privacy and security, and to maintain a safe and inclusive workplace for our colleagues

Required Qualifications:

• Active Pharmacist License in the state where the Store is located
• Active National Provider Identifier (NPI)
• Not on the DEA Excluded Parties list

Essential Functions:

• Ability to travel within a reasonable radius to support market staffing as business needs require
• Regular and predictable attendance, including nights and weekends
• Ability to complete required training within designated timeframe
• Attention and Focus:Ability to concentrate on a task over a period of timeAbility to pivot quickly from one task to another to meet patient and business needsAbility to confirm prescription information and label accuracy, ensuring patient safety
• Customer Service and Team Orientation:Actively look for ways to help people, and do so in a friendly mannerNotice and understand patients’ reactions, and respond appropriately
• Communication Skills:Use and understand verbal and written communication to interact with patients and colleaguesUtilize active listening by giving full attention to what others are saying, taking time to understand the points being made, asking questions as appropriate, and not interrupting at inappropriate times

Title: Medical Scribe

Company: Oak Street Health

Role Description:

The purpose of a Clinical Informatics Specialist (CIS or Medical Scribe) at Oak Street Health is to support our primary care providers with clinical documentation so that they can focus on providing exceptional care to our patients. Scribes assist providers throughout the patient care journey - huddling each morning to plan for the day's visits, joining them in the exam room to observe and document, and touching base after the visit to assist with next steps.

Beyond the typical Scribe role, these important care team members serve as clinical documentation assistants to their paired provider. Internally, we call them CISs (Clinic Informatics Specialists) in recognition of their important role in supporting accurate, specific, and timely clinical documentation. In addition to observing and documenting all patient encounters in real time, our Scribes become experts in our value-based care model and the documentation and care of chronic conditions, including ICD-10 and CPT coding. Scribes use this expertise to help providers identify and help close care gaps. Scribes receive extensive on-the-job training in clinical workflows, value-based medicine, preventative care for chronic conditions, accurate and specific documentation, population health data streams, and team based care.

Because our patients and providers rely on our Scribes, the ideal candidate should commit at least 1-2 years to this role. This is an excellent opportunity for pre-med track individuals looking to gain practical, paid experience in a clinical setting before applying to an MD/DO/PA/NP program, as well as those pursuing careers in Health Informatics, Public Health, Healthcare Administration, Medical Coding, and other related fields.

• Clinical Documentation Improvement ~ 10%Requesting and reviewing medical recordsLeveraging Oak Street's population health tools to support clinical documentation improvementPreparing for and supporting Daily Huddles and Clinical Documentation ReviewsConsulting with provider on clinical documentation opportunities
• Administrative support for your provider and care team ~ 10%Placing orders and referralsAddressing tasksSupporting the care team with additional responsibilities related to clinical documentation
• Other duties as assigned

Knowledge

• Prior clinical experience, including shadowing and/or volunteering [strongly preferred]
• Prior scribe or transcription experience [preferred but not required]

• Strong computer literacy and ability to learn new technical workflows [required]
• Fluency in Spanish, Polish, Russian, or other languages spoken by people in the communities we serve [required where indicated]

jobs.description:

Meet the Team

Cisco is building a unified, AI-native management platform that brings together Networking, Security, Observability, and Collaboration into a single, coherent platform experience. AI Canvas is Cisco’s generative, collaborative workspace within this platform. It combines AI agents, real-time telemetry, and dynamic interfaces so teams can troubleshoot, decide, and act together.

You’ll join a highly motivated platform team partnering across Cisco to deliver enterprise-grade AI capabilities that are reliable, secure, and built for real-world adoption. We ship iteratively, measure outcomes, and obsess over customer and partner time-to-value, collaborating daily across Engineering, Design, Data/AI, Security, and Go-to-Market teams.

Your Impact

As a Technical Program Manager, you will own end-to-end execution of AI Canvas programs across multiple engineering teams, including platform architecture, agent frameworks, UX, data systems, security, and integrations across Cisco’s wider portfolio. You will work as a peer to senior engineering and product leaders with the autonomy to shape how the program runs:

·       Apply deep technical program management expertise to drive delivery of large, cross-functional AI Canvas releases from roadmap through GA and post-launch stabilization.

·       Translate product and technical strategy into clear execution plans, milestones, interdependency tracking, success metrics, and ownership across teams.

·       Lead agentic AI programs from use-case definition through production and iteration, coordinating agent workflows, model and tool integration, grounding, evaluations, guardrails, and human oversight.

·       Establish evaluation-driven delivery practices so that AI quality, safety, latency, cost, and reliability are measured before launch and monitored in production.

·       Manage large programs with moderate to high risk and multiple interdependencies, bringing structure to ambiguous, fast-moving initiatives to drive timely decisions.

·       Communicate program status, technical trade-offs, architecture dependencies, and critical-path risks to executive leadership with clear recommendations.

·       Partner with engineering, quality, and security teams to define validation, release, observability, and operational-readiness requirements.

Minimum Qualifications

·       Bachelor’s degree with 12+ years of related experience, Master’s degree with 8+ years of related experience, or PhD with 5+ years of related experience, or equivalent related work experience.

·       Experience leading complex technical programs for enterprise SaaS products through production launch and ongoing operation.

·       Experience directly leading at least one generative AI, LLM-based, or agentic capability through development, production launch, and post-launch iteration.

·       Previous experience leading cross-functional technical programs across a highly matrixed engineering organization.

·       Technical fluency in cloud platforms, APIs, distributed systems, data systems, and modern AI development and deployment practices.

Preferred Qualifications

·       Experience leading multi-team SaaS or AI programs involving cloud-native architecture, API integrations, data platforms, AI evaluations, security, reliability, and customer-facing production launches.

·       Experience with generative AI and agentic systems, including agent orchestration, tool use, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), evaluation frameworks, guardrails, observability, and human-in-the-loop workflows.

·       Ability to understand system architecture, identify cross-platform dependencies, facilitate engineering trade-offs, and translate complex technical risks and decisions for executive audiences.

·       Experience applying fit-for-purpose development and execution practices, including Agile methodologies, to improve planning, decision-making, delivery, and team learning.

·       Strong ability to bring structure to ambiguous initiatives, drive timely decisions, and create accountability across product, engineering, security, compliance, customer experience, and go-to-market stakeholders.

Why Cisco?

At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.

Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

jobs.title: Senior Director, Product Design - Auto Design
jobs.description:
Senior Director, Product Design - Auto Design

At Capital One, we’re building a leading information-based technology company. Still founder-led by Chairman and Chief Executive Officer Richard Fairbank, Capital One is on a mission to help our customers succeed by bringing ingenuity, simplicity, and humanity to banking. We measure our efforts by the success our customers enjoy and the advocacy they exhibit. We’re succeeding because they’re succeeding.

Guided by our shared values, we thrive in an environment where collaboration and openness are valued. We believe that innovation is powered by perspective and that teamwork and respect for each other lead to superior results. We elevate each other and obsess about doing the right thing. Our associates serve with humility and a deep respect for their responsibility in helping our customers achieve their goals and realize their dreams. Together, we’re on a quest to change banking for good.

We’re currently seeking a Senior Director, Product Design Leader for the Top of House Auto Design Team, which is part of the Experience Design organization.

Our Top of House Design team serves as a strategic catalyst within the Auto Design organization, connecting the foundational architecture of our platform ecosystem with unified, human-centered experiences. Our team operates horizontally across high-impact product areas to align strategy, scale operational frameworks, and elevate end-to-end customer visibility. By partnering closely with leadership and cross-functional partners, Top of House Design translates complex platform capabilities into cohesive, market-leading experiences built on a standard of scalability, security, and design excellence. If you’re a creative innovator who embraces an environment where you can experiment, learn, and change banking for good, we’d love to hear from you.

Role Expectations

As Senior Director of Top of House Design, you’ll lead a talented, cross-disciplinary team of design leaders and designers, and collaborate deeply with Design, Product and Tech leadership. You’ll be responsible for identifying and advocating for high-leverage opportunities with executive stakeholders and leading high-impact, highly complex design projects that set the bar for and drive experience excellence and business outcomes.

Additional responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

• Partner with Product, Technology, and Business unit leaders to understand financial, technical, and experiential objectives, while helping to drive & enable design, product and experience outcomes
• Inspire and mentor a team of high-potential design leaders and designers to stretch and grow their leadership and operational skills; oversee quality and efficiency of the work and create the space and support for learning and growth
• Enable innovation incubation that can then scale across Auto design, including practices and processes that bring about world-class solutions
• Collaborate with peer design leaders across Capital One to orchestrate the greater experience ecosystem, find efficiencies across shared technologies and common service moments, and unlock higher order value from the cross-line-of business perspective
• Recruit top talent, run a best-in-class team, and invest in their continued success
• Champion human-centered methodologies across the Auto line of business

Here are some of the expected competencies for this role:

Product Design Expertise: Leverage established expertise and leadership in product design to elevate the quality and maturity of the design practice at Capital One. Leveraging a variety of skills across interaction, visual and service design; in collaboration with cross-functional partners, help to oversee and optimize the use of appropriate tools, platforms, frameworks and design systems and enable your team to develop artifacts that may include vision stories, journey maps, blueprints, high-fidelity designs and prototypes

Leadership: Build a thriving community of designers who are well supported, trained for excellence and able to collaborate with peers in multiple functions and set the vision and strategic direction for your team in close partnership with your cross-functional partners.

Human-Centered: Recognize and pursue opportunities where customer needs and business goals coincide, while reinforcing with teammates and partners the importance of collecting and considering diverse customer perspectives throughout the design process

Business-Focused: Demonstrate a mastery of products,  processes, customers, competitors and broader industry trends and apply this knowledge to predict shifts in these areas and shape how Design should engage, uncover and solve significant business challenges

Problem-Solving: Revels in the art of the possible, driving cross-functional groups in thinking creatively about potential solutions, illuminating potential pitfalls and fostering shared learnings; Deep understanding for how things are interconnected and systems mindset to build frameworks for complex decision-making that enable effective debate and accelerate getting to the right solutions

Collaboration: Connect the dots across the organization, proactively bringing together executive partners in ways that drive more coherent experiences, accelerate delivery and elevate the value of design

Communication: Present work to executive leaders and stakeholders, modeling a strategic human-centered approach that integrates design frameworks, data and research insights to make the complex accessible, influence change and drive strategic direction

The ideal candidate has a strong portfolio demonstrating your leadership, process, results and impact.

Basic Qualifications:

• At least 10 years of experience in leading product design teams and delivering products to market
• At least 3 years managing managers

Preferred Qualifications:

• At least 12 years of experience in leading product design teams and delivering products to market
• Deep expertise in building, scaling, and governing enterprise-grade design systems, shared platforms, or developer/designer tool ecosystems across multi-platform environments
• Deep experience leading product design teams operating across UX and UI, strategy, content, and research from strategy through delivery to market
• Deep experience partnering with product managers, engineers, marketing, and analytics leaders across multiple business lines to shape strategy, performance metrics, roadmaps, and operating models
• Track record of defining and deploying AI-augmented design workflows, design agents, or generative UI tooling
• Demonstrated success establishing global standards for visual quality, interaction patterns, code/design parity testing, and contribution models
• Proficiency with web and mobile technologies and platforms, navigating technology considerations and constraints to drive sound product and experience decisions
• Proven ability to treat design systems as internal SaaS products, articulating business cases and measuring platform ROI through developer/designer velocity, defect reduction, code reusability, and time-to-market metrics
• Exceptional interpersonal skills and relationship building across complex organizations
• Exceptional people management and development skills

• Experience with educating clients on various mortgage programs

• Knowledge and understanding of sales prospecting and generating referrals
• Experience developing and cultivating professional relationships

• Customer service experience

About this role:

Wells Fargo is seeking an Associate Personal Banker (SAFE) to join our National Branch. In this frontline role, you will build relationships with customers by supporting everyday banking needs through in‑branch interactions, scheduled conversations, and proactive outreach. You will learn about customers’ goals and connect them to the right banking products, services, and digital tools to help them manage their finances with confidence.

You will support account openings, service requests, and credit applications while working closely with branch teammates to deliver a consistent, high-quality customer experience. Success is driven by strong relationship building, sound judgment, and the ability to balance service with growth.

As a member of a leading financial institution, this role provides a strong foundation for long-term career growth and mobility, supported by Wells Fargo’s training and coaching.

In this role you will:

• Build lasting customer relationships through proactive, meaningful conversations that support financial well-being and deepen engagement
• Lead discovery-driven conversations to understand customer needs and connect them with relevant banking products, services, and solutions
• Drive branch growth by identifying opportunities, promoting solutions, and making appropriate referrals to meet customer and business goals
• Support everyday banking needs, including new account openings, service requests, and credit applications
• Perform cash handling and teller line activities, accurately processing transactions while maintaining compliance and operational standards
• Demonstrate comfort using and adopting digital tools and technologies to enhance the customer experience and support evolving banking needs
• Deliver accurate, compliant service while exercising sound judgement within defined risk controls
• Collaborate with branch teammates to coordinate seamless handoffs to licensed bankers or other specialists, ensuring customers are connected to the right expertise

• 6+ months of interacting with customers experience, or equivalent demonstrated through one or a combination of the following: work experience, training, military experience, education

• Prior experience in financial services or a highly regulated, customer-facing role, demonstrating comfort with structured processes, accuracy, and service expectations
• Experience building trust-based customer relationships through active listening, follow-up, and consistent engagement
• Comfort initiating outreach (calls, emails, or other channels) to strengthen relationships and identify opportunities to support customer needs
• Demonstrated comfort with digital tools and technology, with the ability to quickly learn new systems and confidently guide customers in adopting capabilities that enhance their banking experience
• Ability to identify customer needs and connect them to appropriate solutions, including referrals when additional expertise is needed
• Proven ability to collaborate with teammates and partners to resolve needs and deliver a seamless customer experience
• Demonstrated ability to follow policies and regulations while identifying and escalating risk concerns

Job Expectations:

• Ability to work a schedule that will include Saturdays
• Support branch operations by flexing between cash handling and customer banking activities, with an emphasis on delivering strong service through account openings and ongoing account support.

jobs.description:
Airbus is committed to providing reasonable accommodations as an Equal Opportunity Employer to applicants with disabilities. If you require assistance or an accommodation to complete your application, please contact us at USCareers@airbus.com

Job Description:

Position Summary

The Cabin Engineer will work in the F2F Department developing solutions to a variety of simple to complex engineering problems requiring judgment and ingenuity. This role is a key driver for modernizing our processes by applying digitalization and automation techniques to improve efficiency, quality, and data-driven decision-making. The cabin engineer works with internal customers and the manufacturer for the coordination of the 2D/3D Design.

Meet the team:

Our Engineers have the privilege of working on complex, highly engineered machines and are involved at all stages of the aircraft life cycle, from product development to manufacturing and direct support to our airline customers. If you’re interested in designing, creating, and testing the present and future of Airbus products across the globe, join our mission to connect the world.

Your working environment:

The Engineering Center in Mobile, Alabama houses hundreds of Airbus engineers who assist in the design and development of Airbus commercial aircraft cabins, including aftermarket upgrades, reconfigurations and services of all product types across the globe.

Your challenges:

• Support Design & Engineering Delivery: 40%
• Assist with updating and revising 2D/3D models based on manufacturing and design requirements under senior supervision.
• Help track customization milestones and support project deliverables through the engineering change process.
• Coordinate with cross-functional teams (stress engineers, drafters, and designers) to support design manufacturability.
• Help identify recurring design issues and contribute to developing scripted or automated solutions.
• Assist in creating project deliverables, including draft feasibility studies, integration plans, and clash investigations.
• Support automation initiatives by maintaining routine engineering reports, data analysis workflows, and documentation.
• Provide design input during team reviews to support robust project planning.
• Prepare engineering models and documentation following standard templates, company standards, and regulatory requirements.
• Gather and organize test and certification data for review by senior engineers and compliance leads.
• Offer suggestions for improving cabin design and engineering process efficiency.
• Process Automation & Scripting: Basic proficiency in Python to assist with automating repetitive tasks (e.g., document checks, report generation) and parsing technical data. Exposure to data manipulation libraries like Pandas is a plus.
• Workflow & Collaboration Tools: Ability to use Google Apps Scripts or built-in Workspace features to help streamline team workflows, consolidate data, and support report/dashboard updates within Google Workspace (Sheets, Docs, Drive).
• Data Extraction & Web Tools: Basic experience or willingness to learn web automation tools (such as Selenium) to help extract data and interact with internal applications or supplier portals.
• AI & Future Technologies Mindset: Eagerness to explore and utilize Google Gemini ecosystem tools (Gemini web app, Workspace integrations) to enhance daily research, drafting, and problem-solving workflows.
• Adaptability & Learning: Strong willingness to learn new digital tools, follow team coding standards, and apply digital toolsets to everyday engineering support tasks.

Your boarding pass:

• Bachelor of Science (BS) Degree in Engineering (Aero, Civil, Mechanical, Electrical)
• 0 to 3 years total experience in design/analysis with cabin and cargo and/or system installation projects.
• Candidates must have strong proficiency using Google G Suite.
• Demonstrate a willingness to learn and be proactive working with teams.
• Demonstrate flexibility regarding the changing working environment.
• Must have the ability to write reports, specifications, work statements, requirements and other technical documents.
• ​Have excellent communication skills, both written and verbal
• Detailed-oriented with excellent proof-reading and writing skills
• Effective communication skills in English
• Must be able to present information and answer questions related to produced documentation.
• Provides a clear communication link between vendors and the engineering team.
• Communicate frequently with other departments internally, externally and internationally.
• ​CAD experience is essential with Catia V5. Strong capability in MS Office/Google Products. Ability to learn new tool sets as required.
• Ability to independently develop, communicate and recommend changes to processes and procedures.
• Ability to direct and facilitate Problem Solving activities and track progress to completion.
• Authorized to Work in the US

Preferred Knowledge, Skills, Demonstrated Capabilities

• Experience with Airbus cabin and cargo engineering
• French, German, or Spanish skills a plus
• Experience with PDM (TAKSY, PASS-SSI)
• Master of Science (MS) degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Civil, or Aerospace Engineering.
• Internship in the aerospace engineering field.

​Travel Required

• 10 % Domestic and International

Physical Requirements

• Onsite or remote: Minimum 80% onsite and 20% remote.
• Vision: Daily able to see and read computer screens and other electronic equipment with screens; able to read documents, reports, and engineering drawings.
• Hearing: Daily able to participate in conversations in person and via teleconference or phone, and to hear sounds on the production floor including safety warnings or alarms.
• Speaking: Daily able to speak in conversations and meetings, deliver information, and participate in communications.
• Daily Equipment Operation: Able to operate most office and personal electronic equipment (personal computer, telephone, copies, fax machine, and electronic identification card for building entry).
• Carrying: Daily able to carry documents, tools, drawings, and electronic equipment up to 10 lbs.
• Sitting/Standing/Walking: Daily able to sit for long periods of time in meetings or working on a computer ; stand for discussions in offices or on the production floor ; and walk through office and production areas including uneven surfaces.
• Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) Required: Required PPE includes, but is not limited to, Safety Shoes, Safety Glasses, Hearing Protection, Respirators/Masks, and/or Protective Gloves as required by site and/or customer site. Steel-toed shoes are required for all shop floor visits; appropriate hearing/eye protection may also be required when visiting the shop floor.

jobs.title: STAGE 2027 – Ingénieur Performance Financière et Opérationnelle Qualité (ALL GENDER)
jobs.description:
Job Description:

En quête d’une première expérience qui fait la différence ?

Rejoins Airbus Atlantic et donne une trajectoire unique à ton parcours grâce à ce stage.

Nous sommes un leader mondial sur le marché des aérostructures, des sièges pilotes et des fauteuils passagers premium.

Dans le cadre de votre formation initiale, vous recherchez un stage obligatoire ou intégré dans une année de césure, d’une durée de 4 à 6 mois, vous permettant de valider votre année.

Une offre de stage intitulée « STAGE 2027 – Ingénieur Performance Financière et Opérationnelle Qualité (ALL GENDER) » vient de s'ouvrir au sein d’Airbus Atlantic sur le site de Montoir-de-Bretagne.

Cette mission débutera en février 2027 (date sujette à flexibilité) pour une durée de 6 mois.

Découvrez le site en vidéo :

Retrouvez Airbus Atlantic en vidéo et la Présentation du site de Montoir de Bretagne

Tâches et responsabilités :

Vous rejoindrez une équipe de 280 personnes au sein du département  Qualité, et plus précisément de l’équipe en charge du management de la performance opérationnelle et financière.

Piloter c’est savoir prévoir, mesurer et réagir en cas d’écart. Pour se faire, il est important d’avoir des outils efficaces et adaptés aux utilisateurs.

Encadré par votre tuteur, vous interviendrez sur les activités suivantes :

Diagnostic terrain et audit des écarts

• Réaliser une immersion auprès des équipes opérationnelles Qualité pour comprendre les processus métier, les flux de travail et les inducteurs de charge.
• Prendre en main l'outil de modélisation prévisionnelle de la charge et cartographier les paramètres d'entrée.
• Analyser les écarts entre les données théoriques de l'outil et la réalité terrain, en collaboration étroite avec les managers Qualité et le Contrôle de Gestion Finance.

Analyse des causes et résolution de problèmes

• Réaliser une analyse des causes racines sur les dérives constatées (écarts de temps de traitement, volumes de livrables, arbitrages de ressources).
• Évaluer la cohérence globale entre la planification de la charge et les indicateurs de performance opérationnelle.
• Définir et formaliser un plan d'actions correctives avec les parties prenantes.

Évolution de l'outil et intégration de nouvelles technologies

• Concevoir, tester et déployer des évolutions ergonomiques et fonctionnelles sur l'outil de pilotage pour en faciliter l'appropriation au quotidien.
• Explorer et expérimenter l'intégration de briques d'Intelligence Artificielle ou d'automatisation pour optimiser le traitement des données de charge.

Durant votre stage, vous développerez les compétences suivantes en lien avec votre formation

• Ingénierie du Pilotage de Performance & Contrôle de Gestion Opérationnel : Capacité à auditer un système de planification de charge, à identifier les écarts entre théorique et réel, et à modéliser des indicateurs de performance fiables (KPI).
• Data Analytics & Digitalisation des Procédés : Traitement, structuration et analyse de jeux de données complexes, optimisation d'outils d'aide à la décision et expérimentation de solutions basées sur l'Intelligence Artificielle.
• Conduite de Projet de Transformation & Resolution de Problèmes : Utilisation de méthodes d'analyse de causes (Ishikawa, 5 Pourquoi), élaboration de plans d'actions correctives et déploiement de solutions d'amélioration continue.
• Conduite du Changement & Posture Conseil en Milieu Industrialisé : Démarche d'immersion terrain, recueil du besoin auprès d'interlocuteurs pluridisciplinaires (Qualité, Finance, Managers) et accompagnement des utilisateurs lors des évolutions d'outils.

Parlons de VOUS !

Vous préparez actuellement un diplôme de niveau Bac +5 (ou équivalent) dans le domaine du management les entreprises, de l’ingénierie ou une discipline apparentée.

Vous avez les connaissances et compétences suivantes :

• Principes du management de la performance, du contrôle de gestion opérationnel et de l'amélioration continue (Lean, 5S, VSM).
• Concepts généraux d'organisation industrielle et de gestion des ressources.
• Maîtrise avancée du traitement de données (Excel avancé, Power BI ou équivalent) et appétence pour l'expérimentation d'outils IA / Data.Capacités de modélisation de données, de synthèses d'écarts et de calcul de ratios de performance.
• Savoir être : Curiosité, Esprit d'équipe, Bonne communication,Capacité d'adaptation
• Anglais : intermédiaire
• Français : courant

Parlons de NOUS !

Rejoindre Airbus Atlantic en tant que stagiaire, c'est :

• Participer à des projets ambitieux, à la pointe de la technologie, visant à construire l’avion de demain tout en répondant aux défis environnementaux,
• Acquérir des compétences dans un environnement dynamique qui encourage la créativité et l'initiative, avec une approche entrepreneuriale,
• Évoluer au sein d'une organisation solidaire, qui valorise la proximité et l'humain.

Notre processus de sélection

Toutes les candidatures seront soigneusement examinées par un recruteur.

Si votre candidature est présélectionnée, vous serez invité à réaliser un entretien vidéo afin de vous présenter.

Après évaluation, les candidats retenus seront contactés pour un entretien avec le manager ou le tuteur qui procédera alors à la sélection finale.

Job Description:

Airbus is a leading aircraft manufacturer with the most modern and comprehensive family of airliners on the market, ranging in capacity from 100 to more than 500 seats. Airbus champions innovative technologies and offers some of the world’s most fuel efficient and quiet aircraft. Airbus has sold over 13.800 aircraft to more than 360 customers worldwide. Airbus has achieved more than 8,000 deliveries since the first Airbus aircraft entered into service. Headquartered in Toulouse, France.

Contact Data

Please apply on line for this vacancy using your eRecruiting profile with your CV attached.

By submitting your CV or application, you are consenting to Airbus Group using and storing information about you for monitoring purposes relating to your application or future employment. This information will only be used by Airbus Group.

Description of the job

We keep them flying at any time and all around the world !

When A/C structure is damaged, it requires a quick restoration …

Typically, passengers are waiting to take-off, and Airlines are losing money…

We are developing engineers’ ability to establish and deliver, for all fleets, timely and consistent solutions to the technical daily queries raised by the customer support for Technical issues in operations.

A mission for Workflow Manager has arisen within the Fuselage Daily Repairs team at Airbus Commercial Aircraft in Wichita.

You will join Fuselage team in Wichita ( Kansas - US) which provides the repair instructions (definition and justification) following damages reported by airlines (linked to events or during maintenance operations). This includes the steering of the customer in case of deviations observed on aircraft and/or the associated repair.

The Repair definition must be delivered within deadlines set by customer support in accordance with the airlines requirements, in order to guarantee the aircraft return to service in due time.

The portfolio of customer queries is clustered in two main types such as Repair queries (queries that are caused by environmental or accidental damages and which represent the majority) and Engineering queries (deviations from standard product definition and which represent the minority).

Tasks & accountabilities

As workflow manager you will be responsible for the distribution of customer queries which is a key role for the repair engineering team in the frame of our 24/7 support involving Airbus Offshore centres and subcontractors around the world.

Your main tasks and responsibilities will include:

• Assessing the customer daily queries with respect to data completeness, workload, complexity
• Allocating them to our teams and suppliers, anticipating impacts on target dates in line with respective office hours for each team.
• Monitoring progress and ensuring On Time Delivery is met.
• Defining priorities in cooperation with Customer Services department.
• Planning Long-term Queries that can be anticipated, e.g. A/C de-lease checks, review of approval documents in the frame of life extensions, retrofits, weight variant changes
• Supporting team capacity daily assessment, anticipating critical gaps and/or alerting line managers and partners.
• Securing the yearly resource planning matches the capacity need considering workload assumptions from Customer Services and general phases throughout the year, e.g. less maintenance during the summer period.
• Identifying and leading improvement initiatives to the workflow process looking for transverse harmonization,
• Measuring the key performance indicators such as OTD (On Time Delivery) and effort per unit to anticipate cost relevant effects, triggering relevant root cause assessments and corrective actions in case of deviation and/or anticipation of changes.

This job requires an awareness of any potential compliance risks and a commitment to act with integrity, as the foundation for the Company’s success, reputation and sustainable growth.

Required skills

As the successful candidate you are able to demonstrate the following skills and competences:

• Holds an Engineering Degree or equivalent relevant experience in an engineering environment.
• Experience in aircraft structures is mandatory (knowledge of Fuselage structures ATA 52/53 is a plus)
• Understanding of Design, Stress, Methods & Principles, and Airworthiness requirements when designing aircraft structure
• Knowledge of Customer Operations, product Integrity / Liability and maintenance operation would be appreciated
• Negotiation level in English and in French is mandatory

In addition you are showing the following abilities:

• Ability to perform in a high pressure reactive environment and to quickly make decisions
• Ability to translate customer requirements into operational deliverables and to prioritize
• Ability to interface with others and discuss technical matters clearly and simply
• Ability to collaborate well within a team, to work independently when required
• Customer mindset and solution oriented
• Good communication and influencing skills
