jobs.description:
Job Description:

In order to support the Commodity Procurement IT Infrastructure, Airbus Defence and Space is offering an

Internship within Commodity Management for IT Infrastructure (d/f/m)

Are you looking for an internship and want to get to know the work of a Buyer/Commodity Manager for IT Infrastructure (d/f/m)? Then apply now! We look forward to you supporting us at Commodity Procurement IT Infrastructure as an intern (d/f/m)!

• Location: Taufkirchen/Ottobrunn
• Start: 01.04.2027
• Duration: 6 months

As an intern (d/f/m) you will acquire an in-depth insight into divisional sourcing for IT Infrastructure for products and external customers.

The internship covers three main learning areas: IT Demand Management and Standardisation, which involves learning how Airbus aggregates and standardises IT demands for complexity reduction and procurement efficiency; Supplier Evaluation and Development, focusing on the rigorous assessment and continuous improvement of the supplier base; and Strategic Supplier Landscape Development, where the intern contributes to the long-term evolution of the supplier base by analysing market trends, managing risk, and developing resilient sourcing strategies.

By engaging in these activities, you will receive practical exposure to the full lifecycle of commodity management, from initial demand planning and strategic sourcing to ongoing supplier relationship management and development within a leading global aerospace and defence context.

Your location

Our site is just a stone's throw away from Munich, the beautiful capital of Bavaria. Are you into sports and other outdoor activities? The Alps and Lake Starnberg are within an hour’s reach, offering a multitude of recreational options.

Your benefits

• Attractive salary and work-life balance with a 35-hour week (flexitime).
• A final thesis is possible after consultation with the department.
• International environment with the opportunity to network globally.
• Work with modern/diversified technologies.
• At Airbus, we see you as a valuable team member and you are not hired to brew coffee, instead you are in close contact with the interfaces and are part of our weekly team meetings.
• Opportunity to participate in the Generation Airbus Community to expand your own network.

Your tasks and responsibilities

• Assisting in the identification and gathering of purchasing potentials.
• Support and launch RFI (Request for Information) /RFP (Request for Proposal) events (via the Airbus Defence & Space procurement tool) and follow up the ordering process.
• Preparation of negotiation results and supplier proposals.
• Assisting in the creation of the respective commodity- and supplier strategies.
• Special tasks. e.g. project tasks to support team leaders.

jobs.description:
Job Description:

Für Airbus Defence and Space in Ottobrunn suchen wir für den Bereich „Welfare Devops“ einen IT Cloud Engineer (d/m/w).

Wir betreiben weltweit IT-Infrastrukturen und sichere Kommunikationsnetze für unsere Kunden.

Dein Profil

Du bist Fachexperte für Softwareentwicklung im Fokus auf Web-Applikationen. Du hast Ideen zur Implementierung neuer Technologien und kannst diese anhand von technischen Anforderungen bewerten. Du bist kreativ und lösungsorientiert und findest auch zu komplexen Anforderungen funktionierende Lösungen. Du besitzt das übertragbare KnowHow über neu entstandene Technologien, sowie die Fähigkeit zukünftige IT Strategien mit zu entwickeln.

Dein Standort

Unser Standort ist nur einen Katzensprung von München, der schönen Hauptstadt von Bayern, entfernt. Du magst Sport und andere Outdoor-Aktivitäten? Die Alpen und der Starnberger See sind in einer Stunde zu erreichen und bieten eine Vielzahl von Freizeitaktivitäten.

Deine Vorteile

• Attraktive Vergütung und Sonderzahlungen
• 30 Tage Urlaub und zusätzliche freie Tage für besondere Anlässe
• Hervorragende Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten und tolle Entwicklungsperspektiven
• Sonderleistungen: arbeitgeberfinanzierte Altersvorsorge, Mitarbeiteraktienoptionen, vergünstigtes Auto Leasing, Sonderkonditionen bei Versicherungen, Fahrtkostenzuschuss, Mitarbeitervorteile bei kooperierenden Unternehmen
• Vor-Ort-Einrichtungen: standortnaher Kindergarten, Vertrauensarzt für Vorsorgeuntersuchungen und andere gesundheitsbezogene Dienstleistungen, Kantine und Cafeteria, Reinigung, Fitness Studio

Deine Hauptaufgaben

• Betrieb und Weiterentwicklung der selbstgehosteten On-Prem-Kubernetes-Plattform (Rancher, Fleet, RKE2, GitOps)
• Definition von Plattform-Standards, Best Practices für Deployment, Betrieb und Security
• Konzeption und Betrieb von Storage-Anbindungen
• Architektur und Betrieb von Secrets- und Identity-Management (OpenBao/Vault, Keycloak, External Secrets Operator)
• Fachliche Steuerung der In-House-Softwareentwicklung: Design, Qualität und Deployment eigener Services
• Aufbau und Governance von CI/CD-Pipelines sowie Artefakt-/Registry-Management (GitLab Runner, Nexus)
• Betrieb und Weiterentwicklung für Backup/Restore/Disaster Recovery (Velero) und Security-Hardening

Deine Kenntnisse und Qualifikationen

• Abgeschlossenes Studium der Informatik oder vergleichbare Qualifikation bzw. gleichwertige berufliche Kenntnisse
• Mehrjährige, Erfahrung im produktiven Betrieb von Kubernetes-Umgebungen notwendig (idealerweise selbstgehostet)
• Fundierte Kenntnisse in GitOps (Fleet), Infrastructure as Code (Terraform) und CI/CD erforderlich
• Kenntnisse in Secrets Management (Vault/OpenBao) und IAM (Keycloak, OIDC/OAuth) erforderlich
• Sicherer Umgang mit mindestens einer Systemsprache (JavaScript, Python, PHP) sowie Scripting (Bash) von Vorteil

• Erfahrung mit Security-Hardening und Netzwerksegmentierung
• Sprachkenntnisse: Deutsch fließend, Englisch fortgeschritten
• Du bringst Sinn für Humor mit und freust Dich auf die Zusammenarbeit in einem dynamischen und jungen Team

jobs.title: Strukturmechaniker A350 (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Job Description:

Dein neuer Arbeitsplatz: Die Zukunft des Fliegens

Du bist handwerklich geschickt, arbeitest präzise und suchst innovative Tätigkeiten? In der A350-Fertigung werden deine Fähigkeiten auf ein neues Level gehoben. Egal ob du gelernt hast, Holz zu bearbeiten, Autos zu reparieren oder Metall zu formen: Wir bringen dir qualifiziert bei, wie man Flugzeuge baut.

Du arbeitest am Airbus A350, dem modernsten Langstreckenflugzeug der Welt, und montierst Strukturbauteile aus Faserverbundwerkstoffen (CFK/GFK).

Dein Arbeitsort direkt an der Weser:

Du arbeitest in Nordenham zwischen Wattenmeer und Unterweser, geprägt durch landschaftliche Idylle und kilometerweite Sicht bis zum Horizont. Für Großstadtfeeling sind Bremerhaven, Bremen und Oldenburg im pendelbaren Umkreis.

Das Erlebnis A350-Fertigung – Was Dich erwartet:

• High-Tech statt Werkstatt: Die A350-Fertigung ist eine saubere, hochmoderne Umgebung. Da wir viel mit Carbon (CFK) arbeiten, ist der Arbeitsplatz leiser und technologisch fortschrittlicher als im klassischen Metallbau.
• Sichtbares Ergebnis: Du bearbeitest Flugzeugschalen und fügst diese zu Sektionen zusammen. Am Ende deiner Schicht siehst du, was du geschaffen hast.
• Stolz & Verantwortung: Jedes Bauteil, das du montierst, wird um die Welt fliegen. Deshalb steht Qualität bei uns an erster Stelle.

Deine Aufgaben bei uns an Board:

• Montage: Du wirst Strukturbauteile und Halterbauteile positionieren, bohren, senken, reiben, kitten, kleben und schrauben.
• Vorbereitung: Du sichtest Bauunterlagen und Aufträge, rüstest deinen Bauplatz auf und prüfst die Fertigungsmittel.
• Dokumentation: Du dokumentierst deine durchgeführten Montageschritte ordnungsgemäß und führst bei Abweichungen Nacharbeiten und Reparaturen in deinem Arbeitsfeld durch.

Dein Boardingpass:

• Gewerbliche Ausbildung in einem handwerklichen oder industriellen Beruf, wie z. B. Kfz-Mechatroniker, Industriemechaniker, Schlosser, Metallbauer, Tischler, Bootsbauer oder Verfahrensmechaniker
• Mindestens zwei Jahre Berufserfahrung im oben genannten Bereich
• Sehr gute Deutsch- und grundlegende Englischkenntnisse
• Qualitätsbewusste Arbeitsweise und hohe Auffassungsgabe
• Bereitschaft zur Schichtarbeit im 3-Schicht-System

Deine Vorteile:

• Attraktive Vergütung und Sonderzahlungen

jobs.title: Aircraft Security Architect
jobs.description:
Job Description:

SUMMARY

Are you a Cyber Security Architect ready to take on new and exciting challenges?... Do you dare to accept the challenge of working for a worldwide aerospace leader company?...

If you are a highly motivated Engineer, working in Cyber Security field that counts with real work experience in Risk Analysis Methodologies, designing Security Architectures, strong infrastructure and/or secure development background, and real passion for Cyber Security, If you are ready for to be part of the current cybersecurity revolution in the Aeronautic Industry this position is what you're looking for…

Airbus gives you the opportunity to apply for it!... You will feel challenged with a job that won't bore you!...

We are looking for a Cyber Security Architect to join our Product Security team within engineering organization in Airbus Defence & Space in Getafe (Madrid).

You will be key in ensuring that the Airbus Defence and Space Products and supporting services are protected against cybersecurity threats throughout their entire lifecycle (i.e. from early R&T phases, definition, development, implementation, industrialization, operation, maintenance and support, through to end of life and disposal). You will work in a new and challenging international environment where cyber security is becoming and continuously growing as a key factor for all products designed and manufactured by Airbus Defence and Space.

TASKS & RESPONSIBILITIES

You will be in charge of the product security requirements definition, design, implementation, integration, test, verification and compliance.

As a Cyber Security Architect you will drive the definition of product security architectures and design in accordance to their security requirements derived from the security risk assessments using methodologies and tools like MAGERIT (PILAR), NIST, EBIOS, EUROCAE ED202A, 203A. You will specify what security controls are to be applied and where in the overall, associated product architecture.

You will contribute to guarantee that the Airbus Defence and Space Products are inherently secure by design and they fulfil the security requirements in accordance to the applicable national/international security regulations.

You will work in a very close collaboration with all the relevant stakeholders (e.g. Customer, Program manager, Chief engineer,…) for accomplishing the product security milestones for the different programs.

As a Cyber Security Architect the main responsibilities will be to:

• Have a collaborative mindset, and be a real team player.
• Challenge traditional ways of thinking and propose new ideas and new ways of working.
• Lead and manage the security aspects of the Products through their entire lifecycle.
• Provide cybersecurity consultancy and advisory to business projects.
• Adopt and promote a security-by-design approach with the different projects stakeholders.
• Proactively contribute to the business solutions’ architecture and design to manage and reduce risks.
• Conduct the security risk assessments on the Products (including threat and vulnerability assessment) using tools and methodologies like MAGERIT, PILAR, NIST, EBIOS, EUROCAE ED202A and ED203B.
• Define the security requirements to mitigate the security risks.
• Design the security architectures in accordance to the security requirements.
• Decompose the high-level security design into low-level detailed security designs for each sub-system or component.
• Ensure the security compliance of the Products in accordance to the national and international security regulations in accordance to the applicable criteria and methodologies (CC/CEM, ITSEC/ITSEM, CCN-STICs...).
• Drive the definition, development and deployment of the Security Operating Procedures in order to ensure the security maintenance of the Products along their entire lifecycle.
• Act as the product security focal point in your domain.
• Participate in meetings with the Customer and lead the Customer on our Product Security approach.
• Participate in the Airbus international working groups.
• Ensure the good reporting for your activity.

REQUIREMENTS

Soft Skills
- Excellent interpersonal and Leadership skills.
- Highly innovative mindset and permanently challenging the status quo.
- Passionate about Aircrafts, Security and Technology.
- In depth interest to Engineering matters.
- Ability to learn and grow in an evolving environment.
- Excellent written and oral communication skills.
- Ability to work in an environment that requires a high level of detail and confidentiality.
- Proactive, self-motivated with the ability to work independently and as a team member in a challenging environment.
- Able to work autonomously as well as in international teams.
- Strong customer focus and result orientation.
- Strong team player.

Technical Skills
- Bachelors or Master in Telecommunication Engineer or Aeronautical Engineer or Computer Science.
- At least 3 years of experience in Information Security and/or Aircraft Systems design and development and/or Aircraft Safety.

- Threats and risk analysis methods and tools used (MAGERIT, PILAR, NYST, EBIOS, EUROCAE ED203A...)

- Strong knowledge and experience in Systems and applications security architecture design.∙

- Strong knowledge of network and application security architecture and operating systems.

- Knowledge of how to secure systems (application and infrastructure) and implement hardening in systems.

- Functional Security Test and penetration/refutation Testing
- Able to adapt to new regulations and methods of applying the security concepts and to a new environment like A/C systems

- Able to write clear and consumable security documentation.
- Advanced level of English.
- Good command of French or German is an advantage but not essential.

Airbus benefits

At Airbus we are focused on our employees and their welfare. Take a look at some of our social benefits:

• Flexible workshift
• Option of continuous schedule from May to September
• Vacation days plus additional days-off along the year (+35 working days off in total)
• Attractive & competitive salary and additional bonus
• Hybrid model of working when possible, promoting the work-life balance
• Collective transport service in some sites
• Benefits such as health insurance, employee stock options, retirement plan, or study grants
• On-site facilities (among others): free canteen, kindergarten, medical office
• Possibility to collaborate in different social and corporate social responsibility initiatives
• Excellent upskilling opportunities and great development prospects in a multicultural environment
• Special rates in in a wide range of products & other benefits

The successful candidate will be subjected to a NATO/National security clearance in order to undertake related work in accordance with the business needs.

This role will involve occasional travel for business.

jobs.title: Airbus Atlantic - Architecte Industriel (All Gender)
jobs.description:
Job Description:

Chez Airbus Atlantic, on façonne l’aéronautique de demain !

Nous vous proposons de rejoindre Airbus Atlantic, leader industriel mondial en matière d'aérostructures, de sièges pilotes et de fauteuils passagers de classe affaires et de première classe. Nous innovons sans cesse pour définir de nouveaux standards d’excellence industrielle. Nous préparons le futur pour une industrie aérospatiale compétitive et durable.

Etes-vous notre prochain Architecte Industriel (All Gender) ?

🎯 Votre mission
Au sein de notre site de Montoir de Bretagne, ce poste est rattaché aux activités des Architectes Industriels au sein du département R&T Fuselage. Les activités de R&T (Recherche et Technologie) et de R&D (Recherche et Développement) sont menées conjointement pour répondre aux ambitions du programme "Avion du Futur". Dans ce contexte, l'approche de co-développement (Industrie et Produit) est un facteur clé de succès. Elle implique la coordination d'une équipe pluridisciplinaire regroupant de nombreuses compétences, disciplines et fonctions.

Ces activités sont également soutenues par des dispositifs de financement nationaux, tels que le CORAC (Comité pour la Recherche Aéronautique Civile).

L'équipe des Architectes Industriels Fuselage d'Airbus recherche un profil pour rejoindre l'équipe R&T au sein du programme « Transport Payload ».

Votre rôle est de garantir que le concept industriel choisi est le plus performant possible (coût, qualité, cycle).

• Conception du Système : Vous définissez comment sera fabriqué le fuselage avant, des pièces élémentaires (métalliques et composites) jusqu'à l'assemblage final.
• Maturation Technologique : Vous pilotez les niveaux de maturité industrielle (MRL) et identifiez les besoins en démonstrateurs pour valider les nouvelles technologies.
• Arbitrage Product/Process : Vous challengez les exigences de conception pour assurer la fabricabilité et l'optimisation des coûts (analyse des cost drivers).
• Piloter le développement des technologies transversales et des capacités industrielles pour l'ensemble du fuselage, notamment en matière de protection des surfaces, en collaboration avec l'équipe des technologues industriels et l'équipe robotique.

Responsabilités et Livrables Clés

Vous agissez comme le "chef d'orchestre" industriel sur votre périmètre :

• Dossiers Techniques : Rédaction de l'IBD (Industrial Baseline Dossier) et des fiches de tâches pour les projets subventionnés (NAMI 2).
• Performance : Analyse des indicateurs de mérite (FoM) pour justifier les choix industriels.
• Coordination : Animation d'une équipe pluridisciplinaire (Engineering, Achats, Qualité, Finance) et suivi du budget alloué.
• Interface Usine : Lien direct avec les usines et les lignes d'assemblage (FAL) pour préparer l'industrialisation future.

🛠️ Votre profil (Ce qui fera la différence)

• Expérience : Expérience confirmée en planification d'usine, conception de lignes de production Lean et ingénierie système.
• Expertise technique : Connaissances approfondies des matériaux métalliques et composites, ainsi que de leurs processus de fabrication.
• Assemblage : Maîtrise de l'assemblage structurel aéronautique (MCA - Major Component Assembly et FAL - Final Assembly Line).
• Outils : Maîtrise de la gestion des exigences industrielles, ainsi que des logiciels 3DX (3DExperience) et Anylogic.
• Soft Skills : Capacité de prise de décision, esprit d'équipe, aisance relationnelle avec des interlocuteurs variés et capacité à vulgariser des sujets techniques complexes.
• Langues : Anglais et Français courant impératif. La maîtrise de l'allemand ou de l'espagnol est un plus.

💎 Notre entreprise

• Boostez votre carrière : Un accompagnement sur-mesure et mobilité interne boostée.
• Équilibre vie pro/vie perso : Bénéficiez de 6 semaines de congés payés et de RTT.
• Package attractif : Plan d’épargne salariale, actionnariat salarié et une mutuelle individuelle ou familiale.
• Engagement au quotidien : Incitation financière à la mobilité durable (vélo, covoiturage, transports) et opportunité de participer à des projets caritatifs et sociaux stimulants.
• Qualité de vie : Restaurant d’entreprise et un CSE dynamique (loisirs, culture, vacances).
• Culture inclusive : La diversité fait partie de notre ADN.

✈️ Le site de Montoir
Le site Airbus Atlantic de Montoir-de-Bretagne, qualifié d’intégrateur ou de pré-chaîne d’assemblage final, assemble, équipe et teste les fuselages avant et centraux de tous les avions Airbus hormis l’A220. Véritable Hub Logistique d’Airbus Atlantic, le site livre ses “Major Component Assemblies” directement aux chaînes d’assemblage final Airbus de Toulouse, Hambourg, Mobile ou encore Tianjin, par Beluga ou bateau.

jobs.title: Repair Ordering Officer
jobs.description:
Job Description:

Position Summary

The Repair Ordering Officer executes day-to-day transactional, technical, and administrative processing of Repair Orders within Airbus Flight Hour Services (FHS). The jobholder is primarily responsible for the on-time creation and revision of Repair Orders, operating the team inbox Kuala Lumpur Repair Ordering (KULROO), maintaining aircraft data and utilization records in FHS Management Information System (MIS), and supporting unserviceable blockage root-cause resolutions within his/her scope. Additionally, the role provides operational support for Repair Order Blockages (ROB), task closures, and team training routines.

Primary Responsibilities

Repair Order Operations

• Responsible for the on-time creation of Repair Orders (RO) and closure of Repair Order Blockages (ROB) to maintain fleet flow within target window
• Maintain and update operational tracking files as a single source of truth to monitor workload volumes, track operational performance and ensure real-time visibility of repair order management.
• Manage the KULROO inbox mail by analyzing ad-hoc customer and operational requests, providing prompt technical support within Repair Ordering scope.
• Revise Repair Order based on customer requirements, including amending Part Numbers, Serial Numbers, removal reasons, and ageing data for Time-Controlled Items following defined checklists
• Ensure transactional data processing and order alignment for ad-hoc tasks, projects, retrofit modification and specialized campaigns
• Perform routine RO Quality Control through monthly analysis
• Perform non-standard Repair Order regularizations and system alignments to ensure continuous operational compliance and accuracy.
• Manage the administrative closure of delivery tasks, including drop-shipment repair orders and supplier loan closures.

MIS Data Governance

• Maintain accurate aircraft configuration records in FHS MIS based on customer portal inputs and engineering technical documentation
• Update aircraft utilization figures (Flight Hours and Flight Cycles) in FHS MIS, ensuring rigorous adherence to standard operating procedures and individual data-entry precision.
• Execute the resolution of standard abnormal situations, coordinating with stakeholders across the FHS community to ensure complete clearing of abnormal statuses

Root-Cause Analysis and Process Improvement

• Log and flag recurring drivers of blockages during RO creation
• Review operational ways of working based on root-cause findings, propose updates to KUL RO documentation and working checklists, and contribute to local continuous improvement plans
• Contribute to training materials, operational checklists, and refresher sessions.

Operational Backup

• Support technical investigations on Repair Order inaccuracies, via Component Incident Management (CIM) Card or Practical Problem Solving (PPS) and gathering data on root causes to resolve system anomalies and prevent recurring data errors.
• Support the training of newcomers and subcontractors
• Support automation initiatives

Outputs

• Timely creation, revision, and blockage clearing of Repair Orders, accompanied by resolution of KULROO inbox requests within target
• High data-entry accuracy and zero administrative defects in assigned aircraft configurations, utilization updates (FH/FC), and resolved abnormal MIS cases
• Updated KUL RO operational checklists, and accurate daily action trackers and monitoring files

Qualification & Professional Skills

• Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Business Administration, Aviation Management, or Aviation related fields
• 2 years of experience in Aviation Supply Chain, Logistics, MRO, or Order Management
• Clear understanding of repair ordering workflows, order blockage resolution, and goods receipt procedures
• Familiarity with aircraft configuration tracking and aircraft component ageing data
• Familiarity with Flight Hour Services (FHS) operational schemes or similar Power-by-the-Hour (PBH) support models
• Proficiency in Enterprise Resource Planning systems and operational reporting tools
• Familiarity with visual management tools and daily operational steering frameworks (e.g., SQCDP dashboards)

Intel's Automated Material Handling Systems (AMHS) team is the backbone of our 24x7 manufacturing and foundry operations, ensuring the seamless automated delivery and storage of materials across our state-of-the-art fabrication facilities. jobs.title: Transportation Associate

The Energy & Water team is looking for a Senior Manager in Public Affairs, to lead how we engage in that conversation.

In this role you bring a public affairs lens to water: you understand industry trends and the regulatory landscape, you engage with the right internal and external stakeholders, and translate that understanding into the right messaging, You are the expert who shows up, engages authentically with community members, organizations, public officials, builds lasting relationships , and contributes to an informed, transparent, and productive public dialogue. Public Representation:
Represent Water in public and community settings — open houses, boot camps, hearings, and stakeholder forums— building trusted relationships with officials, regulators, and community stakeholders.

Engage with regulatory bodies, agency staff, elected officials, and policy stakeholders alongside our Public Policy and Legal teams, representing the Water perspective accurately and with sound judgment.

Field live questions about water use, wastewater — including detailed questions from engaged community members and advocacy groups

Engage authentically on water topics in real time — accurately representing Amazon's approach and genuinely addressing community questions

In this role you bring a public affairs lens to water: you understand industry and sector trends and the regulatory landscape, you engage credibly with regulatory bodies and policy audiences, and you translate that understanding into the right messaging, delivered in the right tone, to the right stakeholders.

Work closely with the External Engagement team to ensure Water subject matter is well-represented in event programming

Coordinate with Water SMEs to stay current on technical data (FAQ maintenance, approved stats, updated infrastructure positions)

jobs.description:
Join our dynamic team and become a critical guardian of technological infrastructure! As a Data Center Engineering Technician, you'll play a pivotal role in maintaining the heartbeat of mission-critical technology infrastructure, ensuring seamless operations that power global digital experiences. Your expertise will directly contribute to maintaining an extraordinary 99.999% uptime, keeping the digital world running smoothly and efficiently.

Engineering Technicians are Amazon’s front line when it comes to hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment troubleshooting. They will maintain, operate, and troubleshoot, Data Center Operation’s Mission Critical Facilities, which includes stand-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, as well as three phase electrical systems such as: switch gear, UPSs, PDUs, wet cell batteries and associated systems, CRAC, centrifugal chillers, cooling towers/water chemical system, air handlers and associated systems, pumps, & motors.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

NOTE: Amazon does not sponsor for immigration, including for H-1B, TN, and other non-immigrant visas, for this role.

NOTE: Lump sum stipend will be provided to eligible candidates who relocate for this position.

Key job responsibilities
•	Daily building rounds to monitor and record information from electrical, mechanical, and fire/life safety equipment to ensure 24/7 reliability and availability
•	Monitor Building Management Systems (BMS) and Electrical Power Management System (EPMS)
•	Assist in troubleshooting of facility and rack-level events within internal Service Level Agreements (SLA)
•	Perform rack installs and rack decommissioning within internal SLA

•	Technical writing to support change management program
•	Monitor daily work requests and manage to resolution, and execute projects from conception to completion
•	On-site support of contractors, sub-contractors and vendors, ensuring that all work performed is in accordance with established practices, procedures & local legislation

•	Regularly lift and/or move up to 39 pounds independently

•	Regularly walk, use hands and fingers, handle or feel, reach with hands and arms, stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl, climb stairs, twist, bend, work above shoulders, grasp, carry, push and pull objects into position

jobs.title: New Product Lead , Robotics Supply Chain
jobs.description:
Are you inspired by invention? Is problem solving through teamwork in your DNA? Do you like the idea of seeing how your work impacts the bigger picture? Answer yes to any of these and you’ll fit right in here at Amazon Robotics. We are a smart team of doers that work passionately to apply advances in robotics and software to solve real-world challenges that will transform our customers’ experiences in ways we can’t even imagine yet.

Amazon Robotics has locations in the greater Boston and Seattle area, the epicenter of robotics innovation. Our diverse teams come from all over the world to design, test and build our dynamic fleet of robots, mechatronic systems and pack automation solutions. Having our offices, labs, test floors and factories all co-located means that we can design the hardware, write the code, test, build and watch it all come to life. This allows us to innovate quickly and on limitless ideas. Current advancements are underway in autonomous movement and mobility, artificial intelligence and machine learning, manipulation, simulation, robotic management software, predictive analytics, and much more.

The Amazon Robotics Supply Chain provides strategic sourcing for a portfolio of robotic technologies and is responsible for delivering new products by enabling the right suppliers and technologies, and getting the right materials at the right cost to the right place at the right time to support our network of global fulfillment and transportation solutions. It is a fast-paced operation that works cross-functionally with teams across Amazon and is driven by data and metrics.

We are seeking Robotics Supply Chain New Product Lead - Tech tackle to most critical, technologically advanced products at Amazon.  The Lead will be responsible for a small portfolio of robotic products and accountable for supplier and supply chain strategies, product cost roadmaps, enabling rapid NPI builds, and ensuring a successful ramp to mass production.  They manage their products from concept, through development, to scaled deployment. They work with senior product and engineering leaders to drive appropriate trade-offs between commercial vs. technical constraints, risks and goals.  Within the robotic product they lead, they must be able to drive the multiple advanced technologies and commodities, driving a clear path to production.

Essential to the role is a level of technical subject matter expertise to work effectively with the technical teams developing these robotic products. While it varies by group, this expertise includes an understanding of the technologies and architectures of the robotic products and key commodities that make up the robotic products, including the technology’s development and integration strategy and trajectory, both within Amazon and its wider position in the business and industry.  This role will contribute to technical strategies and decisions, with contributions that balance technical and business requirements, to help drive engineering teams toward scalable products that achieve Amazon’s cost targets.

The RSC New Product Lead - Tech is a trusted subject matter expert, consulted by teams above and below. They clearly communicate with direct and indirect stakeholders, advocating for commercial opportunities at the Director level and above. They contribute to strategic documents for aligning goals with cross-functional teams, own reporting on forecasting and planning the business impact of each opportunity, and regularly report on the status and impact of their contributions. Their impact is measurable via quantifiable metrics, and they have the ability to deeply influence measurable business outcomes.

We are looking for strong business owners who can Think Big, Deliver Results, and leaders who are ready to make long lasting impact to Amazon Robotics technologies. They should be comfortable working in a fast-paced environment where delivery time for new products and features is typically measured in months. The leader will have a proven background in Robotics automation, global supplier management and new product introduction on the development and scaled production of advanced technology. The successful candidate for this position will be experienced working with cross-functional leaders from product, engineering, manufacturing, and field operations.  They are self-managing, have a high sense of urgency and driven to achieve product development and deployment. They will be a highly visible leader that will own the communication, coordination execution, and delivery of a multi-year program vision.

Key job responsibilities
- Support the product development process by working across cross-functional supply chain teams focused on supplier management, supply chain design, sourcing, logistics, and supply chain execution for robotics products from concept through scaled deployment.
- Serve as a key point of contact for program teams to communicate supply chain decisions and progress, share feedback on supply chain implications of program changes, and support financial planning and capital approval processes.
- Partner with Robotics leadership and cross-functional teams — including hardware engineering, operations, and program management — on commodity and supplier selection, cost-performance tradeoff analysis, cost roadmap development, and supporting rapid product development and scaled deployment.
- Support the development of Product-level Supply Chain Strategy documents, including identification of critical components and suppliers, product cost roadmaps, capacity planning, sourcing and tooling requirements, and supply chain risk assessment and mitigation plans.
- Collaborate with sourcing teams to develop negotiation strategies for categories impacting the product, working toward business objectives and building sustainable supplier relationships for Amazon Robotics priority programs aligned to the Operating Plan (OP).
- Work with Global Commodity Managers (GCMs) to support supplier relationship management, including supplier performance, capability development, capacity planning, contracting, risk mitigation, and cost and quality improvements.
- Contribute to roadmap development for achieving NPI and GA total cost targets (TCO), including make vs. buy analysis and value engineering opportunities.
- Support non-cost goals including Sustainability, Supplier Development, and Cost Savings as part of the product-specific supply chain strategy.
- 20–25% travel required.

A day in the life
Amazon offers a full range of benefits that support you and eligible family members, including domestic partners and their children. Benefits can vary by location, the number of regularly scheduled hours you work, length of employment, and job status such as seasonal or temporary employment. The benefits that generally apply to regular, full-time employees include:

1. Medical, Dental, and Vision Coverage
2. Maternity and Parental Leave Options
3. Paid Time Off (PTO)
4. 401(k) Plan

If you are not sure that every qualification on the list above describes you exactly, we'd still love to hear from you! At Amazon, we value people with unique backgrounds, experiences, and skillsets. If you’re passionate about this role and want to make an impact on a global scale, please apply!

About the team
The NPI Supply Chain Product Management team  develops supply chain strategies for new FTR products from concept to general availability. As the central integration point between technical, commercial, and operational teams, we drive PDP adherence and comprehensive supplier readiness oversight. Our vision establishes scalable, cost-effective solutions leveraging AI-driven insights to exceed performance targets. Our mission encompasses end-to-end strategy development through data-driven decisions, comprehensive make-vs-buy frameworks, regional manufacturing strategies, and cross-functional integration with Engineering, Strategic Sourcing, AMQE, and Planning. We maintain accountability for product cost targets, supplier readiness metrics, and program milestones while optimizing total landed cost and operational efficiency across FTR's portfolio.

- 3+ years of business agreements development, negotiation and execution experience
- 3+ years of electrical theory, robotics, controls components, and automated equipment experience
- Experience developing strategies that influence leadership decisions at the organizational level
- Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules
- Experience in taking a product from conception & definition phase through engineering design and taking it to market

jobs.description:
The Amazon Devices Software & Services team is looking for a Software Development Engineer to join a high-velocity, specialized team. This is not a traditional framework or infrastructure role - we are building a new  groundbreaking customer experience that will define how millions of users worldwide interact with their technology - making it more proactive, intuitive, and invisible.

We’re building the systems that put AI into production — the runtime, services, and tooling that turn large language models and autonomous agents into reliable, safe, scalable products. As a Software Development Engineer II, you’ll design and ship core software in this stack: model and tool integrations, the agent execution loop, evaluation and quality pipelines, and the APIs that product teams build on. You’ll own meaningful components end to end, make real design decisions, and write production code that runs against real users and real data.
This is a hands-on building role for an engineer who wants to go deep on AI infrastructure — not just call an API, but engineer the reliability, safety, and performance around it. You’ll also work in an AI-native development environment: we use AI coding assistants and agentic workflows as part of our daily software-development lifecycle, and we hold that velocity to a hard bar of automated testing and code review. We expect engineers who can move fast and keep the quality gates green.

Key job responsibilities
- Invent New Paradigms: Move beyond traditional voice UI to build "Ambient Intelligence" experiences that span Alexa, Fire TV, and mobile/wearable surfaces, focusing on proactive assistance rather than reactive commands.
- Rapid Innovation: Operate in a fast-paced environment where you will prototype, test, and deploy features that leverage multimodal inputs (camera, audio, and documents) to create personalized customer magic.
- Cross-Surface Continuity: Ensure that a customer’s experience is persistent and context-aware beyond the device boundaries - whether they are at their desk using Alexa.com, in their living room with Fire TV, or on the go with a wearable.
- Design, build, test, and operate scalable backend services and libraries that power AI/LLM-driven features.
- Integrate and harden model providers, tools, and agent capabilities behind clean, versioned interfaces — with sane failure behavior, observability, and cost/latency awareness.
- Build evaluation and regression tooling so AI behavior is measured, gated, and trustworthy — not vibes.

- Work fluently alongside AI coding assistants: decompose tasks an agent can execute, critically review AI-generated code, and keep engineering rigor high at AI speed.

A day in the life
In our team, you will get to build new products and features from the ground up. You will define and build features and tools used by thousands of developers for building for millions of customers. We work across multiple internal teams as well as product to define what we are building and make it a reality. SDEs on this team are actively writing code, as well as working on designs and mentoring others. As the Device OS org we get to work horizontally across many exciting new device types.

We’re a platform team that builds the shared AI/agent infrastructure used across multiple products. We care about correctness, safety, and developer experience in equal measure. Join us at the forefront of Amazon's sustainability initiatives to work on environmental and social advancements to support Amazon's long term worldwide sustainability strategy. At Amazon, we're working to be the most customer-centric company on earth. To get there, we need exceptionally talented, bright, and driven people.

Amazon's Worldwide Sustainability team is building the science and technology infrastructure that makes our sustainability commitments real — auditable, automated, and actionable at Amazon's scale. At the center of that infrastructure is the Carbon Intelligence Platform: the system that calculates emissions across Amazon's businesses, powers planning and abatement decision-making, and serves external sustainability products for partners and customers outside Amazon.

We are looking for a Senior Manager, Software Development to lead the engineering team building and operating this platform. This is a player-coach role — you will set technical direction, manage and grow a team of engineers, and stay close enough to the code and architecture to make the hard technical calls yourself. You will own production systems that business unit leaders, finance teams, and external partners depend on for numbers they report publicly and use to make consequential decisions.

This role sits at a distinctive intersection: technical depth and organizational scope at the same time. You will partner with research and sustainability scientists whose methodologies — increasingly AI and ML-enabled — your team implements in production. You will own an external-grade API surface that commercial sustainability products depend on to serve customers outside Amazon. And you will build an AI-native engineering team: one that builds AI/ML systems in production *and* uses AI-assisted development and testing as standard workflow, measuring success by the pace at which new capabilities reach customers reliably.

Your ability to communicate and influence others will be a key to success. You are a results-oriented, customer-focused manager who gets excited about diving deep, running hard, and delivering a big impact.

- External-grade API surface consumed by commercial sustainability products — versioned, rate-limited, documented, and reliable at external SLAs
- Assurance & Decision-making: All data must be fully explainable to assurance providers, external stakeholders and enable rapid decision making

As a Data Center Engineering Technician, you'll play a pivotal role in maintaining the heartbeat of mission-critical technology infrastructure, ensuring seamless operations that power global digital experiences. Engineering Technicians are Amazon’s front line when it comes to hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment troubleshooting. jobs.title: Engineering Operation Technician
jobs.description:
Join our dynamic team and become a critical guardian of technological infrastructure! As a Data Center Engineering Technician, you'll play a pivotal role in maintaining the heartbeat of mission-critical technology infrastructure, ensuring seamless operations that power global digital experiences. Your expertise will directly contribute to maintaining an extraordinary 99.999% uptime, keeping the digital world running smoothly and efficiently.

Engineering Technicians are Amazon’s front line when it comes to hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment troubleshooting. They will maintain, operate, and troubleshoot, Data Center Operation’s Mission Critical Facilities, which includes stand-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, as well as three phase electrical systems such as: switch gear, UPSs, PDUs, wet cell batteries and associated systems, CRAC, centrifugal chillers, cooling towers/water chemical system, air handlers and associated systems, pumps, & motors.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

NOTE: Amazon does not sponsor for immigration, including for H-1B, TN, and other non-immigrant visas, for this role.
NOTE: Lump sum stipend will be provided to eligible candidates who relocate for this position.

Key job responsibilities
- Daily building rounds to monitor and record information from electrical, mechanical, and fire/life safety equipment to ensure 24/7 reliability and availability
- Monitor Building Management Systems (BMS) and Electrical Power Management System (EPMS)
- Assist in troubleshooting of facility and rack-level events within internal Service Level Agreements (SLA)
- Perform rack installs and rack decommissioning within internal SLA
- Perform PM, troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and repair of electrical and mechanical equipment
- Technical writing to support change management program
- Monitor daily work requests and manage to resolution, and execute projects from conception to completion
- On-site support of contractors, sub-contractors and vendors, ensuring that all work performed is in accordance with established practices, procedures & local legislation
- Work schedule changes depending on specific site needs. Shifts can be up to 12-hours and may rotate on a predefined schedule. Some locations have on-call rotations.
- Role may support more than one location/site.

Physical Requirements:
- Willingness and demonstrated ability to work in the following physical conditions with reasonable accommodations:
- Regularly lift and/or move up to 39 pounds independently
- Participate in group lifts for 40+ pounds
- Maintain balance and perform construction tasks while on a ladder
- Regularly walk, use hands and fingers, handle or feel, reach with hands and arms, stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl, climb stairs, twist, bend, work above shoulders, grasp, carry, push and pull objects into position
- Work in an environment requiring provided ear protection

This role supports data centers in various operational stages. The position may be assigned to a facility still under development, which could require travel to established locations for training until your designated site becomes fully operational.

Essential Requirements:
- Ability to travel to or commute between data center locations as needed
- Willingness to temporarily work at alternative sites during training periods or until assigned facility is operational
- Travel frequency will vary based on business needs and operational status of assigned facility

Candidates must be able to travel (over 50 miles) or commute (less than 50 miles) to active data center sites as required by business needs.

A day in the life
This role acts as Amazon’s front line when it comes to hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment preventative maintenance (PM) and troubleshooting, reporting to a site’s Data Center Facility Manager (FM). They will maintain, operate, and troubleshoot mission-critical data center facility equipment including stand-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, 3 phase electrical systems such as switchgear, UPS units, PDUs, and wet cell batteries and associated systems. Mechanical equipment includes CRAHU units, centrifugal chillers, cooling towers, water systems, air handlers and associated systems, pumps, and motors. Additional support equipment is included in the scope of the role which includes fire/life safety equipment, building automation systems, and general facilities equipment.

Basic qualifications:
- 2+ years of relevant work experience
- Experience in relevant work
- Can bend or twist the body into unusual positions while working
- Can use hands to manipulate small wires and objects
- Can walk on job sites in uneven terrain
- Can work at heights and from ladders

Preferred qualifications:
- 4+ years of data center engineering experience
- Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field
- Knowledge of network design and layout as well as low voltage (copper/ fiber) cabling
- Experience in data center engineering
- Can perform physical tasks all day without becoming overly tired

*   Proficiency with electrical CAD software (e.g., Altium Designer, OrCAD, Eagle) for schematic capture and PCB layout.
*   Experience with simulation tools (e.g., SPICE, MATLAB/Simulink).
*   Familiarity with various electrical components, sensors, and actuators.
*   Knowledge of safety standards (e.g., UL, CE) and regulatory requirements.
*   Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
*   Strong communication and teamwork abilities.
*   Ability to work independently and manage multiple tasks effectively.

Accessibility and reasonable accommodation

Qualified individuals with a disability may request a reasonable accommodation if you are unable or limited in your ability to use or access the Hitachi Energy career site as a result of your disability. You may request reasonable accommodations by completing a general inquiry form on our website. Please include your contact information and specific details about your required accommodation to support you during the job application process.

This is solely for job seekers with disabilities requiring accessibility assistance or an accommodation in the job application process. Messages left for other purposes will not receive a response.

Use of Al and automated tools in recruitment

As part of our recruitment process, Hitachi Energy uses digital and automated tools, including Al-supported solutions, to assist with activities such as application screening, job matching, and interview scheduling. These tools are designed to support our recruiters and do not replace human decision-making. Candidate data is processed in accordance with applicable data protection and employment laws as well as Hitachi's Global Data Privacy Notice.

Background Screening and Security Checks

As part of the hiring process, Hitachi Energy conducts pre-employment background checks that may include verification of employment history, education, criminal records, and other relevant information, in accordance with applicable laws.

For certain roles—particularly those involving access to sensitive information, financial responsibilities, client data, regulated environments, or security-sensitive functions—additional or more comprehensive background or security screenings may be required. The scope and depth of any background or security review will be determined based on the nature of the role and business necessity, and will always be conducted in compliance with applicable federal, state, and local laws. Candidates will be notified and, where required, asked to provide consent prior to the initiation of any such checks.

jobs.title: Medical Affairs & Clinical Value Lead
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections,  where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

We are looking for a strategic and collaborative Medical Affairs & Clinical Value Lead to drive the medical strategy, operational excellence, and stakeholder engagement across our product portfolio.

The Opportunity

• Lead, coach, and inspire a multidisciplinary team within Medical Affairs and Clinical Value, fostering an environment of trust, mutual respect, and continuous personal growth.

• Shape and drive the strategic disease area roadmaps for prioritized diagnostic solutions, accelerating their integration into clinical practice for direct patient benefit.

• Influence the Swedish healthcare ecosystem by engaging with national decision-making bodies, clinical guideline committees, and regional healthcare stakeholders to advance health-economic value recognition of innovative diagnostics and digital solutions.

• Partner with commercial, health economics, and market access teams to co-create cohesive, high-impact go-to-market strategies.

• Champion clinical adoption and guideline-concordant diagnostic utilization through collaborative partnerships with clinical opinion leaders and medical societies.

• Guide the translation of complex scientific data into actionable health-economic insights that address major societal health challenges.

Who You Are

• You bring a university degree in Life Sciences, Medicine, Pharmacy, Health Economics, or Business Administration (PhD or MD preferred), paired with extensive leadership experience across medical affairs, market access, or commercial roles within the Swedish healthcare sector.

• You have a proven track record of coaching and empowering multidisciplinary teams, creating conditions where people thrive and deliver high performance.

• You possess an in-depth understanding of Swedish healthcare governance, decision-making bodies (such as TLV, Medical Technology Council (MTP-rådet), and Socialstyrelsen), and regional care pathways.

• You demonstrate strong strategic and financial acumen, with the ability to bridge medical-scientific rigor, health economics, and commercial execution.

• You communicate with clarity and influence in both Swedish and English, building lasting relationships across diverse stakeholder groups.

• No restriction for traveling

Please submit your application and CV in English.

At Roche, we aim high to deliver life-changing healthcare solutions. If you are ready to make a meaningful impact on patients and healthcare systems, join us in building a healthier future.

Who we are

A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Job Description:

As Engineering Manager, lead and develop technical engineering team responsible for engine system performance development and current product maintenance.

Provide leadership across people, projects and technical delivery, including resource planning, technical reviews, performance system develop/validation and issue resolution. Collaborate with global and cross-functional partners to deliver robust engineering solutions that meet performance, quality and business requirements.

负责宽体车自动驾驶解决方案的导入项目全生命周期管理，领导跨职能团队完成自动驾驶宽体车平台、车辆系统、自动驾驶软件、现场解决方案以及商业化部署的端到端交付。

该角色需要能够在复杂、多组织、多地域环境下推动项目执行，确保项目在安全，质量，成本，交付和客户满意度方面达成预期目标。

主要职责

1. 无人驾驶宽体车项目全周期管理

负责宽体车自动驾驶项目从业务需求到商业化部署的全过程管理：

• 制定项目总体计划、关键里程碑和资源规划
• 管理项目范围、进度、成本、质量及风险
• 推动各阶段成果交付和项目评审
• 确保项目满足业务目标及客户预期

2. NPI流程与项目管理

依据 Caterpillar NPI、NTI、CPI 及 NMI 流程要求：

• 组织和推动项目Gateway Reviews
• 组织项目设计评审（Design Reviews）
• 监督项目关键交付物的质量和完整性
• 建立项目管理机制和执行节奏
• 主导项目状态汇报及管理层评审

3. 跨职能团队领导与资源协调

协调产品与商业团队进行产品定义与差异化管理； 领导工程团队进行 系统设计，软件开发，功能安全，测试验证；积极参与整机产品组的设计评审与资源协调，保证双方接口与协议的一致性， 与各个横向系统组协作，保证系统的生产以及供应链完整，保证后续的产品易于应用，易于维护。 同时在项目开发中调整系统优先级，合理利用团队资源优势解决项目中的各种挑战。

4. Autonomous WBT产品与解决方案交付

• 自动驾驶车辆的方案以及测试；
• 自动驾驶车辆与其他辅助车辆的调试与优化
• 自动驾驶车辆与平台以及Base machine， DBW车辆的交互
• 矿山应用环境，上下游监控系统集成

5. 客户现场部署与运营支持

• 组织系统集成验证
• 推动Site Readiness评估
• 支持试点项目和Early Learner部署
• 协调产品支持团队完成问题闭环

7. 风险、质量、财务、采购与供应链管理

• 风险管理： 持续识别并管理各种项目中的风险，并管理及降低这些风险：包括技术风险， 团队接口协同， 车辆落地，供应链，客户现场勘探，部署& 运营风险。
• 质量管理： 推动产品质量目标交付，管理产品质量评审，确保发布质量满足要求
• 财务管理： 项目预算管理， 周期性项目成本控制， 资源投入规划， 项目收入与支出管， 投资回报跟踪

教育背景

本科及以上学历：（自动化， 车辆工程， 电气工程， 机械工程，控制工程，计算机科学 etc）

• 能够影响跨组织决策

Problem Solving

jobs.title: Manager Production
jobs.description:
Career Area:

Manufacturing

Job Description:

Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other.  We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

职位概述

对所负责价值流的人员、安全、质量、交付、成本及设备绩效负全面责任。通过严谨的生产计划、跨职能协同、持续改善和现场领导，确保生产目标达成或超越。

核心职责

1. 生产运营与价值流绩效

•            制定并落实近期（至少3周）及中长期（3-12个月）生产计划，确保人员、设备、物料和产能匹配客户需求。

•            建立并持续提升高水准PQVC标准，推动一次做对，并对价值流PQVC绩效、MQ12005认证及Lean/CPS评估结果负责。

•            确保过程数据准确、及时、可追溯，并用于日常管理、资源配置和升级决策。

2. 设备主人翁与效率提升

•            主导“我的设备我作主”活动的策划、部署、执行与闭环，明确责任区、点检标准、异常响应、改善清单和结果复盘。

•            通过安全/浪费巡查审核安全行为、5S、质量、标准作业、生产率及设备综合效率（OEE），系统消除八大浪费。

•            推动设备可靠性和生产效率改善，协同生产、维修、工艺和质量团队解决重复性损失与瓶颈。

3. 质量管理与“质量风暴180”

•            主导“质量风暴180”等质量专项的策划、目标分解、现场实施、进度跟踪、问题关闭和有效性验证，确保成果可复制、可持续。

•            针对安全、质量、生产及成本损失，运用RCCA等方法分析根因，落实遏制、纠正、预防及标准化措施。

•            建立质量风险前移和快速响应机制，强化过程控制、分层审核及跨班组经验复制，减少缺陷、返工和客户风险。

4. 持续改善与创新应用

•            全面负责持续改善流程，建立创意产生、评估、试验、实施和标准化机制，及时清除障碍。

•            定期与Team Leader及Team Member开展改善对话，聚焦现场痛点、客户价值、流程能力和效率。

•            学习并评估先进制造技术，包括自动化、数字化制造、数据分析、智能质量、设备状态监测及适用的AI应用，将成熟方案转化为可控试点和量化改善。

•            以安全、质量、交付、成本和客户价值评估创新，避免“为技术而技术”，并有效管理风险、变更和标准化。

5. 人员领导、文化与组织能力

•            支持新业务/Day 1投产，通过招聘、培训、岗位认证和技能矩阵建设，确保团队具备安全稳定量产能力。

•            激励员工保持工作热情和主人翁意识，及时认可高绩效、好创意和正确行为；对偏差明确反馈、责任和后果，做到标准一致、奖惩分明。

•            营造创新、进取和持续学习的团队氛围，鼓励一线员工提出、验证和推广改善建议。

•            培养Team Leader和关键岗位人才，通过清晰目标、定期辅导、绩效反馈及继任梯队提升组织韧性。

•            以尊重、公平和合规的方式开展认可、奖励、纠偏和纪律管理，并与公司政策及HR流程一致。

6. 跨职能协同与客户价值

•            与质量、工艺、维修、物料、供应链、EHS及其他支持团队高效协同，推动问题快速升级、资源对齐和承诺兑现。

•            将现场改善与产品竞争力和客户价值连接，提升流程稳定性、产品质量、交付能力和成本竞争力。

________________________________________

任职资格

•            机械工程、制造工程、工业工程或相关专业，本科及以上学历。

•            至少3年生产主管或同等现场带队经验，具备复杂制造环境的人员管理和生产执行经验。

•            诚信正直，沟通协作能力强，具备承诺意识、团队精神和结果导向。

•            具备批判性思维和结构化问题解决能力，能运用RCCA、精益工具及数据分析推动问题闭环。

•            具备变革推动能力，能在跨职能环境中影响他人、化解阻力并推动改善落地。

•            熟练使用Microsoft Office（Word、Excel、PowerPoint）；具备良好的英语读写能力并愿意持续学习者优先。

________________________________________

优先条件

•            具备库存、物料管理或供应链协同经验。

•            具备OEE提升、TPM/自主维护、精益制造、质量专项或数字化制造项目经验。

•            具备新产品导入、产线启动、产能爬坡或重大流程变更经验。

________________________________________

Job Summary

Accountable for people, safety, quality, velocity, cost, and equipment performance across the assigned value stream. Leads execution, cross-functional collaboration, continuous improvement, and capability building to meet or exceed production commitments.

________________________________________

Key Accountabilities

1. Production Operations & Value Stream Performance

•            Develop and execute near-term (minimum three weeks) and long-range (3–12 months) production plans, aligning people, equipment, materials, and capacity with customer demand.

•            Establish and continuously improve world-class PQVC standards, promote right-first-time execution, and own value-stream performance, including MQ12005 certification and Lean/CPS assessment results.

•            Ensure process data is accurate, timely, and traceable, and use data to drive daily management, resource allocation, and escalation decisions.

2. Equipment Ownership & Efficiency

•            Lead the planning, deployment, execution, and closure of the “My Equipment, My Ownership” program, including ownership zones, inspection standards, abnormality response, improvement backlogs, and reviews.

•            Conduct safety and waste walks covering safety behavior, 5S, quality, standard work, productivity, and OEE to systematically eliminate the eight wastes.

•            Improve equipment reliability and production efficiency by coordinating production, maintenance, process engineering, and quality teams to eliminate recurring losses and constraints.

3. Quality Excellence & Quality Storm 180

•            Lead Quality Storm 180 and related campaigns through planning, target deployment, shop-floor implementation, progress tracking, issue closure, and effectiveness verification, ensuring repeatable and sustainable improvements.

•            Apply RCCA and other structured methods to safety, quality, production, and cost losses, ensuring containment, corrective action, prevention, and standardization.

•            Build proactive quality-risk prevention and rapid-response mechanisms, strengthen process controls and layered audits, and replicate learning across shifts to reduce defects, rework, and customer risk.

4. Continuous Improvement & Innovation

•            Own the continuous improvement process, enabling idea generation, evaluation, experimentation, implementation, and standardization while removing roadblocks.

•            Conduct regular process-improvement dialogues with Team Leaders and Team Members focused on shop-floor pain points, customer value, process capability, and efficiency.

•            Evaluate advanced manufacturing technologies, including automation, digital manufacturing, analytics, intelligent quality, condition monitoring, and applicable AI, converting viable solutions into controlled pilots and measurable improvements.

•            Evaluate innovation against safety, quality, delivery, cost, and customer value, avoiding technology for technology’s sake while effectively managing risk, change, and standardization.

5. People Leadership, Culture & Capability

•            Support Day 1 production launch through recruiting, training, job certification, and skill-matrix development to ensure readiness for safe and stable production.

•            Sustain employee engagement and ownership by recognizing strong performance, useful ideas, and desired behaviors promptly, while addressing deviations with clear feedback, accountability, and consequences applied consistently.

•            Build a culture of innovation, ambition, and continuous learning, encouraging frontline employees to propose, test, and scale improvement ideas.

•            Develop Team Leaders and critical-role talent through clear goals, regular coaching, performance feedback, and succession pipelines to strengthen organizational resilience.

•            Administer recognition, rewards, corrective action, and discipline respectfully, fairly, consistently, and in alignment with company policy and HR processes.

6. Cross-functional Collaboration & Customer Value

•            Partner effectively with Quality, Process Engineering, Maintenance, Materials, Supply Chain, EHS, and other support functions to accelerate escalation, align resources, and deliver commitments.

•            Connect shop-floor improvements to product competitiveness and customer value by improving process stability, product quality, delivery capability, and cost competitiveness.

________________________________________

Required Qualifications

•            Bachelor’s degree or above in Mechanical Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or a related discipline.

•            At least three years of experience as a Production Supervisor or equivalent shop-floor leader, with demonstrated people management and execution experience in a complex manufacturing environment.

•            High integrity, strong communication and collaboration skills, commitment, teamwork, and results orientation.

•            Strong critical thinking and structured problem-solving capability, with the ability to apply RCCA, Lean tools, and data analysis to close issues.

•            Demonstrated change leadership, with the ability to influence across functions, remove resistance, and translate improvements into execution.

•            Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint); good English reading and writing skills and a strong commitment to continuous learning preferred.

________________________________________

Preferred Qualifications

•            Experience in inventory, materials management, or supply chain collaboration.

•            Experience in OEE improvement, TPM/autonomous maintenance, Lean manufacturing, quality campaigns, or digital manufacturing projects.

•            Experience in new product introduction (NPI), line start-up, production ramp-up, or major process change initiatives.

jobs.title: Leader, Sales
jobs.description:
The application window is expected to close on: 11/29/2026

Candidate MUST reside in NYC/NJ and willing to commute to NYC regularly.

Meet the Team

Join a high-impact sales organization dedicated to driving sustainable growth across Cisco’s comprehensive product and services portfolio. As a cross-functional powerhouse, our team serves as the primary orchestrator between customer needs and innovative technology solutions. We operate with a high degree of corporate interlock, collaborating closely with specialist, partner, and virtual teams to deliver complex deals. You will lead a group of dedicated account and architecture experts who are focused on building long-term relationships with key stakeholders and C-suite executives. It is an exciting time to join us as we shape data-driven strategies to enter new markets and launch cutting-edge product lines.

Your Impact

Lead and manage direct account and architecture teams to drive portfolio profitability and achieve multi-year sales growth objectives. Cultivate influential relationships with C-level executives and purchasing leaders to align Cisco’s technology roadmap with their core business goals. Orchestrate the end-to-end sales process by integrating product and services strategies that maximize cross-portfolio demand. Analyze forecasting data and market trends to refine sales tactics and present actionable insights to senior leadership. Direct resource utilization and team skill-building to ensure consistent execution of strategic priorities and quota attainment.

Minimum Qualifications

•    Bachelor’s degree with 12+ years of related experience, a Master’s degree with 8+ years, or a PhD with 5+ years.

•    2+ years of direct supervisory or people management experience.

•    Experience managing sales growth and portfolio profitability for complex technology accounts.

•    Proficiency in sales forecasting, business plan review, and data-driven account strategy development.

•    Experience leading product and services strategies across a broad technology portfolio.

Preferred Qualifications

•    Proven ability to build and sustain long-term relationships with CTO, CIO, and CFO stakeholders.

•    Strong track record of managing sales cycles ranging from 6 to 24 months for complex opportunities.

•    Expertise in competitive analysis and translating market insights into actionable sales tactics.

•    Demonstrated success in attracting, retaining, and developing top sales talent.

•    Ability to collaborate effectively across mid-to-high corporate interlock environments involving partner and virtual teams.

Why Cisco?

At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.

Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

Message to applicants applying to work in the U.S. and/or Canada:

The starting salary range posted for this position is $366,600.00 to $472,300.00 and reflects the projected salary range for new hires in this position in U.S. and/or Canada locations, not including incentive compensation*, equity, or benefits.

Individual pay is determined by the candidate's hiring location, market conditions, job-related skillset, experience, qualifications, education, certifications, and/or training. The full salary range for certain locations is listed below. For locations not listed below, the recruiter can share more details about compensation for the role in your location during the hiring process.

U.S. employees are offered benefits, subject to Cisco’s plan eligibility rules, which include medical, dental and vision insurance, a 401(k) plan with a Cisco matching contribution, paid parental leave, short and long-term disability coverage, and basic life insurance. Please see the Cisco careers site to discover more benefits and perks.  Employees may be eligible to receive grants of Cisco restricted stock units, which vest following continued employment with Cisco for defined periods of time.

U.S. employees are eligible for paid time away as described below, subject to Cisco’s policies:

• 10 paid holidays per full calendar year, plus 1 floating holiday for non-exempt employees
• 1 paid day off for employee’s birthday, paid year-end holiday shutdown, and 4 paid days off for personal wellness determined by Cisco
• Non-exempt employees** receive 16 days of paid vacation time per full calendar year, accrued at rate of 4.92 hours per pay period for full-time employees
• Exempt employees participate in Cisco’s flexible vacation time off program, which has no defined limit on how much vacation time eligible employees may use (subject to availability and some business limitations)
• 80 hours of sick time off provided on hire date and each January 1st thereafter, and up to 80 hours of unused sick time carried forward from one calendar year to the next
• Additional paid time away may be requested to deal with critical or emergency issues for family members
• Optional 10 paid days per full calendar year to volunteer

For non-sales roles, employees are also eligible to earn annual bonuses subject to Cisco’s policies.

Employees on sales plans earn performance-based incentive pay on top of their base salary, which is split between quota and non-quota components, subject to the applicable Cisco plan. For quota-based incentive pay, Cisco typically pays as follows:

• .75% of incentive target for each 1% of revenue attainment up to 50% of quota;
• 1.5% of incentive target for each 1% of attainment between 50% and 75%;
• 1% of incentive target for each 1% of attainment between 75% and 100%; and
• Once performance exceeds 100% attainment, incentive rates are at or above 1% for each 1% of attainment with no cap on incentive compensation.

For non-quota-based sales performance elements such as strategic sales objectives, Cisco may pay 0% up to 125% of target. Cisco sales plans do not have a minimum threshold of performance for sales incentive compensation to be paid.

$366,600.00 - $543,100.00

Non-Metro New York state & Washington state:

$329,800.00 - $512,400.00

* For quota-based sales roles on Cisco’s sales plan, the ranges provided in this posting include base pay and sales target incentive compensation combined.

** Employees in Illinois, whether exempt or non-exempt, will participate in a unique time off program to meet local requirements.
