jobs.title: Senior OpenShift Engineer
jobs.description:
Who We Are

At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses.  We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.

The Role

Kyndryl ontwerpt, bouwt, beheert en moderniseert de bedrijfskritische technologiesystemen waar de wereld dagelijks van afhankelijk is, met behulp van de meest ervaren experts in de industrie.

Kyndryl combineert de mentaliteit van een start-up met de reikwijdte van een marktleider. Wij zijn een nieuwe organisatie, maar dan een met $19 miljard omzet en 90.000 werknemers. Onze klantenlijst is indrukwekkend, met ruim 4.600 klanten, waaronder 75 van de Fortune 100 bedrijven, verspreid over 64 landen. Een van onze grootste klanten is het Ministerie van Defensie.

Werken bij Kyndryl betekent werken aan vooruitgang. Wij ontwerpen, bouwen, beheren en moderniseren informatiesystemen waar de wereld iedere dag van afhankelijk is. Dat doen we onder andere voor onze klant het Ministerie van Defensie. Daar bouwen we aan een compleet vernieuwde IT-infrastructuur, waardoor de krijgsmacht een hoogwaardige en informatiegestuurde organisatie kan blijven.

Wat ga je als OpenShift Engineer bij Defensie doen?

Als OpenShift Engineer krijg je de kans om te werken met geavanceerde technologieën, samen te werken met diverse teams in verschillende sectoren, en bij te dragen aan belangrijke infrastructuurprojecten die je vaardigheden uitdagen en versterken. Bovendien zorgt de ondersteunende en inclusieve werkomgeving, in combinatie met mogelijkheden voor professionele groei en ontwikkeling, voor extra enthousiasme om deze rol op je te nemen.

Het bouwen van het Container Platform is, samen met je collega’s, jouw domein. Jij bent op dit vlak dé vraagbaak voor de eerste- en tweedelijns support. De expert waar iedereen zich tot wendt als ze vragen hebben. Jij helpt ze met plezier en drive. Jouw probleemoplossend vermogen komt goed van pas in de samenwerking met de development teams, bij het bieden van technische begeleiding op projecten van Container onboarding en server security. Zo zorgen jullie er samen voor dat de configuratie altijd up-to-date en veilig is. Dat betekent ook dat je waakzaam bent als het gaat om performance en beschikbaarheid van de IT-infrastructuur. Je analyseert mogelijke problemen en draagt verbeteringen en oplossingen aan. Als het nodig is, dompel je je helemaal onder in de complexe architectuur en beveiliging. Zelfs de incidentele derdelijns support aan IT infrastructuur teams bied jij, indien nodig.

Waar ga je werken?

Je thuisbasis is Soesterberg, of een andere defensie locatie in Nederland. We bieden flexibel werken aan waarbij we verwachten dat je gemiddeld zo’n 2 dagen per week op kantoor bent om samen te werken met het team.

Belangrijk om te weten: om voor Defensie te mogen werken moet je in het bezit zijn van de Nederlandse nationaliteit en een Nederlands paspoort. Je moet ook Nederlands kunnen spreken en schrijven.

Jouw toekomst bij Kyndryl

Elke functie bij Kyndryl biedt een kans om je carrière te laten groeien, van Junior Administrator tot Architect. We hebben trainings- en bijscholingsprogramma's die je nergens anders vindt, inclusief praktische ervaring, leermogelijkheden en de mogelijkheid om je te certificeren op alle vier de grote platforms. Een van de voordelen van Kyndryl is dat we werken met klanten in verschillende branches, van banken tot retail en de overheid. Of je nu je kennis wilt verbreden of je scope wilt verkleinen en je wilt specialiseren in een specifieke sector, je kunt bij Kyndryl je kans pakken.

Het hoofdkantoor van Kyndryl Nederland is gevestigd in het duurzame Pharos gebouw in Hoofddorp. Onze Kyndryl Social Club organiseert regelmatig informele en inspirerende activiteiten. Deels thuiswerken behoort tot de mogelijkheden.

Who You Are

Professionele en Technische Expertise (Vereiste vaardigheden):

• Minstens 8 jaar ervaring met scripting of programmeren
• Kritische blik: door jouw engineering ervaring blijf je kritisch op mogelijke kansen.
• Je hebt praktijkervaring met: Linux Red Hat OpenShift Kubernetes Docker TCP Networking.
• Communicatie skills: in een team werken vind je fijn, al kun je ook prima zelfstandig werken en je voortgang goed over de bühne brengen.

Het zou mooi zijn als je ook vaardig bent in (Pré):

• Het onboarden van nodes in OpenShift
• Cluster OpenShift systeemintegratie.
• IAAS en Cloud.
• Ansible of Bamboo systeemconfiguratie tools.
• Scripten in Perl, Python, Shell Scripting, Ruby en/of Power CLI ITIL-processen.

Wat bieden wij jou?

• Een bruto maandsalaris van minimaal €5,400 tot €6,500. Het salarisaanbod kan dit bereik eventueel overschrijden, afhankelijk van de vaardigheden en capaciteiten die je meebrengt naar het team.
• Educatieprogramma’s en certificeringen om je kennis te verbreden en verdiepen.
• Je werkt samen met ervaren collega’s. Verschillende doorgroeimogelijkheden, afhankelijk van je ervaring en interesse.
• De Kyndryl Social Club organiseert regelmatig borrels en andere leuke activiteiten.
• Kyndryl Cares: jij kunt 1 dag per jaar vrijwilligerswerk doen zonder dat het je wat kost.
• De ruimte om je werktijden flexibel in te delen en thuis te werken.
• Parttime werken is in overleg mogelijk
• De tools om je werk uit te oefenen: een mobiele telefoon die je ook privé kunt gebruiken en de keuze uit een Macbook of Lenovo laptop.
• Een maandelijkse internetvergoeding.
• Een bijdrage aan je pensioen: als je bij Kyndryl werkt ben je automatisch aangesloten bij het BeFrank pensioenfonds.
• Ruime regelingen voor bijvoorbeeld partnerverlof.

Daarnaast bieden wij jou een open en inclusieve cultuur

Diversiteit is veel meer dan hoe we eruit zien of waar we vandaan komen; het is hoe we denken en wie we zijn. We verwelkomen mensen van alle culturen, achtergronden en ervaringen. Deze toewijding om iedereen welkom te heten in ons bedrijf betekent dat Kyndryl jou – en iedereen naast je – de mogelijkheid geeft om je volledig in te zetten in je werk, zowel persoonlijk als in samenwerking met je collega's en actief bij te dragen aan onze cultuur die inclusie en rechtvaardigheid centraal stelt. Onze Kyndryl Inclusion Networks – onze employee resource groups (ERGs) – zijn slechts één van de vele manieren waarop we een werkomgeving creëren waarin alle Kyndryls steun en advies kunnen vinden én geven.

Als je nog vragen hebt over deze functie of over werken voor Kyndryl, neem dan contact op via het volgende e-mailadres: working-at-kyndryl-nl@kyndryl.com

Als je nu al denkt, dit is de baan voor mij!, solliciteer dan via de onderstaande button. Je wordt doorgeleid naar onze Engelstalige sollicitatiewebsite. We zien je sollicitatie met plezier tegemoet!

Being You

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.

What You Can Expect

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose.  We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.

From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.

We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.

We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.

Get Referred!

If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.

jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer - Backend
jobs.description:
Job Requisition ID #

26WD97363

Position Overview

We are seeking a Principal Software Engineer – Backend to join Autodesk’s Enterprise Data Management (EDM) organization within the COO-GET Engineering group. This is a senior individual contributor role operating at the Principal (P4) level, expected to drive technology direction for large, complex, and business-critical backend and distributed systems.

This role is anchored in backend software engineering excellence: designing, building, and evolving scalable services, APIs, and event-driven systems that operate at enterprise scale. As a Principal Engineer, you will work with high autonomy and ambiguity, shape long-term architecture, and influence multiple teams and domains. Familiarity with data engineering concepts is valuable, but backend systems, service design, and distributed systems are the core competencies.

You will function as a technical authority and force multiplier—guiding design decisions, setting standards, and ensuring Autodesk’s core data services are reliable, resilient, and evolvable over time.

Responsibilities

• Provide principal-level technical leadership across multiple backend and platform teams, shaping architecture and technical strategy beyond a single squad or service

• Author and evolve critical backend systems and APIs, ensuring they meet long-term scalability, reliability, and extensibility goals

• Lead design of distributed, event-driven systems, addressing consistency, ordering, failure handling, replay, idempotency, rate limiting, and backpressure

• Establish and drive service and API standards across domains, including schema design, versioning strategies, backward compatibility, and consumer experience

• Act as a technical decision-maker for cross-team initiatives; evaluate tradeoffs and make durable architectural choices aligned with business priorities

• Drive operational excellence across systems you influence: observability, alerting strategy, incident response, post-incident learning, and systemic remediation

• Introduce and reinforce engineering best practices for design reviews, code quality, testing, CI/CD, and production readiness across multiple teams

• Mentor senior engineers and emerging technical leaders; raise the bar through influence, example, and coaching rather than direct management

• Partner deeply with product, data, and platform leaders to translate ambiguous business problems into clear, actionable technical solutions

• Remain hands-on where impact is highest: complex system design, critical implementations, architectural refactors, and high-severity incident resolution

Minimum Qualifications

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience

• 10+ years of professional software engineering experience, with significant depth in backend and distributed systems
• Experience building enterprise platform services consumed by many internal and/or external teams.
• Python + AWS + API + backend services integration experience

• Demonstrated expertise building and operating backend services and APIs in production environments at scale

• Strong experience with distributed systems design, including asynchronous processing, messaging, eventual consistency, and fault tolerance

• Deep hands-on experience with AWS and cloud-native architectures (compute, storage, messaging, IAM, observability, scaling patterns)

• Proven ownership of mission-critical systems, including design accountability, operational responsibility, and long-term maintainability

• Strong software engineering fundamentals: system design, service-level data modeling, API design, automated testing, CI/CD, and infrastructure as code

• Track record of influencing architecture and engineering outcomes across multiple teams without formal authority

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to clearly articulate complex technical concepts to diverse audiences

Preferred Qualifications

• Familiarity with data engineering or data platform ecosystems (e.g., streaming pipelines, data warehouses such as Snowflake) as a producer or advanced consumer of data services

• Experience with event streaming and messaging platforms (e.g., Kafka, Kinesis, or equivalents)

• Background in domains such as master data management, identity resolution, data enrichment, or data quality

• Experience integrating backend services with analytics, search/indexing, or ML/AI platforms

• Prior experience operating in large, complex organizations where systems span multiple teams, regions, and business units

Learn More

About Autodesk

Welcome to Autodesk! Amazing things are created every day with our software – from the greenest buildings and cleanest cars to the smartest factories and biggest hit movies. We help innovators turn their ideas into reality, transforming not only how things are made, but what can be made.

We take great pride in our culture here at Autodesk – it’s at the core of everything we do. Our culture guides the way we work and treat each other, informs how we connect with customers and partners, and defines how we show up in the world.

When you’re an Autodesker, you can do meaningful work that helps build a better world designed and made for all. Ready to shape the world and your future? Join us!

Benefits

From health and financial benefits to time away and everyday wellness, we give Autodeskers the best, so they can do their best work. Learn more about our benefits in the U.S. by visiting https://benefits.autodesk.com/

Salary transparency

Salary is one part of Autodesk’s competitive compensation package. For U.S.-based roles, we expect a starting base salary between $139,000 and $249,260. Offers are based on the candidate’s experience and geographic location, and may exceed this range. In addition to base salaries, our compensation package may include annual cash bonuses, commissions for sales roles, stock grants, and a comprehensive benefits package.

Equal Employment Opportunity

At Autodesk, we're building a diverse workplace and an inclusive culture to give more people the chance to imagine, design, and make a better world. Autodesk is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and considers all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status or any other legally protected characteristic. We also consider for employment all qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with applicable law.

Belonging

We take pride in cultivating a culture of belonging where everyone can thrive. Learn more here: https://www.autodesk.com/company/global-belonging

jobs.title: Senior Zoning Analyst - Envelope (in office)
jobs.description:
Who We Are

Join a team that puts its People First! First American's Direct division provides comprehensive title insurance protection and professional settlement services for real estate purchases, refinances and equity loans. Since 1889, First American (NYSE: FAF) has held an unwavering belief in its people. They are passionate about what they do, and we are equally passionate about fostering an environment where all feel welcome, supported, and empowered to be innovative and reach their full potential. Our inclusive, people-first culture has earned our company numerous accolades, including being named to the Fortune 100 Best Companies to Work For® list for eleven consecutive years. We have also earned awards as a best place to work for women, diversity and LGBTQ+ employees, and have been included on more than 50 regional best places to work lists. First American will always strive to be a great place to work, for all. For more information, please visit www.careers.firstam.com.

What We Do

Envelope is a property analytics and zoning technology platform that uses zoning regulations and property data to visualize and evaluate the development potential of a site. The platform helps translate complex zoning requirements into actionable property and development insights. The Senior Zoning Analyst is responsible for performing advanced zoning research and analysis, with a primary focus on interpreting New York City zoning regulations and evaluating their application to real property within the proprietary Envelope platform.

Serves as a subject matter resource on complex zoning matters and regulatory changes. Translates zoning requirements into structured logic and product requirements, validates technology-generated zoning analyses through manual testing, and prepares client-ready zoning analyses.

Partners with product, engineering, GIS/data, and business teams to support the accuracy and continued development of Envelope and related zoning products.

Works with sales reps to present and market the product when a more advanced subject matter expert is needed.

What You’ll Do

• Research and interpret NYC zoning regulations, maps, amendments, resolutions, and other applicable land-use requirements.
• Analyze development standards, including permitted uses, FAR, bulk, height and setback, yards, lot coverage, density, parking, special districts, overlays, and applicable bonuses.
• Monitor regulatory changes and assess their impact on properties, zoning analyses, product logic, data, and internal processes.
• Serve as a subject matter resource on complex or ambiguous zoning provisions.
• Perform zoning feasibility and baseline site analyses to test and validate Envelope outputs against applicable regulations, property data, and manual calculations.
• Provide guidance and technical support to less experienced zoning analysts on complex zoning research and interpretation.
• Translate complex zoning provisions into clear rules, calculations, and step-by-step logic for use within Envelope and related products.
• Partner with product, engineering, GIS/data, and business teams to translate zoning requirements into business, data, and product requirements.
• Communicate complex zoning requirements and findings to clients and internal stakeholders.
• Participate as needed in client meetings, product demonstrations, training, and presentations.

What You’ll Bring

Knowledge and Skills

• Familiarity with New York City zoning regulations, including the NYC Zoning Resolution and zoning maps.
• Strong understanding of zoning concepts such as FAR, permitted uses, bulk and dimensional requirements, height and setback regulations, density, special districts, overlays, and other development controls.
• Demonstrated ability to break down complex, text-based regulations into clear, structured rules, calculations, and logical requirements.
• Strong ability to independently evaluate zoning code changes and determine their practical impact on properties, analyses, processes, data, and products.
• Strong quality-control and technical-review skills, including the ability to manually validate technology-generated zoning analyses.
• Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain complex zoning concepts to technical and non-technical audiences.
• Strong project coordination and organizational skills.
• Experience working with cross-functional teams, including technology, product, engineering, operations, GIS/data, and client-facing teams.
• Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications.
• Familiarity with NYC property and planning data sources and mapping tools, such as PLUTO/MapPLUTO and ZoLa, preferred.
• Experience with GIS or mapping software, such as ArcGIS or QGIS, preferred.
• Familiarity with architectural or development analysis tools, such as AutoCAD or Rhino, is a plus.

Education and Experience

• Bachelor’s degree in urban planning, real estate, architecture, land use, geography, or a related field required.
• 5+ years of directly related zoning, land-use, planning, real estate, or regulatory analysis experience.
• Demonstrated experience independently researching and interpreting zoning regulations required.
• Experience reviewing zoning code amendments and regulatory changes and determining their impact strongly preferred.
• Experience with New York City zoning regulations, the NYC Zoning Resolution, and land-use requirements strongly preferred.
• Experience performing zoning feasibility, development potential, or site analysis preferred.
• Experience working with zoning, GIS, property-data, or real estate technology platforms preferred.

Pay Range: $29.30 - $39.07 Hourly

This hiring range is a reasonable estimate of the base pay range for this position at the time of posting.  Pay is based on a number of factors which may include job-related knowledge, skills, experience, business requirements and geographic location.

What We Offer

By choice, we don’t simply accept individuality – we embrace it, we support it, and we thrive on it! Our People First culture is inclusive for all employees - not just because it's the right thing to do, but because it's the key to our success. We are proud to foster an authentic and inclusive workplace For All. You are free and encouraged to bring your entire, unique self to work. First American is an equal opportunity employer in every sense of the term.

Based on eligibility, First American offers a comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, vision, 401k, PTO/paid sick leave and other great benefits like an employee stock purchase plan.

jobs.title: SBU LS/SWIFT Customer Support Engineer
jobs.description:
To make electronics, you need chips, wafers, transistors, reticles, and... To make these, you must see, test and manufacture them at scale—faster and better than ever before. That's where KLA comes in. Whether you're early in your career or an experienced professional, you'll solve complex challenges, work alongside brilliant minds and help shape the future of technology.

Group/Division

The KLA Services team consists of Service Sales, Marketing, Spares Supply Chain Management, Field Operations, Engineering, Product Training, Digital Solutions and Analytics, and Technical Product Support. Our services organization maximizes the value of our customers' KLA assets – with highly trained service and product support engineers providing installation services and 24/7 technical support and parts delivery through our extensive supply chain network.

What You'll Do

In this role, you will play a key part in advancing business priorities by delivering high-impact work across your area of expertise.

• Evaluates, analyzes, diagnoses and troubleshoots technical equipment problems via telephone or at customer site.
• Ensures equipment enhances customer production.
• Repairs and updates equipment at customer facility.
• Repairs of system level problems (which have multiple causes and for which no standard procedures exist) are based on engineer’s technical knowledge, education, training and certification.
• Engineer’s may access and determine the problems existing in customers' processes such as chemical leaks or contamination, and as a result may recommend shutdown of customer fab due to unsafe conditions

Minimum Qualifications

• BS degree in Engineering, Electronics, Physics, or Material Science
• Experience with defect, metrology, and inspection tools preferred.
• Good communication skills in English.
• Clear and logical communication skills.

About KLA

We provide advanced inspection tools, metrology systems, process solutions, and computational analytics that make electronics possible, tackling complex challenges. From electron and photon optics to machine learning and data analytics, we seek perfection at the most fundamental level of matter in the universe. If you want to make electronics that push industries forward and make the world a better place, join us.

Use of AI Statement

At KLA, our interviews seek to understand your individual skills, problem-solving approach and authentic thinking. To ensure a fair and consistent evaluation, the use of AI, recording tools or other technologies to generate, suggest or provide responses during interviews—whether virtual or in person—is not permitted unless explicitly approved in advance as part of a reasonable accommodation or invited by the interviewer. Use of these tools may interfere with our ability to evaluate your individual qualifications and affect your candidacy. KLA is committed to advancing innovation through responsible AI, and we value candidates who share this mindset.

We offer a competitive, family friendly total rewards package. We design our programs to reflect our commitment to an inclusive environment, while ensuring we provide benefits that meet the diverse needs of our employees.

KLA is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.

jobs.title: Warehouse & Assembly Technician
jobs.description:
Proconex is the exclusive Emerson Impact Partner for Emerson Automation Solutions in the Mid-Atlantic region. We provide a full portfolio of Process Automation Control Systems, Valves and Control Devices, and related technologies and services to a range of customers—in the Life Sciences, Chemical, Power, Refining, Oil & Gas, Food & Beverage, Paper, Metals, and other industries, as well as commercial enterprises and campus facilities. With three strategically located offices, Proconex maintains a deep dedication to its 200+ employees, a sharp focus on safety and quality, and the drive to deliver.

WAREHOUSE & ASSEMBLY TECHNICIAN - ENTRY LEVEL

Royersford, PA | Mon-Fri, Day Shift

Your Launch into Technical Careers

Are you a recent graduate or trade school student looking to start your technical career? Do you want hands-on experience working with real industrial equipment in a structured, organized environment? Proconex is hiring entry-level Warehouse & Assembly Technicians to join our fast-growing team in Royersford, PA.

This is a launching pad. We'll train you, mentor you, and give you the skills to advance into field service roles, lead technician, supervisor, or management positions within a reasonable amount of time.

What You'll Do

You'll be the backbone of our warehouse and assembly operations, supporting the Proconex sales organization and our customers. Your responsibilities include:

• Assembly – Assemble control valves, regulators, and automated valve systems with precision and attention to detail

• Quality Control – Perform safety checks and inspections on products after completing required training

• Warehouse Operations – Load and unload trucks, organize inventory, ship and receive materials, and manage material flow

• Technical Support – Assist with packaging, skid building, crate loading, and inventory management

• Facilities Support – Help maintain a clean, organized, safe work environment and support company operations

• Safety First – Follow all company and customer safety policies, maintain proper procedures, and prioritize a secure workplace

Be honest with yourself: This job is hands-on, detail-oriented, and physical. You'll be moving materials weighing up to 50 lbs, working in a warehouse environment, and following precise procedures. If you want routine desk work, this isn't it. If you're ready to build real technical skills and learn the foundation of industrial operations, let's go.

What We'll Teach You (3-4 Month Training)

You don't need prior experience. We provide formal training in:

• Valve assembly and product specifications

• Safety inspections and quality control procedures

• Warehouse operations and inventory management

• Shipping, receiving, and material handling

• Forklift operation

• Customer safety requirements and compliance

As you advance, you'll have access to Emerson factory training programs—industry-recognized certifications that open doors to field service, supervisory, or technical roles.

Advancement Paths

This role offers two clear career directions:

• Field Service Track – Move into our Field Service Technician role, working directly with customers in the field (higher responsibility, better pay)

• Warehouse Leadership Track – Advance to Lead Technician or Supervisor roles

Your performance and interests determine which path you pursue. Both offer growth, mentorship, and industry training.

What We're Looking For

• High school diploma or equivalent (or currently enrolled in/graduated from a trade or technical program)

• Mechanical aptitude and willingness to learn

• Strong attention to detail and ability to follow procedures

• Physical ability to lift up to 50 lbs and work in a warehouse environment

• Teamwork and communication skills

• Valid driver's license and clean driving record (preferred)

• Drug screening required

Preferred but not required:

• Forklift certification (we can train you)

• Trade school or technical background

• Any warehouse, inventory, or technical experience

• Shipping/receiving experience

Why Proconex?

• Mentorship-driven culture – You'll work alongside experienced technicians and leaders who invest in your growth

• Dual advancement paths – Choose field service or warehouse leadership; clear progression in a reasonable time

• Structured training – formal onboarding + Emerson factory training as you advance

• Supportive team – Collaborative environment where you're valued and your input matters

• Industry recognition – Part of Emerson Impact Partner Network; training opens doors in your career

• Stable, predictable schedule – Mon-Fri day shift with overtime opportunities

Ready to launch your technical career?

Apply Now!

We are proud to be an employee-owned organization. Through our ESOP, every team member shares in the growth and success of the company, fostering a culture of collaboration, accountability, and long-term rewards.

Proconex offers a standout culture, fantastic work environment, and has very competitive benefits to include premium medical, 401K match, tuition reimbursement, and other unique incentives.

Candidates must be legally eligible to work in the United States without company sponsorship.  Also, we are not interested in working on a corp-to-corp basis with other companies at this time.

We invite you to join the world of luxury hospitality at Fairmont Olympic as our new Director of Engineering! Are you a skilled and experienced engineering professional with a proven track record in overseeing maintenance and facility operations? Fairmont Olympic Hotel is seeking an accomplished and strategic Director of Engineering to lead our engineering team. If you possess exceptional technical expertise, excellent leadership skills, and a passion for maintaining a world-class facility, we invite you to take on this pivotal role and shape the future of our esteemed establishment!

• Leadership: Provide leadership and direction to the engineering team, ensuring optimal performance, productivity, and guest satisfaction.
• Strategic Planning: Develop and implement engineering strategies to enhance facility operations and achieve organizational goals.
• Budget Management: Manage the engineering department budget effectively, optimizing resources and controlling costs.
• Maintenance Oversight: Oversee the maintenance and repair of all mechanical, electrical, and structural components of the hotel to ensure smooth operations and safety.

jobs.title: Medical Laboratory Scientist - Immunology, Full-Time, Days (Sign-On Bonus Offered)
jobs.description:
This role qualifies for a $3,000 Sign-On Bonus

The Medical Laboratory Scientist reflects the mission, vision, and values of NM, adheres to the organization’s Code of Ethics and Corporate Compliance Program, and complies with all relevant policies, procedures, guidelines and all other regulatory and accreditation standards.

A Medical Laboratory Scientist performs test procedures in a clinical laboratory and conveys the results to the physician or designee in an accurate and timely manner for the purpose of patient diagnosis and treatment

RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Technical responsibilities:
• Performs all aspects of pre-analytic workflow appropriate for the specific laboratory section to ensure orders are entered correctly, specimens collected are appropriate for the test ordered and are correctly processed/transported.
• Verifies order where necessary
• Verifies non-patient information (e.g., collection time) according to established protocol.
• Handles unresolved orders, troubleshoots where needed.
• Verifies with physicians and/or nurses prior to laboratory information system (LIS) order entry to resolve unclear, duplicate or otherwise ambiguous orders.
• Verifies specimens for add-on tests are available and acceptable and generates add-on test orders.
• Recognizes when fraud and abuse compliance issues require adjustments to the test order
• Collecting, receiving and processing of specimens:
• Verifies specimens are correctly and completely labeled upon receipt. Evaluates specimens for appropriateness and takes necessary corrective action. Appropriately documents unacceptable specimens and proper notifications as needed.
• Prioritizes specimen processing based on established priorities.
• Aliquots specimens according to established protocols.
• Performs all aspects of analytical testing appropriate for the specific laboratory section,following established written protocols and standard operating procedures (SOP)

• Maintains test system integrity:
• Performs preventive maintenance on instruments/equipment in a timely fashion according to defined schedule.
• Verifies reagents and supplies meet defined acceptability criteria upon receipt and prior to use; takes action to ensure unacceptable items are removed from use.
• Ensures that sufficient reagents and supplies necessary for test performance are available. Notifies senior staff when minimum inventory level is encountered.
• Performs and records all necessary quality control (QC) required for test system performance.
• Evaluates QC results and takes necessary corrective actions according to established protocol.
• Performs specimen preparation:
• Performs any necessary pretest specimen preparation according to protocols (e.g., microbiology plating, cell cultures, filtering, extraction, separation, elution, absorption, etc.)
• Transfers or ships specimens to approved testing locations according to SOPs

• Performs tests:
• Prioritizes testing based on assignment or established priorities, completes testing within defined turn-around-times (TAT).
• Recognizes the need for and follows any age-specific protocols
• Responds effectively to changes in the workflow by coordinating a simultaneous series of tests when needed or adjusting work to incorporate STAT tests or fluctuations in work volume.
• Monitors daily workflow and priorities to assure meeting service levels.
• Performs technical review and interpretation:
• Reviews results for completeness, correctness, and consistency within defined test system
• Evaluates test results/reactions and provides accurate interpretations as appropriate to include correlation with, and integration of, other patient data as necessary.
• Performs visual interpretation/identifications as appropriate.
• Recognizes unusual test results/interpretations and completes indicated reflex testing or other follow-up actions.
• Follows established notification protocols for critical values, phone/fax/e-mail results requests, abnormalities.
• Troubleshoots and solves problems:
• Recognizes test system performance problems and takes necessary corrective actions
• Recognizes when unresolved problems need to be escalated and takes necessary follow-up action.
• Prints pending logs and follows-up to ensure pending tests are completed or cancelled when appropriate.
• Post-test specimen storage:
• Stores specimens and related materials (blood, slides, tissues, etc.) according to protocols for location and duration.
• Retrieves specimen and related materials when needed
• Post-analytical responsibilities:
• Performs all aspects of the post-analytical workflow appropriate for the specific laboratory section to ensure accurate results are reported within established time frames, specimens are retained appropriately, test results and/or current status are available upon inquiry, and billed charges are correct for testing performed.
• Verifies and reports results:
• Verifies results according to procedure.
• Performs computer functions necessary for releasing results.
• Generates written reports according to established protocol.
• Reviews electronic or printed reports when applicable, recognizes problems and escalates according to protocol.
• Amends reports:
• Corrects erroneous reports and amends reports according to procedure
• Responds to inquiries:
• Responds to requests for information according to established protocol for confidentiality and release of information
• Recognizes when unresolved inquiries need to be escalated and takes action
• Stores documents and records:
• Stores documents and records according to established protocol.
• Charge capture/billing:
• Performs billing and/or enter credits for tests and services when applicable.
• Recognizes billing problems and escalates accordingly
• Universal responsibilities:
• Ensures quality of operations:
• Follows written standard operating procedures (SOP).
• Operates instruments/equipment according to protocol.
• Uses computers according to established protocol; follows downtime procedures as required.
• Performs required quality system responsibilities
• Meets proficiency and competency standards of the department.
• Participates in the training of new employees and students
• Performs operational review of new SOPs.
• Participates in new test development, validations and implementation.
• Attends at least one personal development session per year
• Performs other duties as assigned, or as needed, to ensure continued quality operations
• Ensures safety of operations:
• Follows all required safety procedures, uses personal protective equipment (PPE) appropriate for tasks performed.
• Maintains cleans and organized work area
• Provides service excellence:
• Answers telephone when needed, using NM telephone etiquette
• Maintains patient confidentiality including protected health information (PHI)
• Assists patients, visitors and other contacts whenever need occurs

Minimum Requirements:

Education:

• Bachelor’s Degree in Medical Technology, Medical Laboratory Science, Clinical Laboratory Science, Chemistry, Biology, or Allied Health qualifying the applicant to take the American Society for Clinical Pathology (ASCP), or equivalent certification examination.

Certification:

• General MLS or MT (ASCP) Certification or eligible or
• Categorical BB, C, H or M (ASCP) Certification or eligible
• If hired after 1/19/2025 must be ASCP certified (or equivalent certification) within one year of employment

Northwestern Medicine is an equal opportunity employer (disability, VETS) and does not discriminate in hiring or employment on the basis of age, sex, race, color, religion, national origin, gender identity, veteran status, disability, sexual orientation or any other protected status.

Background Check

Northwestern Medicine conducts a background check that includes criminal history on newly hired team members and, at times, internal transfers. If you are offered a position with us, you will be required to complete an authorization and disclosure form that gives Northwestern Medicine permission to run the background check.  Results are evaluated on a case-by-case basis, and we follow all local, state, and federal laws, including the Illinois Health Care Worker Background Check Act.

Artificial Intelligence Disclosure

Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools may be used in some portions of the candidate review process for this position, however, all employment decisions will be made by a person.

Benefits

We offer a wide range of benefits that provide employees with tools and resources to improve their physical, emotional, and financial well-being while providing protection for unexpected life events.

Click on or copy and paste URL to your browser to view detailed benefits information https://jobs.nm.org/benefits

Please refer to the Benefits Eligibility by Employment Classification to determine benefits eligibility for job postings.

If sign-on bonus is included in a job posting eligibility is as followed: Internal employees and rehires who left Northwestern Medicine within 1 year are not eligible for the sign-on bonus. Exception: New graduate internal employees seeking their first licensed clinical position as a Registered Nurse at NM may be eligible.

jobs.title: Prototyping Engineer, Automation & Hardware
jobs.description:
About the Role

We’re looking for someone early in their career who likes making physical systems work. You’ll build, wire and modify the prototypes and test rigs our R&D team uses to develop new bioreactor technology, from benchtop setups to pilot reactors. One day that’s wiring a control panel; the next it’s plumbing a skid or chasing down why a sensor drifts. You’ll work alongside our engineers and learn how industrial fermentation equipment is designed, built and run.

Responsibilities

• Build and modify prototypes, test rigs and bioreactor systems: mechanical assembly, sanitary fittings and tubing, pumps, valves, heaters and gas lines.

• Wire and program small control systems: PLCs and microcontrollers, motor drivers, sensors (temperature, pH, dissolved oxygen, pressure, flow) and mass flow controllers.

• Run experiments, keep clean data and build records.

• Troubleshoot equipment and fix it.

• Document what you build: wiring diagrams, parts lists and procedures.

• Help commission new equipment, and keep our lab and pilot systems running.

Qualifications

• Have built physical things that work, at school, at a job or on your own.

• Can wire and troubleshoot basic electrical and control systems, and have programmed a PLC, an Arduino, a Raspberry Pi or similar.

• Are handy with tools, and ideally have done some machining or fabrication.

• Have worked around bioreactors, fermenters or other lab or process equipment, in a lab, a brewery, a food or biotech plant, or similar.

• Take safety seriously around electricity, pressure, steam, compressed gases and chemicals.

• Have a degree in mechanical, electrical, chemical or biological engineering, mechatronics, or equivalent hands-on experience.

• You don’t need all of these. If you’ve built real things and want to learn bioprocess hardware, apply.

Preferred Skills

• Industrial automation: CODESYS, Siemens, or SCADA and HMI tools such as Ignition

• Sanitary process hardware: tri-clamp fittings, diaphragm valves, cleaning in place

• Building or running fermentation or cell culture equipment

Benefits

At Biosphere, our goal is to empower talented individuals who are driven by the desire to work on tackling society's biggest challenges. To that end, we take pride in striving to be an equal opportunity employer with a healthy work culture, creating an environment where high performers can thrive. We currently offer the following benefits:

• Competitive compensation through a mix of salary and equity.

• Unlimited paid vacation and sick/leave days + public holidays.

• Comprehensive health insurance for employees and their dependents, including dental and vision.

• Paid family leave.

• Membership at Pacific Pipe Climbing gym next door.

Biosphere is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

jobs.title: Member of Technical Staff - Applied ML, RecSys
jobs.description:
ABOUT LIQUID AI

Spun out of MIT CSAIL, we build general-purpose AI systems that run efficiently across deployment targets, from data center accelerators to on-device hardware, ensuring low latency, minimal memory usage, privacy, and reliability. We partner with enterprises across consumer electronics, automotive, life sciences, and financial services. We are scaling rapidly and need exceptional people to help us get there.




THE OPPORTUNITY

This is a rare chance to apply frontier sequential recommendation architectures to real enterprise problems at scale. You will own applied ML work end-to-end for recommendation system workloads, adapting Liquid Foundation Models for customers who need personalization and ranking capabilities that run efficiently under production constraints.

Unlike most recommendation roles that are siloed into a single product surface, this role gives you full ownership over how large-scale recommendation models are adapted, evaluated, and deployed for enterprise customers. Between engagements, you will build reusable applied tooling and workflows that accelerate future delivery.

If you care about data quality at scale, user behavior modeling, and making recommendation systems actually work in enterprise production environments, this is the role.




WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

We need someone who:

 - Takes ownership: Owns customer recommendation system engagements end-to-end, from requirements through delivery and evaluation.

 - Thinks at scale: Can reason about user interaction data, sequential modeling, feature engineering, and evaluation across large-scale production systems.

 - Is pragmatic: Optimizes for measurable customer outcomes (engagement, conversion, revenue lift) over theoretical novelty.

 - Communicates clearly: Can translate between customer business metrics and internal technical decisions, and push back when needed.




THE WORK

 - Act as the technical owner for enterprise customer engagements involving recommendation and ranking workloads

 - Translate customer requirements into concrete specifications for recommendation models

 - Design and execute data pipelines for user interaction data, feature engineering, and training data curation at scale

 - Fine-tune and adapt large-scale sequential recommendation models (e.g., HSTU-style architectures) for customer-specific use cases

 - Design task-specific evaluations for recommendation model performance (ranking quality, latency, throughput) and interpret results

 - Build reusable applied tooling and workflows that accelerate future customer engagements




DESIRED EXPERIENCE

Must-have:

 - Hands-on experience building or fine-tuning recommendation models at scale (not just off-the-shelf collaborative filtering)

 - Experience with sequential recommendation architectures, user behavior modeling, or large-scale ranking systems

 - Strong intuition for data quality and evaluation design in recommendation contexts (offline metrics, A/B testing, business metric alignment)

 - Experience with large-scale data pipelines for user interaction data and feature engineering

 - Proficiency in Python and PyTorch with autonomous coding and debugging ability

Nice-to-have:

 - Experience with transformer-based recommendation architectures (HSTU, SASRec, BERT4Rec, or similar)

 - Experience delivering recommendation systems to external customers with measurable business outcomes

 - Familiarity with serving recommendation models under latency and throughput constraints




WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE (YEAR ONE)

 - Independently owns and delivers enterprise recommendation system engagements with minimal oversight

 - Is trusted by customers as the technical owner, demonstrating strong judgment on the tradeoffs between model quality, latency, and business impact

 - Has built reusable applied workflows or tooling that accelerate future customer engagements




WHAT WE OFFER

 - Real ML work: You will build and adapt large-scale recommendation models for enterprise customers, working with frontier architectures like HSTU under real production constraints.

 - Compensation: Competitive base salary with equity in a unicorn-stage company

 - Health: We pay 100% of medical, dental, and vision premiums for employees and dependents

 - Financial: 401(k) matching up to 4% of base pay

 - Time Off: Unlimited PTO plus company-wide Refill Days throughout the year

This position is expected to begin Summer 2027.

Candidates who have graduated with a Bachelor’s Degree and plan to continue with the Master’s Degree are also eligible to apply for these positions. Graduates must have been enrolled in their bachelor’s degree in the most previous school term with an interest in pursuing an advanced degree in the same or similar discipline at the conclusion of the internship.

Preferred Qualifications:

• Completed courses related to statics, strength of materials, introductory steel design, and introductory reinforced concrete design.
• Ability to follow procedures and pay attention to detail.
• Good written and oral communications skills.
• Familiarity with Microsoft Office and AutoCAD.

• Relocation assistance is not available for this position.

jobs.title: Senior Technical Project Manager (Enterprise Modernization & AI Delivery
jobs.description:
About Tessera Labs

Tessera is an AI-native platform for enterprise transformation. The multi-agent platform delivers governed execution across ERP, CRM, HCM, and finance systems, cutting timelines from years to weeks and costs by more than half. Built on deep expertise across Oracle, SAP, Salesforce, Workday, and other systems of record, Tessera address the scope a system integrator would have traditionally taken up with the speed of execution and efficiency of an AI-native platform.

 

For decades, enterprises have struggled with fragmented business systems, where migrations have consumed hundreds of millions of dollars, data stayed inconsistent and unreliable, and business processes slowed under manual review. Tessera was founded to change that, for SAP and every other system enterprises depend on. The name itself — a tessera, a single tile in a mosaic — reflects our mission: unifying the disparate pieces of the enterprise into a coherent whole. Tessera is an AI-powered, multi-agent platform that harmonizes systems and lets teams work in plain English.

Our mission: Modernize global enterprises safely, automatically, and at unprecedented speed. We move fast, own outcomes end-to-end, and build at the frontier of applied AI for large-scale transformation.

Role Summary
We are seeking a Technical Project Manager (TPM) with deep expertise in delivery and value stream management to lead our most strategic customer implementations. In this role, you are not just a project scheduler. You are the delivery leader who directs cross-functional pods across multiple parallel workstreams, making sure Tessera’s multi-agent AI solutions are integrated predictably, safely, and successfully into complex enterprise environments, and that every phase of the engagement delivers measurable value.

You will be the bridge between Tessera and enterprise client’s delivery team spanning core business systems, ERP, CRM, finance, HR, and operational platforms. The role calls for strong technical fluency across enterprise architectures, business processes, integrations, and transformation programs.

You will work closely with customer Solution Architects, technical teams, system owners, and business stakeholders, translating operational and technical requirements into actionable plans for Tessera’s delivery pods. You will use your understanding of enterprise modernization to guide issue resolution, support architecture discussions, and keep every workstream aligned on what is required, technically feasible, and most valuable to the customer.

The ideal candidate has spent years leading delivery within System Integrator environments or large enterprises and wants to apply AI to accelerate modernization at scale.

 

Key Responsibilities

Cross-Functional Delivery Pod Leadership

 - Lead cross-functional delivery pods of Forward-Deployed Engineers, Data Engineers, and AI engineering teams, setting priorities, removing blockers, and holding the team accountable to outcomes

 - Own end-to-end delivery of multi-agent AI modernization programs from discovery through deployment and operational handoff

 - Build pod structures, cadences, and operating rhythms that scale across multiple concurrent customer engagements

 - Anticipate technical friction points related to data structures, legacy customizations, integrations, and workflow orchestration before they affect the pod’s velocity

Multi-Workstream Orchestration

 - Run multiple parallel workstreams across data, integration, AI agent configuration, testing, and business process alignment, managing dependencies and sequencing between them

 - Coordinate across Tessera teams, customer stakeholders, and third-party vendors to maintain delivery momentum across every workstream

 - Develop integrated program plans that give leadership a single view of progress, risk, and value across all workstreams

 - Support modernization efforts spanning core business systems, CRM, finance, HRIS, and operational platforms

Delivery & Value Stream Management

 - Map customer value streams end to end, identifying where Tessera’s agentic AI capabilities remove manual effort, shorten cycle times, and reduce cost

 - Define and track delivery and value metrics such as time-to-value, throughput, cycle time, and business outcomes achieved, and report them to executive stakeholders

 - Prioritize work by business value, so the highest-impact capabilities reach customers first

 - Continuously improve delivery flow by identifying bottlenecks, handoff delays, and waste across the program

Technical Communication & Stakeholder Alignment

 - Act as the primary technical interpreter between customer technical teams, business stakeholders, and Tessera’s AI and product organizations

 - Lead discovery workshops to map system landscapes, business processes, data flows, and integration points to Tessera’s agentic AI capabilities

 - Translate technical trade-offs, delivery plans, and value outcomes for both executive stakeholders and delivery teams

 - Facilitate alignment across enterprise architecture, IT operations, security, and business functions

Execution in Complex Enterprise Landscapes

 - Drive Agile delivery within enterprise change management frameworks and modernization methodologies

 - Anticipate risks related to legacy system remediation, data harmonization, integration dependencies, and business continuity

 - Develop mitigation plans grounded in operational and technical realities

Enterprise-Grade Governance & Deployment

 - Ensure all delivery activities meet enterprise standards for security, compliance, auditability, and operational governance

 - Oversee technical prerequisites for integrations across enterprise platforms and cloud environments

 - Partner with customer security and infrastructure teams to ensure successful deployments and operational readiness

Customer Engagement & Escalation Management

 - Serve as the primary delivery contact during onboarding and implementation

 - Manage technical escalations from customer IT and business teams, coordinating responses across pods, engineering, and product

 - Build trusted relationships with enterprise customers through clear communication, accountability, and consistent delivery

Startup Mindset & Extreme Ownership

 - Operate effectively in a fast-paced, high-growth environment with evolving priorities and ambiguous challenges

 - Bring structure, clarity, and momentum to complex enterprise transformation programs

 - Travel to customer sites for workshops, solution design sessions, and implementation oversight as needed

Required Qualifications

 - 4–6+ years of experience leading technical delivery for large enterprise modernization or transformation programs

 - Proven track record leading cross-functional delivery teams or pods through complex, technically demanding implementations

 - Demonstrated experience running multiple concurrent workstreams with significant dependencies

 - Experience mapping and managing value streams, and tying delivery work to measurable business outcomes

 - Comfort defining, tracking, and reporting delivery and value metrics to executive audiences

 - Strong understanding of enterprise business systems, integrations, data flows, and modernization challenges

 - Experience with one or more enterprise platforms such as SAP, Oracle, NetSuite, Workday, Salesforce, Microsoft Dynamics, Infor, or similar

 - Familiarity with enterprise architecture concepts, APIs, middleware, and cross-platform integrations

 - Ability to explain technical concepts, system constraints, integration challenges, and data models to both engineering teams and business stakeholders

 - Strong executive presence and stakeholder management skills

 - Strong command of Agile methodologies and experience orchestrating complex programs with multiple dependencies

Preferred Qualifications

 - Experience at a top-tier consulting or system integration firm (e.g., Accenture, Deloitte, PwC, EY, IBM, Capgemini), or leading large enterprise modernization programs internally

 - Experience delivering AI/ML-enabled programs, or strong interest in LLMs, automation, and multi-agent AI orchestration

 - Familiarity integrating ERP and other core systems with adjacent platforms including CRM, HRIS, finance, analytics, middleware, and cloud infrastructure

 - PMP, Scrum Master, SAFe, value stream management, enterprise platform certifications, or related certifications are a plus

Behavioral & Problem-Solving Expectations

 - Balance technical systems understanding with program structure and executive communication

 - Lead pods with clarity, accountability, and a bias toward outcomes over activity

 - Operate with extreme ownership and thrive in ambiguity

 - Simplify complexity and drive alignment across technical and business teams

 - Keep a strong customer-first, value-first mindset throughout complex transformation programs

jobs.title: Director of PR & Communications
jobs.description:
About Norm Ai
Norm Ai, the agentic law company, has a client base with a combined $30 trillion in assets under management.


Norm Ai pioneered Legal Engineering, the process that empowers lawyers to build and supervise domain-specific AI agents with Norm’s proprietary suite of no-code software tools. Norm Ai technology is deployed inside many of the largest and most consequential institutions in the world.


Norm Ai is also the technology behind Norm Law, LLP, a separate but affiliated AI-native law firm built for the era of agentic AI. Norm Law’s attorneys advise leading institutions across private funds, private equity, venture capital, real estate, registered funds, and financial regulation, using the same legal intelligence platform that powers Norm Ai’s products.

AI Fluency:
Norm Ai prefers all team members to be fluent in AI. Successful candidates actively use AI in their day-to-day work to support thinking, creation, and problem-solving. They use it to improve the quality and speed of their work and to continuously refine how work gets done end-to-end.

Candidates should be prepared to demonstrate and discuss their AI usage throughout the interview process, including concrete examples of tools, workflows, and outcomes. We look for practical, hands-on experience, not theoretical familiarity.




THIS ROLE

Norm is seeking a Director of PR & Communications to build and lead an external communications program that strengthens the reputations of both Norm and Norm Law, our affiliated AI-native law firm. This role will establish a clear, credible voice at the intersection of AI, legal services, regulation, and business.

Reporting to the Head of Marketing, you will own PR and communications across the broader Norm organization. You will shape how our founder, executives, Norm Law leadership, and partners communicate with the media, policymakers, clients, investors, and other influential audiences.

A central part of the role will be supporting the growth and reputation of Norm Law. You will work closely with law-firm leadership and partners to translate their expertise into compelling narratives, identify meaningful media and thought-leadership opportunities, and ensure Norm Ai and Norm Law tell one coherent story.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Build the communications strategy: Develop an integrated approach to media relations, executive communications, public affairs, thought leadership, and reputation management across Norm and Norm Law.

 - Advance the Norm Law narrative: Shape how Norm Law communicates its differentiated model, practice-area expertise, client value, and role in the future of legal services.

 - Translate narratives into executive and partner communications: Partner with the Head of Marketing to turn Norm’s core positioning—and the expertise of our founder, executives, and Norm Law partners—into social content, essays, op-eds, speeches, talking points, and public positions.

 - Lead media relations: Build relationships with business, technology, AI, legal, and policy reporters while managing inbound requests, proactive outreach, interviews, and follow-up.

 - Define messages and guardrails: Maintain core narratives, proof points, Q&A, spokesperson guidance, and sensitive-issues frameworks across the technology company and law firm.

 - Prepare spokespeople: Create briefing materials, lead preparation sessions, staff interviews, and ensure executives and partners communicate consistently and credibly.

 - Own the operating process: Establish clear intake, evaluation, approval, tracking, and escalation processes for media, speaking, podcast, byline, and partner-content opportunities.

 - Lead partners and manage risk: Direct external communications agencies, hold partners accountable, identify emerging issues early, and navigate client confidentiality, professional obligations, and reputational risk.
   
   


WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR:




CORE QUALIFICATIONS

 - 8+ years experience leading PR, corporate communications, executive communications, public affairs, or media relations.

 - A track record of serving as a trusted communications adviser to founders, executives, senior partners, or other high-profile subject-matter experts.

 - Exceptional writing and editorial judgment, including experience ghostwriting executive or partner social content, speeches, essays, op-eds, and bylines.

 - Strong media instincts and experience building productive relationships with top-tier reporters and managing external agencies.

 - The judgment to navigate sensitive topics, client confidentiality, reputational risk, complex approvals, and highly scrutinized claims.

 - The ability to translate technical, legal, regulatory, or policy-heavy subjects into clear and compelling public narratives.

 - Strong operational ownership and the ability to build effective systems in a fast-moving environment with evolving priorities.
   
   


NICE TO HAVES

 - Experience supporting a law firm, legal-services organization, professional-services business, or other partner-led environment.

 - Familiarity with AI, legal technology, financial services, government, or regulation.

 - An established network across business, technology, AI, legal, policy, or government media.

 - Experience supporting major company milestones, law-firm launches, practice-area growth, fundraising announcements, or regulatory developments.
   
   


WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE




30 DAYS

 - Develop a strong understanding of Norm, Norm Law, their leadership teams, practice areas, audiences, existing narratives, and reputational priorities.

 - Build relationships with key executives and Norm Law partners while auditing current messaging, media materials, agency workflows, and communications requests.

 - Take ownership of the communications intake process and establish a reliable working cadence with leadership and agency partners.


60 DAYS

 - Establish aligned message houses for Norm and Norm Law, including spokesperson guidance, proof points, sensitive topics, and language governing how the two organizations are described together.

 - Launch an editorial program for our founder, executives, and priority Norm Law partners with a consistent calendar and review process.

 - Present a prioritized media and public-affairs strategy spanning company priorities, Norm Law practice areas, target reporters, opportunities, and risks.


90 DAYS

 - Run a proactive and reliable communications program with clear ownership, deadlines, approvals, and escalation paths.

 - Build an active pipeline of executive and partner thought leadership, media opportunities, and direct reporter relationships.

 - Ensure Norm executives, Norm Law partners, agencies, and internal teams communicate from consistent messages and approved positions.

 - Establish communications as a meaningful driver of Norm Law’s reputation, practice-area visibility, and broader business priorities.
   
   


COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS

Base salary: 200,000 - 250,000

The range displayed in this job posting reflects the minimum and maximum target for new-hire salary for this position. Within the range, individual pay is determined by various factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

Equity: Included

Benefits: 401(k) with employer match; health, dental, and vision coverage; unlimited paid time off; free lunch in the office daily; and an employee referral bonus program.

Relocation: Financial support to ease your move to New York City, designed to make the transition smooth and stress-free.




WORK LOCATION

Location: New York City

Work model: Hybrid

In-office expectation: 3–4 days per week

To learn more about Norm Ai, visit our website https://www.norm.ai.

jobs.description:
Tenstorrent is leading the industry on cutting-edge AI technology, revolutionizing performance expectations, ease of use, and cost efficiency. With AI redefining the computing paradigm, solutions must evolve to unify innovations in software models, compilers, platforms, networking, and semiconductors. Our diverse team of technologists have developed a high performance RISC-V CPU from scratch, and share a passion for AI and a deep desire to build the best AI platform possible. We value collaboration, curiosity, and a commitment to solving hard problems. We are growing our team and looking for contributors of all seniorities.

Tenstorrent is leading the industry on cutting-edge AI technology, and our Legal team supports that work at every turn: commercial deals, global partnerships, financings and IP. We are looking for a Senior Manager, Legal Operations to build the engine behind it. You will own the tools, workflows and data that let a lean legal team operate like a much larger one, so our attorneys can focus on the judgment calls that matter most. This is a builder's role with real room to shape how Legal works as we grow.

This role is hybrid, based out of Santa Clara, CA, Austin, TX, Boston, MA or Toronto, ON.

We welcome candidates at various experience levels for this role. During the interview process, candidates will be assessed for the appropriate level, and offers will align with that level, which may differ from the one in this posting.

Who You Are

• Contracts Pro: Hands-on experience with commercial agreements of all types, including NDAs, MSAs and amendments, plus the templates and playbooks that keep them consistent.

• Data-Driven Operator: Comfortable building KPIs, and overseeing legal vendors and outside counsel bills.

• Document Expert: Seasoned in legal holds, collection and production of documents and in gathering and cataloging materials for litigation, M&A and investor diligence.

• Measure What Matters: Develop and track KPIs for legal efficiency, and refine Legal’s processes as the team scales.

What You Will Learn

• Hands-on experience shaping AI-enabled legal workflows at a company that builds AI infrastructure.

• How legal teams partner with Finance, Procurement, Sales, Security, IT, People, Engineering, and Operations across a global organization.

Tenstorrent offers a highly competitive compensation package and benefits, and we are an equal opportunity employer.
