jobs.title: H&M Sales Advisor - Outlets at Castle Rock
jobs.description:
About the Role

As a Sales Advisor, you'll be responsible for providing excellent customer service, welcoming & guiding customers through your store to actively sell our products and providing customers with support & guidance. You'll use your fashion and product knowledge to provide our customers with all the relevant information they need for the best experience. You'll also work on garment refill & care, presentation and contribute to a clean and tidy sales floor and back of house, working closely with the rest of your store team to deliver an excellent customer experience.

A Day in the Life

Working at H&M means no two days are ever the same, but a typical day will include the following responsibilities*

Customer Sales & Profit

• Provide excellent customer service: welcoming & guiding customers through the store & OMNI experience where available, supporting them with direct customer service
• Willingness to engage and have conversations with customers to provide excellent service
• Guide customers through our fashion trends, stories & products in all areas of the store
• Ability to effectively promote and sell our products to customers
• Actively promote our Customer Loyalty App (Hello Member) & in-store sustainability initiatives
• Representing yourself and the H&M brand positively during all customer interactions
• Support with commercial or operational actions to reach sales targets with store management team

General Information

Fashion & Trend Awareness

• Keep up-to-date with fashion scene, trends, tendencies, styles, brands, products, competitors, and relevant influencers, etc.
• Use your product & fashion knowledge to share relevant information to customers

Team & Development

• Retain and share your service, fashion and store operations knowledge and skills with colleagues
• Follow all procedures, routines, and legal requirements in all areas of the store
• Give & receive feedback with your colleagues to learn, develop & support each other
• Participate in relevant available Onboarding, introduction processes & trainings and courses relevant for your role & future development

Retail Operations/ Visual & Commercial Execution

• Complete full garment cycle from unpacking and refill to steaming and ensure good garment care
• Operate fitting room and checkout areas according to best practice & processes
• Contribute to a clean and tidy sales floor and back of house (including stockrooms)
• Support with garment presentation, execution and maintain attractive merchandise displays, clear trends & stories according to visual & commercial guidelines
• Ensure good stock levels with replenishment routines on sales floor
• Upkeep & follow best practice for any in-store OMNI Services & in-store tech services/tools, etc (Instore Care App, Click & Collect, Smart Store etc)
• Support with opening and closing of the store
• Following all H&S guidelines and legal requirements applicable to role and responsibilities

Who You Are

• As a Sales Advisor, you'll be passionate about fashion and everything we create in-store.
• Motivated by giving customers a great experience.
• You should also be communicative, creative and curious, motivated, flexible, decisive, and action-oriented.
• You should also enjoy working in a collaborative and dynamic environment.
• You have sales experience working in a dynamic and collaborative environment that you can apply to your role
• Experience working with customer service in fashion, retail or other service-related industries

Why You'll Love Working at H&M

• We value diverse backgrounds, including but not limited to race, ethnicity, gender, age, religion, sexual orientation, and disability
• We pride ourselves on being a values-driven organization, guided by our 7 unique values that have been part of our success story for over 75 years
• You'll have access to our Colleague Resource Groups (CRGs) to find community and networking opportunities among colleagues
• We are an inclusive company where you're encouraged to be yourself at work
• You will have access to a large global talent community, where career growth and aspirations have no limits
• We believe in supporting your overall wellbeing and offer comprehensive benefits inclusive of health insurance, wellness and family support programs, company match retirement plan, paid leave programs, and paid time off, including a community day to serve your local community
• You'll be able to express your personal style with our employee discount at H&M, & Other Stories, and COS

Job Status: Hourly, Non-Exempt

EEOC Code: SLS

Compensation: Sales Associates Pay Rate $17.00 per hour**

*This job posting highlights the most critical responsibilities and requirements of the job and is not all-inclusive. There may be additional duties, and responsibilities assigned for this job at the company's discretion.

**H&M, in good faith, has assessed this posted range of compensation as the accurate range for this role and location at the time of this posting. H&M may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range depending on candidate qualifications. This range may be modified in the future.

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for applicants with disabilities. If you require assistance or accommodation during the application or interview process, please contact us at https://hm.ethicspoint.com, and use Ask a Question.

Benefits:

We offer all our employees at H&M Group attractive benefits with extensive development opportunities around the globe. All our employees receive a staff discount card, usable on all our H&M Group brands in stores and online. Brands covered by the discount are H&M (Beauty and Move included), COS, Weekday, Monki, H&M HOME, & Other Stories, ARKET, Afound. In addition to our staff discount, all our employees are included in our H&M Incentive Program – HIP. You can read more about our H&M Incentive Program here.

In addition to our global benefits, all our local markets offer different competitive perks and benefits. Please note that they may differ between employment type and countries.

Inclusion & Diversity:

H&M is a part of H&M Group. At H&M Group, we’re determined to create and maintain inclusive, diverse and equitable workplaces throughout our organization. Our teams should consist of a variety of people that share and combine their knowledge, experience and ideas. Having a diverse workforce leads to a positive impact on how we address challenges, on what we perceive possible and on how we choose to relate to our colleagues and customers all over the world. Hence, all diversity dimensions are considered in our recruitment process.

We strive to have a fair and equal process and therefore kindly ask you not to attach a cover letter in your application as they often contain information that easily can trigger unintentional biases.

Company Description:

H&M is a fashion brand that offers the latest styles and inspiration, from fashion pieces and unique designer collaborations to affordable wardrobe essentials. Our business idea is fashion & quality at the best price in a sustainable way. Learn more about H&M here.

H&M Fashion USA, Inc. – Maki Assessment Tool:

We use an online assessment tool called Maki for skills-based selection of applicants for sales advisor positions within some of our stores. Maki is not an automated decision-making tool. Rather, it is a tool that uses an AI-created avatar to present to you a set of multiple-choice questions. These questions are prepared by the H&M hiring team to assess candidates’ ability to perform the duties of the position for which they are applying. The assessment calculates your total score based on predefined point values provided by our H&M team. The hiring team will review your whole application, including your assessment score, to decide whether to advance each candidate to the next stage. Doing the assessment is optional. If you choose to complete the assessment, your score will be one factor that the hiring team considers.

If you have any difficulties or concerns with the online assessment method, you can request an alternative method of assessment by contacting recruitment_support@hm.com. Choosing an alternative method will not affect your chances of being considered for the position, nor does any assessment method provide an advantage or disadvantage in the selection process. You will have the opportunity to provide optional feedback immediately after the assessment and you may always ask questions.

When you take the assessment, we collect your responses and use this information to evaluate your suitability for the role to which you have applied. The answers are saved in your applicant profile. We do not sell the information captured in the questionnaire and do not use any personal information to train any AI models. Our applicant tracking system provider has access to this information but is contractually prohibited from using it for any other purpose.

During this process, we may collect information from you through cookies, with your consent. This may include details such as your electronic network activity information (IP address, timestamps, and device identifiers). This information is accessible to our hiring team but is otherwise kept confidential. For more information, please refer to our Cookie Notice.

We retain this information for 3 years in your applicant file and use it as set forth in our Applicant Privacy Notice. For more information on how your personal data is processed by us, please refer to our Applicant Privacy Notice.

jobs.title: Senior Project Manager / Scrum Master
jobs.description:
Location: Washington, DC (CA/PPT Headquarters, SA-17, 600 19th Street NW)

Work Arrangement: On-site (telework only as identified and approved by CA/PPT)

Type: Full-Time

Clearance: Active SECRET security clearance; Department of State building pass required

Travel: None anticipated

Status: Contingent Upon Award

Company Overview:

Since 2017, Kymber Consulting Group has been blazing a trail through the consulting landscape, providing solutions across healthcare, defense, and civilian sectors. We're trusted advisors for high-visibility, high-impact engagements, rapidly becoming a valued partner within both government agencies and large established firms in the space. Kymber employs a collaborative team approach to deliver high value, tailored, and innovative solutions. Our engagement teams are built to meet each client’s unique needs. Our employees currently support a variety of Defense and Civilian agencies.

Job Summary:

We are seeking a highly qualified Senior Project Manager / Scrum Master to support the U.S. Department of State, Bureau of Consular Affairs, Passport Services Directorate (CA/PPT). CA/PPT directs a nationwide network of 29 passport agencies and centers and nearly 8,000 acceptance facilities that issue approximately 20 million passports each year, and is strengthening its headquarters operations through ISO 9001 quality management and Scaled Agile (SAFe) practices. The Senior Project Manager / Scrum Master serves as primary Scrum Master for one or more Agile teams and implements and manages Quality Management Systems in alignment with ISO 9001. This is a Key Personnel position under the contract.

Responsibilities and Duties:

• Serve as primary Scrum Master for one or more Agile teams, fostering collaboration, learning, and continuous improvement.

• Facilitate Scrum events and SAFe program increment activities.

• Implement and manage Quality Management Systems in alignment with ISO 9001 to ensure high-quality deliverables.

• Proactively identify and remove impediments to team progress and protect the team from external distractions.

• Track team metrics and report progress to program leadership.

Qualifications and Skills:

• Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree (9 years of relevant experience may be substituted for the degree).

• Minimum experience: 5 years.

• Required certification: PMI Agile Certified Practitioner (PMI-ACP) or Certified ScrumMaster (CSM); Certified Scrum Professional (CSP) also accepted.

• Strong understanding of Scrum practices and a proven record implementing a Quality Management System in compliance with ISO 9001.

• Proficiency with Microsoft Office, including Outlook, Teams, Word, PowerPoint, Excel, and SharePoint, and ability to prepare written products in accordance with the Department of State writing guide.

• Active SECRET security clearance (or ability to obtain one prior to start) and ability to obtain a Department of State building pass; Moderate Risk Public Trust investigation may be required for designated positions.

• 401K plan

• Short-term disability, Long-term, and Life Insurance

• Education and Training Assistance Program

• Incentive Plans and Referral Bonuses

• Employee Assistance Programs

jobs.title: Customs Associate
jobs.description:
About Flexport:

At Flexport, we believe global trade can move the human race forward. That’s why it’s our mission to make global commerce so easy there will be more of it. We’re shaping the future of a $10T industry with solutions powered by innovative technology and exceptional people. Today, companies of all sizes—from emerging brands to Fortune 500s—use Flexport technology to move more than $19B of merchandise across 112 countries a year.

The recent global supply chain crisis has put Flexport center stage as we continue to play a pivotal role in how goods move around the world. We are proud to have the support of the best investors in the game who believe in our mission, solutions and people. Ready to tackle global challenges that impact business, society, and the environment? Come join us.

The opportunity:

Flexport continues to experience significant growth as a technology platform for international trade. One of the company's core products is Customs which is working on behalf of clients to facilitate the import of goods across international borders. The process includes classifying the imported items, calculating duties, and transmitting this information to the US government. The Customs team works with clients, shippers, and other freight companies to collect and file the necessary documentation required by different governments to import goods. Internally, the Customs team works closely with our technology partners to drive innovation through process automation. This product is positioned for more than 10x growth in the coming five years.

This is a great opportunity for someone with at least 1 year of Customs experience to join the broker of the future. As part of our team, you'll leverage state-of-the-art technology to streamline and automate customs processes, setting new standards in the industry. You’ll be working alongside industry leaders and experts in a vibrant, intellectually stimulating environment that thrives on innovation and teamwork to drive global trade. We invest in our people and provide continuous learning opportunities to help you advance in your career and become a thought leader in the customs brokerage field. Be part of Flexport, where your contributions as a Customs Broker will not only redefine the trade landscape and help us build the future of global trade!

Key Responsibilities:

• Navigate the complex landscape of customs regulations and ensure that all goods comply with international protocols and legal requirements

• Obtain necessary documents and provide complete and accurate information to CBP to facilitate smooth customs clearance

• Collaborate with international clients and logistics partners to provide them with timely and accurate customs advice and support

• Optimize customs processes using Flexport's proprietary technology, providing insights and data-driven recommendations to our clients

• You will be responsible for ensuring your work satisfies internal key performance indicators that demonstrate quality and timeliness.

• Follow standard operating procedures (SOP) and improve processes as needed

• Participate in business reviews on a regular cadence including presentation prep as well as hold client operational calls when deemed necessary

Qualifications:

• At least 1 year experience as a Customs Entry Writer

• Familiarity with U.S. Customs regulations, classifications, and rulings

• A "compliance-first" mindset, with a commitment to maintaining the highest standards of integrity and regulatory adherence

• Works independently with minimal supervision

• Works under fluctuating pressure and tight deadlines

• Adapt to new technology and can thrive in a fast paced environment

• Effective time management. Be able to properly prioritize and manage a large volume of tasks

• High attention to detail

• Effectively seek and receive feedback

• Effective communication both verbally and in writing

• Orientation towards working smarter and adopting best practices and standardization

• Strong problem-solving capabilities

• Bachelor's degree in Business, Supply Chain Management, or a related field a plus

jobs.title: Southwest Policy Manager
jobs.description:
Waymo is an autonomous driving technology company with the mission to be the world's most trusted driver. Since its start as the Google Self-Driving Car Project in 2009, Waymo has focused on building the Waymo Driver—The World's Most Experienced Driver™—to improve access to mobility while saving thousands of lives now lost to traffic crashes. The Waymo Driver powers Waymo’s fully autonomous ride-hail service and can also be applied to a range of vehicle platforms and product use cases. The Waymo Driver has provided over ten million rider-only trips, enabled by its experience autonomously driving over 100 million miles on public roads and tens of billions in simulation across 15+ U.S. states.

The Southwest Policy Manager will be the face of Waymo as we preserve our freedom to operate in Texas and Arizona, particularly as we look to increase our public-facing service in these states. This role will help us strategize and navigate state and local policy and regulatory challenges particularly as the business faces increasing headwinds from a political environment.  Who do we need to know, what do we need to know, and how do we need to conduct our business - in order to continue our existing, and grow our planned operations in the midwest. Day to day, the Southwest Policy Manager will manage a mix of internal meetings, reporting, strategic advising, managing external consultants and external meetings, and events representing and advocating for Waymo- specifically in state capitols and major metro areas.  The role will require strong emphasis on internal collaboration and cross-functional team work, and strong emphasis on organizational skills.

This role follows a hybrid work schedule and reports to the Regional Head of the West

You will:

• Engage directly with Southwest state and local policymakers, regulators, industry stakeholders, and key opinion leaders to shape policy and political dialogue and serve as the “face of Waymo” throughout the region.

• Track current and emerging political activity in the region while executing policy strategy that benefits Waymo’s users and business.

• Develop and maintain strong relationships with Southwest state and local elected officials, their staff, regulators, and other key external stakeholders.

• Collaborate closely with internal cross-functional stakeholders including strategic advising.

• Work closely with other teams at Waymo to ensure up to date knowledge of company plans and reporting policy political developments with analysis.

• Collaboratively manage state consultant relationships and represent Waymo in local chambers and trade associations, state organizations, and national political organizations including 501C3 and 527 organizations.

You have:

• Reside in the Southwest/ Texas / Austin with ability to frequently travel to state capitols and Southwest cities.

• 5-7 years of experience of public policy experience within government, or relevant nonprofit, public interest groups, companies, lobbying firms or industry associations;

• A well-developed network of relationships with key figures across the Southwest legislative and policy landscape.

• Skilled and experienced at persuasively and diplomatically advocating complex policy positions before a wide variety of audiences

• Excellent interpersonal and organizational skills, and exceptional verbal and written communication skills.

• Hands-on legislative and regulatory analytics experience, including drafting and editing legislation.

We prefer:

• At least 2+ years working specifically on technology or transportation policy issues.

• Bachelor’s degree, MPP/MBA/JD preferred.

• Work experience in both state and local politics.

• Work experience in the private sector.

• Knowledge of the policy environment for autonomous vehicles.

• Knowledge of future of work, labor, and workforce development policy issues

• Knowledge of privacy, artificial intelligence, cybersecurity, and other public policy issues related to data-driven industries

Travel Requirements:

• Up to 40% travel within Texas and Southwest on a frequent basis and occasionally travel to California, DC, and other major U.S. cities for conferences.

The expected base salary range for this full-time position across US locations is listed below. Actual starting pay will be based on job-related factors, including exact work location, experience, relevant training and education, and skill level. Your recruiter can share more about the specific salary range for the role location or, if the role can be performed remote, the specific salary range for your preferred location, during the hiring process.

Waymo employees are also eligible to participate in Waymo’s discretionary annual bonus program, equity incentive plan, and generous Company benefits program, subject to eligibility requirements.

Salary Range

$177,000—$218,000 USD

jobs.title: Electrical Failure Analysis Engineer
jobs.description:
Location: Sunnyvale, CA (Onsite)

Schedule: Full-time, onsite lab role. Typical Monday–Friday daytime hours; flexibility required to support urgent analyses, extended hours, or occasional weekend work based on lab demand.

About the Role

Eurofins EAG Laboratories is seeking a Senior Engineer to lead hands-on investigations of electronic components, packages, and systems. You will work directly in the lab owning electrical failure analysis from problem definition through root cause and client recommendations.

This role is best suited for someone who enjoys deep technical debugging, operates lab tools independently, and can translate complex data into clear, actionable conclusions.

What You’ll Do

• Perform hands-on failure analysis on semiconductor devices and electronic components (ICs, subcomponents, systems)
• Design and execute analytical plans to determine root cause of electrical/mechanical failures
• Use and interpret results from tools such as: X-ray, SEM/EDS, FA isolation techniques, and electrical characterization tools
• Analyze ATE datalogs, schematics, and test results to diagnose issues
• Lead or contribute to fault isolation and deprocessing workflows
• Review, validate, and approve lab data and technical reports
• Communicate findings to internal teams and external clients in clear, practical terms
• Identify process improvements to increase lab throughput and reduce repeat failures
• Support cross-functional collaboration with lab staff to manage workflow, quality, and priorities

Why Join EAG

• Work on high-impact technical problems across multiple industries
• Access to advanced lab tools and techniques
• Opportunity to own investigations end-to-end and influence outcomes
• Collaborative, hands-on team environment focused on technical excellence

Compliance Requirement (ITAR)

This position supports work subject to U.S. export control regulations.

Applicants must meet U.S. Person status as defined by ITAR:

• U.S. Citizen
• U.S. Permanent Resident (Green Card)
• Protected Individual (asylee or refugee)

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering or related field
• 2+ years of hands-on failure analysis experience in semiconductor or electronics environment
• Demonstrated experience with multiple FA techniques and tools, such as:Electrical characterization (curve trace, parametric analysis, oscilloscope)Fault isolation (e.g., OBIRCH, emission microscopy, thermal techniques)Deprocessing and sample prep (e.g., RIE, FIB/PFIB, lapping, etching)Physical analysis (SEM/EDS, cross-sectioning, X-ray, C-SAM)
• Working knowledge of device physics, IC layout, and semiconductor processes
• Experience reviewing and writing technical reports for internal or customer use
• Ability to work onsite in a lab environment daily and handle multiple active analyses

Preferred

• Experience with advanced nodes (e.g., FinFET) or complex packaging
• Familiarity with industry standards (JEDEC, IPC, MIL-STD, AEC)
• Experience supporting external customers or client-facing technical discussions
• Exposure to LabView, GDS layout tools, or similar systems

Work Environment & Expectations

• This is a fully onsite lab role in Sunnyvale, CA
• Work involves operating lab equipment, handling chemicals/materials, and following safety protocols
• Schedule may adjust based on priority turnaround times and customer commitments
• Must be able to coordinate with team members to manage workload and meet deadlines

We encourage you to apply even if your experience is not a 100% match with the position. We are looking for someone with relevant skills and experience, not a checklist that exactly matches the job description. We want to help you grow and in return, you help us grow into a stronger, more inclusive organization.

Physical Requirements

• Ability to continuously operate a personal computer or lab equipment for extended periods (4+ hours).
• Ability to operate a keyboard and other lab equipment, use a telephone, access file cabinets and other items stored at various levels, including overhead.
• Must be able to remain in a stationary position 80% of the time.
• Ability to communicate clearly and understandably in normal conversational distance, over the telephone, and in group settings.
• Ability to handle small and fragile devices with tweezers and/or fingers.
• Require close-distance visual acuity with or without correction (glasses, contacts, etc.).
• Must be willing and able to wear PPE such as respirator, hard-hat, steel-toed shoes, safety glasses, laboratory coat, and other required devices or equipment.
• Ability to learn new tasks, remember processes, maintain focus, complete tasks independently, and make timely decisions in workflow contexts.
• Ability to move equipment or items up to 50 lbs.

The essential physical and mental requirements described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of the job.  We will consider reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities. If you have a disability or special need, we would like to know how we can better accommodate you.

What It’s Like to Work Here:

• Teamwork: experience what being a part of the Eurofins-EAG community feels like. Be inspired by your leaders, be encouraged by your teammates and be supported in all parts of your journey while you work with us.
• Learning & Development: take on career development programs and goal setting to create big possibilities for your career and life. Develop within the company; be mentored and grown as a leader.
• Diversity & Authenticity: we work hard to embrace diversity and inclusion and encourage everyone to bring their authentic selves to work every day.

Benefits & Perks to Foster Work/Life Balance:

✓ Medical, Dental and Vision Coverage

✓ 401k Company Matching

✓ Paid Time Off

✓ Wellness Program

✓ Education Assistance

✓ …and more!

If you enjoy being immersed in technology, tackling problems head-on, finding solutions through teamwork, and taking pride in accomplishments, join us today!

jobs.title: Senior Sales Executive, North America
jobs.description:
Revinate is the hotel data activation platform for hotels, groups, resorts, and enterprise brands.
Every hotel has that guest: years of stays, the same room, never skips the spa. But their story sits scattered across the PMS, the booking engine, the spa system, and whoever happened to be on shift. Revinate brings that story together. We connect and clean guest data from every system into Rich Guest Profile® data, then put it to work for the people who look after guests.
Reservations answers the phone already knowing the guest. Marketing sends the spa offer to the guest who raved about the spa. Behind it all, Ivy, our AI intelligence layer trained on 17 years of hospitality data, reads the patterns and handles the digital labor.
Revinate powers 1.1 billion Rich Guest Profile® data points across 12,500+ hotels, driving over $24 billion in direct revenue.
Get Revinate. Get superpowers.

Hotels and resort groups are under pressure to drive direct bookings and grow guest lifetime value. Revinate helps them do it. As a Senior Sales Executive, you’ll own the full cycle for large, multi-property hospitality accounts: opening doors, building consensus across stakeholders, and closing deals that reshape how our clients engage their guests.
You’ll partner closely with a Sales Engineer and senior leadership, and you’ll be trusted to translate complex business and technology problems into clear, quantified value.

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Robotics Engineer
jobs.description:
What We’re Building:
We have been quietly building the foundational layers of our Physical AI Scientist platform:
🤖 Physical AI that can operate scientific instruments with human-level dexterity.
🧪 Scientific AI that can analyze results, reason about next steps, and close the loop autonomously.
This is an incredibly ambitious mission, but we believe that a team of ambitious people with high ownership can accomplish incredible things.



The Team:

 - We’re a team of passionate, mission-driven engineers from companies like Tesla, Amazon, SpaceX, and Neuralink. We’re collaborative and love moving fast, both with our product and on team trips skiing or go-karting!

 - As a team, we love nerding out about engineering and robotics — plus other topics like race cars or cooking. We like learning new things and then sharing our new knowledge with each other.

 - Our team is opinionated and straightforward. We don’t mind intense discussions about design tradeoffs. If we have arguments or miscommunication, we resolve conflicts quickly and empathetically.



In this role, you will:

 - Operate like the technical co-founder of a small startup within Medra, owning end-to-end delivery of high-impact customer projects and defining the roadmap to meet customers’ most critical scientific challenges

 - Translate scientific workflows into technical requirements, support system architecture from conception to delivery, and develop interfaces between robots, instruments, and software

 - Design, build, and test scientific workflows on our Physical AI Scientist platform, combining existing capabilities with new production software and instrument integrations

 - Make implementation tradeoffs with robotics and software engineers, deciding where to reuse existing capabilities and where a customer requirement needs new engineering

 - Integrate, test, and debug software solutions in simulation and on physical robots

 - Work with forward deployed scientists through integration testing, water runs, customer-site bring-up, and scientific validation, resolving engineering blockers along the way

 - Diagnose failures across software, instrument behavior, robotics, and customer infrastructure, and work with specialist engineers to resolve them

 - Extend deployed systems to support new instruments, consumables, and workflows, rolling out releases with appropriate verification and clear operating guidance

 - Bring deployment learnings back into the platform by generalizing integrations and sharing reusable tests, diagnostics, and tooling with other deployment teams

 - Clearly explain technical decisions, limitations, and risks to customers and teammates

 - Travel to customer sites approximately 30% of the time for hands-on deployment and support

 - This position is 100% in-person, you must be able to come on-site to our San Francisco office. We do not offer hybrid roles at Medra. We do offer relocation benefits for applicants that need to relocate.



Let’s talk if you have:

 - Strong software engineering fundamentals and experience shipping production code

 - Demonstrated systems thinking: designing, implementing, testing, or debugging interfaces in a production system

 - Experience delivering technical solutions with customers or users, from an ambiguous problem to a working solution in use

 - A penchant for customer-facing engineering: you enjoy working directly with users, making technical decisions, and being accountable for the result

 - A track record of learning unfamiliar technologies quickly and making sound decisions with incomplete information

 - Clear written and verbal communication, including the ability to explain technical tradeoffs and surface problems early

 - Interest in developing depth in robotics, automation, and physical AI, with a willingness to work directly with physical systems



Bonus points if you have:

 - Experience shipping a product that combines software and hardware

 - Forward deployed engineering experience, or another engineering role with direct responsibility for customer implementations

 - Production code in Python, C++, or Rust

 - Experience designing APIs, distributed systems, or software that coordinates external services and equipment

 - Experience designing integration tests, reliability tests, observability, or deployment tooling

 - Experience with robotics, laboratory automation, or biology



What we offer:

 1. 401k

 2. Medical insurance

 3. Dental Insurance

 4. Relocation benefits

 5. Unlimited PTO

 6. Weekday dinners

jobs.title: Structural Technician Lead, 3rd Shift, Site 2
jobs.description:
AST SpaceMobile and our global partners are building the first and only space-based cellular broadband network to be accessible by standard smartphones. Called SpaceMobile, this ultra-powerful network is being designed to provide connectivity at 4G/5G speeds everywhere on the planet – on land, at sea and in flight.

Position Overview

We are seeking a Structural Technician, Lead to oversee a team responsible for assembling satellite structural components in a manufacturing environment. This is a hands-on leadership role where the successful candidate will actively participate in structural assembly while leading and supporting a team of technicians. The position is part of the Control Sat (CSAT) Structures Group, responsible for the assembly, integration, maintenance, and rework of primary satellite structures. Candidates should possess experience working with composite and metallic structures in a precision manufacturing environment.

Key Responsibilities

• Lead and support a team of technicians while actively performing structural assembly tasks.

• Assign, prioritize, and coordinate work based on production schedules and team capabilities.

• Interpret engineering drawings, blueprints, specifications, and work instructions.

• Execute and lead rework (MRO) activities in accordance with engineering dispositions and non-conformance documentation.

• Assemble, drill, fit, and fasten aluminum and composite components to engineering specifications.

• Ensure compliance with approved manufacturing processes, quality standards, and documentation requirements.

• Utilize precision tools including calipers, torque tools, drills, rivet guns, grinders, and measurement equipment.

• Operate and maintain assembly fixtures, jigs, tooling, and drill guides.

• Communicate production status, risks, and schedule impacts to leadership.

• Coach, mentor, and develop technicians to meet quality and productivity objectives.

• Partner with Engineering, Quality, Manufacturing, and Production teams to resolve technical and production issues.

• Assist with onboarding and training of new team members.

• Serve as a liaison between production personnel and leadership.

• Maintain compliance with all company safety policies and procedures.

• Support additional manufacturing activities as required to meet business objectives.

Compensation & Schedule

• Competitive pay based on experience (DOE).

• Overtime opportunities available.

• Higher-level technician opportunities available for candidates with advanced experience.

• Standard schedule: Friday thru Sunday 6:00 AM- 6:00 PM (3x12 schedule).

• Paid lunch and breaks.

Qualifications

Education:

• High School Diploma or GED required.

• Technical training, trade certification, or Associate degree in a related field preferred.

Experience:

• Minimum of 1 year of experience in aerospace manufacturing, mechanical assembly, structural assembly, or a related manufacturing environment.

• Experience working with composite and metallic structures.

• Experience interpreting engineering drawings, assembly instructions, and specifications.

• Experience using precision measurement and assembly tools.

Preferred Qualifications:

• Previous lead, supervisory, or team leadership experience.

• Experience in aerospace, satellite, aviation, defense, or advanced manufacturing industries.

• Background in MRO (Maintenance, Repair, and Overhaul) and rework environments.

• Experience assigning work and coordinating production activities.

• Experience working cross-functionally with Engineering and Quality organizations.

• Familiarity with structural fasteners including rivets, Hi-Loks, bolts, and inserts.

Soft Skills:

• Strong leadership and team development capabilities.

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

• Proven ability to prioritize work and manage multiple tasks in a fast-paced environment.

• Strong problem-solving and decision-making skills.

• Ability to remain calm and solution-focused under pressure.

• High attention to detail and commitment to quality.

• Strong organizational and time-management skills.

• Demonstrated accountability, reliability, and professionalism.

• Ability to build trust and drive team performance.

Technology Stack:

• Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES)

• Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) systems

• Digital work instruction platforms

• Engineering drawings and blueprint management systems

• Precision measurement tools and torque-control equipment

Physical Requirements

• Ability to stand and walk for extended periods throughout the workday.

• Ability to perform repetitive and precision hand movements using tools and equipment.

• Ability to bend, stoop, kneel, climb, balance, reach, and work in varying positions as required.

• Ability to communicate effectively through speaking and hearing.

• Ability to work around large structures, tooling, and production equipment.

• Ability to lift, push, pull, and carry up to 40 pounds.

• Ability to work around moving mechanical parts and manufacturing equipment.

• Ability to work in confined or restricted spaces when required.

• Ability to work in environments that may involve exposure to airborne particles, fumes, composite materials, carbon fiber dust, adhesives, and other manufacturing substances while utilizing appropriate PPE.

If you are open to relocating to Midland, this can be a career-changing opportunity to enter the high-tech aerospace industry, develop specialized skills, and build a long-term career in satellite manufacturing.

This job description may not be inclusive of all duties and responsibilities. Additional tasks may be assigned from time to time, and the scope of the position may change based on business needs.

AST SpaceMobile is an Equal Opportunity, at will Employer; employment is governed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications and will not be influenced in any manner by race, color, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, mental or physical disability or any other legally protected status.

jobs.description:
We’re ALTEN Technology USA, an engineering company helping clients bring groundbreaking ideas to life—from advancing space exploration and life-saving medical devices to building autonomous electric vehicles. With 3,000+ experts across North America, we partner with leading companies in aerospace, medical devices, robotics, automotive, commercial vehicles, EVs, rail, and more.

As part of the global ALTEN Group—57,000+ engineers in 30 countries—we deliver across the entire product development cycle, from consulting to full project outsourcing.

When you join ALTEN Technology USA, you’ll collaborate on some of the world’s toughest engineering challenges, supported by mentorship, career growth opportunities, and comprehensive benefits. We take pride in fostering a culture where employees feel valued, supported, and inspired to grow.

Workplace: On-site, 5 days per week
Location: Casa Grande, AZ
Salary: $100-110k

We are currently seeking a Restraint System Integration and Testing Engineer. Our ideal candidate exhibits a can-do attitude and approaches his or her work with vigor and determination. Candidates will be expected to demonstrate excellence in their respective fields, to possess the ability to learn quickly and to strive for perfection within a fast-paced
environment.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer I
jobs.description:
ABOUT ROCKET LAB

Rocket Lab is the end-to-end space company building rockets, spacecraft, and critical subsystems that keep the world connected, protected, expand humanity’s reach to the Moon, Mars, and beyond. We move fast, build real hardware for meaningful missions, and make the impossible routine. Come shape the future with us.

SPACE SYSTEMS

At Rocket Lab, we’re not just launching rockets — we're building the future of space. Our Space Systems team builds everything from complete spacecraft, precision payloads to the components and subsystems that allow them to thrive in space, like solar panels, flight software, star trackers, optical systems, separation systems, radios, and more.

Our Space Systems team has enabled more than 1,700 missions, ranging from interplanetary exploration, in-space manufacturing to national security and defense initiatives. The team has built spacecraft, payloads, and components for missions to the Moon and Mars, working with partners including NASA, the Space Development Agency, and the U.S. Space Force. Whether it’s a single high-performance spacecraft, constellation, or the vertically integrated components that help them get to space — our world class Space Systems team is empowering some of the boldest and most ambitious space missions

SENIOR SOFTWARE ENGINEER I – MES

Based at Rocket Lab's HQ in Long Beach, CA, the Senior Software Engineer I - MES will collaborate with teams across Engineering, Manufacturing, Technicians, and Operations to develop full-stack software solutions that improve the efficiency of critical Rocket Lab operations. This role focuses on the in-house Manufacturing Execution System (MES) platform, as well as tools that integrate with the ERP system and related products. These applications rely heavily on relational databases and REST APIs, both upstream and downstream, as part of service-oriented architecture.

WHAT YOU'LL GET TO DO:

• Operate across the full stack, demonstrating expertise in areas such as frontend or backend development, database administration, UI/UX design, product ownership, DevOps, Or Site Reliability Engineering (SRE)

• Develop world-class software using best practices, including automated testing (unit integration, and end-to-end) code reviews, Agile methodologies, and project management tools like Jira

• Leverage version control systems (e.g., Git) to manage code, maintain thorough documentation, and collaborate effectively with stakeholders

• Provide user support and ensure seamless integration with related technical systems outside your immediate area of responsibility

• Solve complex engineering challenges by proposing innovative solutions, sharing insights into technical concepts, and navigating tasks within your technical domain

YOU'LL BRING THESE QUALIFICATIONS:

• A degree or diploma in Software Engineering, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or other technical discipline

• 5+ years of professional experience in full-stack software engineering

• Strong Git skills for version control and collaboration

• Proficiency in C#, and TypeScript

• Operational knowledge of Angular or another front-end framework, .NET or another backend framework, Git, SQL, and HTML/CSS

• US citizenship is required due to program requirements

THESE QUALIFICATIONS WOULD BE NICE TO HAVE:

• Proficiency in RabbitMQ, Docker, Kubernetes, and Elasticsearch

• Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work collaboratively in a team environment

• Experience in aerospace domains such as Launch Operations, ERP, QMS, and PLM

This position may require prolonged periods of sitting, standing, walking, computer work, and occasional exposure to moderate levels of noise, dust, and fumes in production areas.

Anticipated annual equity grant value is designed around function, level, experience, and other factors; realized value depends on vesting and stock-price performance.

Join one of the world's fastest-growing space companies and own a piece of it. In addition to competitive base pay, you'll receive company stock as part of your total compensation package, giving you a direct stake in our success. As we expand to new launch sites, groundbreaking missions, and global markets, your ownership has the opportunity to grow alongside the company.

Our comprehensive benefits package includes our industry-leading Employee Stock Purchase Program (with a 15% discount on company stock), top-tier medical plans (HMO, PPO, and a zero cost HDHP option with a significant HSA company contribution), dental and vision coverage, paid vacation and sick time, 11 paid holidays, flexible spending and dependent care accounts, paid parental leave, disability and life insurance, and a 401(k) retirement plan with company match.

Additional perks include subsidized EV charging, onsite fitness centers (where available), discounted gym memberships, complimentary snacks and beverages, 50% employee discount on our popular merch store, and a variety of other employee discounts.

Level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience.

Total Compensation (base and equity)

$196,275—$233,675 USD

Base Salary

$132,000—$198,000 USD

WHAT TO EXPECT

We’re on a mission to unlock the potential of space to improve life on Earth, but that’s not an easy task. It takes hard work, determination, relentless innovation, teamwork, grit, and an unwavering commitment to achieving what others often deem impossible. Our people out-think, out-work, and out-pace. We pride ourselves on having each other’s backs, checking our egos at the door, and rolling up our sleeves on all tasks big and small. We thrive under pressure, work to tight deadlines, and our focus is always on how we can deliver, rather than dwelling on the challenges that stand in the way.

Important information:

FOR CANDIDATES SEEKING TO WORK IN US OFFICES ONLY:

To conform to U.S. Government space technology export regulations, including the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR), Rocket Lab Employees must be a U.S. citizen, lawful U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State and/or the U.S. Department of Commerce, as applicable. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment at Rocket Lab, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training.

Applicants requiring a reasonable accommodation for the application/interview process for a job in the United States should contact Giulia Johnson at g.biow@rocketlabusa.com.This dedicated resource is intended solely to assist job seekers with disabilities whose disability prevents them from being able to apply/interview. Only messages left for this purpose will be considered. A response to your request may take up to two business days.

FOR CANDIDATES SEEKING TO WORK IN NEW ZEALAND OFFICES ONLY:

For security reasons, background checks will be undertaken prior to any employment offers being made to an applicant.  These checks will include nationality checks as it is a requirement of this position that you be eligible to access equipment and data regulated by the United States' International Traffic in Arms Regulations.

jobs.title: Partnerships and Business Development Associate
jobs.description:
About Seen Health

At Seen Health, we are revolutionizing the way senior care is delivered through the PACE (Programs of All-Inclusive Care for the Elderly) model. Backed by top VCs, Seen Health is a culturally-focused, technology-enabled healthcare organization that integrates comprehensive medical care and social support with a high-touch, interdisciplinary approach.

Our mission is to empower seniors to age-in-place with dignity and provide their families peace of mind. We are building upon a proven Home and community based services model to create a culturally-competent and scalable PACE program. We are also building a comprehensive operating system focused on data and workflows that span across systems, processes, people, and care contexts. We want to empower our clinicians and staff with tools that deliver relevant data at the time and site of care and enable them to deliver exceptional care to our participants, which improve clinical outcomes, participant & provider satisfaction, and ultimately our strength as an organization.

We are a mission-driven, multidisciplinary team with deep healthcare, technology, and operations expertise, each inspired by our own personal stories of caring for seniors in our lives. Our name, Seen Health, was chosen to reflect our commitment to provide the highest standard of care to underserved older adults while respecting and incorporating their individual beliefs, heritage, and values, so that they can truly be seen.

About the Role

At Seen Health, Expansion is the engine that allows us to bring our transformative PACE model to more seniors. Our growth depends on our ability to architect complex, sustainable partnerships that allow us to enter and scale in new markets with speed and local resonance.

Reporting directly to the Head of Expansion, you will be a key driver of new market entry. This is a high-ownership, externally-facing role for someone who thrives building relationships, representing an organization with confidence, and getting things done without a lot of hand-holding. You'll work across two interconnected areas: local business development in the San Gabriel Valley and greater LA area, and new market expansion research and early relationship-building across emerging PACE markets nationally. This is not a back-office role. You'll be at community meetings, on the phone with health officials and prospective partners, and attending conferences. If you love building from the ground up and want to see your work have a direct impact on how we grow — this is the job.

Key Responsibilities

Local Business Development & Community Partnerships

• Represent Seen Health at local coalition meetings, chamber of commerce events, cultural community gatherings, and senior care forums in the SGV and greater LA area

• Build and maintain relationships with day health programs, community health centers, hospitals, senior centers, and local referral partners

• Initiate and manage outreach to prospective care delivery partners — Mandarin-language outreach is a core part of this work

• Identify and develop local BD opportunities that the team has mapped but hasn't had bandwidth to pursue

• Help grow our referral and enrollment pipeline through consistent local presence

Market Expansion & Intelligence

• Monitor PACE program developments nationally — RFP timelines, legislative activity, regulatory readiness, and competitive landscape — across a portfolio of target states

• Research new markets: population demographics, existing care providers, state agency contacts, and potential partnership opportunities

• Contribute to application and proposal logistics as opportunities take shape

• Surface timely opportunities to the strategy team and maintain organized, up-to-date market intelligence

Qualifications

• Based in the Los Angeles / San Gabriel Valley area or willing to be

• 2–5 years of experience in healthcare, community health, or a related field

• Demonstrated ability to represent an organization confidently and effectively in meetings and partner conversations — you're the face in the room when leadership isn't there

• Execution-oriented: you get things done with limited direction and follow up without being asked

• Comfortable operating in a fast-moving environment where priorities evolve

• Strong written communication for briefings, partner summaries, and internal updates

• Mandarin fluency (spoken and written) — essential given the communities we serve and the nature of local outreach

Nice-to-have qualifications:

• Experience with PACE, ADHC, FQHC, or other senior care / long-term care settings

• Familiarity with DHCS, CMS, or state Medicaid program structures

• Additional language fluency desired (Cantonese, Korean, or Spanish)

• Prior experience supporting RFP responses or grant applications

• Existing relationships in the SGV senior care or community health ecosystem

Salary and Benefits

• Pay Rate: $105,000 to $145,000 per year

• Equity: included as part of founding team package

• Benefits: Seen Health is proud to offer a robust benefits offering for our employees. In addition to traditional healthcare coverage, we also offer additional benefits to help further your wellness and feeling of being part of the team. Medical, Dental, and Vision benefits for you and your family Life Insurance and Disability Benefits Parental and Caregiver Leave Lunch, as well as delicious snacks and coffee to keep you energized Paid Time Off across holidays, vacation time, personal days, and sick days 401k Plan Personal and professional development, including CME support and career growth opportunities Subscriptions and training on using AI tools

Seen Health does not discriminate in employment opportunities or practices on the basis of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity, pregnancy, national origin, age, disability, creed, ancestry, genetic information, marital status, sexual orientation/identity, transgender status, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law. jobs.title: Test Design Engineer
jobs.description:
About Etched
Etched is building hardware for frontier intelligence. We co-design chips, racks, software, and manufacturing to deliver best-in-class throughput and latency across both prefill and decode workloads. Our first products are heavily focused on inference. Backed by hundreds of millions from top-tier investors and staffed by leading engineers, Etched is redefining the infrastructure layer for the fastest growing industry in history.



Job Summary
Etched is seeking a Test Design Engineer to own how our AI systems are tested end to end: the overall test strategy and the test systems that carry it out, from silicon bring-up through boards, servers, and full racks, and from early validation into production.

You will join a new, small central team that owns making testing reliable, repeatable, and scalable. Our domain teams (firmware, system software, inference, platform hardware, and silicon validation) each bring deep expertise in their own tests. You will bring the full picture: what the complete test strategy should be at every stage, how tests are built, gated, and run as one system, whether they actually catch the defects that matter, and how they hold up at production volume. When a failure doesn't have an obvious owner, you will be the engineer who finds out why.



Key Responsibilities

 - Define and own the overall test strategy and coverage map across silicon, firmware, board, server, and rack levels, from EVT/DVT/PVT validation through production.

 - Design the test systems and frameworks that carry out that strategy: how tests are structured, versioned, gated, and run across the lab and the factory.

 - Review test plans from domain teams at each build phase, find coverage gaps and unnecessary duplication, and balance coverage against test time.

 - Build regression gating so changes to firmware, drivers, and test packages are validated on representative hardware before they ship.

 - Define pass/fail criteria, retest policies, and diagnostics, and work with Production to turn them into clear procedures.

 - Lead technical triage of failures that cross hardware, firmware, and software: read logs, reproduce issues, isolate root cause, and drive corrective actions with domain engineers.

 - Turn repeated failures into better tests, upstream screening, and diagnostics.

 - Partner with Test Infrastructure and our manufacturing partners to bring the strategy into production, including travel to Taiwan.
   
   

You may be a good fit if you have (Must-have qualifications)

 - You have owned the test strategy or test systems for at least one hardware product from bring-up into production.

 - Hands-on experience across levels of test: low-level firmware, board-level, and system-level testing.

 - Experience designing regression gating or CI for hardware and firmware.

 - Strong debugging skills across hardware, firmware, and software, working from logs and lab tools.

 - Clear communication across teams, and comfort making coverage and risk tradeoffs explicit. 

 - Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or equivalent practical experience.

 - Willingness to work onsite in San Jose and travel internationally to manufacturing partners.
   
   

Strong candidates may also have experience with (Nice-to-have qualifications)

 - 8+ years in test engineering, test architecture, system validation, or test automation for hardware products.

 - Server, rack, GPU, or accelerator systems, including post-silicon bring-up and rack-level (L10/L11) integration testing.

 - BMC, BIOS, PCIe, high-speed interconnects, power and thermal validation.

 - Hardware-in-the-loop test systems.

 - Factory test, test stations, or working with contract manufacturers and ODMs.

 - Yield analysis and data-driven test optimization.

 - Bringing first-generation hardware into production at a fast-paced startup.




BENEFITS

 - Medical, dental, and vision packages with generous premium coverage
   
   - $500 per month credit for waiving medical benefits

 - Housing subsidy of $2,500 per month for those living within walking distance of the office

 - Relocation support for those moving to San Jose (Santana Row)

 - Various wellness benefits covering fitness, mental health, and more

 - Daily lunch and dinner in our office

 - Unlimited compute budget subject to ROI justification



How we’re different
Etched believes in the Bitter Lesson http://www.incompleteideas.net/IncIdeas/BitterLesson.html. We are the first inference-focused frontier AI system, betting early on transformer and transformer-like architectures and on increasing model sizes. Our addressable market is the entirety of inference, unlike many of our competitors.

We are a fully in-person team in San Jose (Santana Row), and greatly value engineering skills. We do not have boundaries between engineering and research, and we expect all of our technical staff to contribute to both and work across disciplines as needed.

jobs.title: Strategic Sourcing Manager
jobs.description:
Who We Are

Verkada is transforming how organizations protect their people and places with an integrated, privacy-sensitive AI-powered platform that includes solutions for video security, access control, air quality sensors, alarms, intercoms, and visitor management.

We’ve got serious momentum in the market: more than 30,000 customers (including 100+ of the Fortune 500), a $5.8B valuation, more than $1 billion in annualized bookings, and backing from CapitalG, Sequoia Capital, General Catalyst, Felicis Ventures, Next47 and more. Physical AI is one of the most consequential technology shifts of our time, and Verkada is at the center of it.

You can look at all kinds of communities to see our platform’s impact in the world. It's the retailer that uses our agentic AI to deter theft before it happens. The warehouse that uses AI-powered alerts to make sure its team is protected on the floor with proper PPE. The school that’s alerted to a threat in real-time and triggers a lockdown in seconds, not minutes. We’re rapidly scaling this impact: today, more than 2 million Verkada devices are deployed across 170+ countries.

About the Role

As a Strategic Sourcing Manager, you will be responsible for developing and executing sourcing strategies, negotiating with various vendors, and partnering closely with cross-functional teams to deliver on business objectives for the Spend Money Wisely team (Verkada’s take on Strategic Sourcing). Your primary focus will involve negotiating strategic deals, optimizing the technology portfolio through vendor consolidation opportunities, and providing strategic guidance to functional partners in balancing new features, seat/usage expansion, and rip-n-replace initiatives. You will lead sourcing initiatives, manage vendor relationships, work closely with Legal, Security, and Finance teams, and ensure cost efficiency and value optimization across Verkada’s spend portfolio. A key focus will be to create and deliver category strategies. We are committed to a thriving in-office culture. This role requires that you be on-site at our HQ in San Mateo, CA 5 days a week.

What You'll Do

• Lead the development and implementation of strategic sourcing initiatives for Engineering, IT, Product and Sales teams.

• Negotiate complex, high-value contracts and agreements with strategic vendors.

• Identify and execute vendor consolidation opportunities to optimize the spend portfolio.

• Provide strategic guidance to functional partners on procurement decisions, balancing new features, seat/usage expansion, and rip-n-replace considerations & initiatives.

• Build and maintain vendor relationships, ensuring performance and compliance with contracts.

• Conduct market research and analysis to identify trends, opportunities, and risks in technology space and how that may impact sourcing decisions.

• Develop and implement cost-saving strategies and initiatives.

• Monitor and report on key sourcing metrics and performance indicators.

• Develop key category strategies for business partners to establish priorities to maximize value.

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams such as Legal, Security, and Finance to ensure alignment of sourcing strategies with business needs.

• Ensure compliance with procurement policies and regulations for Verkada’s global scale.

• Be a key contributor in driving and supporting our P2P process.

What You Bring

• 5+ years of proven experience in strategic sourcing, technology procurement, and vendor management.

• Strong negotiation skills and experience in negotiating complex contracts.

• Ability to analyze market trends and identify opportunities for cost savings and value optimization.

• Excellent communication, prioritization and interpersonal skills.

• Ability to provide strategic guidance to functional partners on procurement decisions.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

• Knowledge of procurement policies and regulations.

• Experience with vendor consolidation and technology portfolio optimization.

• 5-star customer service mindset.

• Excellent teamwork skills - we have a #OneTeam mindset!

• Ability to find out-of-box solutions to best fit business needs and requirements.

• Must be willing and able to work onsite five days per week.

US Employee Benefits

Verkada is committed to fostering a workplace environment that prioritizes the holistic health and wellbeing of our employees and their families by offering comprehensive wellness perks, benefits, and resources. Our benefits and perks programs include, but are not limited to:

Additional Information

Annual Pay Range

At Verkada, we want to attract and retain the best employees, and compensate them in a way that appropriately and fairly values their individual contribution to the company. With that in mind, we carefully consider a number of factors to determine the appropriate starting pay for an employee, including their primary work location and an assessment of a candidate's skills and experience, as well as market demands and internal parity. jobs.title: Account Manager
jobs.description:
Job Description

We are looking for a Local Account Manager who is passionate about developing customers, building relationships, and growing business.

This role goes beyond maintaining the business we already have. We need someone who is curious, proactive, commercially minded, and motivated to uncover new opportunities for Expeditors. The successful candidate will take ownership of assigned customer relationships while continually looking for ways to deepen those relationships, understand the customer's business, and create opportunities for growth.

The Account Manager will be expected to understand more than what we currently do for a customer. We want someone who wants to learn how the customer operates, what they are trying to accomplish, what challenges they face, where they are growing, and where Expeditors can provide additional value.

This is an opportunity for someone who enjoys connecting with customers, asking good questions, developing relationships throughout an organization, and turning what they learn into meaningful business opportunities.

Success in this position will require both excellent customer management and a strong business development mindset.

Key Responsibilities

Business Development & Growth

• Actively identify and pursue opportunities to retain, develop, and grow business within assigned accounts.
• Develop a strong understanding of each customer's business, supply chain, priorities, challenges, and objectives.
• Look beyond the business we handle today to identify opportunities for additional Expeditors products, services, locations, and solutions.
• Demonstrate curiosity by asking meaningful questions and using customer knowledge to uncover needs and potential opportunities.
• Build and actively manage a pipeline of business opportunities, maintaining consistent ownership and follow-up.
• Turn customer needs and challenges into actionable opportunities by collaborating with the appropriate internal teams.
• Take ownership of business development activity and maintain momentum from initial discovery through solution development and implementation.
• Look for opportunities to introduce value-added solutions that strengthen the customer relationship and differentiate Expeditors.

Customer Development & Relationship Management

• Manage assigned customer accounts and maintain strong, consistent customer relationships.
• Develop relationships beyond the primary point of contact and across different levels and functions of the customer's organization.
• Become a trusted resource by understanding what matters to the customer and connecting those priorities to Expeditors' capabilities.
• Lead meaningful customer conversations that address both current performance and future business opportunities.
• Participate in and lead customer meetings and business reviews with clear objectives, actionable follow-up, and a focus on creating value.
• Deliver a high level of customer service while using strong service performance as a foundation for deeper relationships and future growth.

Account Ownership & Execution

• Partner closely with Product, Operations, Sales, and other internal teams to support customer needs and develop solutions.
• Identify, communicate, and help coordinate the resolution of service issues in a timely manner.
• Maintain accurate and timely customer information, meeting activity, opportunities, and follow-up actions in CRM.
• Monitor customer activity, performance, and business trends to identify potential risks as well as opportunities.
• Ensure customer requirements and expectations are clearly understood and communicated internally.
• Follow through on commitments and maintain accountability for customer and business-development actions.
• Continuously look for ways to improve the customer experience, account-management practices, and the value Expeditors provides.

• Experience in account management, customer service, business development, logistics, supply chain, or a related field.
• Strong customer service and relationship-building skills.
• Strong verbal and written communication skills.
• Ability to clearly document and communicate customer requirements.
• Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to coordinate issue resolution across teams.
• Ability to manage multiple priorities and maintain consistent follow-up.
• Proficiency with Microsoft Office and other business systems or CRM tools, where applicable.
• Strong attention to detail and organizational skills.
• Experience supporting complex customer accounts across multiple stakeholders or locations.
• Presentation skills.
• Project management skills.
• Experience identifying growth opportunities within existing customer accounts.
• Experience working in a cross-functional service environment.

Benefits

• Holidays (10)
• Flexible Days (2)
• Paid Sick Time (accrual rate of 1 hour of sick time per 30 hours paid)

• Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP)
• Medical, Prescription Drug, Dental & Vision Coverage
• Health Savings Account (HSA)
• Life and Disability Insurance
• Paid Parental Leave (additional eligibility criteria)

• Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
• Training and Personnel Development Program
• Educational Assistance and Reimbursement
• Salary + Commissions

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO Guidelines.

jobs.title: Structural Technician, 2nd Shift, Site 2
jobs.description:
AST SpaceMobile and our global partners are building the first and only space-based cellular broadband network to be accessible by standard smartphones. Called SpaceMobile, this ultra-powerful network is being designed to provide connectivity at 4G/5G speeds everywhere on the planet – on land, at sea and in flight.

Position Overview

We are seeking a Structural Technician to support spacecraft manufacturing by assembling and maintaining the primary structures that satellites are built around. This hands-on role within the CSAT Structures team is responsible for building, fitting, assembling, and inspecting structural components and subassemblies used in satellite production. Candidates with experience in aerospace, aircraft structures, automotive manufacturing, or precision mechanical assembly will find a highly transferable skill set in this environment.

Key Responsibilities

• Assemble spacecraft structural components and subassemblies using engineering drawings, specifications, and work instructions.

• Install aerospace fasteners including rivets, bolts, nut plates, and specialty hardware to required specifications.

• Perform drilling, reaming, countersinking, deburring, and precision fitting operations.

• Build and bond composite and metallic structures, including frames, panels, and deployable assemblies.

• Execute structural alignment and fit-up activities while maintaining tight tolerances.

• Partner with Manufacturing Engineers to troubleshoot assembly issues and improve production processes.

• Maintain strict adherence to quality standards, documentation requirements, and configuration control procedures.

• Inspect assemblies for structural integrity and dimensional accuracy.

• Support integration, modifications, repairs, and rework activities as required.

• Follow all safety procedures and maintain a clean, organized work environment.

• Support production schedules and work overtime as needed to meet business objectives.

Compensation & Schedule

• Competitive compensation based on experience.

• Overtime opportunities available based on work demand.

• Higher-level roles available for candidates with advanced experience and qualifications.

• Standard schedule is Monday through Thursday, 6:00 PM to 4:00 AM (4x10 schedule) with paid lunch and breaks.

Qualifications

Education

• High School Diploma or GED required.

• Technical Certificate or Associate Degree in Manufacturing, Aerospace, Aviation Maintenance, Mechanical Technology, or a related field preferred.

Experience

• Minimum of 3 years of experience in manufacturing, aerospace structures, aircraft assembly, automotive assembly, or precision mechanical build environments.

• Experience with rivets, structural fasteners, and aerospace hardware installations.

• Experience interpreting and working from blueprints, engineering drawings, and assembly instructions.

• Hands-on experience working with metals such as aluminum, titanium, and stainless steel and/or composite materials.

Preferred Qualifications

• Previous aerospace or spacecraft manufacturing experience.

• Experience working in a controlled manufacturing or cleanroom environment.

• Familiarity with structural repair and rework processes.

• Working knowledge of aerospace quality standards and documentation requirements.

• Experience supporting new product introduction or prototype builds.

Soft Skills

• Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality.

• Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.

• Strong problem-solving and troubleshooting skills.

• Proven ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams including Engineering, Quality, and Production.

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

• Ability to adapt to changing priorities and production demands.

• Strong organizational and time management skills.

Technology Stack

• Blueprint and engineering drawing interpretation tools.

• Precision measurement equipment including calipers, micrometers, gauges, and torque tools.

• Manufacturing documentation and work instruction systems.

• Standard Microsoft Office applications (Outlook, Excel, Word, Teams).

• Aerospace assembly tooling and equipment.

Physical Requirements

• Ability to stand and walk for extended periods throughout the workday.

• Ability to use hands and fingers to perform repetitive and precision assembly tasks.

• Ability to climb, balance, bend, stoop, kneel, crouch, and reach as required.

• Ability to communicate effectively, including speaking and hearing.

• Ability to work in, on, around, and in proximity to large structures, equipment, and tooling.

• Ability to lift, push, pull, and/or carry up to 40 pounds.

• Ability to work near moving mechanical parts and manufacturing equipment.

• Ability to work in tight or confined spaces as required.

• Ability to work in environments that may include exposure to fumes, airborne particles, composites, carbon fiber materials, adhesives, and other manufacturing-related substances.

• Ability to wear required personal protective equipment (PPE).

Additional Information

If you are open to relocating to Midland, this can be a career-changing opportunity to join the high-tech aerospace industry while leveraging your manufacturing and mechanical experience. AST SpaceMobile offers the opportunity to develop advanced technical skills within a growing and innovative environment.
