jobs.title: Nurse Practitioner or Physician Assistant (Oakland Uptown) - Sign-On Bonus Available - 4 days in clinic, 1 day remote
jobs.description:
About Us

One Medical is a primary care solution challenging the industry status quo by making quality care more affordable, accessible and enjoyable. But this isn’t your average doctor’s office. We’re on a mission to transform healthcare, which means improving the experience for everyone involved - from patients and providers to employers and health networks. Our seamless in-office and 24/7 virtual care services, on-site labs, and programs for preventive care, chronic care management, common illnesses and mental health concerns have been delighting people for the past fifteen years.

In February 2023 we marked a milestone when One Medical joined Amazon. Together, we look to deliver exceptional health care to more consumers, employers, care team members, and health networks to achieve better health outcomes. As we continue to grow and seek to impact more lives, we’re building a diverse, driven and empathetic team, while working hard to cultivate an environment where everyone can thrive.

Employment type:

• Full time

What you’ll be working on:

• Managing a patient panel with a broad array of patient needs; conducting a mix of acute, chronic, and well visits

• Treating patients in-office or in testing centers as well as conducting occasional tele-health visits

• Continuous learning during weekly Clinical Rounds and through other modalities

• Ongoing collaboration with in-office teammates via daily huddles, as well as with virtual clinical teams

• Utilization of your specific clinical training and opportunities to perform in-office procedures

• Willing to obtain additional state licensure and credentialing for One Medical virtual primary care in additional states

Education, licenses, and experiences required for this role:

• Completed an accredited NP or PA program with a national certification

• In the past 5 years, practiced as an Advanced Practitioner for at least:

• 2 years in an outpatient primary care setting, OR 1 year in an outpatient primary care setting, coupled with either a 1 year primary care fellowship or 1+ year in an urgent care setting

• State licensed in California, obtained by your One Medical start date

One Medical providers also demonstrate:

• A passion for human-centered primary care

• The ability to successfully communicate with and provide care to individuals of all backgrounds

• The ability to effectively use technology to deliver high quality care

• Clinical proficiency in evidence-based primary care

• The desire to be an integral part of a team dedicated to changing healthcare delivery

• An openness to feedback and reflection to gain productive insight into strengths and weaknesses

• The ability to confidently navigate uncertain situations with both patients and colleagues

• Readiness to adapt personal and interpersonal behavior to meet the needs of our patients

This is a full- time role based in Oakland, CA.

One Medical is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices.

The base salary range for this role is $164,700 to $196,900 based on a full-time schedule. Final determination of starting pay may vary based on factors such as practice experience and patient care schedule. Additional pay may be determined for those candidates that exceed these specified qualifications and requirements. For more information, visit https://www.onemedical.com/careers/

Relocation assistance may be available for this role.

One Medical offers a robust benefits package designed to aid your health and wellness.  All regular team members working 24+ hours per week and their dependents are eligible for benefits starting on the team member's date of hire:

Taking care of you today

• Paid sabbatical for every five years of service

• Free One Medical memberships for yourself, your friends and family

• Employee Assistance Program - Free confidential services for team members who need help with stress, anxiety, financial planning, and legal issues

• Competitive Medical, Dental and Vision plans

• Pre-Tax commuter benefits

• PTO cash outs - Option to cash out up to 40 accrued hours per year

Protecting your future for you and your family

• 401K match

• Credit towards emergency childcare

• Company paid maternity and paternity leave

• Paid Life Insurance - One Medical pays 100% of the cost of Basic Life Insurance

• Disability insurance - One Medical pays 100% of the cost of Short Term and Long Term Disability Insurance

In addition to the comprehensive benefits package outlined above, practicing clinicians also receive

• Malpractice Insurance - Malpractice fees to insure your practice at One Medical is covered 100%.

• UpToDate Subscription - An evidence-based clinical research tool

• Continuing Medical Education (CME) - Receive an annual stipend for continuing medical education

• Rounds - Providers end patient care one hour early each week to participate in this shared learning experience

• Discounted rate to attend One Medical’s Annual REAL primary care conference

One Medical is an equal opportunity employer, and we encourage qualified applicants of every background, ability, and life experience to contact us about appropriate employment opportunities.

One Medical participates in E-Verify and will provide the federal government with your Form I-9 information to confirm that you are authorized to work in the U.S.  Please refer to the E-Verification Poster and Right to Work Poster for additional information.

Your work schedule could be subject to change based on business direction at any time.

jobs.title: Senior Field Service Engineer
jobs.description:
Quantum-Si is seeking a highly skilled and motivated Senior Field Service Engineer to play a critical role in scaling our global service organization. This individual will combine hands-on field support with the development of service processes, infrastructure, and best practices to support a growing installed base of advanced life science instrumentation. The ideal candidate is both technically strong and operationally minded, capable of resolving complex issues in the field while helping build the foundation for a world-class service organization.

Key Responsibilities:

Field Service Execution

• Install, maintain, troubleshoot, and repair advanced life science instrumentation in customer laboratories

• Perform preventative maintenance, calibrations, upgrades, and system validations

• Support instrument relocations and ensure systems meet operational specifications

Customer Support and Escalation Management

• Diagnose and resolve complex hardware, software, and system integration issues

• Serve as a technical escalation point for critical customer issues

• Collaborate with internal engineering and support teams to drive rapid resolution

Service Infrastructure Development

• Develop and refine service procedures, manuals, and troubleshooting protocols

• Partner with product management and commercial leadership to define service contract offerings

• Help establish global service models including training programs, parts strategies, and depot operations

• Contribute to the development of service documentation including IFUs,manuals,knowledge base articles, FAQs and training videos

Cross-Functional Collaboration

• Partner with R&D to identify failure trends and drive product improvements

• Support Sales and Field Applications teams with pre- and post-sales activities

• Provide feedback from the field to inform product design, usability, and reliability

Operational Excellence

• Document all service activities in CRM or case management systems

• Track and report key service metrics including uptime, response time, and resolution performance

• Manage multiple service cases and projects simultaneously

• Deliver a high level of customer satisfaction as measured by service feedback and retention

Connectivity and IT Integration

• Support instrument connectivity in customer environments including secure networks

• Enable remote diagnostics and cloud-based system integration

• Work with customer IT teams to ensure compliance with security and data requirements

Qualifications:

• Bachelor's degree in engineering, Physics, or a related technical field

• 5+ years of field service experience supporting capital equipment in biotech, diagnostics, life sciences, medical device or equivalent industry

• Strong experience with fluidics and optical instrumentation systems

• Experience connecting instruments to enterprise or cloud-based networks in secure environments

• Proficiency with CRM or service management systems such as Salesforce

• Excellent troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving skills

• Strong communication and interpersonal skills with a customer-first mindset

• Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively across teams

• Valid driver’s license and ability to obtain a passport for international travelas required

Leadership Expectations

• Serve as a technical expert and leader within the field service organization

• Mentor and support the development of junior field service engineers

• Drive continuous improvement in service operations and customer experience

Work Conditions

• This position is based in San Diego, California with significant field travel

• Travel requirement of up to 70 percent, including overnight and international travel

• Ability to lift up to 50 pounds and work in laboratory environments

• Exposure to biological samples and hazardous materials may be required

Compensation and Benefits

The estimated base salary range for this role in the United States of America is: $135,000 – $155,000.

Compensation decisions are dependent on several factors including, but not limited to, level of the position, an individual’s skills, knowledge and abilities, location where the role is to be performed, internal equity, and alignment with market data. Additionally, all full-time employees are eligible for our discretionary bonus program and equity as part of the compensation package.

Equal Opportunity Statement

Quantum-Si is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, veteran status, or other protected characteristics.

Quantum-Si does not accept agency resumes.

Mercor's mission is to organize human intelligence to power the AI economy. We're a leading AI data company, building the layer between human expertise and frontier models. Mercor Enterprise brings this same infrastructure to Fortune 500 companies: helping companies capture how their best people actually work, translating that expertise directly back into agents.

 

Mercor is creating a new category of work where expertise powers AI advancement. Achieving this requires an ambitious, fast-paced and deeply committed team. You’ll work alongside researchers, operators, and AI companies at the forefront of shaping the systems that are redefining society. Mercor is a profitable Series C company valued at $10 billion. We work in-person five days a week in our San Francisco, NYC, or London offices.


ABOUT THE ROLE

As a Research Engineer at Mercor, you’ll work at the intersection of engineering and applied AI research. You’ll contribute directly to post-training and RLVR, synthetic data generation, and large-scale evaluation workflows that meaningfully impact frontier language models.

Your work will be used to train large language models to master tool use, agentic behavior, and real-world reasoning in real-world production environments. You’ll shape rewards, run post-training experiments, and build scalable systems that improve model performance. You’ll help design and evaluate datasets, create scalable data augmentation pipelines, and build rubrics and evaluators that push the boundaries of what LLMs can learn.


WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Work on post-training and RLVR pipelines to understand how datasets, rewards, and training strategies impact model performance.

 - Design and run reward-shaping experiments and algorithmic improvements (e.g., GRPO, DAPO) to improve LLM tool-use, agentic behavior, and real-world reasoning.

 - Quantify data usability, quality, and performance uplift on key benchmarks.

 - Build and maintain data generation and augmentation pipelines that scale with training needs.

 - Create and refine rubrics, evaluators, and scoring frameworks that guide training and evaluation decisions.

 - Build and operate LLM evaluation systems, benchmarks, and metrics at scale.

 - Collaborate closely with AI researchers, applied AI teams, and experts producing training data.

 - Operate in a fast-paced, experimental research environment with rapid iteration cycles and high ownership.


WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

 - Strong applied research background, with a focus on post-training and/or model evaluation.

 - Strong coding proficiency and hands-on experience working with machine learning models.

 - Strong understanding of data structures, algorithms, backend systems, and core engineering fundamentals.

 - Familiarity with APIs, SQL/NoSQL databases, and cloud platforms.

 - Ability to reason deeply about model behavior, experimental results, and data quality.

 - Excitement to work in person in San Francisco, five days a week (with optional remote Saturdays), and thrive in a high-intensity, high-ownership environment.


NICE TO HAVE

 - Real-world post-training team experience in industry (highest priority).

 - Publications at top-tier conferences (NeurIPS, ICML, ACL).

 - Experience training models or evaluating model performance.

 - Experience in synthetic data generation, LLM evaluations, or RL-style workflows.

 - Work samples, artifacts, or code repositories demonstrating relevant skills.


BENEFITS

 - Health Benefits eligible at 30+ hours a week

 -  Overtime eligible at 1.5x from 40 to 55 hours; 2x over 55 hours-week. 

 - $1.5K monthly stipend for meals

 - Relocation & Housing Support

 - Free Equinox membership

 - $200 monthly laundry reimbursement

 - $200 monthly personal wellness reimbursement

jobs.title: Guest Service Manager
jobs.description:
The Guest Service Manager is responsible for the overall leadership, operational excellence, and strategic direction of the Guest Services department at Auberge du Soleil. Reporting directly to the Director of Rooms, this position oversees Front Office, Concierge, Bell, Valet, and Assistant Guest Service Managers, ensuring a seamless, personalized, and memorable experience throughout every stage of the guest journey.

As a key leader within the Rooms Division, the Guest Service Manager embodies the spirit of Auberge du Soleil through genuine hospitality, thoughtful attention to detail, and an unwavering commitment to service excellence. This individual is responsible for cultivating a high-performing, engaged team that consistently delivers intuitive and anticipatory service aligned with Forbes Five-Star standards, Auberge Collection’s Promises & Practices, and the property’s distinguished luxury positioning.

The ideal candidate is a polished, emotionally intelligent, and hands-on hospitality leader who combines exceptional guest relations with strong operational discipline, financial acumen, and a passion for developing others.

Key Responsibilities

Leadership & Team Development

• Provide direct leadership, guidance, and accountability for all Guest Services operations, including Assistant Guest Service Managers, Guest Service Agents, Concierge, Bell, and Valet.
• Lead, coach, mentor, and develop Assistant Guest Service Managers, empowering them to independently manage daily operations, resolve guest concerns, and maintain service standards.
• Foster a positive, inclusive, and collaborative work environment rooted in mutual respect, accountability, recognition, and genuine care.
• Partner with Talent & Culture in recruitment, onboarding, training, performance management, and succession planning.
• Establish clear performance expectations, conduct regular coaching conversations, and complete timely performance evaluations.
• Identify opportunities for professional growth and create individualized development plans for emerging leaders.
• Conduct departmental meetings, pre-shift briefings, and ongoing service training to reinforce expectations and communicate priorities.
• Model Auberge Collection’s Promises & Practices and consistently demonstrate the behaviors expected of a luxury hospitality leader.
• Promote strong communication, teamwork, and collaboration across all shifts and operational functions.

Guest Experience & Service Excellence

• Champion an exceptional guest experience from pre-arrival planning through arrival, in-house engagement, departure, and post-stay follow-up.
• Ensure each guest interaction reflects genuine warmth, personalized recognition, discretion, and anticipatory service.
• Oversee the coordination of VIP arrivals, repeat guests, special occasions, and guests requiring additional attention.
• Maintain accurate and detailed guest profiles, including preferences, special requests, and service history, to enhance personalization and encourage repeat visitation.
• Serve as a visible and accessible leader, proactively engaging with guests and anticipating opportunities to elevate their experience.
• Personally address escalated guest concerns and service recovery situations with empathy, sound judgment, professionalism, and timely resolution.
• Monitor guest feedback, satisfaction scores, online reviews, and service recovery trends to identify opportunities for continuous improvement.
• Ensure the consistent execution of Forbes Five-Star service standards, internal quality expectations, and established departmental procedures.
• Collaborate with Concierge, Spa, Food & Beverage, Housekeeping, and other departments to create thoughtful, seamless, and memorable guest experiences.
• Cultivate relationships with repeat guests, travel partners, and local businesses to enhance the property’s reputation and guest loyalty.

Front Office & Operational Excellence

• Direct and oversee daily Front Office operations, including guest arrivals and departures, registration, room assignments, cashiering, billing, and guest communications.
• Ensure efficient and accurate execution of all front desk procedures, including reservations verification, payment processing, room inventory management, and guest account reconciliation.
• Review daily arrivals, departures, occupancy forecasts, VIP reports, and special requests to ensure operational readiness.
• Partner with Reservations and Revenue Management to optimize room assignments, upgrades, inventory availability, and revenue opportunities.
• Oversee the daily activities of Bell and Valet operations, ensuring timely luggage handling, vehicle coordination, guest transportation, and exceptional arrival and departure experiences.
• Ensure Concierge services provide knowledgeable, creative, and highly personalized recommendations, reservations, and arrangements reflective of the Napa Valley destination.
• Maintain consistent service standards, operational procedures, and communication protocols across all Guest Services functions.
• Ensure the accuracy, integrity, and confidentiality of guest information and financial transactions.
• Conduct regular inspections of guest-facing areas, including the arrival experience, reception, lobby, and associated service areas.
• Maintain appropriate staffing, supplies, equipment, and resources to support efficient operations.
• Serve as Manager on Duty when assigned, providing leadership and decision-making support for property-wide operational matters.
• Maintain readiness to respond effectively to emergencies, safety concerns, guest incidents, and unexpected operational challenges.

Financial Performance & Business Acumen

• Support the Director of Rooms in the preparation, execution, and monitoring of departmental budgets, forecasts, and financial objectives.
• Manage departmental labor expenses through thoughtful scheduling, productivity analysis, and alignment with business demand.
• Monitor payroll, overtime, operating expenses, and departmental purchasing while maintaining service excellence.
• Identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency without compromising the luxury guest experience.
• Support room revenue optimization through strategic upgrades, upselling opportunities, and collaboration with Reservations and Revenue Management.
• Ensure compliance with established cash-handling, credit, billing, and financial control procedures.
• Review operational reports and key performance indicators to identify trends, address challenges, and recommend improvements.
• Demonstrate sound business judgment when balancing guest satisfaction, team member engagement, and financial performance.

Cross-Departmental Collaboration & Communication

• Partner closely with the Director of Rooms to align departmental objectives with the property’s broader operational and strategic priorities.
• Maintain strong working relationships with Housekeeping to ensure room readiness, accurate room status communication, and seamless guest arrivals.
• Collaborate with Engineering to coordinate room maintenance, service requests, and the timely resolution of guest-impacting issues.
• Partner with Food & Beverage, Spa, Events, and Concierge to coordinate personalized experiences, special occasions, and complex guest itineraries.
• Work closely with Sales, Events, and Reservations to ensure accurate communication regarding group arrivals, special accommodations, and guest expectations.
• Ensure comprehensive shift handovers and effective communication of outstanding guest requests, operational concerns, and follow-up items.
• Represent the Guest Services department in leadership meetings, operational discussions, and property initiatives as assigned.

Systems, Technology & Continuous Improvement

• Maintain strong working knowledge of property management systems, guest service platforms, and operational technology utilized throughout the Rooms Division.
• Ensure accurate use of systems for reservations, guest profiles, room assignments, service requests, billing, reporting, and operational communication.
• Monitor departmental adherence to established data-entry standards and guest information management procedures.
• Identify opportunities to leverage technology to improve efficiency, communication, guest personalization, and service delivery.
• Train and support team members in the effective use of property systems and evolving operational processes.
• Evaluate existing workflows, standard operating procedures, and service practices, recommending enhancements that improve consistency and overall performance.

The starting salary for this position is $85,000-$90,000. This is the salary for this position that Auberge du Soleil reasonably expects to pay. Decisions regarding individual pay will be based on a number of factors, such as experience and education.

• Minimum of 3–5 years of progressive experience in ultra-luxury hotel or resort operations, including at least 3 years in a management capacity.

• Experience within a Forbes Five-Star, AAA Five Diamond, or comparable ultra-luxury hospitality environment highly desirable.
• Exceptional leadership, interpersonal communication, and relationship-building skills.
• High emotional intelligence, sound judgment, and the ability to remain composed under pressure.
• Demonstrated ability to coach, inspire, and hold team members accountable while maintaining a supportive work environment.
• Strong organizational skills with the ability to prioritize competing operational demands.
• Excellent problem-solving skills and a proactive, solutions-oriented approach.
• Financial literacy, including experience with departmental budgets, labor management, productivity, and operational reporting.
• Exceptional attention to detail and commitment to maintaining elevated service standards.
• Strong written and verbal communication skills.

jobs.title: Technical Program Manager, Satellite
jobs.description:
Xona is the navigational intelligence company bringing real-time, centimeter-level certainty to any device, anywhere on Earth.



With Pulsar – the world’s most advanced PNT satellite infrastructure in Low Earth Orbit – Xona will offer a future-proof, backwards-compatible global positioning system optimized for absolute precision, superior power, and robust protection.



Role Overview

As Technical Program Manager, Satellite, you’ll support the execution of our satellite program across bus and payload, working closely with our program lead and engineering teams to keep a complex, fast-moving hardware program on track. You’ll own key program management workstreams, drive coordination across teams, and build deep familiarity with the hardware and development lifecycle.



You’ll have meaningful ownership, proximity to the hardware, and the opportunity to contribute to how program management operates as Xona scales. If you want to work closely with engineering teams, help drive a complex hardware program forward, and contribute to something genuinely new in space, this role is for you!



Responsibilities

 - Satellite Schedule Management: Maintain and drive the satellite development schedule across bus subsystems (power, GNC, structure) and payload (electrical, antennas, RF). Track progress against milestones, manage dependencies and critical-path items, and flag schedule risks early.

 - Cross-Functional Coordination: Coordinate across avionics, RF/payload, ground software, and production teams -- translating technical progress into shared plans, clear accountability, and actionable next steps.

 - Supplier & Partner Coordination: Work alongside the Supply Chain team and technical leads to track bus-vendor and payload-supplier deliverables, follow up on open items, and help keep external commitments synchronized with internal milestones.

 - Risk & Issue Resolution: Maintain the risk register and issue tracker, surface risks early, and work directly with technical leads to resolve blockers before they affect the schedule. Escalate material issues to the program lead with context, impact, and a recommended path forward.

 - Program Reporting: Prepare and deliver regular satellite program-status updates to leadership, maintaining a clear and accurate picture of schedule health, milestone progress, open risks, action items, and upcoming decisions.

 - Meeting & Action Management: Organize and facilitate program working sessions and cross-functional meetings; capture decisions and action items; and drive follow-through to closure.

 - Process Improvement: Help develop and improve lightweight, effective program-management processes suited to a small team moving quickly. Contribute ideas and practical improvements as the company scales.





Required Qualifications

 - 3–5 years of experience in technical program management, project management, systems engineering, engineering operations, or a related role supporting complex hardware and/or software development.

 - Experience supporting a technical development program involving hardware, embedded software, systems integration, testing, manufacturing, and/or external suppliers.

 - Strong systems-thinking and organizational skills, with the ability to track interdependencies across mechanical, electrical, software, and integration workstreams while maintaining focus on the critical path.

 - Demonstrated ability to build and maintain schedules, track risks and action items, and communicate program health clearly.

 - Proactive and self-directed: you identify gaps, keep work moving, and know when to seek input or escalate.

 - Clear communicator who can work credibly with engineers and summarize status cleanly for leadership.

 - Comfortable operating in a fast-paced, evolving environment with lightweight processes and shifting priorities.





Preferred Qualifications

 - Experience supporting a satellite, spacecraft, launch-vehicle, aerospace, defense, robotics, telecommunications, or similarly complex hardware program.

 - Familiarity with satellite bus subsystems, RF communications, GNSS, PNT systems, navigation payloads, or mission operations.

 - Exposure to the hardware development lifecycle, including design reviews such as PDR/CDR, integration, test, manufacturing, and launch or operational readiness.

 - Experience coordinating deliverables with suppliers, vendors, or technical partners.

 - Proficiency with scheduling tools such as Wrike, MS Project, Smartsheet, Jira, or similar.

 - PMP, CAPM, Agile, or other PM certifications are nice to have, but not a substitute for practical program execution experience.





For U.S. Roles: To comply with U.S. Government space technology export regulations, applicant must be a U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident of the United States (i.e. Green Card holder), or other protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3). 



For U.K. Roles: To comply with U.K. regulations, this role requires Baseline Personnel Security Standard (BPSS) checks, and successful candidates must be eligible to obtain UK Security Clearance (SC).



For Canada Roles: Successful candidates must obtain and hold a security clearance at the reliability status level, and pass security assessment for the Canadian Controlled Goods Program (CGP) and ITAR. 



We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status.

jobs.title: Managing Editor, Stripe Press
jobs.description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

Stripe Press publishes ideas for progress in technology, science, and economics because we believe that for many of the most significant breakthroughs in each of these categories, the key ingredient is ideas. The Stripe Press team is effectively a startup within Stripe; we have an unusual amount of autonomy and the trust of Stripe’s leadership team.

Our bar for publishing is high, and our list is small—by design. We’d rather publish fewer books than publish books we’re not passionate about and that we don’t think will challenge and galvanize our audience, which is global, fiercely curious, and shares our exacting standards.

What you’ll do

Stripe Press is seeking a Managing Editor to own the editorial development and execution of its publishing program. You will guide intellectually ambitious nonfiction from acquisition through final proofs and production-ready handoff, upholding Press’s standards for rigor, clarity, accuracy, and editorial distinction.

This role calls for exceptional editorial judgment and project management skills. You will work closely with Stripe Press’s editors, production manager, designers, authors, agents, and external specialists. You will also help build the systems and contributor network needed to support a growing list without compromising quality.

Responsibilities

• Own the editorial path of every Stripe Press book from acquisition through final proofs and handoff to production.

• Establish and manage editorial schedules spanning manuscript delivery, editorial review, revision, copyediting, fact-checking, permissions, indexing, proofreading, and final approval.

• Evaluate manuscripts for structure, argument, clarity, pacing, voice, evidence, and accessibility, ensuring that complex ideas remain accurate and intellectually substantive.

• Establish clear expectations with authors and provide candid, actionable guidance throughout development. Provide direct developmental or line-editing support when a project requires senior intervention.

• Determine the appropriate editorial and verification process for each book, including when to commission technical, legal, or other specialist review.

• Build, commission, and supervise a trusted network of developmental editors, line editors, copyeditors, fact-checkers, proofreaders, indexers, typesetters, and specialist reviewers.

• Give final editorial approval before manuscripts enter production, and remain responsible for editorial decisions and author review through the proof stages.

• Maintain the Stripe Press house style and create clear, repeatable workflows and handoffs across editorial and production.

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

• You have significant experience managing complex nonfiction books at a trade, academic, journalistic, or ideas-focused publishing organization.

• You demonstrate exceptional editorial judgment across structure, argument, prose, evidence, and authorial voice.

• You are comfortable working with technical, scientific, economic, historical, or otherwise research-intensive nonfiction.

• You have deep knowledge of developmental editing, line editing, copyediting, fact-checking, permissions, proofreading, and editorial-production workflows.

• You are an exceptional project manager, capable of coordinating multiple complex projects and timelines with a high degree of precision.

• You enjoy operating in a small, ambitious organization where systems are still being built, and you share Stripe Press’s appetite for ideas that can improve how people understand and shape the world.

Preferred qualifications

• You have helped launch or materially scale a publishing program, list, or imprint.

• You have developed editorial standards, tools, or workflows that improved quality and execution in a growing organization.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Operations Development
jobs.description:
About Carvana

At Carvana, we sell cars but we aren’t car salesmen.  Our promise is simple: we won’t sell a car to a customer that we wouldn’t sell to our own Mom. Period. To make sure our cars are in first-rate condition,  we’ve built multiple vehicle Reconditioning Centers around the country, where our cars are inspected, perfected, and photographed before reaching the Carvana website. Using our Carvana Certified 150-point inspection process, we’re able to verify that every vehicle meets our rigorous mechanical and cosmetic standards.

We strive to provide only the highest quality vehicles to our customers in our mission to deliver a no-hassle, better car buying experience. We are actively looking for passionate and talented individuals who can help us deliver on that promise.

Think you’ve got what it takes to join our team? Keep reading below to see what we’re looking for!

About the team and position

jobs.title: Expanded Care Family Nurse Practitioner or Physician Assistant (All Ages) (Sign-on Bonus Available)
jobs.description:
About Us

One Medical is a primary care solution challenging the industry status quo by making quality care more affordable, accessible and enjoyable. But this isn’t your average doctor’s office. We’re on a mission to transform healthcare, which means improving the experience for everyone involved - from patients and providers to employers and health networks. Our seamless in-office and 24/7 virtual care services, on-site labs, and programs for preventive care, chronic care management, common illnesses and mental health concerns have been delighting people for the past fifteen years.

• Work flexible hours, including evenings (after 5 p.m.) and weekends, as our clinics operate 7 days a week from 8 a.m. to 9 p.m. 365 days per year

• At least one year of experience caring for pediatric patients including newborns

• The ability to work a flexible schedule including weekends and evenings

• The ability to work at least 3 major holidays a year

• The ability to work two full weekends per month (4 shifts)

Taking care of you today

• Employee Assistance Program - Free confidential services for team members who need help with stress, anxiety, financial planning, and legal issues

• Credit towards emergency childcare

jobs.title: Senior Accountant, Revenue
jobs.description:
UTA seeks a Senior Accountant to join the Revenue Accounting team. In this role you will be responsible for ensuring accurate and timely revenue recognition and general accounting in accordance with U.S. GAAP across our Sports and Advisory subsidiary businesses. The ideal candidate is a motivated, detail-oriented accountant, who excels at a fast-paced, high-volume desk. This position is based in Beverly Hills, California.

The salary range for this role is $95,000 to $105,000, commensurate with experience and skills.



What You Will Do



 - Own certain aspects for KLUTCH Sports Group (“KLUTCH”) and Advisory, including revenue recognition under ASC 606, accruals, deferred revenue, and related journal entries with complete supporting documentation and schedules

 - Evaluate and document accounting conclusions for new/amended or non-standard contracts; consult with the Corporate Technical Accounting Group, where necessary

 - Ensure compliance with revenue accounting policies and ensure consistent application

 - Manage the accounting for client-reimbursable expenses including reconciliations with Client Accounting teams and gross vs. net presentation

 - Record client payment journal entries and reconcile the client ledger for KLUTCH

 - Reconcile monthly balance sheet accounts and resolve reconciling items promptly

 - Analyze monthly balance sheet and income statement fluctuations and explain key drivers

 - Support the annual financial statement audit, including preparing schedules and responding to auditor requests

 - Identify opportunities to improve and document revenue processes and controls

 - Participate in system implementations and automation initiatives impacting revenue processes

 - Prepare ad hoc reports and analysis, as requested

 - Assist with M&A integration activities and special projects, as needed



What You Will Need



 - 4+ years of progressive accounting experience, revenue accounting experience preferred

 - Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or related field required

 - Big 4 or other national public accounting firm experience preferred

 - CPA or working towards CPA preferred

 - Strong working knowledge of ASC 606 and US GAAP and month-end close processes

 - NetSuite and NetSuite Advanced Revenue Management (“ARM”) experience a plus

 - Advanced Microsoft Excel skills and comfort with large data sets

 - Excellent written and verbal communication and problem-solving skills

 - An analytical mind who works in an organized manner with high attention to detail

 - High-energy level and a strong pro-active work ethic; self-starter with the ability to work independently

 - Demonstrated ability to create processes and procedures while working in a very fast-paced environment



What You Will Get



 - The unique and exciting opportunity to work at one of a leading global entertainment companies

 - Access to the tools, leadership, and resources you will need to create and drive a center of excellence

 - The opportunity to do the best work of your career

 - Work in an inclusive and diverse company culture

 - Competitive programs to support your well-being

 - Experience working in a collaborative environment with room to grow



About UTA


UTA is a premier global talent agency built for the future of media and entertainment. The agency's diversified platform and best-in-class, client-first approach is innovative, collaborative, and positioned to lead in an evolving market. UTA represents the most celebrated artists, creatives, and brands, from icons and legends to next-generation talent. Its integrated capabilities span film and television, music, comedy, creators, sports, brands, news, publishing, speakers, theater, and more. It is based in Los Angeles with offices in the U.S., London, and Munich.

For more information: https://www.unitedtalent.com/about/

UTA and its Affiliated Companies are Equal Employment Opportunity employers and welcome all job seekers.

jobs.title: CT Technician Float - Full Time Mid Shift *sign on bonus
jobs.description:
• 8 hour shifts
• Mid Shift (flexible mid morning start time)
• Position will support McHenry, Huntley, and Woodstock Hospitals as well as Crystal Lake outpatient center.
• Position includes a $10 float shift differential.

The  CT Technologist Float I reflects the mission, vision, and values of NM, adheres to the organization’s Code of Ethics and Corporate Compliance Program, and complies with all relevant policies, procedures, guidelines and all other regulatory and accreditation standards.

RESPONSIBILITIES

• Maintains accountability for patient safety throughout the imaging process, including screening, preparation, monitoring, and post-procedure care.
• Produces diagnostic-quality images using approved protocols and professional standards.
• Apply professional judgment within approved protocols to optimize image quality and address imaging challenges.
• Reviews images prior to exam completion and initiates corrective action when diagnostic adequacy is not met.
• Administers contrast in accordance with policy, including screening for contraindications and patient monitoring (as applicable).
• Operates imaging equipment and maintains imaging room readiness.
• Identifies equipment performance issues and initiates follow-up through established service processes.
• Coordinates exam flow and prioritizes time-sensitive studies.
• Maintains accurate and timely documentation in medical record and image archive system, including exam set-up, image routing, result availability and charging accuracy.
• Adheres to organizational values, ethical standards, and compliance requirements.
• Consistently upholds all applicable quality and safety standards within diagnostic imaging, such as radiation safety, MRI safety, Infection prevention measures safe practices (as applicable to the role) to protect self, patients, visitors and team members
• Ensures a positive patient experience throughout care delivery
• Supports department initiatives to improve relationships, reliability, efficiency, growth
• Supports additional responsibilities aligned with patient care and department needs
• Verifies orders and confirms protocol.
• Positions and immobilizes patient on examining table.
• Positions patients and selects anatomic and technical parameters accurately and uses ALARA principles during examinations.
• Assures patient, staff and personal safety by adhering to established standards including positively confirming Right Patient and Right Exam.
• Establishes IV access for contrast administration and related lab draws.
• Administers contrast media oral and/or IV contrast in accordance with department policies and procedures, patient history indicators, exam protocols and physician orders and follows through with post exam instructions.
• Prepares for and assists the physician in computed tomography procedures, including interventional procedures.
• Enters data such as type of scan, slice thickness, scan time and other technical data into computer.
• Communicates with patient before and during procedure; monitors safety, comfort.
• Validates that all required series, images, protocols and reconstructions are complete and meet established image quality standards.
• Assures complete study transfer to PACS for radiologist interpretation.
• Performs CT equipment QA and maintains required logs.
• Performs clerical tasks such as receiving orders, scheduling patients, and recordkeeping.
• Maintains and cleans work area and equipment; replenishes supplies as needed

QUALIFICATIONS

Required:

• Graduate of an accredited Radiology Technologist Program
• American Registry of Radiologic Technologists (ARRT) Computed Toography (CT)
• Illinois Emergency Management Agency (IEMA) Accreditation
• Basic Life Support (BLS)

• 6 months of CT experience

jobs.title: Senior HSE Specialist, Energy Projects
jobs.description:
Overview

Working closely with project teams, clients, contractors, procurement, and senior stakeholders, the successful candidate will identify and communicate HSE risks at an early stage, influence project strategies and budgets, and ensure that appropriate HSE resources and controls are planned and funded. This role will ensure HSE requirements are incorporated into contractual documentation, contractor scopes, procurement packages, and project HSE plans. During delivery, the Project HSE Manager will oversee HSE performance, manage project HSE resources, and ensure that projects are executed in accordance with contractual, client, regulatory, and Ramboll requirements. The position works in close cooperation with the wider Energy HSEQ team and will also contribute to the continued development of HSE capability within the Americas business.

Project Responsibilities

Serve as the Project HSE Manager for major EPC, EPCM, and other project delivery models, providing leadership throughout the full project lifecycle.

Integrate HSE requirements, risks, resources, and cost considerations into project planning, budgeting, and decision-making.

Embed HSE requirements into contracts, procurement packages, contractor scopes, and project execution plans.

Lead hazard identification, risk assessments, JHAs, and risk mitigation activities to proactively manage project risks.

Ensure HSE is incorporated into design reviews, risk workshops, governance processes, and operational decision-making.

Monitor contractor and supplier HSE performance, ensuring compliance and escalating significant risks or deficiencies as needed.

Manage and mentor project HSE teams, including resource planning, technical guidance, and competency development.

Develop HSE performance metrics, dashboards, reporting systems, training programs, and safety initiatives to drive continuous improvement.

Lead audits, inspections, incident investigations, assurance activities, and corrective action programs to ensure compliance and effective close-out.

Act as the primary HSE liaison for clients, contractors, regulators, and senior leadership while supporting organizational HSEQ programs, audits, safety culture, and tender development.

Requirements

8+ years of site-based HSE experience on EPC projects, including 5+ years within engineering consultancy environments.

Proven Project HSE Management experience supporting EPC/EPCM projects across multiple phases of delivery.

Expertise in HSE planning, tender support, risk assessment, budgeting, resource planning, and development of project HSE deliverables.

Strong knowledge of contractor management, procurement processes, contract HSE requirements, and HSE performance management through KPIs, audits, and reporting.

jobs.title: Director Production Management
jobs.description:
Sphere Entertainment Co. is a leader in immersive experiences, technology and media. The Company includes Sphere, an experiential medium powered by advanced technologies. The first Sphere opened in Las Vegas, with a second venue planned for Abu Dhabi. In addition, the Company includes MSG Networks, which operates two regional sports and entertainment networks, MSG Network and MSG Sportsnet, as well as a direct-to-consumer and authenticated streaming product, MSG+, delivering a wide range of live sports content and other programming. More information is available at www.sphereentertainmentco.com.

Who are we hiring?

Sphere Studios is looking for a Director, Production Management to join a groundbreaking team based in Burbank. As the content design, production and delivery team for all Sphere projects, Sphere Studios strives to create world-class experiences at an unprecedented scale for the largest and highest-resolution LED screens ever made.

The Director will be overseeing a team that leads projects related to the Exterior display of the Sphere (The Exosphere), the innovative displays in Sphere’s atrium, as well as the 16K Media Plane. The Production Management team is responsible for managing and tracking multiple projects from creative ideation through final delivery. The Director will interface cross-departmentally with Creative, Design, Motion Graphics, Post Production, Visual Effects and Experiential Production teams while also leading many high-profile projects themselves.

Additionally, this role will manage external vendors and/or freelancers that specialize in VFX, Motion Graphics and creative content. They are required to manage all aspects of this workstream including directing coordinators, deftly moving between the daily minutiae while reporting progress to senior management.

Critical to this role is having the innate foresight to identify and address future issues. This position reports to the SVP, Production & Studio Management, and works closely with other key production, creative, technical and executive staff. This role needs to be flexible, and open to taking on additional test/live projects as needed.

What will you do?

• Oversee a team that will provide production management support for Exosphere Ads, Exosphere Art & Promo, Atrium content and Media Plane projects.

• Develop and maintain departmental processes and procedures to ensure operational efficiency and transparent project tracking capabilities.

• Help manage vendor and partner relationships while having an ongoing understanding of their capacity and capabilities

• Work with departmental production and creative staff to ensure project needs are being met, identify interdependencies and track them

• Create project budgets and schedules as needed, oftentimes working with multiple stakeholders

• Schedule cross-departmental meetings with the intention of disseminating critical project information, ending with buyoff of a cohesive, budget-conscious plan

• Communicate and present project updates to senior leadership and key cross-divisional Sphere stakeholders

• Provide exceptional experiences for our guests, partners, and team members, including by adhering to our appearance and presentation guidelines while on-site.

What do you need to succeed?

• College degree preferred or additional production certificate programs.

• Minimum of seven years of experience as a VFX, studio, network or post-production facility Producer

• Familiarity with the creative advertising/design industry, understating basic terminology and practices

• Acute understanding of creative advertising practices and processes

• Familiarity with a broad range of post-production software from content creation and editorial to production management tools

• Working knowledge of scheduling software applications including Airtable and Toggl

• Asset Management software experience a must, working in ShotGrid is a plus

• Comfortable working across multiple departments and roles spanning from entry level to Executive Management

• Excellent skills in collaboration and communication (oral and written). Must be a team player and work well under tight deadlines.

Special Requirements

• Travel to Las Vegas and location shoots as necessary.

• Must be able to work a flexible schedule that will occasionally require weekends, nights and holidays and must be willing to travel to other locations as needed.

jobs.title: Product Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
Do work that matters.

At AlertMedia, everything we do supports our mission: To save lives and minimize loss by identifying active threats globally and facilitating timely communications when an emergency threatens personal safety and business continuity.

Our core values drive us in our important mission of keeping people safe & informed:

• We’re humans, not robots

• Customers always come first

• We work better together

• Simplicity is our strength

• Our reputation is priceless

• Hard work pays off

As one of the fastest-growing software companies in the United States, we’re focused on building the best team to continue accelerating our growth and meeting increasing demand.

AlertMedia is looking for a Product Marketing Manager to drive go-to-market strategy, competitive differentiation, and revenue growth across our product portfolio. This is a high-impact role focused on strengthening the commercial performance of established products, identifying growth opportunities, and turning customer and market insights into effective go-to-market strategies.

You will partner closely with Product, Sales, Customer Success, Demand Generation, and Content teams to sharpen positioning, improve sales effectiveness, and drive product adoption and revenue growth. You will own initiatives from strategy through execution, bringing analytical rigor, creative problem-solving, and a strong sense of accountability to your work.

We're looking for someone who combines strategic thinking with a bias for action, takes initiative, challenges assumptions, and uses data and emerging technologies, including AI, to deliver meaningful business results.

Who You Are:

You are an analytical, commercially minded product marketer who knows how to connect customer needs, product capabilities, and market opportunities to business growth. You don't just create messaging and launch materials. You understand what drives customers to buy, what helps sales teams win, and how to translate those insights into strategies that improve performance.

You are a proactive problem solver who takes ownership and gets things done. You bring structure to complex projects, ask thoughtful questions, and know how to move initiatives forward across multiple teams. You're comfortable balancing strategic thinking with hands-on execution and take pride in delivering measurable results.

You're naturally curious, resourceful, and eager to experiment with new approaches. You actively explore how AI and emerging technologies can make your work smarter, faster, and more effective. You challenge conventional ways of working and continuously look for opportunities to improve.

Above all, you're a collaborative partner and clear communicator who builds credibility through strong relationships, sound judgment, and consistent follow-through. You take accountability for outcomes, not just deliverables, and contribute to the success of the broader team.

What You Get to Do Every Day:

Product Positioning & Go-to-Market Strategy

• Own positioning, messaging, and go-to-market strategies for assigned products, translating capabilities into compelling customer value and competitive differentiation.

• Evaluate market opportunities, buyer needs, product performance, and commercial data to identify growth opportunities and develop focused GTM plans.

• Partner with Product to inform roadmap priorities, support product launches, and ensure new capabilities are positioned for successful market adoption.

Revenue Growth & Sales Effectiveness

• Analyze pipeline performance, conversion rates, win/loss trends, and customer insights to identify opportunities to improve revenue performance.

• Partner with Sales and Revenue Enablement to develop compelling sales narratives, competitive strategies, enablement tools, and programs that improve sales effectiveness.

• Collaborate with Demand Generation and Content teams to develop targeted campaigns and programs that support acquisition, expansion, and revenue goals.

Customer, Market & Competitive Intelligence

• Develop deep expertise in customer needs, buying behaviors, use cases, and competitive dynamics to inform positioning and go-to-market decisions.

• Engage directly with customers, prospects, and customer-facing teams to uncover insights, validate value propositions, and identify opportunities for growth.

• Translate customer feedback, competitive intelligence, and market trends into actionable recommendations for Product, Sales, and Marketing.

Cross-Functional Execution & Business Impact

• Lead cross-functional go-to-market initiatives, aligning stakeholders, managing priorities, and driving projects from planning through execution.

• Define success metrics, track performance, and continuously optimize strategies to improve product adoption, pipeline, conversion, and revenue impact.

• Communicate insights, recommendations, progress, and results clearly to stakeholders and leadership, connecting marketing activities to business outcomes.

Innovation & AI-Native Ways of Working

• Leverage AI tools to accelerate market research, competitive analysis, messaging development, content creation, and go-to-market execution.

• Experiment with AI-powered workflows and automation to improve productivity, quality, and scalability of product marketing activities.

• Bring a continuous-improvement mindset, sharing new approaches and contributing to more effective ways of working across the team.

What You Bring to The Role:

Required

• 3+ years of B2B product marketing experience, preferably in enterprise SaaS, with demonstrated success developing and executing go-to-market strategies.

• Strong commercial acumen and analytical skills, with experience using CRM data, pipeline reporting, competitive insights, and performance metrics to inform decisions.

• Proven ability to develop compelling product positioning, differentiated messaging, sales enablement, and go-to-market programs that contribute to measurable business outcomes.

• Proactive, entrepreneurial mindset with the ability to independently own projects, navigate ambiguity, solve problems, and drive initiatives through execution.

• Strong cross-functional collaboration and project leadership skills, with the ability to align stakeholders, manage competing priorities, and influence without direct authority.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to simplify complex concepts and present clear, actionable recommendations.

• Hands-on experience using AI tools to improve productivity, accelerate research, develop content, or streamline workflows, with curiosity to continually experiment and learn.

• Resourceful, results-oriented, and comfortable balancing strategic thinking with hands-on execution in a fast-paced environment.

• Must be located in the Austin metro area and comfortable with a hybrid work model.

Preferred

• Experience driving go-to-market growth for established B2B SaaS products, including customer acquisition, expansion, or adoption initiatives.

• Familiarity with Salesforce, Seismic, marketing automation platforms, and product analytics tools.

• Experience in security, emergency management, business continuity, or adjacent enterprise software markets.

• Experience in a growth-stage company where you've helped build scalable processes and repeatable go-to-market motions.

Why This Role Matters:

AlertMedia's continued growth depends on helping customers understand the value of our solutions and making it easier for them to adopt and expand their use of our platform. In this role, you'll connect market insights, product strategy, and commercial execution to drive meaningful business results, helping strengthen our competitive position and accelerate growth across our product portfolio.

Why you’ll love working at AlertMedia:

At AlertMedia, you won’t just build your career — you’ll be part of something meaningful, surrounded by people who genuinely care about the work and each other.

• Competitive base salary + Company-wide bonus program

• Generous and flexible time off and parental leave policies

• Health benefits - Medical, Dental, Vision and Life Insurance are 100% paid for employees!

• 401K with generous company match

• Amazing rewards and incentives – we love celebrating each other!

• Commitment to community service with opportunities to give back

• A Best Places to Work company 10 years in a row and numerous other awards

• Access to new downtown office with 360 views of Austin, high-tech building gym and nearby running trails

• Ongoing career development opportunities through our Learning & Development team

• You'll do meaningful work—while growing your career in a fast-moving, global company with an award-winning culture

About AlertMedia:

We are the leading unified risk intelligence and response platform— trusted by the largest companies in the world to protect their people and assets when it matters most. We are a high-growth, PE-backed SaaS company with more than 4,000 clients scaling rapidly across the globe. Our technology is unmatched with a unified platform, a 7+ year history of AI innovation, a customer NPS of 70+, and a culture that sets us even further apart from our competition.

We are an equal opportunity employer focused on creating a collaborative and exciting place for all to work. Ensuring a diverse, inclusive, and equitable workplace for all people is key to our success and core to our values.  All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

This is an amazing opportunity to be part of our wave of momentum and take our company, and your career, to the next growth stage. We'd love to get to know you better and share how we serve our amazing customers. For more information, please visit www.alertmedia.com.

Come join us in our mission to save lives and minimize loss through effective communication.

By applying for the role, you agree that AlertMedia will use your Personal Information in connection with the recruitment process and in accordance with our Privacy Policy – https://www.alertmedia.com/legal/privacy-policy/

jobs.title: Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
Turn Marketing Strategy Into Measurable Growth

Are you a performance-driven marketing professional who knows how to turn insights into action and campaigns into measurable results? Join the Champions Group team and help drive growth across our West Division, with a primary focus on one of our largest home services brands.

As Marketing Manager, you’ll connect marketing strategy with business performance, partnering with operations leaders, digital teams, and agency partners to increase customer acquisition, generate leads, and strengthen brand growth. This is an opportunity to make a meaningful impact today and to expand your influence across additional brands as our business grows.

What You’ll Do

• Drive Marketing Strategy: Develop and execute integrated, omnichannel marketing plans aligned with business goals, service lines, and customer acquisition targets.

• Optimize Digital Performance: Partner with agencies and digital teams to improve PPC, Local Services Ads (LSA), retargeting, and other digital campaigns.

• Lead Local Marketing: Coordinate campaigns across digital, direct mail, TV, radio, SMS, sponsorships, and community-based initiatives.

• Partner With Operations: Serve as a trusted marketing partner to General Managers and operational leaders, translating business priorities into effective marketing programs.

• Analyze Performance: Monitor campaign results, lead volume, web traffic, and revenue impact. Deliver weekly performance reports that highlight opportunities, risks, and actionable recommendations.

• Manage Budgets: Develop marketing plans and budgets, track spending, and optimize investments to improve results and generate incremental leads.

• Oversee Agency Partnerships: Collaborate with external agencies, vendors, and internal creative and campaign teams to deliver effective, on-brand marketing.

• Champion Continuous Improvement: Leverage advanced Excel capabilities and AI-powered tools to uncover insights, streamline reporting, and improve marketing effectiveness.

What You’ll Bring

• Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, or a related field; an MBA is a plus.

• 5+ years of marketing experience, including developing and executing campaigns that deliver measurable business results.

• Strong digital marketing knowledge, including performance metrics, attribution, lead generation, and campaign optimization.

• Experience with local marketing, budget management, analytics, and agency partnerships.

• Advanced Excel skills, including pivot tables, complex formulas, dashboards, and performance modeling.

• Comfort using AI tools such as ChatGPT or Copilot to improve analysis and reporting.

• Excellent communication, project management, and cross-functional collaboration skills.

• Ability to manage competing priorities in a fast-paced, results-oriented environment.

• A track record of connecting marketing initiatives to lead generation, revenue, or brand growth.

Preferred: Experience in home services, HVAC, plumbing, electrical, retail, or other consumer service industries. Experience supporting multiple locations, brands, or franchise operations is also a plus.

Why Join Us?

• Competitive Rewards: Competitive compensation with bonus potential.

• Comprehensive Benefits: Medical, dental, vision, life, and supplemental benefits.

• Plan for Your Future: 401(k) with company match.

• Work-Life Balance: Paid time off and holidays.

• Make an Impact: Drive measurable results that influence lead generation, revenue, and business growth.

• Grow Your Career: Explore advancement opportunities within a growing, multi-brand organization.

• Collaborate and Innovate: Partner with marketing experts and operational leaders to develop impactful campaigns and strengthen our brands.

If you’re analytical, collaborative, and energized by turning marketing insights into business results, we’d love to hear from you!

Pay Range

$125,000—$140,000 USD

Champions Group is a nationwide leading provider of essential home services specializing in heating, air conditioning and plumbing services. With the mission to maintain long term relationships with its customers, Champions Group is dedicated to delivering timely, high-quality services across a comprehensive suite of HVAC, plumbing and electrical products. Champions Group Holdings includes brands from across the country, including Adeedo!, ASI, Bee's Plumbing, Bell Brothers, Fetch-A-Tech, HELP, Hobaica, Howard Air, JW Plumbing Heating and Air, Lex Cooling, Heating, Plumbing & Electrical, M and M Heating, Cooling, Plumbing & Electrical, McAfee Heating and Air, Moore Home Services, ProSkill Services, Scottsdale Air, Seatown Electric, Plumbing, Heating & Air, Service Champions, Service Wizard, Sierra Air, Swan Plumbing, Heating & Air Conditioning and Timo’s Air Conditioning & Heating.

jobs.title: Head of Detection and Response
jobs.description:
We believe that the way people interact with their finances will drastically improve in the next few years. We’re dedicated to empowering this transformation by building the tools and experiences that thousands of developers use to create their own products. Plaid powers the tools millions of people rely on to live a healthier financial life. We work with thousands of companies like Venmo, SoFi, several of the Fortune 500, and many of the largest banks to make it easy for people to connect their financial accounts to the apps and services they want to use. Plaid’s network covers 12,000 financial institutions across the US, Canada, UK and Europe. Founded in 2013, the company is headquartered in San Francisco with offices in New York, Seattle, Washington D.C., Raleigh, London, and Amsterdam.

We are hiring for a leader for the newly forming Detection and Response team at Plaid. Our mission is to protect Plaid's financial infrastructure by detecting and responding to suspicious activity across the company. We are responsible for the entire lifecycle of detection and response, including detection infrastructure, AI triage and response, investigation tooling, Red Teaming, and Fraud Operations. Security is foundational to the trust thousands of businesses and millions of consumers place in Plaid, and we work directly to reduce risks and enable our business to move faster and safer.

As the Head of Detection and Response, you will be the founding leader responsible for standing up and evaluating Plaid's detection and response team. You will lead a specialized technical team of analysts and engineers, gain deep experience partnering with the CISO and cross-functional engineering leaders, and build critical security infrastructure at scale. This is a unique leadership opportunity to manage a team that encompasses traditional security operations alongside Red Teaming and Fraud Operations, directly impacting Plaid's security posture and long-term stability.

Responsibilities:

 - Form and set up Plaid’s Detection and Response team from scratch, defining its culture and operational standards.

 - Lead the day-to-day operations for incident response and evaluate the overall effectiveness of the detection and response program.

 - Manage and mentor a technical team responsible for detection infrastructure, AI-driven triage, and investigation tooling.

 - Oversee Fraud Operations and Red Team activities to ensure a proactive and comprehensive security posture.

 - Partner with senior leadership (CISO, CTO, COO) to communicate security risks and maturity gains achieved through influence and cross-functional collaboration.

 - Define and track metrics to evaluate and demonstrate the effectiveness of the D&R program

Qualifications:

   - 8-14 years of overall detection and response or security engineering experience.
   
   - Strong technical background in security or detection engineering, with the ability to guide work on SIEMs, EDR, and SOC operations.
   
   - Experience managing a team of security analysts and engineers in an operational, platform, or infrastructure context.
   
   - Ability to build cross-functional relationships and drive security maturity through influence rather than authority.
   
   - High-empathy communication skills with the ability to represent technical work to Staff-level leadership.
   
   - Strong AI-first skillset applicable to security operations.

   - Experience at a fintech or high-technology organization adjacent to payments/finance.
